The other evaluations test current-state inference, task success, or prediction from recorded actions. We propose a 1-step negotiation experiment that separates these questions. The findings describe the audited sample, not the prevalence of this evaluation gap across the field.

</details>


### [245] [SLICE-Mem: Salience-Gated Lightweight Information Curation for Efficient LLM Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33015)
*Xiaobin Chen,Dian Jin,Lin Shu,Defeng Sun,Xiaoming Tao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SLICE-Mem 提出一种轻量级长期记忆框架，用紧凑分类器做显著性引导的记忆准入、用语义依存提取器做谓词中心的信息抽取，在线阶段无需生成式 LLM 调用，从而在保持记忆精度的同时大幅削减 token 消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆使 LLM 智能体能够维持个性化、时间连贯的交互，但记忆的准入、抽取与组织需要反复调用 LLM 推理，带来巨大的成本与延迟；现有生成式记忆方案（如 MemOS）开销过高。

Method: 框架包含两部分：1）显著性引导的准入——用紧凑分类器判断哪些用户轮次值得保留；2）谓词中心的信息抽取——基于语义依存关系将准入轮次转换为简洁记忆条目。在线流水线完全不调用生成式 LLM，跨条目的一致性协调（reconciliation）被推迟到离线 consolidation 阶段。在 Memora 周度子集与 LongMemEval-S 上，使用 8B 与 30B Qwen 骨干进行记忆构建与整合评估。

Result: 在 Qwen3-30B 配置下与生成式记忆基线 MemOS 对比：Memora Weekly 上 FAMA 为 46.60 vs 46.68；LongMemEval-S 上准确率为 56.8% vs 59.3%；同时总 LLM token 消耗分别降低 92.4% 与 99.5%。

Conclusion: SLICE-Mem 能够以远低于生成式方案的 LLM 依赖度保留对长期记忆有用的证据，说明记忆构建中的大部分开销可被非生成式组件替代，而精度损失很小。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to maintain personalized and temporally coherent interactions, but repeated LLM inference for memory admission, extraction, and organization introduces substantial cost and latency. We present SLICE-Mem, a lightweight memory framework that combines salience-guided admission and predicate-centered information extraction. A compact classifier identifies user turns worth retaining, and a semantic-dependency-based extractor converts admitted turns into concise memory entries. This online pipeline requires no generative LLM calls, while cross-entry reconciliation is deferred to an offline consolidation stage. We evaluate SLICE-Mem on the weekly subset of Memora and LongMemEval-S using 8B and 30B Qwen backbones for memory construction and consolidation on both benchmarks. Compared with the generative-memory baseline MemOS under the Qwen3-30B configuration, SLICE-Mem's online pipeline achieves 46.60 versus 46.68 FAMA (Forgetting-Aware Memory Accuracy) on Memora Weekly and 56.8% versus 59.3% accuracy on LongMemEval-S, while reducing total LLM token consumption by 92.4% and 99.5%, respectively. These results demonstrate that SLICE-Mem can preserve useful evidence for long-term memory with substantially less reliance on LLM-based memory construction.

</details>


### [246] [Merge-Based Vocabulary Extension Stalls at the Pre-Tokenizer: An English-Preserving Repair for Nepali, Tested in Continued Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33016)
*Aarjan Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Llama-3/Qwen3 等开源 LLM 的正则预分词器仅接受 Unicode 字母，导致天城文元音符号（组合记号）处被切分，尼泊尔语 token 数为英文的 2.6–5.8 倍；基于 merge 的词表扩展无法突破约 2.2 的溢价下限，作者通过一处正则小改动 + 32k merges 将其降至 1.01。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流开源 LLM（Llama-3、Qwen3 等）使用只承认 Unicode 字母的正则表达式做预分词，天城文元音符号属于 combining marks，会被切分，造成尼泊尔语 token 膨胀（相对英文 2.6–5.8×）。而已发布的十个词表扩展都在 merge-based 方案下逼近该预分词下限（约 2.2），说明仅靠加 merge 无法修复，需要从预分词层面着手。

Method: 1) 分析并量化预分词造成的尼泊尔语 token 溢价，并给出 merge-based 扩展的理论/经验下限（Llama-3、Qwen3 均约 2.2）；2) 对已部署正则做一处小修改，并证明对不含组合记号与天城文字符的文本保持所有 token id 不变；3) 在此基础上加入 32,000 条新 merge 训练词表；4) 在 Llama-3.2-1B 与 Qwen3-0.6B 上做小预算 continued pretraining，比较原始 tokenizer 与标准扩展、正则修复扩展在 held-out 尼泊尔语 bits per byte 与训练步数匹配（约 35% 数据重复）下的表现。

Result: 正则修复 + 32k merges 将尼泊尔语/英文 token 比降至 1.01，相比标准扩展减少约 54% 尼泊尔语 token。在继续预训练中，原始 tokenizer 在所有测试配方下取得最低 held-out 尼泊尔语 bits per byte；将修复方案的训练步数与标准扩展匹配（约 35% 数据重复）后，Qwen 上两者排序反转，Llama 上未反转。

Conclusion: 问题根源在预分词正则而非 merge 数量，一处向后兼容的正则修改即可绕开 2.2 的 token 溢价地板并大幅降低尼泊尔语 token 数；但 token 节省并未在少量继续预训练中转化为更低的 bits per byte，收益与训练步数/数据重复的耦合明显（模型间不一致）。生成阶段的延迟—质量权衡仍待验证。作者开源 tokenizer 与代码。

Abstract: Llama-3, Qwen3 and many other open LLMs pre-tokenize text with a regular expression whose word class admits only Unicode letters. Devanagari vowel signs are combining marks, so this regex splits Nepali words at every vowel sign, and models that use it spend 2.6 to 5.8 times as many tokens on Nepali as on the same English text. Merge-based vocabulary extension cannot join the split pieces: for Llama-3 and Qwen3 no number of new merges brings this premium below about 2.2, and ten released extensions already end within 4% of this pre-token floor. We give a small edit to the deployed regex that provably keeps every token id of text without combining marks or Devanagari characters. With 32,000 new merges it brings Nepali to 1.01 times English, about 54% fewer Nepali tokens than standard extension. In small-budget continued pretraining of Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen3-0.6B, the original tokenizer gave the lowest held-out Nepali bits per byte under every recipe we tested. Matching the repair's training steps to standard extension, with about 35% of the data repeated, reversed their order on Qwen but not on Llama. Whether the token savings give a favourable latency and quality trade-off in generation remains untested. We release the tokenizers and code.

</details>


### [247] [AdaptTok-Indic: Script-Aware Adaptive Tokenization for Indic Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33017)
*Binayak Mukherjeea,Moitreya Nandi,Arindam Panja*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 AdaptTok-Indic：面向印度语系的自适应分词扩展，结合 Unicode 归一化预处理、显式连写（conjunct）处理、文字系统感知路由与字节级边界预测，在孟加拉语/印地语等上显著降低 token 生育率并保持下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以英语为主语料训练的多语言分词器会对印度语系过度切分，导致 token 序列变长、跨文字系统的分词差异（disparity）增大。

Method: AdaptTok-Indic = 自适应分词的印度语系专用扩展：Unicode 归一化预处理 + 显式 Indic conjunct 处理 + script-aware 路由 + 学习式字节级边界预测（与小型 Transformer 语言模型联合训练）。

Result: 孟加拉语/印地语为主评测，另测古吉拉特语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语。5 个随机种子下平均 fertility：孟加拉语 1.432、印地语 1.388；SentencePiece BPE 分别为 2.156、2.085。下游均分 57.69 vs 50.82（SentencePiece BPE）。独立复现验证趋势一致。

Conclusion: 印度语系专用自适应切分可降低分词差异并保持有竞争力的下游表现；但当前为小规模原型，存在已记录的简化，未做显著性检验、未与官方发布版 MAGNET 对比、未做语码混合评测。

Abstract: Multilingual tokenizers trained on English-dominated corpora often over-segment Indic languages, resulting in longer token sequences and increased tokenization disparity across scripts. We present AdaptTok-Indic, an Indic-specialized extension of adaptive tokenization that combines Unicode-normalized preprocessing with explicit Indic conjunct handling, script-aware routing, and learned byte-level boundary prediction jointly trained with a small Transformer language model. Evaluated on Bengali and Hindi, with additional evaluation on Gujarati, Tamil, and Telugu, AdaptTok-Indic achieves lower token fertility than SentencePiece BPE, an Indic-oriented tokenizer baseline, and an independently implemented MAGNET-style baseline. Across five recorded seeds, mean fertility is 1.432 for Bengali and 1.388 for Hindi, compared with 2.156 and 2.085 for SentencePiece BPE. Recorded downstream scores average 57.69 on evaluated Indic settings versus 50.82 for the SentencePiece BPE configuration. Independent verification runs using the released prototype confirm the same directional trends. The current implementation is a small-scale prototype with documented simplifications, and no statistical significance testing, released-MAGNET comparison, or code-mixed evaluation is performed. These results suggest that Indic-specialized adaptive segmentation can reduce tokenization disparity while maintaining competitive downstream performance.

</details>


### [248] [SUDO: From Scientific Publications to Global Scholarly Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33018)
*Nipun D. Pathirage,Henrique Santos,Deborah L. McGuinness*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出学术上层话语本体 SUDO，用语言学原则自底向上构建每篇论文可溯源、连贯的学术话语表示，并在多种知识建模用例及 LLM 科学问答任务上验证其能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学术知识图谱普遍预先指定知识单元（命名实体或贡献级陈述），仅保留该单元可表达的内容，导致概念中心与陈述中心两种范式各自只反映抽取目标，而非论文如何构建与传达知识。

Method: 定义 SUDO（Scholarly Upper Discourse Ontology），基于可跨领域跨任务泛化的语言学原则，规定知识要素如何组织并相互关联以构成论文的研究叙事；据此从文本自底向上构建每篇论文连贯、源依据的话语表示，并通过统一结构将多篇论文的研究叙事连接为全局学术话语，同时保留局部语境与出处。

Result: 在完整的学术知识建模用例套件中展示了 SUDO 的能力，并在下游基于 LLM 的科学问答任务上取得性能提升。

Conclusion: 以话语为中心、自底向上且可溯源的本体化表示可统一概念与陈述两种范式，兼顾局部语境与全局连通性，为学术知识图谱构建及 LLM 科学问答提供有效基础。

Abstract: Scholarly Knowledge Graphs (SKGs) support literature search, scientific discovery, and agent-assisted research. Yet, most approaches to SKG construction pre-specify the knowledge unit to be represented, typically named scholarly entities or contribution-level statements, and retain only the publication content expressible through that unit. This choice produces two dominant yet distinct paradigms: concept-centric SKGs that preserve entities and local relations, and statement-centric SKGs that capture high-level discourse in sentences. In both cases, the graph reflects a chosen extraction target rather than how a paper constructs and communicates knowledge. We introduce SUDO, the Scholarly Upper Discourse Ontology, which defines how knowledge elements are organized and related to form a paper's research narrative, namely its scholarly discourse. Using linguistic principles that generalize across fields and tasks, SUDO enables each publication's scholarly discourse to be constructed from the bottom up as a coherent, source-grounded representation. Applied consistently across papers, the same structure connects their research narratives into a global scholarly discourse without discarding local context or provenance. We demonstrate SUDO's capabilities across a comprehensive suite of scholarly knowledge-modeling use cases and performance improvements on a downstream Large Language Model (LLM)-based scientific QA task.

</details>


### [249] [Mine or Yours? Mind-Bridged Language Models Take Each Other's Memories as Their Own](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33020)
*Yunlong Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用两个共享同一语言模型的副本构建"脑-脑直连"的功能模型（接收方额外读取伙伴的内部记忆），发现接收方会把他人的指派规则和码词当作"自己的"（双倍权重下达97%），且这种所有权归属与内容可辨识度、归因方式无关，仅靠切断连接才恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受"脑与脑直连后能否区分哪些想法属于自己"这一思想实验启发，探讨当模型之间交换内部状态（而非外部文本消息）时，接收方是否会错误地将对方的内容判定为"我的"。

Method: 构建功能性"脑桥"：取同一语言模型的两个副本，各自持有私有规则与码词；接收方通过注意力读取伙伴的内部记忆。操纵伙伴记忆的权重（双倍、等权）、加入匹配访问增益的引导向量（steering vector）、注入以伙伴名义的文本消息、把伙伴名字写入记忆，以及切断连接，比较接收方的回答与自我报告。

Result: 伙伴记忆权重加倍时，接收方在97%的回答中把伙伴的规则当成自己的（无连接时为0）；其开放报告把伙伴的码词称为自己的（从不归于伙伴）。所有权归属与接收方能否辨识伙伴被指派的内容无关。等权时约半数回答采纳伙伴规则，而匹配访问增益的引导向量为0；以伙伴名义引入的文本消息能被正确理解但从不被当作自身内容；写入伙伴名字无帮助；切断连接后恢复自身规则。

Conclusion: 在该模型中，叠加于接收方自身记忆之上的内容默认被判定为"mine"（我的）。因此允许模型交换内部状态的系统必须同时检验"所有权"与"信息迁移"，而真正的脑间桥接需要来自主体之外的ground truth（外部基准）才能判定归属。

Abstract: If your brain were connected directly to someone else's, would you still know which thoughts were yours? We build a functional version with two copies of one language model: each holds a private rule and code word, and one copy, the receiver, also attends to its partner's internal memory. The receiver took its partner's assignment as its own. Asked which rule it had been assigned, it named its partner's in 97% of answers when the partner's memory was weighted double (none without the link), and its open reports called the partner's code word its own, never the partner's. Ownership did not follow how well the receiver could tell what its partner had been assigned. At equal weight, the link made the receiver take its partner's rule in about half of its answers, and a steering vector matched on access gain in none; a text message introduced as the partner's was read correctly and never taken as the receiver's own. Writing the partner's name into its memory did not help, and cutting the link restored the receiver's own assigned rule. In this model, content laid over the receiver's own memory defaults to "mine", so systems that let models exchange internal states must test ownership as well as transfer, and a bridge between brains would need ground truth from outside the subject.

</details>


### [250] [Conceptizer: Next-Token Prediction Is Not All You Need](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33027)
*Haoran Zheng,Chen Shani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Conceptizer 训练框架，在下一词预测之外增加"语义奖励"，通过约9K概念的固定词表把语义作为训练信号，不加参数即提升困惑度、同义词概率与下游知识/情感任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下一词预测（NTP）只奖励实际出现的下一个词、惩罚所有其他词，但自然语言对同一语义常有多种表达方式，这种"唯一答案"式监督与语言的多义表达特性不匹配，浪费了同义表达的监督信息。

Method: 构建约9K个由上下文同义词组成的、与模型无关的固定概念词表，将概念作为与 token 并列的"语义单元"；把每个位置的下一词分布映射为概念分布，并将目标语义的奖励分摊到其所有可能表述上，从而在概念层面提供训练信号，且不增加模型参数。

Result: 在1B–8B参数的3个模型家族上，Conceptizer 在概念目标位置取得最低的留出 NTP 困惑度，并在全部3个基线对比中给上下文同义词分配最高概率；下游知识类与情感类任务提升，常识类任务保持可比。

Conclusion: 语言模型可以被直接优化为预测"语义"而非仅仅是下一个 token，NTP 与语义级奖励可结合互补。

Abstract: Next-token prediction (NTP) rewards only the token that occurs next, penalizing every alternative. But natural language often offers many ways to express the same meaning. We introduce Conceptizer, a training framework that extends next-token prediction with a reward for meaning. Conceptizer uses a fixed, model-agnostic vocabulary of ~9K concepts, built from contextual synonyms, as units of meaning alongside tokens as units of text. It maps each next-token distribution to a concept distribution and shares the reward for the target meaning across its possible wordings. This provides a concept-level training signal without adding model parameters. Applied to 3 model families at 1B-8B parameters, Conceptizer achieves the lowest held-out NTP perplexity at concept-target positions and assigns the highest probability to contextual synonyms, against all 3 baselines. It also improves downstream performance on knowledge and sentiment tasks while remaining comparable on commonsense. These results show that language models can be directly optimized to predict meaning, not just the next token.

</details>


### [251] [A Benchmark for Controllable Speaking-Style Captioning in Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33036)
*Shreeram Suresh Chandra,Ashwyn Sharma,Liang Lu,Xiutian Zhao,Leda Sari,Björn Schuller,Berrak Sisman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文将可控说话风格描述（SSC）形式化为指令遵循的音频-语言任务，并提出首个标准化基准 StyleInstructCaps，包含数据集与多维评测框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SSC研究缺乏统一的可控形式化定义；下游应用（对话AI、可控语音生成、大规模音频标注）需要面向特定维度（说话人特征、情感、表达风格）的风格描述，而非单一未加区分的描述。

Method: 将SSC建模为指令遵循的音频-语言任务，用显式指令指定需描述的说话风格维度；构建StyleInstructCaps基准（数据集+评测框架），评测元数据接地性、幻觉、指令遵循能力、对未见指令与音频数据集的泛化性、说话人-风格一致性。

Result: 在九个先进音频-语言模型上评测发现：强指令遵循能力并不必然意味着有接地的说话风格理解；SSC专用、指令多样化的训练能显著提升接地性、可控性与说话人一致性。

Conclusion: 指令遵循式形式化与标准化基准填补了可控说话风格描述的统一评测空白，揭示了指令能力与风格理解之间的差距。

Abstract: Speaking-style captioning (SSC) aims to generate natural language descriptions of how speech is delivered, capturing paralinguistic attributes such as vocal timbre, prosody, and expressivity. Many downstream applications, including conversational AI agents, controllable speech generation, and large-scale audio annotation, require dimension-specific style captions that describe targeted aspects of speech (e.g., speaker traits, emotion, or delivery style), rather than a single undifferentiated description. However, existing work lacks a unified formulation for controllable speaking-style captioning. We address this gap by formulating SSC as an instruction-following audio-language task, where explicit instructions specify the speaking-style dimensions to be described. We introduce StyleInstructCaps, the first standardized benchmark for controllable speaking-style captioning in audio-language models. StyleInstructCaps provides a dataset and evaluation framework that measures metadata groundedness, hallucination, instruction-following ability, generalization to unseen instructions and audio datasets, and speaker-style consistency. Across nine state-of-the-art audio-language models, we find that strong instruction-following ability does not necessarily imply grounded speaking-style understanding, and that SSC-specific instruction-diverse training substantially improves groundedness, controllability, and speaker consistency.

</details>


### [252] [EviGround-CT: Sentence-to-Volume Grounding for Verifying LLM-Generated Chest CT Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33038)
*Ziyuan Li,Juncheng Ni,Feng Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出EviGround-CT，在报告生成后对胸部CT报告中"无图像证据支持"的阳性发现进行验证：用确定性抽取器定位阳性发现句，用3D grounding模型为每句预测证据掩膜，并以完整句子（保留解剖位置、左右侧、描述修饰语）作为grounding查询，从而提升证据支持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的胸部CT报告可能描述扫描中缺乏局部证据的阳性发现，存在"报告-图像"不一致风险，而现有工作多为生成即止，缺少生成后的证据核验环节。

Method: 两阶段后验验证框架：1) 确定性抽取器识别报告中的阳性发现句；2) 3D grounding模型为每个句子预测证据掩膜。grounding查询采用完整句子而非类别条件，以保留解剖部位、偏侧性和描述性修饰语。评估设置：在CT-RATE上评估报告生成，在留出的100例ReXGroundingCT子集上评估grounding与验证，并与"类别条件"基线对比，采用配对病例级bootstrap。

Result: 在137条抽取的范围内阳性发现上，句子级grounding验证将证据支持精度ESP从0.263提升至0.365（相比类别条件）；相应的无支持阳性发现率从0.737降至0.635。配对病例级bootstrap的ESP差值为+0.102（95% CI: [0.028, 0.181]），置信区间不含0。

Conclusion: 以完整句子作为grounding查询的后验证据验证可有效减少无图像证据支持的阳性陈述，且预测掩膜可将单条报告语句与可人工核查的空间证据关联，提升CT报告的可解释性与可信度。评测规模（100例、137条阳性）较小，尚需更大规模验证。

Abstract: Chest computed tomography (CT) reports generated by large language models (LLMs) can describe positive findings that lack localized evidence in the scan. We propose EviGround-CT to verify these findings after report generation. A deterministic extractor identifies positive finding sentences, and a 3D grounding model predicts an evidence mask for each sentence. Using the full sentence retains anatomical location, laterality, and descriptive modifiers in the grounding query. We evaluate report generation on CT-RATE, and grounding and verification on a held-out 100-case ReXGroundingCT subset. Using the available annotations, sentence-grounded verification raises evidence-supported precision (ESP) from 0.263 to 0.365 across 137 extracted in-scope positives, compared with category conditioning. The corresponding unsupported positive finding rate falls from 0.737 to 0.635. The paired case-level bootstrap ESP difference is +0.102 (95% confidence interval: [0.028, 0.181]). The predicted masks associate individual report statements with spatial evidence that can be inspected alongside the CT.

</details>


### [253] [Parametric Session States Recover Retrieval Intent without Replaying History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33047)
*Qingsen Ma,Dianyun Wang,Jiahong Liu,Irwin King*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出可复用的会话记忆层 Parametric Session State (method)，用会话级参数化状态记住“要检索什么”（检索意图），而把事实知识保持为外部检索，从而在无需重放长上下文的前提下完成依赖早期轮次的指代与约束解析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程助手面对的后续请求，其指代对象、约束条件与活跃目标往往在很早的轮次就已建立；核心难点不只是上下文长度，而是检索意图缺失——如“用之前的配置”这类查询缺少项目、实体、版本等检索关键词。长上下文模型可重放历史恢复这些词但反复付出处理成本；传统 RAG 更便宜却假设查询信息充分；对话式重写要么重读历史，要么依赖显式维护的文本记忆。

Method: 引入参数化会话状态（Parametric Session State）：一种可复用的会话记忆层，以参数化（非纯文本显式记忆）方式在会话层面编码并更新检索意图，用于补全当前查询的检索词，同时将事实性知识保留在外部知识库/检索器之中，实现“记住要搜什么”与“存事实”的解耦。

Result: 摘要为问题陈述型，未给出具体实验数据、数据集或指标结果。

Conclusion: 将长程会话的连续性难题重构为检索意图问题，主张用轻量的参数化会话状态替代历史重放与文本化记忆，在降低长上下文重复计算开销的同时保持事实知识的外置与可更新性。

Abstract: Long-running assistants often interpret follow-up requests whose referents, constraints, and active goals were established many turns earlier. The central challenge is therefore not only context length, but retrieval intent: a current query such as ``use the previous configuration'' may omit the project, entity, and version terms needed to locate relevant evidence. Long-context models can recover those terms by replaying the interaction, but repeatedly pay the cost of processing history. Conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is cheaper, yet assumes an information-sufficient query; conversational rewriting either rereads the history or depends on an explicitly maintained textual memory. We introduce \emph{Parametric Session State} (\method{}), a reusable session-memory layer that remembers what to search for while keeping factual knowledge external.

</details>


### [254] [Position, Role or Label? A Controlled Study of Instruction Conflicts in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33201)
*Anish Laddha,Nitesh Pradhan,Gaurav Srivastava*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文构建WhoWins基准（1080个代码评分场景、7组控制实验）与188万条评分回复，系统研究LLM智能体在指令冲突时"谁赢"，发现"先出现者胜"是主导机制，并揭示来源位置/角色/标签被混淆导致基准结论失真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体同时接收操作者、仓库配置、用户、工具结果与记忆等多源指令且常相互冲突。既有指令层级基准只问"高优先级来源是否获胜"，却把来源的位置、角色、标签三者耦合在一起，无法判断获胜究竟源于层级还是源于呈现方式与顺序，因此需要解耦变量重新测量冲突判定机制。

Method: 1) 构建WhoWins：5类任务、1080个代码可评分场景，每场景最多5条互斥指令；并设计7组仅改变指令投递方式（同消息内顺序、跨消息顺序、system/developer vs 带标签user、工具与文件写入场景等）的控制实验。2) 评测14个开源权重模型（0.6B–122B，thinking开/关），累计1,887,356条评分回复，并在留出场景上复核主结论。3) 测试模型能否用配对样例预测更大规模冲突；4) 以关键词模式统计回复中对冲突的标记/回避率。

Result: 同条消息内两条冲突行，先出现者获胜率72.42%–94.66%；跨消息时降至22.95%–62.65%。置于system/developer消息首位的策略在所有Qwen模型中输给后续行，而在gpt-oss生效时多数获胜。工具与文件写入任务中，同文本作为带标签user消息先发时胜率高于置于system首位——该现象在所有模型-模式组合中一致。让模型获知任务行位置后，冲突预测在所有模型-模式组合中均有提升。关键词检测显示，已判定的配对回复中最多仅2.92%对冲突做了标记或权衡表述。

Conclusion: 冲突裁决高度依赖呈现顺序与格式而非语义层级，"先出现者优势"在同消息内近乎压倒性、跨消息明显衰减；system首次位并非普适最高优先级保证，其效应随模型族反转。基准设计必须解耦位置、角色与标签，否则层级结论易被混淆。模型对指令冲突普遍缺乏显式觉察与提示（&lt;3%），存在系统性安全与可控性风险。

Abstract: LLM agents take instructions from the operator, repository configuration, user, tool results and saved memory, which often conflict. Instruction-hierarchy benchmarks ask whether the higher-ranked source wins, but a source sets position, role and label at once. First, we build WhoWins, 1,080 code-scored scenarios in five task types, each with up to five mutually exclusive instructions, and seven controlled experiments that vary only how instructions are delivered. Second, we study 14 open-weight models (0.6B to 122B, thinking off and on) over 1,887,356 scored replies, checking main findings on held-out scenarios. Inside one message the first of two conflicting lines wins 72.42 to 94.66%, and across messages it keeps 22.95 to 62.65%. A policy sent first in the system (or developer) message loses most conflicts with later lines in every Qwen model but wins most on gpt-oss when it acts. In tool and file-write tasks it wins less often than the same text sent first as a labelled user message, in every model-mode. Third, we test whether pairs forecast larger conflicts; forecasts improve in every model-mode once they know where the task line is. Finally, by our keyword patterns at most 2.92% of decided pair replies flag or hedge a conflict.

</details>


### [255] [Each Insufficient in Its Own Way: Calibrating Language Models Across Varying Evidence States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33237)
*Jiayi Li,Dennis L. Shung,Bradly C. Stadie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出“证据状态校准（evidence-state calibration）”概念，并给出微调方法 SuCE，使模型置信度随证据变化而与实际答对概率一致；在临床诊断与多跳问答上显著降低 Brier 分数、提升 AUROC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在证据不足时仍倾向于作答，而“作答还是继续收集证据”的决策依赖于对“现有证据下答对概率”的校准估计。现有校准研究把输入视为固定，未考察置信度应如何随证据变化，因此缺少对证据充分性的判别能力。

Method: 提出证据状态校准：要求模型作答前置信度既与答对概率匹配，又能在证据改变该概率时相应变化。据此设计 SuCE（Sufficiency Confidence Estimation），对模型下一词分布中已有的置信信号进行微调，使其与模型在各证据状态下的实际答对频率对齐（不改动生成流程，仅重校准置信度）。

Result: 在临床诊断与多跳问答任务上，跨两个模型家族的四个模型，SuCE 最多将 Brier 分数降低 60%，AUROC 最多提升 0.16；其置信度与经验成功率相吻合，且不仅对证据数量、还对其体证据内容作出响应。

Conclusion: 模型可以学习判断当前证据是否足以作答；证据状态校准为“作答/继续取证”的决策提供了可行且有理论依据的置信度信号。

Abstract: How can a language model know whether it has enough evidence to answer? Language models tend to answer even when the evidence they have is insufficient. Deciding whether to answer or gather more evidence requires a calibrated estimate of how likely an answer is to be correct with the available evidence. However, most calibration work treats the input as fixed, without asking how this estimate should change with the evidence. We introduce \emph{evidence-state calibration}, which requires a model's confidence before answering to match its probability of answering correctly and to change accordingly whenever the evidence changes this probability. We propose \ours{} (\textbf{Suffi}ciency \textbf{C}onfidence \textbf{E}stimation), which fine-tunes the confidence already present in a model's next-token distribution to match how often the model answers correctly from each evidence state. Across clinical diagnosis and multi-hop question answering with four models from two families, \ours{} reduces the Brier score by up to 60\% and increases AUROC by up to 0.16. Its confidence matches the empirical success rate and responds not only to the amount of evidence but also to which evidence is present, showing that models can learn to judge whether their current evidence is enough to answer.

</details>


### [256] [Hey, guess what: CUES lead to inferences about typicality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33239)
*Alison Chi,Sanghyeok Choi,Hannah Rohde,Emily Allaway*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究人们对事件典型性/非典型性的推断（meaning recovery），构建EventTyp与人工验证的EventTypGold语料库，并通过大规模人类与LLM实验提出CUES框架：常识知识、话语强调与讽刺三类线索驱动人类的典型性推断，而LLM因缺乏必要常识知识难以遵循这些线索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们会积累事件典型性的知识，并在日常对话中据此恢复言外之意。然而现有工作对"典型性与非典型性推断"这一意义恢复过程的理解不足，同时LLM是否具备完成此类推断所需的前提能力尚不清楚，因此需要系统刻画这一现象及其机制。

Method: 1）构建两个语料库：EventTyp及经人工验证的EventTypGold；2）开展大规模人类实验与LLM实验；3）提出并检验三类线索（CUES）——常识知识（Commonsense Knowledge）、话语强调（Utterance Emphasis）、讽刺（Snark）——对典型性推断的预测作用；4）在多数实验设置下对比LLM与人类的表现。

Result: 人类实验中，常识知识、话语强调与讽刺三类线索均能预测关于典型性的推断。而在多数实验设置下，LLM缺乏准确评估事件一般典型性所需的前提性常识知识，因而难以遵循这些线索。

Conclusion: 典型性推断是一个由多线索驱动的意义恢复过程，可通过CUES框架刻画；LLM在此任务上的瓶颈在于常识知识缺失，而非线索利用策略本身，这为评估与改进LLM的语用推断能力提供了依据。

Abstract: Throughout life, we accumulate knowledge of how typical certain events are. We use this knowledge in daily conversation, often interpreting meaning beyond what has been said explicitly. In this work, we take steps to better understand this meaning recovery, investigating both atypicality and typicality inferences. First, we construct two corpora, EventTyp and the human-validated EventTypGold. We conduct large-scale human and LLM experiments and find that for humans, three CUES predict inferences about typicality: Commonsense Knowledge, Utterance Emphasis, and Snark. However, in most experimental settings, we find that LLMs lack the prerequisite Commonsense Knowledge necessary to accurately assess an event's general typicality, and therefore struggle to follow these CUES.

</details>


### [257] [Two Uncertainties Are Not One: Disagreement versus Decision-Risk in Cheap Structured Content Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33258)
*Karan Yadav*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对一款冻结式"System One"内容审核模型做了首个独立审计：在142,658条人工标注评论上，其零样本AUROC（0.83）与14个前沿推理模型中13个统计上不可区分，成本低1–3个数量级；研究进一步指出"置信度"混淆了人类标注分歧与决策风险两种不确定性，二者在非对称审核损失下需要相反的升级信号，并提出用并行子问题答案的离散度来恢复人类分歧信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内容审核需将分级的、存在争议的人类判断压缩为"保留/下架"的二元动作，规模达数十亿条，逐条调用前沿LLM不经济。冻结式"System One"模型以约0.000025美元/次、约100ms返回带类型且校准的决策而非文本，但其可靠性与不确定性含义缺乏独立验证。

Method: 在142,658条人工标注评论上对一款冻结式System One模型进行独立审计，并在共享探针集上与其14个前沿推理模型（GPT-5.x、Claude、Gemini 3、Grok系列）做基准对比；采用配对自助法（paired bootstrap）进行统计检验；将判断分解为多个并行子问题，以其答案离散度作为人类分歧的代理信号，并与模型原生置信度比较。

Result: 零样本分类AUROC为0.83，在配对自助法（n=56）下与14个前沿系统中的13个统计上不可区分（属未能拒绝等效，而非证明等效），成本低1–3个数量级，校准不劣于其中若干系统。模型原生"置信度"将人类分歧（讽刺与编码语言上的标注者分裂）与决策风险（自动动作代价性错误）混为一体。并行子问题离散度可恢复原生置信度遗漏的人类分歧信号，但仅在最弱、对分歧不敏感且分解与分歧来源对齐时有效；专用毒性模型与最强LLM无需此方法，且效果对分布敏感。

Conclusion: 廉价冻结式模型在准确率上可与前沿推理模型竞争且成本极低，是可行的审核工具；但单一置信度数值无法同时服务于人类分歧与决策风险两类升sampling需求，实践上需按非对称损失分别设计升级信号。子问题分解是一种特定而非通用的补救手段。作者将公开工具、缓存运行结果与分析代码。

Abstract: Content moderation compresses a graded, contested human judgment into a binary act (leave up / take down) over billions of items, at a scale where running a frontier LLM on every post is uneconomical. A new class of frozen "System One" models returns typed, calibrated decisions instead of text at ~USD 0.000025 per call and ~100 ms. We run the first independent audit of one such model on 142,658 human-labeled comments, and benchmark it against 14 frontier reasoning models (the GPT-5.x, Claude, Gemini 3, and Grok families) on a shared probe set. Two findings stand out. First, the cheap model is accuracy-competitive: its zero-shot classification AUROC (0.83) is not statistically separable (paired bootstrap, n=56; a failure to reject parity, not proof of equivalence) from 13 of the 14 frontier systems while costing 1-3 orders of magnitude less, and it is no worse calibrated than several of them. Second, "confidence" conflates two uncertainties that come apart: human disagreement (where annotators split on satire and coded language) and decision risk (where the automatic action is costly-wrong). Under an asymmetric moderation loss these call for opposite escalation signals, so no single confidence number serves both. Because the model prices extra questions at nearly zero, decomposing the judgment into parallel sub-questions and reading their spread recovers a human-disagreement signal that the model's native confidence misses -- but this remedy is specific: it helps the weakest, disagreement-blind models and only when the decomposition aligns with the sources of disagreement; a specialist toxicity model and the strongest LLMs do not need it, and the effect is distribution-sensitive. We will release the instrument, the cached runs, and the analysis.

</details>


### [258] [FlexA-Mem: Budget-Adaptive Agentic Memory for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33274)
*Wujiang Xu,Jiaojiao Han,Xi Zhu,Qizheng Zhang,Kaiqu Liang,Yutong Yin,Kai Mei,Dimitris N. Metaxas*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FlexA-Mem 提出"写入一次、按需渲染"的通用记忆：历史记录一次性写入不可变存储，每次调用时用固定规则（不调用 LLM）渲染出由记录时间线+细节组成的紧凑记忆，同时服务精确事实问答与多步任务两类场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体的记忆需求差异很大：过去对话类问题需要查询中明确提到的精确事实，多步任务则需要已执行步骤的轨迹以及下一步无法预先命名的细节。现有方案各自只针对单一场景设计与评测：检索式记忆（如 A-Mem）会漏掉当前查询未表达的步骤，摘要式记忆会丢失精确字符串，而二者拼接又需预先固定预算分配比例。

Method: 每个历史单元只写入一次到不可变存储；每次调用现场渲染新的记忆，内容为紧凑的记录时间线，再加由固定规则填入剩余空间的细节，全程无需 LLM 调用。细节形式包括原始文本、片段摘录，或与查询最匹配的逐字片段。

Result: AppWorld 挑战任务 4k 预算下比次优方法高 11.5%；在 147 个未使用任务、预测事先固定的设置下比带摘要的 A-Mem 高 12.2%；在 LongMemEval 与 LoCoMo 上达到与不写记忆的专用关键词检索器相当的水平，而基于 LLM 生成文本构建的记忆在紧预算下明显落后。消融显示时间线主导 AppWorld 完成率，恢复机制主要挽回步骤，精确事实准确性则取决于恢复。

Conclusion: 单一不可变存储配合按需渲染的紧凑记忆，可在不依赖 LLM 写记忆、也不预设预算切分的情况下统一覆盖精确检索与多步任务两类场景，且结构（时间线）与内容恢复在两类场景中作用互补。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents work in scenarios with very different memory needs. A question about past conversations needs the exact facts it names, while a multi-step task needs a trace of the steps already taken together with details that the next step cannot name. Existing memories are each designed and tested for one kind of scenario. Retrieval memories such as A-Mem miss steps that the current query does not express, summaries drop exact strings, and pairing the two fixes the split of the budget in advance. We propose FlexA-Mem, a general memory that writes each unit of history once into an immutable store and renders a fresh memory for every call. The rendered memory is a compact timeline of records plus detail that a fixed rule fits into the remaining room without an LLM call. The detail is either relevant units as raw text or excerpts or the verbatim pieces that best match the query. With one store, FlexA-Mem serves both kinds of scenario. On AppWorld challenge tasks at 4k, it outperforms the second-best method by 11.5%, and on 147 unused tasks with predictions fixed in advance it outperforms A-Mem with a summary by 12.2%. On LongMemEval and LoCoMo, it matches a dedicated keyword retriever that writes no memory, while memories built on text written by an LLM fall far behind at tight budgets. Ablations show that the timeline carries AppWorld completion, whereas recovery mainly saves steps there and decides accuracy on exact facts. Code is available at https://github.com/WujiangXu/Flex-Amem

</details>


### [259] [Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment (MARCA) of Individual Case Safety Reports in Pharmacovigilance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33279)
*Daisy Rae Lopez,Angela Boccia,Maurizio Sessa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MARCA 是一个四智能体 RAG 框架，用于自动生成 Naranjo 因果性评估依据；在 215 份 ICSR、1562 个药物-事件组合上与专家共识一致性为 79.4%（kappa=0.587），各条目一致性差异明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICSR 数量快速增长，使药物警戒中依赖专家的人工因果性评估难以为继，需要可扩展、可解释的辅助评估手段。

Method: 构建四智能体框架 MARCA（科学文献检索、药品说明书评估、客观证据分类、临床因果推理），基于 Gemini 2.5 Pro 与 DeepSeek-V3.2 生成理由以支持人工评分；以 FAERS 2025 Q1–Q2 的 215 份 ICSR、1562 个 DEC 的专家共识为参考标准，用百分比一致率与 Cohen's kappa 评价，并在 60 个 DEC 的回顾性子集中比较 RAG 与非 RAG 评分。

Result: 条目层面：Naranjo Q2 一致率 96.8%（kappa=0.491，95%CI 0.265–0.663），Q5 为 85.4%（kappa=0.269，95%CI 0.180–0.340），Q10 为 96.8%（kappa=0.922，95%CI 0.885–0.951）；最终因果性分级一致率 79.4%（95%CI 71.8–85.3，kappa=0.587，95%CI 0.450–0.690）。回顾性子集中 RAG 优于非 RAG：Q5 83.3% vs 65.0%，Q10 100.0% vs 18.3%。

Conclusion: MARCA 辅助评估在各 Naranjo 条目上一致性不均衡，涉及"其他原因"的条目（Q5）一致性最低；RAG 对比属回顾性、探索性结果，尚不能证明前瞻性有效性。

Abstract: Introduction: Increasing volumes of individual case safety reports (ICSRs) challenge expert-led causality assessment in pharmacovigilance. We developed MARCA (Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment), a four-agent framework for Naranjo-based assessment, and evaluated agreement with human experts and exploratory differences between non-RAG and RAG-labelled scores.
  Methods: MARCA combined scientific literature retrieval, drug-label assessment, objective-evidence classification, and clinical causality reasoning using Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2. Agent-generated rationales informed human-assisted scoring. A consensus expert reference standard covered 215 ICSRs and 1,562 drug-event combinations (DECs) from FAERS (Q1-Q2 2025). Agreement was measured using percentage agreement and Cohen's kappa.
  Results: Question-level agreement was 96.8% for Naranjo Q2 (kappa = 0.491; 95% CI 0.265-0.663), 85.4% for Q5 (kappa = 0.269; 95% CI 0.180-0.340), and 96.8% for Q10 (kappa = 0.922; 95% CI 0.885-0.951). Final causality classification agreement was 79.4% (95% CI 71.8-85.3; kappa = 0.587, 95% CI 0.450-0.690). In a retrospective subset of 60 DECs, agreement was higher for RAG-labelled than non-RAG scores for Q5 (83.3% vs 65.0%) and Q10 (100.0% vs 18.3%).
  Discussion: MARCA-assisted assessment showed substantial variation in agreement across Naranjo questions, with lower concordance for alternative causes. Retrospective RAG comparisons are exploratory and do not establish prospective effectiveness.

</details>


### [260] [The Emergence and Sparsification of a Syntactic Circuit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33299)
*Qing Yao,Sasha Boguraev,Tiago Pimentel,Kyle Mahowald*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文追踪Pythia模型训练过程中主谓一致（subject-verb agreement）电路的形成，发现该语法行为习得较早，但其神经机制在行为稳定后仍持续重组：负责的注意力头会替换、电路逐渐收缩、最终高度稀疏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为理解语言模型中语法行为如何涌现及其表征方式，作者选择主谓数一致这一经典语法现象，考察其内部电路在训练全过程中的动态演化，弥补以往多关注训练完成模型、忽视形成过程的不足。

Method: 对pythia-1b以及pythia-410m的十个随机种子，跨多个训练检查点追踪主谓一致电路；通过定位参与该行为的注意力头与神经元，比较不同训练阶段电路的组成与规模变化。

Result: 主谓一致习得较早，初期由一组弥散的神经元共同承担；行为稳定后机制仍持续重组。中介该行为的注意力头常发生迁移：pythia-1b早期由两个头控制，后期由一个不同的第三个头控制。此外电路随训练收缩，pythia-1b最终电路异常稀疏。

Conclusion: 语言模型中的语法知识表现为一个动态、可重组的电路形成过程：功能先以冗余弥散方式出现，随后在行为不变的前提下被精炼为稀疏、特定的子网络。这为理解语言知识的涌现与表征提供了机制层面的启示。

Abstract: To understand the emergence of grammatical behavior in language models, we track circuits for subject-verb number agreement in pythia-1b and ten seeds of pythia-410m across training. We find that subject-verb agreement is learned early, and is initially handled by a diffuse collection of neurons. However, after agreement behavior has stabilized, the mechanisms responsible for it continue to reorganize. The attention heads which mediate agreement often shift during training: in the case of pythia-1b, behavior is controlled by two heads early in training but by a third (different) head later. Furthermore, the circuit shrinks over training, with pythia-1b's final circuit being strikingly sparse. We take these results to be informative about how linguistic knowledge emerges and is represented in a language model.

</details>


### [261] [Preference Optimization Improves Definition Generation: Semantic Change in EU Institutional Sustainable Finance Disclosures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33357)
*Mariia Fedorova,Andrey Kutuzov,Gustavo Cadenas Delascio*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出用Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）微调词典式定义生成器，缓解其在词汇语义变化检测中"义项分布过细、定义冗余"的问题，并在学术LSCD基准与真实欧盟发展金融项目文档的可持续性术语审计任务上进行定量与定性验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 词典式定义生成器（dictionary-like definition generators）对词汇语义变化检测（LSCD）有用，但其缺陷是义项粒度过度细分：同一词汇义项会被生成过多重复/碎片化的定义，影响检测质量与实际可用性。

Method: 采用Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）对定义生成模型进行微调，以偏好优化方式抑制过度细分的义项分布；评估上结合（1）一个经整理的学术LSCD基准进行定量评测，（2）真实数据上的定性分析——欧盟发展金融项目文档中可持续性术语的历时变化审计任务。

Result: DPO微调能够缓解义项粒度过细的问题；在学术LSCD基准上取得定量改进，并在真实可持续性术语历时审计任务中展现出实用价值。所有模型、代码与预测结果均已公开（GitHub: ltgoslo/dpo-for-definition-generation）。

Conclusion: DPO是一种有效且可复用的手段，用于改善词典式定义生成器的义项粒度控制，从而提升LSCD的实用性，并可迁移到真实世界的术语历时变化审计场景。

Abstract: Dictionary-like definition generators are known to be useful for lexical semantic change detection (LSCD). However, they suffer from overly granular sense distribution, producing excessive number of definitions for one and the same lexical sense. In this work, we show that fine-tuning with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) helps to overcome this problem. We test our approach both quantitatively on a curated academic LSCD benchmark and qualitatively on real-world data for a practical task of auditing diachronic changes in sustainability terminology within project documentation of EU development finance. All models, code and predictions produced in this study are publicly available at https://github.com/ltgoslo/dpo-for-definition-generation.

</details>


### [262] [Distill, Debate, Discover: Grounding Multi-Agent Research Ideation in Graph-Distilled Insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33366)
*Qianran Ma,Muxin Liu,Grace Kim,Xiao Liang,Chris Callison-Burch*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出InsightAgents框架，通过从相关论文图蒸馏洞见来构建多智能体的文献型专长，再以辩论方式生成研究提案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被广泛用于研究创意生成与科学发现，多智能体辩论可汇聚多元视角，但关键难点在于如何让各智能体具备互不相同且有意义的专长来引导其贡献。

Method: 受研究者协作时调用积累研究经验的启发，从相关论文构成的图中蒸馏洞见，构建有文献依据的智能体专长；洞见用于刻画研究路线的演进、揭示潜在假设、识别未解难题；智能体在此引导下共同确定研究问题，并通过辩论提出、质疑与精炼候选方案以形成研究提案。

Result: 在100个NLP研究主题上，与三个研究创意生成框架进行两两比较，由两个LLM评审打分；无论在线还是离线知识设置，InsightAgents在两位评审下的五个评价维度平均分均为最高。

Conclusion: 以文献洞见支撑的专长差异化为多智能体辩论提供了有效引导，能显著提升研究提案生成质量，且在不同知识获取设置下均具稳健优势。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support research idea generation and scientific discovery. Multi-agent debate offers a collaborative approach to this task by bringing together diverse perspectives to develop research ideas. However, a key challenge is how to equip agents with distinct and meaningful expertise to guide their contributions. Inspired by how researchers draw on accumulated research experience during collaboration, we introduce InsightAgents, a framework that constructs literature-grounded agent expertise by distilling insights from graphs of related papers. Guided by insights that trace evolving research approaches, reveal underlying assumptions, and identify unresolved challenges, within a line of research, agents jointly identify a research problem and propose, challenge, and refine potential approaches through debate to develop a research proposal. We evaluate InsightAgents against three research idea generation frameworks on 100 NLP research topics through pairwise comparisons by two LLM judges. In both online and offline knowledge settings, InsightAgents achieves the highest average score across the five evaluation dimensions under both judges.

</details>


### [263] [How Does Post-Training Shape LLM Value Preferences?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33371)
*Yang Liu,Shaoyang Xu,Masahiro Kaneko,Chengzhi Zhong,Wenxuan Zhang,Chenhui Chu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过控制实验考察后训练语料中不同群体观点比例失衡如何影响LLM价值偏好，发现SFT、DPO、GRPO等五条后训练路径对观点失衡的放大程度不同，且已形成的价值偏好能否被后续训练消除取决于训练方法与语料观点构成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练语料中不同人群观点比例可能失衡，模型会从中学习价值偏好并放大失衡，导致部分群体观点进一步被低估；但观点混合比例如何在不同后训练路径下塑造价值偏好尚不明确。

Method: 构建具有不同观点混合比例的后训练语料，基于SFT、DPO、GRPO设计五种后训练路径，进行控制实验；并考察偏好消除、干预稳定性以及蒸馏向学生模型的迁移。

Result: 后训练会放大观点失衡，且放大程度随后训练路径而异；既有价值偏好能否被后续训练消除取决于训练方法和语料观点构成；模型在干预下的稳定性与后续训练是否改变其价值偏好相关；即使蒸馏语料不含显式观点问题，价值偏好仍迁移至学生模型。

Conclusion: 开发、评估与复用LLM时需同时考虑后训练语料的观点混合比例与后训练方法的选择；价值偏好的放大、持久性与迁移性构成需关注的风险。

Abstract: During post-training, large language models (LLMs) learn value preferences from corpora that may contain imbalanced proportions of opinions associated with different demographic groups. Amplifying these imbalances may further underrepresent some groups' opinions. However, how opinion mixtures shape value preferences across post-training paths remains unclear. To answer this question, we conduct controlled experiments using post-training corpora with different opinion mixtures and five post-training paths based on SFT, DPO, and GRPO. We find that post-training amplifies opinion imbalances differently across post-training paths. Once value preferences are amplified, whether further post-training can remove them depends on both the post-training method and the opinion mixture in the corpus. More concerningly, a model's stability under interventions depends on whether further post-training changes its value preference. Moreover, these value preferences are transferred to student models even when distillation uses corpora with no explicit opinion questions. These findings suggest that both the opinion mixture in post-training corpora and the choice of post-training method should be considered when developing, evaluating, and reusing LLMs. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/ku-nlp/llm-value-preferences.

</details>


### [264] [Examining form-based linguistic productivity in people and large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33433)
*Michael Wilson,Robert Frank*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 人类能将新动词从主动句泛化到被动句，即便该动词无可赋予的意义，体现抽象的形式知识；大语言模型仅在该动词可映射到已有动词意义时才成功。故模型的句法知识与具体词项的意义和分布绑定，而人类句法知识并非如此。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言生产力（在全新语境中使用词语）是人类语言的显著事实，但支撑这种生产力的知识有多抽象仍不清楚。作者希望通过比较人与计算语言模型在新动词被动化任务上的泛化表现，检验句法知识的抽象程度。

Method: 采用新动词学习—泛化范式：被试与语言模型先学习一个新动词的主动句用法，再考察其能否将该动词扩展到被动语境。关键操纵在于新动词是否可被赋予类似已有动词的意义，以区分纯形式泛化与意义驱动的泛化。

Result: 人类在无可赋予意义的情况下仍按抽象的语言形式规律将主动用法扩展到被动；大语言模型仅当新动词可获得类似已有动词的意义时才成功扩展。

Conclusion: 计算模型的句法知识仍受具体词汇项的分布与意义约束，而人类句法知识不依赖于此，显示出更强的抽象性。

Abstract: Linguistic productivity, as evidenced by the use of words in novel contexts, is one of the most striking facts about human language. However, how abstract the knowledge that enables such productivity is remains unclear. We compare people's and computational language models' linguistic productivity in contexts where successful generalization depends on form-based information. We focus on extending the use of a novel verb learned in the active voice to passive contexts. We find people extend active to passive uses in a way consistent with abstract generalizations concerning linguistic form, even when no plausible meaning can be assigned to the novel verb. In contrast, large language models succeeded only when a meaning like an existing verb's could be assigned to the novel verb. We conclude that computational models' syntactic knowledge remains tied to the distribution and meaning of specific lexical items in a way that human syntactic knowledge is not.

</details>


### [265] [Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33440)
*Yuexin Wu,Dayou Yu,Vasile Rus*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究医学问答模型适配中的数据选择问题，提出基于高斯扰动的表示敏感性优先级方法（RSP/RSP-Drop），在MedGemma-4B与五个医学QA基准上验证其在128样本预算下优于熵池匹配随机选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从现有问答库适配医学语言模型时，需挑选紧凑训练子集；已有选择信号（如熵）是否充分、如何利用表示层的扰动敏感性尚缺乏系统考察，作者希望刻画扰动式选择的经验效用与局限。

Method: 对最终层表示施高斯扰动，提取两类信号：预测翻转频率与不翻转样本的边缘收缩量；经统一的熵预筛选后，RSP用自动RMS缩放融合两信号，RSP-Drop仅按收缩量排序。选择过程仅使用问题与选项文本。用MedGemma-4B在五个医学QA数据集上，于保留集预算64/128/256下评测。

Result: 在128预算下，RSP与RSP-Drop的数据集平均Macro-F1分别为47.55与48.28，高于熵池匹配随机选择的45.11；相对优劣随数据集与预算变化。案例分析显示两规则交换样本的干净边缘分布存在差异；全池消融表明熵预筛选并非一致有益。

Conclusion: 扰动式选择在固定适配协议下具有实证收益但存在局限；评估仅基于单一骨干与存在训练家族重叠的基准，结论为回溯性经验刻画，不构成临床有效性证据。

Abstract: Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks. We investigate perturbation-based data selection using two signals derived from Gaussian perturbations of the final-block representation: prediction-change frequency and non-flipping margin contraction. After a shared entropy prefilter, Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) combines the signals using automatic root-mean-square scaling, while RSP-Drop ranks candidates by contraction alone. Both selectors use only questions and answer options during selection. We evaluate them with MedGemma-4B on five medical QA datasets at retained-set budgets of 64, 128, and 256 examples. At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection. Their relative performance varies across datasets and budgets. A selected-set case study identifies contrasting clean-margin profiles among the examples exchanged by the two rules, while a full-pool ablation shows that entropy prefiltering is not uniformly beneficial. These retrospective results characterize the empirical utility and limitations of perturbation-based selection under a fixed adaptation protocol. Evaluation uses one backbone and benchmarks with documented training-family overlap; it does not establish clinical effectiveness.

</details>


### [266] [Quantifying Meaning with SCAPE-T: Semantic Complexity from Encoder-Only Transformer Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33441)
*Maxim Khovansky,Lev Mukhanov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出语义复杂度（语义复杂度=唯一确定语义所需的码长）的注意力派生指标SCAPE-T，在词长控制下以78.5%成对准确率显著超越可读性、句法/词汇与LLM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLP中自动语义复杂度估计研究不足，虽有语言学与可解释性应用价值；现有度量或刻画读者努力（可读性、词汇难度，受词长/句法等表层特征混淆），或直接量化表层特征（类符形符比、词频），缺乏直接针对语义整合的度量。

Method: 将语义复杂度定义为唯一指定文本语义所需的码长，并以基于仅编码器Transformer的注意力派生指标SCAPE-T加以操作化：融合三个子指标——(i) 逆加权自聚焦（token-to-self）、(ii) CLS聚焦（token-to-CLS）、(iii) 头间冗余（跨注意力头余弦相似度），采用层加权聚合；数据驱动学习仅限超参数校准。开发集为哲学散文 vs. MCTest故事，评测集为儿童故事 vs. 技术维基文章，以对比样本的成对准确率为主准则，基线含可读性、句法/词汇及LLM派生度量。

Result: 词长控制下SCAPE-T显著优于全部基线，成对准确率78.5%（95% bootstrap CI 76.1–80.4，N=10k成对比较；比最强基线高12.7个百分点）；不加该控制时可读性启发式反超，与其依赖表层特征一致；在短文本抽象性数据集上亦领先；消融显示各子指标均有实质贡献。

Conclusion: SCAPE-T比现有方法更好地将概念结构从词汇/句法混淆中分离，并在两个留出领域上具备泛化性。

Abstract: Automated semantic complexity estimation remains underexplored in NLP, despite important applications in linguistics and interpretability. This paper defines semantic complexity as the code length required to uniquely specify a text's semantic meaning, and operationalises it via SCAPE-T, an attention-derived metric based on encoder-only transformers. Existing measures either model reader effort (readability, lexical difficulty), which correlates with surface features (word length, syntax), or quantify surface features directly (type-token ratio, word frequency). SCAPE-T targets semantic integration directly by combining three submetrics: (i) inverse-weighted self-focus (token-to-self), (ii) CLS focus (token-to-CLS), and (iii) inter-head redundancy (cosine similarity across heads), using layer-weighted aggregation; data-driven learning is confined to hyperparameter tuning for calibration. Development uses philosophical prose vs. MCTest stories; evaluation is on children's stories vs. technical Wikipedia articles, with pairwise accuracy on contrasts as the primary criterion. Baselines include readability, syntactic/lexical, and LLM-derived measures. SCAPE-T substantially outperforms all tested baselines under word-length control, with a pairwise accuracy of 78.5% (95% bootstrap CI: 76.1-80.4, N=10k pairwise comparisons; +12.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline); without that control, readability heuristics overtake, consistent with their reliance on surface features. On a short-terms abstractness dataset, SCAPE-T also leads. Ablations show each submetric contributes materially. Overall, the results show SCAPE-T isolates conceptual structure from lexical/syntactic confounds better than existing methods, and generalises across two held-out domains.

</details>


### [267] [Adaptive Transfer of Representational Signatures for LLM Reliability Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33442)
*Yongtong Li,Yixuan Florence Wu,Jiawei Zhang,Naichen Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出跨相关领域迁移表示特征的统计框架，用交叉拟合学习域特定预测器的组合权重，在仅需少量目标域标注数据时提升幻觉与推理错误检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于内部表示的质量检测器虽准确度尚可，但训练需大量领域特定标注数据，难以迁移到新领域。

Method: 构建统计框架：先为每个领域提取低维表示特征，再用交叉拟合（cross-fitting）学习域特定预测器的组合权重，使权重随各源域对目标域的预测相关性自适应调整；并通过最小二乘类比的渐近分析，刻画极限预测风险与聚合权重同域差异、表示偏差的关系。

Result: 在多个幻觉数据集与开源权重LLM上，仅用新领域25个标注问题，自适应迁移使幻觉检测AUROC提升6.8%，推理步骤预测AUROC提升8.4%。

Conclusion: 跨域表示特征迁移可在极低标注成本下有效提升LLM不可靠输出检测的泛化能力，域自适应加权是关键。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are reported to be susceptible to reliability issues including hallucinations and reasoning errors. Existing quality detectors can predict unreliable outputs based on internal representations with decent accuracies. However, training these detectors often requires substantial domain-specific labeled data, which limits their applicability to new domains. We propose to address this challenge by transferring representational signatures across related domains. More specifically, we build a statistical framework that first extracts low-dimensional signatures for each domain, then uses cross-fitting to learn composition weights of domain-specific predictors. The weights adapt to each source domain's predictive relevance to the target domain. Our asymptotic analysis of a least-squares analogue characterizes the limiting prediction risk and aggregation weights in terms of domain discrepancies and representation bias. Experiments across multiple hallucination datasets and open-weight LLMs show that, with only 25 labeled questions in the new domain, adaptive transfer improves hallucination-detection AUROC by 6.8%. For reasoning-step prediction, it improves AUROC by 8.4%.

</details>


### [268] [Propasafe-Hybrid: A Text-Based Hybrid Propaganda Detection Tool](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33464)
*Thomas Kimmeth,Avijit Roy,Vivek Sharma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Propasafe-Hybrid 是一个句级宣传检测系统，融合微调 Transformer 分类器与 LLM 技术分类，输出高亮句、技术标签与简明理由，并通过成本感知预筛选降低推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线新闻与社交媒体中宣传性内容日益增多，读者往往缺乏审慎核查，因而需要可靠且细粒度的检测手段；同时需兼顾可解释性与实际部署的推理成本。

Method: 构建句级流水线：以微调 Transformer 分类器做检测，再以 LLM 完成宣传技术（策略）分类，并生成简明理由；引入成本感知预筛选阶段，仅将高概率句子送入 LLM，以在保留决策逻辑的前提下减少 token 消耗。

Result: 系统可输出高亮句子、技术标签分配及简洁理由，使用户能即时理解句子被标记的原因及标签判定依据；预筛选机制在保持决策逻辑的同时降低推理成本。

Conclusion: 该设计提升了句级宣传检测的可解释性、效率与实用可用性，适用于真实新闻环境中的部署。摘要未给出定量评测结果。

Abstract: Propagandistic content increasingly circulates through online news and social media, where readers often encounter it with limited scrutiny, highlighting the need for reliable and fine-grained detection. This paper introduces Propasafe-Hybrid, a sentence-level system that integrates a fine-tuned transformer classifier with LLM-based technique classification to identify, label, and explain specific propaganda strategies. The pipeline generates actionable outputs, including highlighted sentences, technique assignments, and concise rationales, so users can immediately understand why a sentence was flagged and how each label was determined. To control inference cost, Propasafe-Hybrid employs a cost-aware pre-filtering stage that forwards only high-likelihood sentences to LLMs, reducing token usage while preserving the underlying decision logic. Together, these design choices enhance the explainability, efficiency, and practical usability of sentence-level propaganda detection in real-world news environments.

</details>


### [269] [Incremental Predictive Value of LLM Tutoring Interactions for Student Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33488)
*Zeyu Dong,Mikael Kwame Kuada,Asa Holley Buchakjian-Tweedy,Ibrahem Aljabea*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文比较学期级LLM辅导交互特征与常数基线在作业分数预测上的效果，发现梯度提升仅带来微小改善（MAE 3.023 vs 基线3.138），且误差高度集中于低分群体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估基于大语言模型辅导系统的学期级交互特征是否能在常数基线之上提供额外的作业成绩预测价值，并厘清基线选择与误差分布对预测价值评估的影响。

Method: 使用StudyChat数据集（两轮本科AI课程，16,851条学生—助教交互，175/203条学生—学期记录匹配到成绩）。六种拟合估计器与训练折均值、中位数基线共享重复嵌套交叉验证；对每名学生十次重复的留出预测取平均后比较MAE，并用条件95% bootstrap区间检验配对差异；另做表征变更与学期特定中位数基线，并按成绩四分位分层分析误差。

Result: 梯度提升MAE为3.023分，中位数基线3.138分，配对差异-0.114，条件95% bootstrap区间[-0.245, 0.013]，未排除零，提升不显著。表征变更与学期特定中位数收益同样很小。最低分四分位中，提升法误差7.30分，中位数8.07分，均值6.67分；Ridge在该子群误差最低（6.37），但整体MAE较差（3.331）。成绩集中于天花板：160人（91.4%）高于90分，最低四分位贡献了提升法总绝对误差的62.1%。

Conclusion: 该回顾性比较表明，LLM辅导交互特征相对常数基线的预测增益微小且统计上不确定；基线选择与误差分布显著影响预测价值的判断。研究为学习支持工具的评估设计提供参考，但并未确立任何学习效果。

Abstract: We evaluate whether semester-level interaction features from a large language model tutor improve assignment-score prediction beyond constant baselines. StudyChat provides 16,851 student-assistant exchanges from two offerings of an undergraduate artificial intelligence course, with outcomes matched to 175 of 203 student-semester records. Six fitted estimators and training-fold mean and median baselines share repeated nested cross-validation. After averaging each student's held-out predictions across ten repeats, Gradient Boosting achieves mean absolute error of 3.023 grade points, versus 3.138 for the median baseline. The paired difference is -0.114, with a conditional 95% bootstrap interval of [-0.245,0.013]. Representation changes and a semester-specific median yield similarly small gains. In the lowest observed-score quartile, however, boosting's error is 7.30 points, versus 8.07 for the median and 6.67 for the mean; Ridge has the lowest fitted-model error at 6.37 despite its worse overall error of 3.331. Scores concentrate near the ceiling: 160 students (91.4%) score above 90, and the lowest quartile contributes 62.1% of boosting's total absolute error. This retrospective comparison shows how baseline choice and error distribution affect predictive value, informing evaluation of student-support tools without establishing a learning effect.

</details>


### [270] [Small Edits, Shifting Decisions: Benchmarking LLM Accuracy and Reliability on French Input Variants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33493)
*Jiaming Yu,Xiaotian Xie,Jian Ma,Yingjie Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文构建法语表层变体基准（7类任务、4,200组原始-低-高三元组、12,600实例），评测两个LLM家族共6个模型，发现扰动强度越高准确率越低、Brier与NLL越差；键盘拼写错误危害最大；原始输入拟合的校准温度可迁移到变体，校准+输入还原组合最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法语用户日常输入中常省略撇号和变音符号或产生键盘拼写错误，但这些常见表层变化对语言模型性能与预测可靠性的影响尚缺乏系统理解。

Method: 构建受控的法语表层变体基准，覆盖7种任务类型，包含4,200组原始-低强度-高强度三元组（共12,600条输入），高强度变体在保留低强度全部编辑的基础上进一步叠加改动；评测来自两个LLM家族的6个模型，同时考察任务准确率与概率质量指标（Brier分数、NLL），并分析模型规模效应、按变体类型的差异、校准温度迁移性以及校准与输入还原的组合效果。

Result: 准确率随扰动强度上升而下降，Brier分数与NLL随强度上升而升高；高强度下更大模型的准确率损失更小，但Brier与NLL的增幅并不随规模稳定减小；在预设高强度设置下，键盘拼写错误导致准确率和预测概率质量的最大损失；在原始输入上拟合的校准温度能有效迁移到表层变体；校准与输入还原结合在保持还原后准确率的同时，较任一单独方法进一步改善Brier与NLL。

Conclusion: 该基准为在常见法语表层变化下联合评估任务准确率与预测可靠性提供了统一框架，并表明表层扰动对概率校准的影响不能仅靠模型规模化解决，校准与输入还原具有互补性。

Abstract: French users may omit apostrophes and diacritics or make keyboard typos in everyday input. The effects of these common variations on language model performance and prediction reliability remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we construct a controlled French surface-variant benchmark covering seven task types, with 4,200 original-low-high triplets (12,600 input instances). Each high-intensity variant retains all low-intensity edits and adds further changes. We evaluate six models from two LLM families. The results show that accuracy decreases and Brier score and negative log-likelihood (NLL) increase with perturbation intensity. Larger models show smaller accuracy losses under high intensity, but increases in Brier score and NLL do not consistently decrease with scale. Keyboard typos cause the largest losses in accuracy and the quality of predicted probabilities at the predefined high-intensity settings. Finally, calibration temperatures fitted on original inputs transfer effectively to surface variants. Combining calibration with input restoration further improves Brier score and NLL over either method alone while preserving restored accuracy. Our benchmark provides a unified framework for jointly evaluating task accuracy and prediction reliability under common French surface variations.

</details>


### [271] [Five Architectures, One Shared Space Cross-Model Representational Alignment Without Weight Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33495)
*Oladimeji Anthonio,Dimeji Olawuyi,Oloruntoba Ajayi,Temilola Aderemi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 五个冻结且独立训练的模型（4个Transformer+1个状态空间模型）仅通过激活建立了统计上稳健的共享表征空间；该空间在最后一层检索精度达0.91-0.93，优于成对线性映射，但在中间层更差、在数学逻辑符号上失败，且基于该空间的路由器未能在任何任务上超越最强单模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型合并通常依赖权重平均，前提是模型共享同一初始化起点。作者质疑：若放弃权重合并，仅凭激活，结构设计不同、独立训练的冻结模型之间是否存在可度量、可复用的对应关系？

Method: 使用排列检验、独立复现探针集、逐层深度扫描、池化消融与混淆因素检验验证跨模型对应关系；用广义Procrustes分析（GPA）构建无固定参考模型的共享空间；与成对线性映射对比；在四类可评分任务上测试基于该空间的路由器。全部实验在单台无GPU笔记本上完成。

Result: 跨模型表征对应关系在各自最后一层最强，状态空间模型较弱但其最弱配对仍为随机水平的35-43倍；最终层二十个有序模型对的留出检索平均精度0.91-0.93（随机0.03），优于成对线性映射（0.82-0.85），但在中间层反而不如后者；可迁移至语法形式陌生的普通英语，在数学与逻辑记号上失败；四类任务中路由均未超越始终使用最强模型，且看似强的正确性信号实为类别归属的伪装。

Conclusion: 独立训练、结构异构的模型之间存在强而稳健的激活层面共享结构，可构建统一共享空间并支持跨模型检索，但该空间尚不足以支撑有效的模型路由器；路由失败作为负面结果被报告，并提示此类"正确性信号"需警惕类别混淆。

Abstract: Combining language models is usually done by averaging weights, which works only when the models share a common starting point. We ask whether five frozen, independently trained models with different internal designs (four transformers from four organizations and one state-space model) can be related through their activations alone, with no weight merging. Using permutation tests, an independent replication probe set, depth sweeps, pooling ablations and confound checks, we find statistically robust correspondence between how the five models organize the same text. It is strongest at each model's final layer and weaker for the state-space model, whose weakest pairing is still 35-43 times chance. We use this to build a shared space with Generalized Procrustes Analysis, in which no model is a fixed reference. At the final layer, mean held-out retrieval accuracy over the twenty ordered model pairs is 0.91 to 0.93 on two probe sets (chance 0.03), beating pairwise linear maps (0.82 to 0.85), but the space is worse than those maps in the middle layers. It transfers to ordinary English of unfamiliar grammatical form and fails on mathematical and logical notation. We then test whether the space supports a router that picks among the five models on gradeable tasks. Across four task types we find no case where routing beats always using the strongest model, and we report this as a negative result. A correctness signal that looked strong turned out to be category membership in disguise. All experiments ran on one laptop without a GPU.

</details>


### [272] [Towards a Learnable Retriever for Textual Graph Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33511)
*Kaifeng Jin,Yuchen Yan,Zhichen Zeng,Xiao Lin,Lihui Liu,Yinglong Xia,Hanghang Tong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TaLenT 提出一种基于 LLM 的端到端“检索-生成”框架用于文本图问答：将检索器本身设计为可学习的 LLM，并用金标准答案信号以加权伪标签损失监督证据节点选择，在三个 GraphQA 数据集上稳定提升下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GraphQA / GraphRAG 方法存在两个缺口：(1) 架构缺口——通常只微调 LLM 生成器，而未把检索器本身做成可学习的 LLM，缺乏统一的端到端 retrieve-then-generate 管线；(2) 检索监督缺口——检索器很少利用金标准答案信号监督证据选择，导致金答案所需证据节点召回不足、覆盖不全，而简单提升召回又引入大量无关信息，损害紧凑性并淹没 LLM。

Method: TaLenT 由可学习的 LLM 检索器（负责证据选择）与微调的 LLM 生成器组成，二者统一在一个 retrieve-then-generate 管线中。监督方面，将图节点分层为金标准答案、答案相关节点与无关噪声三类，采用加权伪标签损失：对金答案赋高权重、保留答案相关节点以保证覆盖、丢弃无关噪声以保证紧凑。

Result: 在三个 GraphQA 数据集上的实验表明，TaLenT 一致提升下游问答性能。

Conclusion: 通过让检索器成为可学习 LLM 并以金答案信号进行分层加权监督，TaLenT 在覆盖性与紧凑性之间取得平衡，验证了端到端 LLM 检索-生成范式对文本图问答的有效性。

Abstract: Textual graph question answering (GraphQA) and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) have gained increasing attention as a way to ground large language models (LLMs) on structured knowledge. Despite extensive efforts, existing methods still face two key gaps. The first is an architectural gap: existing methods typically fine-tune an LLM-based generator, but do not also make the retriever itself a learnable LLM for graph evidence selection within one end-to-end retrieve-then-generate pipeline. The second is a retrieval-supervision gap: existing retrievers rarely use gold answer signals to supervise evidence selection. As a result, they may fail to recall evidence nodes required for reasoning, resulting in insufficient coverage of the gold answer set; meanwhile, naive attempts to boost recall often introduce excessive irrelevant information that compromises compactness and overwhelms the LLM. To address these gaps, we propose TaLenT, an LLM-based end-to-end retriever-generator framework for textual GraphQA. To bridge the architectural gap, TaLenT pairs a learnable LLM-based retriever for evidence selection with a fine-tuned LLM-based generator within one unified retrieve-then-generate pipeline. To bridge the retrieval-supervision gap, we leverage gold answer signals as retriever supervision. Specifically, we stratify graph nodes into gold answers, answer-related nodes, and irrelevant noise. We then adopt a weighted pseudo-label loss to prioritize gold answers and preserve answer-related nodes for coverage, while discarding irrelevant noise for compactness. Experimental results across three GraphQA datasets demonstrate that TaLenT consistently improves downstream performance.

</details>


### [273] [Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33512)
*Hyun Ryu,Jong-Heon Kim,Yiqing Xie,Seungone Kim,Carolyn Rose,Eunho Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FORK奖励，在评分细则(rubric)覆盖率(召回)之外联合优化精确率目标，缓解rubric-based RL导致的冗长与事实错误问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于评分细则的奖励使模型主要最大化"召回"（rubric覆盖率），导致RL后模型回答更完整但更冗长、含不必要或事实错误内容，甚至不如基座模型受偏好。

Method: FORK奖励联合优化召回与新的精确率目标：要求回答中每个单元既"必要"（由rubric驱动的重要性/必要性评分，necessity credits衡量）又"事实正确"（由事实正确性评分器判定）。

Result: FORK优于现有rubric-based RL方法，实现兼顾rubric覆盖与整体回答质量的Pareto最优；相比原始召回奖励，在覆盖度相近时显著提升精确率、缩短回答长度，相对基座策略胜率大幅提升（RubricHub-Medical 10.6%→68.0%，HealthBench 22.1%→74.1%）。

Conclusion: 仅优化召回不足，引入必要性与事实正确性构成的精确率目标可纠正冗长与错误倾向，使rubric-based RL在非可验证任务上取得质量与覆盖的平衡。

Abstract: Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. However, because these rewards are typically defined as a weighted measure of rubric coverage, models are trained primarily to maximize a recall objective. As a result, RL-trained models produce responses that are more complete but also more verbose and contain more unnecessary or factually incorrect content, leading them to be less preferred than responses from the base model. To address this issue, we present the FORK reward, which jointly optimizes recall and a novel precision objective, which requires each unit of a model response to be both necessary and factually correct, as measured by rubric-driven necessity credits and a factual-correctness grader, respectively. Our experimental results show that FORK outperforms existing rubric-based RL methods and achieves Pareto-optimal performance that balances rubric coverage and overall response quality. Compared to the original recall-based reward, FORK substantially improves precision and reduces response length while achieving similar rubric coverage, which leads to significantly higher win rate compared to the base policy (e.g., from 10.6% to 68.0% on RubricHub-Medical and from 22.1% to 74.1% on HealthBench).

</details>


### [274] [One Model, Two Paths: Balancing Single-Pass and Looped Performance in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33517)
*Jiarun Shen,Lei Zhao,Xiao Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过在中层权重上复用进行循环推理，并采用单次/循环双输出加权联合训练（辅以冻结原模型指导），可在保持单次推理质量的前提下提升循环预测效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复Transformer层可在不增加参数的情况下提升语言模型性能，但单次推理与循环推理共享权重，导致为改善循环预测而训练时可能损害单次推理质量，需要研究如何兼顾两条路径。

Method: 研究对两条输出施加加权损失的联合训练策略，并引入冻结的原始模型作为指导；分析各因素（单次损失权重、冻结模型指导）对结果的贡献，并用验证集选择权重。

Result: 联合监督相比仅循环训练显著降低单次性能退化，同时相对普通继续训练仍保留循环增益；收益主要来自调整单次损失权重，冻结原模型指导进一步提升循环输出；验证集选权重可在预设容差内保持单次质量并改善循环预测。

Conclusion: 加权联合训练配合冻结模型指导是一种有效的双路径适配方案，可缓解共享权重带来的性能权衡，实现单次质量可控退化下的循环性能提升。

Abstract: Repeating Transformer layers can improve language-model performance without adding parameters. A pretrained model can be adapted to support both single-pass and looped inference by reusing middle-layer weights for additional computation. Because both paths share weights, training to improve looped predictions can degrade single-pass quality. We study joint training strategies using weighted losses on both outputs, with guidance from the frozen original model. Joint supervision substantially reduces single-pass degradation compared to looped-only training, while preserving looped gains over ordinary continued training. Most of this benefit comes from adjusting the single-pass loss weight, with guidance from the frozen original model further improving the looped output. With validation-selected weights, our method preserves single-pass quality within a predefined tolerance of ordinary continued training while improving looped predictions.

</details>


### [275] [SEDATE: Do Large Language Models Share an Aggression Circuit Across Languages?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33542)
*Sagnik Basu,Sayan Das,Somnath Banerjee,Animesh Mukherjee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法SEDATE，通过“检测-编辑-验证”定位并编辑责任神经元以提升AI响应的安全性与可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态与多语言场景下的AI安全干预手段计算或标注成本高，且难以扩展到多语言环境。

Method: SEDATE采用免训练策略：先检测负责不安全行为的神经元，必要时对其进行编辑，最后验证模型响应，全程无需额外训练。

Result: 在7种语言、4个模型家族上评估，并在4种分布外语言和4个额外数据集上验证；各语言与模型的安全得分均显著优于最佳基线，同时保持通用能力且开销可忽略，分布外场景趋势一致。

Conclusion: SEDATE为多语言安全部署提供了低成本、可迁移且稳健的免训练方案。

Abstract: As the applications of AI continue to expand across various multimodal and multilingual domains, ensuring safe and responsible deployment of these systems has become an important concern. A wide-range of interventions have been proposed to make AI responses safer and more reliable. They often incur substantial computational or annotation costs, or cannot be extended to multilingual settings. In this work, we propose Selective Detection And Targeted Editing (SEDATE), a training-free approach based on detect-edit-verify strategy. SEDATE first detects the responsible neurons, edits them as and when necessary and finally verifies the model responses; all without any additional model training. We evaluate SEDATE across 7 languages and 4 model families. We further evaluate its effectiveness across 4 out-of-distribution languages and 4 additional datasets. We show that SEDATE achieves substantially superior safety scores across all languages and models over the best-performing baseline while retaining the general capabilities and incurring negligible overhead. Our results are robust, with the trends remaining similar for out-of-distribution languages and datasets.

</details>


### [276] [Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33568)
*Yihao Hu,Zhihao Wen,Yitong Lin,Siyuan Lu,Pan Wang,Wei Wu,Jiang-Ming Yang,Tao Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Trajectory2Gym，将工具使用轨迹监督从"收集成功轨迹"重构为"主动构造可学习的交互经验"：围绕欠支撑的组合结构生成可执行交互，并仅从其真实执行中被可见历史所支撑的决策提取监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成功的工具使用轨迹并不等同于有效监督：成功交互可能低估多步依赖关系，或包含在决策时刻依据可见信息无法被合理解释的动作。作者据此识别出有效轨迹监督的两个耦合要求——组合覆盖（重要观察-动作依赖需被表示）与决策落地（每条被监督的动作须由学习者可见的交互历史支撑）。

Method: Trajectory2Gym：围绕支撑不足的组合结构构造可执行交互，监督信号仅取自其真实执行中的落地决策；采用结构支撑选择（structural-support selection）分配所得经验，并用父节点归一化的监督微调（parent-normalized SFT）以语义交互为单位保持训练权重。

Result: 在五个Qwen3规模上，Tau1、Tau2、BFCL均全面提升，三基准等权平均提升16.9–29.8个百分点；增益在有状态、多轮交互场景中最显著，即后续决策依赖先前观察与反馈的情形。

Conclusion: 扩展工具使用智能体的关键不仅在于收集更多成功轨迹，更在于构造其依赖被充分表示、其决策可从智能体可见历史学习的交互经验。

Abstract: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible interaction history. We introduce Trajectory2Gym, which constructs executable interactions around under-supported compositional structures and derives supervision only from grounded decisions in their realized executions. Structural-support selection allocates the resulting experience, while parent-normalized supervised fine-tuning preserves the semantic interaction as the unit of training weight. This reframes trajectory generation as the deliberate construction of learnable interaction experience, rather than the collection of successful trajectories. Across five Qwen3 scales, Trajectory2Gym improves Tau1, Tau2, and BFCL at every tested scale, increasing the equal-weight three-benchmark mean by 16.9-29.8 percentage points. The gains are strongest in stateful and multi-turn interaction, where later decisions depend on earlier observations and feedback. Our results suggest that scaling tool-use agents depends not only on collecting more successful trajectories, but on constructing interactions whose dependencies are represented and whose decisions are learnable from the agent's visible history.

</details>


### [277] [When the Weakest Language Keeps Moving: ARMOR-DP for Multilingual BabyLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33583)
*Hanyu Liao,Yijing Chen,Tao Ji*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ARMOR-DP模块化框架，用各语言验证损失动态调整采样比例，替代固定的语言采样比例/固定语言保护策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言BabyLM系统通常固定语言采样比例，但训练过程中最弱语言会发生变化（representation、exposure、capacity、objective pressure失衡所致），固定的语言标签式保护会失效甚至造成新的弱项。

Method: ARMOR-DP框架：诊断由表征、暴露量、容量与目标压力四类来源导致的失衡；以per-language validation loss为信号构建动态控制器更新采样比例，将诊断与干预解耦，使保护跟随当前瓶颈语言；并以受控实验考察字符预算均等带来的中文表征伪影、byte-level编码的缓解作用，以及与静态中文保护基线的对比。

Result: 等字符预算对中文造成严重representation artifact，byte-level编码可大部分消除；静态中文保护随后使英语成为最弱语言；动态控制器能跟踪这些转换，取得优于固定保护的score–balance权衡；官方评测中curriculum-dynamic checkpoint在更少中文epoch下优于匹配的静态中文保护基线；扩大容量得到最强的内部ARMOR-DP系统。

Conclusion: 多语言中的“弱”是训练时的状态而非语言的固定属性；ARMOR-DP将诊断与干预分离，使保护跟随当前瓶颈而非预设语言标签。

Abstract: Multilingual BabyLM systems usually fix language sampling proportions even though the weakest language can change during training. We present ARMOR-DP, a modular framework that diagnoses imbalance arising from representation, exposure, capacity, and objective pressure, and uses per-language validation loss to update sampling. Controlled experiments show that equal character budgets create a severe representation artifact for Chinese; byte-level encoding removes much of it, while static Chinese protection can subsequently make English the weakest language. The dynamic controller tracks these transitions and achieves a better score--balance tradeoff than fixed protection. On official evaluation, curriculum-dynamic checkpoints outperform a matched static Chinese-protective baseline while using fewer Chinese epochs; scaling capacity yields the strongest internal ARMOR-DP system. These results support a simple conclusion: multilingual weakness is a training-time state rather than a fixed property of a language. ARMOR-DP therefore separates diagnosis from intervention, allowing protection to follow the current bottleneck instead of a predetermined language label.

</details>


### [278] [Words Are the Voice of the Mind: Depression Severity Estimation from Social Traces via Mental-Guided Evidence Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33586)
*Nada Xu,Xueqin Chen,Qiang Gao,Hongru Liang,Wenqiang Lei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出UMer框架，通过用户特定心理先验、量表引导的多查询检索与由粗到细的证据推理，实现基于社交媒体痕迹的抑郁严重程度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统抑郁评估依赖临床访谈或自评问卷，需用户主动参与。社交媒体痕迹可反映心理状态，但现有方法（文本特征分类、LLM完成标准化量表）在用户特定心理先验建模、多样化语义检索及细粒度证据推理三方面存在不足。

Method: UMer包含三步：(1) 从历史社交痕迹中蒸馏用户特定心理先验，刻画心理倾向、行为模式与自我表达风格；(2) 进行量表引导的多查询检索，由条目相关帖子构建证据记忆；(3) 执行由粗到细的证据感知推理，区分直接与间接证据，输出条目级分数及可解释依据。

Result: 在真实世界基准上实验表明，UMer在性能上优于或可比于现有基线，并提供有证据支撑的可解释性，且可泛化到其他基于量表的任务。

Conclusion: 融合用户先验建模、检索增强与层次化证据推理，可有效提升社交媒体抑郁严重程度估计的性能与可解释性，并具备跨任务迁移潜力。

Abstract: Depression severity estimation is crucial for mental health assessment and intervention, yet traditional approaches depend on clinical interviews or self-report questionnaires that require users' active participation. With the widespread use of online social media, users leave rich social traces that may reflect their mental states, motivating the task of social media-based depression severity estimation. Existing efforts have progressed from textual-feature-based classification to LLM-based questionnaire completion over standardized scale items, yet they still fall short in user-specific mental priors modeling, diversified semantic retrieval, and fine-grained reasoning over mental evidence. To address these limitations, we propose UMer, a user-specific mental evidence reasoning framework for social traces-based depression severity estimation. UMer first distills a user-specific mental prior from historical social traces to capture the user's psychological tendencies, behavioral patterns, and self-expression style. It then performs scale-guided multi-query retrieval to construct evidence memories from item-relevant posts. Finally, it conducts coarse-to-fine evidence-aware reasoning to distinguish direct and indirect evidence and predict item-level scores with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that UMer not only achieves competitive performance over existing baselines, but also provides evidence-grounded interpretability and generalizes to other scale-based tasks.

</details>


### [279] [Mycelium: A Meta-Study of Hallucination Detection Across Provenance, Typology, and Granularities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33608)
*Julia Belikova,Elisei Rykov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文将幻觉检测视为"基准条件依赖的测量问题"，提出provenance、typology、granularity三轴框架来组织现有基准，分析基准构建对检测任务与评估结果的塑造作用，并提出Span Coverage F1以补充span级评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法在不同基准上比较，而这些基准对幻觉的定义与度量方式差异很大，导致报告分数难以跨设定解读；同时span级评估中标注边界差异会显著影响结果，跨基准比较的有效性存疑。

Method: 提出三轴分析框架：（1）provenance——模型输出与证据条件的获取方式；（2）typology——基准标签所代表的factuality与faithfulness失败类型；（3）granularity——幻觉被标注、预测与评估的单位。据此分析基准构建、标注与评估选择如何改变底层预测任务，并将检测器机制与假设同其性能测量设定相关联；针对span级评估提出基于包含关系的Span Coverage F1指标。

Result: 框架揭示检测器分数实际捕捉的内容随基准条件而变化，说明跨基准比较存在局限；span级评估中标注边界变化会显著影响报告结果，Span Coverage F1可作为对边界敏感的现有指标的补充度量。

Conclusion: 幻觉检测评估应显式条件化于基准设定；需更明确地评估检测器跨基准条件的泛化能力，并谨慎对待跨基准分数比较。

Abstract: Hallucination detection is increasingly important for evaluating and deploying large language models. However, existing methods are often compared across benchmarks that define and measure hallucination in substantially different ways, making reported scores difficult to interpret across settings. We study hallucination detection as a benchmark-conditioned measurement problem and organize existing benchmarks along three axes: provenance, which describes how model outputs and evidence conditions are obtained; typology, which captures the factuality and faithfulness failures represented by benchmark labels; and granularity, which specifies the unit at which hallucinations are annotated, predicted, and evaluated. Using this framework, we analyze how benchmark construction, annotation, and evaluation choices shape the underlying prediction task, and relate detector mechanisms and assumptions to the settings in which their performance is measured. We also examine span-level evaluation, where variation in annotation boundaries can substantially affect reported results, and propose Span Coverage F1 as a complementary containment-based metric. Our analysis clarifies what detector scores capture, highlights limitations of cross-benchmark comparisons, and motivates more explicit evaluation of generalization across benchmark conditions.

</details>


### [280] [RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33624)
*Yue Huang,Yanbo Wang,Lichi Li,Yuanyuan Chen,Andreas Haupt,Xiaonan Luo,Zheyuan Liu,Jihye Choi,Felix Juefei-Xu,Xiangliang Zhang,Radha Poovendran,Misha Sra,Ying Liu,Ben Burtenshaw,Thomas Wolf,Alex Pentland,Zichen Chen,Zhangchen Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 RSI Arena：一个两阶段、可审计的自主后训练实验，让十个前沿模型作为"训练代理"在受限算力与预算下自行完成数据选择、训练实现与检查点筛选，并利用用户反馈进行第二轮改进。结果显示十个代理都能产出可用的助手，最佳者弥合了76%的基座到Instruct差距，且八/十个模型在风格校正后的偏好评分上从第一阶段到第二阶段有所提升；但基准分数的提升与偏好提升缺乏明显关联，且出现长度膨胀与有害合规上升等风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索 AI 代理能否自主训练有用的语言模型，并利用用户反馈持续改进，即迈向"带人类反馈的递归自我改进"（RSIHF）。现有研究缺乏一个可控、可审计的环境来比较不同代理的自主后训练能力及其对反馈的利用情况，因此需要一个标准化的竞技场式设定。

Method: 两阶段研究。第一阶段为期六天，十个前沿模型作为训练代理，各自从 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base 出发，在共享的 64-GPU 集群上各拥有 1,000 GPU 小时与 300 美元 API 额度，独立选择数据、实现训练流程并挑选检查点。评估采用 20 个基准测试与盲测人工评价。第二阶段给每个代理提供涉及自身第一阶段模型的对比记录与投票，并追加三天训练时间。以 NVIDIA Instruct 作为跨两轮评估的公共参照，用经风格（长度与格式）校正后的相对评分进行比较。

Result: 十个代理全部产出可工作的助手；最强模型（由 GPT-6 Astra 训练）在 12 个能力基准上中位数弥合了 76% 的基座到 Instruct 差距，其人类偏好评分经长度与格式统计校正后接近 NVIDIA Instruct。第二阶段中，十个模型里有八个的风格校正相对评分较第一阶段提升。基准指标的提升幅度有限，且与偏好提升无明确关联；部分代理倾向于生成更长回答，另有一个模型在 StrongREJECT 上的有害合规率上升。

Conclusion: RSI Arena 提供了一个可审计的环境，用于研究人类反馈如何引导自主模型开发，是迈向"带人类反馈的递归自我改进"（RSIHF）的一步——由人类参与界定"改进"的含义。同时，实验揭示基准分数与人类偏好脱耦、长度膨胀和安全性退化等隐患，说明自主后训练需要更严谨的评估与安全约束。

Abstract: Can AI agents autonomously train useful language models and improve them using feedback from users? We introduce RSI Arena, a two-stage study of autonomous post-training as a step toward recursive self-improvement. Ten frontier models act as training agents, each starting from NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base. During a six-day first stage, each agent has 1,000 GPU-hours and $300 in API credit on a shared 64-GPU cluster, independently selecting data, implementing training procedures, and choosing checkpoints. We evaluate their models on 20 benchmarks and through blind human evaluations. All ten agents produce working assistants, with the strongest model, trained by GPT-6 Astra, closing a median of 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across 12 capability benchmarks. Its human-preference rating is also close to NVIDIA Instruct after statistical adjustment for answer length and formatting. In Stage 2, each agent receives the comparison records and votes involving its Stage 1 model and is given three additional days for further training. Using NVIDIA Instruct as a common reference across the two evaluation rounds, we observe an improvement from Stage 1 to Stage 2 in the style-adjusted relative rating of eight of the ten models. We show that benchmark gains were modest, with no clear link to preference gains, while some agents encouraged longer responses and one model showed increased harmful compliance on StrongREJECT. RSI Arena provides an auditable setting for studying how human feedback can guide autonomous model development. It takes a step toward recursive self-improvement with human feedback (RSIHF), in which people help define what improvement means for the AI systems they use.

</details>


### [281] [Embedding-Based Educational Taxonomies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33694)
*Kia Karbasi,Kaveh Karbasi,Gregory Pottie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究用语义文本嵌入聚类来自动构建基于嵌入的教育分类体系（education taxonomy），并在ASSISTments数据集上与CCSS知识组件分类体系比较，发现二者存在实质性但不完全的对应关系；用于深度知识追踪时AUC提升约3-5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统教育分类体系（技能/知识组件）依赖人工专家构建与迭代精炼，成本高且主观；而语义文本嵌入的进展使从内容本身计算性地构建替代性分类体系成为可能，作者据此探究该自动构建方案的可行性与其在下游教育建模中的效用。

Method: 对数学题目的语义嵌入进行聚类，构建基于嵌入的教育分类体系；在两个ASSISTments数据集上与现有的基于CCSS的知识组件分类体系进行对比，并以深度知识追踪（Deep Knowledge Tracing）作为依赖题目—知识组件映射的下游任务，评估不同分类体系下的预测性能。

Result: 嵌入分类体系与现有CCSS分类体系呈现实质性但不完全的对应，既保留了既有结构，也揭示了教育内容的替代性组织方式；在知识追踪任务中，嵌入分类体系使预测性能提升约3-5个AUC百分点。

Conclusion: 语义嵌入具有自动构建教育分类体系的潜力：其既能恢复人工分类体系中的部分结构，又能提供对下游教育建模有用的替代表示。

Abstract: Educational taxonomies organize educational content, such as exercise problems, into concepts, which are also called skills or knowledge components.
