These taxonomies define learning objectives in educational applications such as intelligent tutoring systems. Developed through human expertise and iterative refinement, they also provide fundamental structure for curricula, assessment, and models of student learning. Recent advances in semantic text embeddings make it possible to construct alternative educational taxonomies computationally from the content itself. In this paper, we investigate this possibility by clustering embeddings of math questions to construct embedding-based educational taxonomies. We compare these taxonomies with the existing Common Core State Standards (CCSS)-based knowledge-component taxonomies in two ASSISTments datasets and evaluate their utility in Deep Knowledge Tracing, a downstream task that relies on taxonomic mappings of questions to knowledge components. The embedding-based taxonomies exhibit substantial but incomplete correspondence with the existing taxonomies, revealing both preserved and alternative organizations of educational content. When used for knowledge tracing, they improve predictive performance by approximately 3-5 AUC percentage points. These results demonstrate the potential of semantic embeddings for automatically constructing educational taxonomies that both recover structure present in human-developed taxonomies and provide useful alternative representations for downstream educational modeling.

</details>


### [282] [Gender Associations in LLM-Mediated ADHD Self-Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33697)
*Matilde Elene Hansen,Ross Deans Kristensen-McLachlan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究将Context Association Test (CAT)适配到零样本自诊断场景，考察GPT-4o在ADHD诊断中是否对性别化关联产生不同回应，发现显式性别线索会放大某些ADHD亚型关联，而隐式线索产生的分布更接近代理基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被用于医疗自我诊断，但人口学线索如何塑造输出尚不清楚；ADHD存在持续性别差异且与临床证据不完全一致，使该问题尤为关键。

Method: 将Context Association Test (CAT)改造为性别化的ADHD自诊断测试，在零样本、自我诊断设定下对比显式与隐式性别线索条件下GPT-4o的关联输出。

Result: 显式线索一致地放大特定ADHD亚型的性别关联；隐式线索则给出接近代理基准（proxy-aligned）的分布；两者出现明显分歧。

Conclusion: 显式人口学线索可能激活过度矫正的偏见缓解机制，而隐式线索更反映模型默认行为；评估LLM自诊断中的性别偏见须关注模型所编码的人口学关联。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical self-diagnosis. However, the way demographic cues shape outputs in these interactions remains poorly understood. This is particularly consequential for diagnoses like ADHD, where persistent gender disparities are not fully aligned with the clinical evidence. We adapt the Context Association Test (CAT) to evaluate whether GPT-4o responds to gendered ADHD associations in a zero-shot, self-diagnostic setting. We show that explicit cueing consistently amplifies certain ADHD subtype associations while implicit cueing produces near proxy-aligned distributions. These divergences suggest that explicit demographic cues may activate bias-mitigation mechanisms that over-correct rather than eliminate bias, whereas implicit cues appear to reflect the model's default behavior. Our results demonstrate that evaluating gendered bias in LLM-mediated self-diagnosis requires careful attention to the demographic associations a model encodes.

</details>


### [283] [Beyond Prompts: A Systematic Study of LLM-Based Machine Translation Evaluators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33741)
*Dmitry Popov,Roman Bokhyan,Ekaterina Enikeeva,Artem Mekhraliev,Stepan Vysotsky,Nikolay Karpachev*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM机器翻译评测器的设计要素（指令设计、少样本示例、骨干模型、多步流程）对跨度级与排序评测的影响，并据此提出ORBIT评测器家族，在专家级性能下成本约为人工标注的1/20。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评测器已成为机器翻译评测的标准工具，但其设计选择如何影响评测行为仍缺乏系统理解，缺乏可迁移的设计原则。

Method: 在WMT24与WMT25英俄翻译上收集新的专家RATE标注，并在MQM与ESA标注基准、五个额外语言对上做迁移验证；控制变量考察指令结构、少样本示例、骨干模型选择与多步工作流的影响；将发现综合为ORBIT评测器家族。

Result: 四项稳健结论：指令结构塑造评测器行为；高质量示例比数量更重要；前沿骨干模型呈现不同评测画像（召回型、精确型、排序型）；跨异构骨干融合优于单评测器多次调用。设计原则在标注协议与语言对间一致可迁移。

Conclusion: ORBIT最强配置在错误跨度检测及准确度与流畅度排序上达到专家级水平，成本约为专家人工标注的20倍降低。

Abstract: LLM-based evaluators have rapidly become a standard tool for machine translation evaluation, yet the design choices that shape their behavior remain poorly understood. We present a systematic study of how instruction design, few-shot demonstrations, backbone model choice, and multi-step workflows affect span-level and ranking-based MT evaluation. We collect new expert RATE annotations on WMT24 and WMT25 English-Russian translations, with transfer validation on MQM- and ESA-annotated benchmarks across five additional language pairs. Our experiments reveal four robust findings: instruction structure shapes evaluator behavior, high-quality demonstrations matter more than quantity, frontier backbones exhibit distinct evaluator profiles (recall-, precision-, or ranking-oriented), and fusing outputs across diverse backbones outperforms single-evaluator multi-call setups. Although evaluator design exposes a large combinatorial space, several discovered design principles transfer consistently across annotation protocols and language pairs. We synthesize these findings into ORBIT, a family of LLM-based MT evaluators. Our strongest configurations achieve expert-level performance in error span detection and in Accuracy and Fluency ranking at roughly 20x lower cost than expert human annotation.

</details>


### [284] [Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation: Rethinking Machine Translation Evaluation in the Era of Human-Level Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33749)
*Dmitry Popov,Vladislav Negodin,Ekaterina Enikeeva,Iana Matrosova,Nikolay Karpachev,Max Ryabinin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文批判现有机器翻译评估范式（MQM、ESA）的局限，提出高质量人工评估数据集与RATE评估协议，发现无时间压力的专家评估结果与标准评估显著不同，并揭示当前最优MT系统在准确性上或已超越人工译文，但流畅性仍落后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着机器翻译质量接近人类水平，传统评估方法难以检测细微翻译错误。现有金标准方法（MQM、ESA）存在标注者专业水平不一导致的不一致、错误分类过于复杂、严重程度粒度粗糙、重准确轻流畅、时间约束等问题，因此需要新的评估范式。

Method: 构建由专业语言学家对WMT24英俄翻译进行人工评估的高质量数据集；提出RATE（Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation）协议，包含精简的错误分类体系、扩展的严重程度评级、以及平衡准确性与流畅性的多维评分。

Result: 无时间压力的专家评估与标准评估结果存在实质性差异；基于该专家数据集的分析表明，最先进MT系统在准确性上可能已超越人工译文，但在流畅性上仍落后，而这一关键区别被现有偏重准确性的指标所掩盖。

Conclusion: 推进机器翻译评估不仅需要更好的协议，更关键的是需要来自专业语言学家的高质量标注。

Abstract: As machine translation systems approach human-level quality, traditional evaluation methodologies struggle to detect subtle translation errors. We critically examine limitations in current gold-standard approaches (MQM and ESA), including inconsistencies from variable annotator expertise, excessive categorization complexity, coarse severity granularity, accuracy bias over fluency, and time constraints. To address this issue, we introduce a high-quality dataset consisting of human evaluations for English-Russian translations from WMT24, created by professional linguists. We show that expert assessments without time pressure yield substantially different results from standard evaluations. To enable consistent and rich annotation by these experts, we developed the RATE (Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation) protocol. RATE provides a streamlined error taxonomy, expanded severity ratings, and multidimensional scoring balancing accuracy and fluency, facilitating deeper analysis of MT outputs. Our analysis, powered by this expert dataset, reveals that state-of-the-art MT systems may have surpassed human translations in accuracy while still lagging in fluency - a critical distinction obscured by existing accuracy-biased metrics. Our findings highlight that advancing MT evaluation requires not only better protocols but crucially, high-quality annotations from skilled linguists.

</details>


### [285] [RoleHear: Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Role-Attributed Streaming Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33765)
*Zefang Liu,Chenyang Zhu,Sangwoo Cho,Xujun Peng,Rongqing Huang,Shi-Xiong Zhang,Sambit Sahu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RoleHear 提出一种半监督流水线，使单个 cache-aware 流式 transducer 通过 in-vocabulary 角色 token 内联输出说话人角色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式 ASR 延迟低但只输出无归属的词流，而客服分析等实时应用需要把每个词绑定到说话人角色；现有做法需额外的离线/流式说话人日志对齐或文本 LLM 后处理，且角色标注训练数据稀缺。

Method: 用轻量 in-vocabulary 角色 token 内联输出角色：先输出快速 turn-boundary 标记，隔几个词后输出对应角色 token；将离线 transducer 教师微调为角色感知识别器，对无标注音频重标注；在缺少金标处用多模态大语言模型生成 silver 角色标签；流式学生模型在混合数据上单遍微调。

Result: 在带金标角色的客服通话和带 silver 角色的财报电话会议上，RoleHear 角色归属准确，同时保持转写质量，并缩小了与离线教师的差距。

Conclusion: 角色归属可直接融入流式 transducer 的内联 token 预测，结合教师重标注与 MLLM silver 标签的半监督方案可在低延迟下实现准确的角色归属且不损害识别质量。

Abstract: Streaming automatic speech recognition transcribes at low latency but produces an unattributed word stream, while real-time applications such as customer-service analytics need each word tied to a speaker role. Role attribution is usually a separate stage, either an offline or streaming speaker-diarization model aligned to the words or a text-based large language model applied to the transcript, and role labels for training are scarce. We present RoleHear, a semi-supervised pipeline that makes a single cache-aware streaming transducer emit roles inline through lightweight in-vocabulary role tokens: a fast turn-boundary marker followed by a per-role token a few words later. An offline transducer teacher, fine-tuned into a role-attributed recognizer, relabels unlabeled audio, and a multimodal large language model supplies silver role labels where gold annotations are unavailable. The streaming student is fine-tuned on the mixture in a single pass. Across customer-service calls with gold roles and earnings calls with silver roles, RoleHear attributes roles accurately while preserving transcription quality and narrowing the gap to the offline teacher.

</details>


### [286] [StateWise: Teaching Language Models to Track and Obey Evolving Constraints in Multi-Turn Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33766)
*Samarth Varshney,Ritu Yadav*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: StateWise teaches a single LLM to maintain its own revisable constraint state (typed state with tombstones for revoked constraints) via fine-tuning on state-summarization and state-conditioned response, self-training with round-trip checks, and a preference stage on self-generated relapse contrasts.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Users of conversational assistants add, amend, withdraw and return to constraints mid-dialogue. Instruction-tuned LLMs fail in two ways: active constraints stop being honored as turns accumulate (persistence failure), and withdrawn constraints keep being enacted (relapse). The only known repair is an external ledger that re-injects a compiled specification every turn, i.e., inference-time scaffolding.

Method: Propose a self-improving approach training one LLM to hold its own revisable typed constraint state with tombstones for revoked constraints; persistence and relapse are measured by executable checkers with free ground-truth state compilation. Fine-tune on two skills (dialogue→state summarization, state-conditioned response), self-train on own trajectories keeping only exact round-trip-checked turns, then add a preference stage on self-generated relapse contrasts (rejected enacts a revoked rule; chosen passes the round-trip check).

Result: On 7-8B models state tracking becomes near-perfect but obedience does not follow; on Llama-3.1-8B every supervised variant roughly doubles relapse. With the preference stage, on two backbones with held-out constraint families and unseen phrasings, relapse drops 8-22 points vs. supervised self-training, conversation success rises 8-19 points over the backbone, and it beats an oracle compiled-ledger baseline on relapse with no inference-time scaffolding. Also characterizes cost on general instruction-following benchmarks and studies weight interpolation as mitigation.

Conclusion: Maintaining accurate internal constraint state is necessary but insufficient for compliance; a preference stage on relapse contrasts is needed to convert state knowledge into behavior. StateWise outperforms an oracle external-ledger baseline on relapse without inference-time scaffolding, at measurable cost to general instruction following that weight interpolation can partially mitigate.

Abstract: Users of conversational assistants rarely state all requirements up front: they add constraints, amend them, withdraw them, digress, and return. Instruction-tuned LLMs fail here in two ways: active constraints stop being honored as turns accumulate (persistence failure), and withdrawn constraints keep being enacted (relapse). The only existing repair we know of is an external ledger that re-injects a compiled specification every turn. We propose StateWise, a self-improving approach that teaches a single LLM to maintain its own revisable constraint state, a typed state with tombstones for revoked constraints, so persistence and relapse are measured by executable checkers and ground-truth states are compiled for free. StateWise fine-tunes the LLM on two complementary skills, summarizing a dialogue into its constraint state and responding conditioned on that state, then self-trains on its own trajectories, keeping only turns that pass an exact round-trip check against the compiled state. This teaches 7-8B models to track the state almost perfectly but, surprisingly, not to obey it: on Llama-3.1-8B every supervised variant roughly doubles relapse. We therefore add a preference stage on self-generated relapse contrasts, where the rejected response enacts a revoked rule and the chosen one passes the round-trip check. On two backbones with held-out constraint families and unseen phrasings, StateWise cuts relapse by 8-22 points relative to supervised self-training, lifts conversation success by 8-19 points over the backbone, and beats an oracle compiled-ledger baseline on relapse with no inference-time scaffolding. We also characterize the recipe's cost on general instruction-following benchmarks and study weight interpolation as a mitigation.

</details>


### [287] [TriageRAG: Failure-Aware Self-Training for Adapting Retrieval-Augmented Language Models to Specialized Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33776)
*Samarth Varshney,Ritu Yadav*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TriageRAG：面向领域RAG自训练，按"学生是否已知/已解/读者失败/检索失败"四类对自生成样本分诊，并为每类路由对应训练信号，含教读者在检索缺失时作答的参数化路径。11个数据集上较预算匹配SimRAG提升1.2–6.4分，并在检索有害时全面恢复闭卷水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在仅有未标注语料的专业领域（如医学）适配通用RAG困难。SimRAG等自训练方法用LLM自写问答并做往返一致性过滤，但把保留样本一视同仁，不区分学生是否已知答案、能否从上下文正确抽取、失败源于读者还是检索器，导致训练信号粗糙。

Method: 对每个自生成问题，分别在有/无检索上下文下探测学生，将其划分为四类（known、solved、context-failure、retrieval-failure），每类路由到针对性训练信号，其中参数化路线使读者在检索缺失时也能作答；探测廉价且逐轮重复，训练混合随学生状态动态演化，分诊直方图兼作无标签的领域鸿沟诊断。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B骨干、跨三领域11个数据集，及Qwen3-8B上的CS-Bench实验中，TriageRAG较预算匹配的SimRAG提升1.2–6.4分；在检索反而损害基线的所有情形中，是唯一恢复到闭卷水平的方法。

Conclusion: 消融揭示机制：往返一致性过滤会剔除所有不含证据的训练上下文，从未见过此类上下文的读者因而学会过度信任噪声检索；分诊式差异化训练可修正该偏差，兼具性能与可解释诊断价值。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets large language models (LLMs) answer knowledge-intensive questions from retrieved evidence, but adapting a general-purpose RAG system to a specialized domain such as medicine is difficult when only an unlabeled corpus is available. Self-training approaches such as SimRAG address this by letting the LLM write its own question-answer pairs from domain passages and fine-tuning on the pairs that survive a round-trip consistency filter. We observe that these approaches treat every retained example identically: they never ask whether the student already knows the answer, already extracts it correctly from the retrieved context, or fails - and if so, whether the failure lies with the reader or with the retriever. To tackle this, we propose TriageRAG, a failure-aware self-training approach that probes the student on each self-generated question with and without retrieved context, triages it into one of four categories (known, solved, context-failure, retrieval-failure), and routes each category to the training signal that addresses it, including a parametric route that teaches the reader to answer when retrieval misses. Probing is cheap and repeated every round, so the training mixture follows the student, and the triage histogram doubles as a label-free diagnostic of where the domain gap lies. Experiments on 11 datasets spanning three domains with a Qwen3-4B backbone, and on CS-Bench with Qwen3-8B, demonstrate that TriageRAG outperforms a budget-matched SimRAG by 1.2-6.4 points and is the only method that recovers the closed-book level in every case where retrieval hurts the base model. A single ablation identifies the mechanism: round-trip filtering removes every training context that lacks the evidence, and a reader that never sees such contexts learns to over-trust noisy retrieval.

</details>


### [288] [MTA-Zero: Self-Improving Multimodal Deep Search via Online QA-Solver Co-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33799)
*Xiangyu Peng,Jiaxin Zhang,An Yan,Yu Li,Ran Xu,Zeyuan Chen,Chien-Sheng Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出MTA-Zero：一个无需预构建多跳语料的在线多模态QA–Solver协同训练框架，通过Goldilocks奖励引导QA生成器产出处于Solver能力前沿的问题，使多模态深度搜索智能体自提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在开放世界多步搜索（图像定位、工具选择、网页证据整合）上仍受限；而主流做法构建的固定离线语料，其问题分布无法随目标深度搜索智能体的进步而自适应，导致训练信号逐渐失配。

Method: 基于MTA-Agent的图像 grounded QA 构造，从图像VQA种子上下文出发，由可训练的QA Generator在线检索证据并生成经校验的多跳问题；独立的深度搜索Solver选择工具、收集证据并作答。以Solver的组内 rollout 成功率构造Goldilocks奖励：全对或全错的问题奖励为零，接近当前能力前沿者被偏好。两个策略各自用GRPO独立优化，不共享参数与梯度。

Result: 在六个多模态深度搜索基准上，将Qwen3-VL-8B Solver平均准确率从36.91%提升至51.58%，在同一智能体工作流下与GPT-5相当；对更新的Qwen3.6-27B Solver亦提升10.82个点。

Conclusion: 经校验的在线问题生成可为策略提供针对性的课程（policy-specific curriculum），从而持续提升多模态深度搜索智能体，且无需预计算多跳语料。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong visual reasoners, yet remain limited in open-world, multi-step search that requires grounding images, selecting tools, and integrating web evidence. Existing approaches typically construct and filter fixed offline corpora whose question distributions cannot adapt as the target deep-search agent improves. Building on MTA-Agent's image-grounded QA construction, we present MTA-Zero, an online multimodal QA-Solver co-training framework for self-improving multimodal deep-search agents that requires no precomputed multi-hop corpus. Starting from image-grounded VQA seed contexts, a trainable QA Generator retrieves evidence and constructs verified multi-hop questions online. A separate deep-search Solver then selects tools, gathers evidence, and answers the generated questions. To focus generation on the Solver's learning frontier, we derive a Goldilocks reward for the QA Generator from the Solver's group-wise rollout success rate: questions solved by all rollouts or by none receive zero reward, whereas questions near the current frontier are favored. We optimize the two policies independently with GRPO, without sharing parameters or gradients. Across six multimodal deep-search benchmarks, MTA-Zero improves a Qwen3-VL-8B Solver from 36.91% to 51.58% mean accuracy and achieves performance comparable to GPT-5 under the same agent workflow. The same framework also improves a newer Qwen3.6-27B Solver by 10.82 points. These results show that verified online question generation provides a policy-specific curriculum for continually improving multimodal deep-search agents.

</details>


### [289] [IntentDelta: A Human-Constructed Benchmark for Evolving User Intent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33806)
*Jieyu Zhou,Zijian Wang,Yun Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出IntentDelta多轮基准（638条轨迹、3766轮，覆盖WebShop与TravelPlanner），用于评测语言模型智能体在用户意图演化下的意图恢复与动作质量；11个智能体表现均较差（意图恢复33.1%/44.7%，动作得分31.6%/41.0%），且意图恢复正确并不保证执行成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测多假设用户需求静态不变，而真实复杂任务中用户会不断修订需求与优先级（约束增删、软偏好与硬约束转换）。缺少可量化"意图演化—动作执行"链条的基准，难以诊断智能体是意图跟踪失败还是意图到行动的映射失败。

Method: 人工构建多轮基准IntentDelta：638条轨迹、3,766轮，源自WebShop与TravelPlanner两个环境；每轮将用户话语与累积意图状态、人工参考动作配对；轨迹经交叉校验，覆盖可行性驱动与偏好驱动的约束/优先级变化。在意图恢复与动作质量两个维度上评测11个智能体。

Result: 平均意图恢复率TravelPlanner 33.1%、WebShop 44.7%；平均动作得分分别31.6%、41.0%。错误集中表现为：难以保留早期提出的需求、难以区分软偏好与硬性约束。意图恢复正确与执行成功之间存在明显解耦。

Conclusion: 持续意图跟踪与意图到行动的落地是当前智能体的双重瓶颈；IntentDelta提供了可分解的诊断性评测。未来工作需要显式的累积意图状态建模与约束类型（硬/软）区分，并联合优化意图恢复与执行成功率。

Abstract: Language-model agents must adapt as users revise their requirements and priorities during complex tasks. We introduce IntentDelta, a human-constructed multi-turn benchmark with 638 trajectories and 3,766 turns across WebShop and TravelPlanner. Each turn pairs a user utterance with a cumulative intention state and human reference actions. The trajectories are cross-verified and cover feasibility- and preference-driven changes in constraints and priorities. We evaluate eleven agents on intention recovery and action quality. Average Intention Recovery is 33.1\% in TravelPlanner and 44.7\% in WebShop, while average Action Score is 31.6% and 41.0%, respectively. Agents struggle to preserve earlier requirements and distinguish soft preferences from must-have constraints. Correct intention recovery also does not guarantee successful execution, highlighting challenges in translating evolving user intentions into actions.

</details>


### [290] [Task Format as a Factor in Adaptation: A Controlled Comparison of LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning for Prompt-Safety Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33813)
*John Alderete,Srirakshith Betageri,Jennifer Flynn,Alex Greenhalgh,Josh Rubin,Yoshita Varma Annam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在匹配的400M编码器-解码器模型上系统比较LoRA与全量微调用于提示安全分类：在预设学习率下全量微调一致领先LoRA 2–3个百分点，但统一学习率搜索后编码器上的差距消失；训练LoRA先给判定再写理由可提升4.0pp并消除差距；领域内准确率不能预测分布外鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA与全量微调的比较研究虽多但常存在混淆因素（学习率、模型规模、任务格式未控制），且任务格式（尤其是"先判定后给理由"的推理输出格式）对分类性能与鲁棒性的影响鲜有研究。作者希望在严格控制变量的条件下厘清"适配方式"与"训练细节"各自的作用。

Method: 以匹配的400M Ettin编码器-解码器模型为对象，在提示安全分类任务上比较LoRA与全量微调两种范式，交叉三种任务格式；每个实验单元最多15个随机种子，采用预注册（pre-specified）分析。分别考察：预设学习率下的直接对比；对两种方法使用同一学习率搜索后的对比；让LoRA在判定后生成理由（reason）与等长但无信息内容的句子作对照；并与prompted 8B模型在域内及三个分布外语料（含对抗性jailbreak、有害外观但良性的提示）上比较。

Result: 预设学习率下，全量微调在每种架构与格式（仅用标签训练）上均领先LoRA 2–3pp；在编码器上，当两者学习率由同一搜索确定后差距消失。LoRA在判定后生成理由带来+4.0pp并弥合差距，而等长无内容句子无此效果。训练模型域内表现优于prompted 8B，但在三个分布外语料中的两个上落后8–23pp（对抗性jailbreak），且将27–66%的良性但外观有害提示误判为不安全，而8B仅为2–3%。

Conclusion: 适配范式（LoRA vs 全量微调）的影响小于训练配置本身——学习率选择与训练目标（是否生成理由）才是关键变量；同时域内准确率是不充分的鲁棒性指标，需结合分布外与误报率评估。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a language model for classification involves many design decisions. Comparisons of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with full fine-tuning are common but often confounded, and task format is rarely studied. We compare both regimes on prompt-safety classification with a matched 400M encoder-decoder pair (Ettin) across three task formats, with up to 15 seeds per cell and pre-specified analyses. At the pre-specified learning rates, full fine-tuning leads LoRA by 2-3 pp in every architecture and format trained on the label alone. On the encoder, the gap closes once both rates are chosen by the same search. Training LoRA to write a reason after its verdict adds 4.0 pp and closes the gap, but a content-free sentence of equal length does not. Trained models score above a prompted 8B in domain but fall behind it on two of three out-of-distribution corpora, trailing by 8-23 pp on adversarial jailbreaks and flagging 27-66% of benign but harmful-looking prompts as unsafe, against the 8B's 2-3%. Together, the results suggest that the adaptation regime matters less than how each model is trained, its learning rate, and training target, and that in-domain accuracy alone is an incomplete guide to robustness.

</details>


### [291] [EdgeDeID: A 0.6B Clinical De-identifier Trained Without Real Patient Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33839)
*Sina Daneshgar,Raya Namazi,Amirali Khosravi,Pouria Rouzrokh,Bardia Khosravi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EdgeDeID：一个0.6B参数、纯本地运行且不使用真实病历训练的临床文本去标识化模型，在合成基准上达0.994微F1，但迁移到真实MIMIC护理记录时F1降至0.48。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去标识化方案将临床笔记发送给托管大模型，本身就会泄露本应受保护的信息；因此需要可在本地部署、且不依赖真实患者文本训练的去标识化器。

Method: 构建仅解码器架构的0.6B模型：三个LLM教师生成合成笔记，单一标注器按统一规范重新标注，模型学习输出所识别标识符的类型化XML schema。另考察三类监督训练外的增强：验证器适配器、召回加权强化学习、规则后处理层。量化后CPU运行内存615MB。

Result: 100条人工核验的合成域内基准上微F1为0.994，99%的笔记无漏检标识符，对比八个现成系统中最优者的0.857与12%。验证器适配器可区分其他系统的完整/不完整输出，AUROC 0.94；强化学习与规则后处理未改善域内结果。MIMIC ICU护理笔记上F1为0.48，误差源于电报式风格与低标识符密度两个合成数据缺失特性，三条手写上下文示例可在无标注目标数据下恢复0.08 F1。

Conclusion: 轻量本地模型可在合成数据上实现高精度去标识化并保护隐私，但合成数据与真实临床文本的风格和标识符分布差异导致明显域偏移；简单上下文示例是低成本的缓解手段，验证器适配器有助于过滤下游系统的不完整输出。

Abstract: De-identifying clinical notes with a hosted language model discloses the information the step is meant to protect. We present EdgeDeID, a 0.6B-parameter decoder-only de-identifier that runs locally and is trained without real patient text: three LLM teachers write synthetic notes, a single labeler re-annotates them into one convention, and the model learns to emit a typed XML schema of the identifiers it finds. On a 100-note synthetic in-domain benchmark with manually verified annotations it reaches 0.994 micro-F1 and leaves no missed identifier in 99% of notes, against 0.857 and 12% for the strongest of eight off-the-shelf systems. Quantized, it runs on CPU in 615 MB. Of three additions to supervised training, only a verifier adapter helps: it separates complete from incomplete outputs of other systems at 0.94 AUROC, whereas reinforcement learning with a recall-weighted reward and a rule-based post-processing layer leave in-domain results unchanged. On MIMIC ICU nursing notes F1 falls to 0.48. The errors follow two properties our synthetic notes lack, telegraphic style and low identifier density, and three hand-written in-context examples recover 0.08 F1 without annotated target data.

</details>


### [292] [When Personas Become Harmful: Guiding LLMs with Global Citizenship Values Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33899)
*Siqi Shen,Lajanugen Logeswaran,Moontae Lee,Honglak Lee,Rada Mihalcea*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出面向"价值负载人格"（value-laden personas）的LLM安全评测与对齐框架：基于Schwartz价值维度构建1.1万争议话题-人格配对数据集，用智能体流水线迭代挖掘商业LLM的有害响应（成功率>47%），以UNESCO全球公民原则界定"合法价值表达"与"有害行为"的边界，并提出可在推理时控制人格遵从度与安全性的对齐模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全基准与对齐方法主要针对显式恶意（对抗性）请求，而人格条件下的请求往往表面无害，危害源自人格与价值的组合，导致模型要么拒绝合法的价值表达，要么盲目服从不安全人格。因此需要一个能刻画"价值多元性下安全"的评测与对齐方案。

Method: 1) 构建11k争议话题×价值型人格的数据集，人格映射至Schwartz Value Survey价值维度；2) 采用智能体流水线迭代精炼话题与人格，以诱导并收集已对齐商业LLM的有害响应；3) 以UNESCO全球公民原则作为最小共识标准，区分有效价值表达与有害行为；4) 训练可控对齐模型，支持推理时在人格遵从与安全之间调节权衡。

Result: 智能体流水线在良好对齐的商业LLM上以超过47%的成功率挖掘出有害响应；所提出的可控对齐模型在多数样本上同时优于基线的人格遵从性与安全性。

Conclusion: 人格条件下的安全风险是现有对抗式对齐的盲区；细粒度价值维度建模加最小共识伦理标准，可在不压制合法价值表达的前提下实现安全，推理时可调的对齐控制为多元化用户需求提供了可行折中。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly being used by users from diverse demographics with pluralistic values and distinct backgrounds. Maintaining safety while respecting value-laden personas is uniquely challenging because persona-conditioned requests are often not overtly malicious, unlike those in existing safety benchmarks. Alignment methods aimed at adversarial requests therefore may miss the harm that emerges from persona use, leaving models to either refuse legitimate value expression or blindly follow unsafe personas. We construct a dataset of 11k controversial topics paired with value-based personas mapping to value dimensions from the Schwartz Value Survey. Through an agentic pipeline that iteratively refines the topic and persona, we surface and collect harmful responses from well-aligned commercial LLMs with a more than 47% success rate. We use UNESCO's global citizenship principles as a minimal common ground for distinguishing valid value expressions from harmful behaviors, and introduce a controllable alignment model that lets users balance persona adherence and safety at inference time. The resulting model is safer and more persona-adherent than baselines on most samples.

</details>


### [293] [HerHealthGPT: An Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI System for Women's Reproductive Health Copy title](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33931)
*Hassan Saeed Hassan Albattra,Mazen Mohammed Bahgat,Rahatara Ferdousi,Hana Essam Sayed Ahmed Amrya,Mariam Mousa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 HerHealthGPT，一个面向女性生殖健康的证据支撑型对话 AI 系统，融合 RAG、上下文感知澄清与来源校验，减少对不完整健康问询的即时作答，并通过离线评测与用户研究验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式 AI 面对不完整健康问询时往往直接作答，既不追问关键上下文，也不将建议建立在可验证证据之上，这在女性生殖健康场景中风险突出（如"月经推迟"需排除妊娠、周期波动等多因素）。因此需要一种能维持对话上下文、主动澄清并证据落地（grounding）的系统设计。

Method: 系统层面整合三部分：检索增强生成（RAG）用于证据检索与回复落地；上下文感知澄清模块（clarification router）维护对话状态、生成针对性追问并检测过早结论；来源校验（source validation）机制，并封装为交互式 Web 界面。评测包括：(1) AI 组件离线评测，使用 90 个生殖健康案例衍生的 540 条英文消息；(2) 30 名成年人参与的原型问卷用户研究。

Result: 证据检索相较仅微调将关注类别（concern-category）准确率由 54.1% 提升至 59.3%；澄清路由在构造目标上达到 85.6% 召回率与 86.2% 特异度；用户研究中 83.3% 参与者偏好启用检索的配置，30 人中有 25 人认为其追问具有相关性。

Conclusion: 证据检索与交互式澄清的结合是构建更透明、上下文感知的生殖健康信息系统的可行路径；但当前仅为原型验证，仍缺乏临床有效性验证，需后续开展临床评估。

Abstract: "Why is my period late?" Sometimes, the most useful response begins with another question. Yet conversational AI systems may respond to incomplete health queries without seeking essential context or grounding their guidance in verifiable evidence. This paper introduces HerHealthGPT, an evidence-grounded conversational AI system designed to address these challenges in women's reproductive health. HerHealthGPT integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context-aware clarification, and source validation within an interactive web interface. Rather than responding immediately to incomplete queries, the system maintains conversational context, asks targeted follow-up questions, checks for premature conclusions, and grounds its responses in retrieved evidence. We evaluate the AI components using 540 English messages derived from 90 reproductive-health cases and conduct a prototype questionnaire study with 30 adults. Evidence retrieval improves concern-category accuracy from 54.1% to 59.3% compared with fine-tuning alone. The clarification router achieves 85.6% recall and 86.2% specificity on constructed targets. In the user study, 83.3% of participants preferred the retrieval-enabled configuration, while 25 of 30 considered its follow-up questions relevant. These findings suggest that integrating evidence retrieval with interactive clarification offers a promising approach to more transparent, context-aware reproductive-health information systems, while further clinical validation remains necessary.

</details>


### [294] [Schema-Free Text-to-SQL: Learning Enterprise Database Structure from Query Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33946)
*Ömer Faruk Akgül,Nikhil Kapahi,Prajit Reddy Muppidi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出首个无需数据库模式文档的text-to-SQL框架，通过历史查询日志构建知识图谱，并用实体驱动的GraphRAG检索将用户问题锚定到业务术语，在企业部署与Beaver基准上显著优于基于嵌入的检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有text-to-SQL在学术基准上准确率高，但在企业部署中性能骤降。根因在于现有方法假设模式文档完整，而企业数据库通常缺乏文档，存在命名晦涩、关系隐式等问题。

Method: 不依赖模式文档，改从历史查询日志学习数据库结构：查询日志隐含表共现、连接方式、列与业务概念映射等结构知识。基于解析后的查询模式构建知识图谱，并引入实体驱动的GraphRAG检索，将用户问题锚定在领域术语上，而非仅依赖嵌入相似度。

Result: 在工业部署（专家评估）与Beaver基准上均大幅优于主流的相似度检索方法。Beaver上执行有效率达95.7%，对比嵌入检索的60.8%；内部部署中数据工程师以70%对10%的比例偏好该系统（其余为中立）。

Conclusion: text-to-SQL可在模式歧义的企业环境中有效运行，使自然语言数据库接口在真实场景中落地可行。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems achieve remarkable accuracy on academic benchmarks, yet performance drops dramatically in enterprise deployments. This gap stems from a fundamental assumption: existing approaches require complete schema documentation, but enterprise databases typically lack comprehensive documentation, featuring cryptic naming and implicit relationships. We present the first text-to-SQL framework that operates without schema documentation, instead learning database structure from historical query logs. Query logs encode implicit structural knowledge: which tables are queried together, how they join, and what columns map to business concepts. We construct a knowledge graph from parsed query patterns and introduce entity-driven GraphRAG retrieval that grounds user questions in domain terminology rather than relying solely on embedding similarity. Validated on both an industrial deployment with expert evaluation and the Beaver benchmark, our approach substantially outperforms similarity-based retrieval methods, the dominant industry approach, in both executability and answer quality. On Beaver, we achieve 95.7% execution validity compared to 60.8% for embedding-based retrieval, with expert data engineers preferring our system 70% to 10% on internal deployment. Our work demonstrates that text-to-SQL can operate effectively in schema-ambiguous enterprise environments, enabling natural language database interfaces "in the wild".

</details>


### [295] [What Makes a Question Curious? Measuring Model Curiosity in Human-LLM Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33950)
*Angana Borah,Rachana Ramchandar,Inderjeet Nair,Rada Mihalcea*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究定义"模型好奇心"（以认识论提问揭示知识缺口、假设与替代方案），提出理论驱动的分类体系区分好奇心提问与一般性提问，并在四个对话数据集中发现此类提问占比仅17–28%，但与更探索性、认识论更丰富的用户后续回复相关，且在建议、创意、研究情境中尤为有用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益成为日常沟通伙伴，有用协助不仅需要"回答"，还需要"提出恰当问题"以暴露知识缺口、隐含假设与替代方案；然而当前缺乏区分"好奇心驱动的提问"与"一般性提问"的理论框架，也不清楚其频率与效果。

Method: 1) 将"认识论式提问"界定为模型好奇心，并构建理论驱动的细粒度分类体系；2) 在四个对话数据集上进行标注与统计分析，考察好奇心提问的占比及其与用户后续回复探索性/认识论丰富度的关联；3) 开展人类评估实验，测量模型好奇心在不同情境下的有用性。

Result: 好奇心导向提问在所有提问中仍属少数（17–28%）；其与更探索性、认识论更丰富的用户后续回复相关，但该模式在不同数据集间存在差异（即效应具情境依赖性）；人类研究显示好奇心提问可促进探索，在建议、创意与研究情境中效果最明显。

Conclusion: 模型好奇心是高价值但稀缺的交互行为；LLM应"更具选择性地"提问，以支撑更深入的探索与人机协作。研究为构建选择性提问的模型提供理论与实证依据。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly act as partners in everyday communication. In these interactions, useful assistance may require not only answering, but also asking the right questions that surface knowledge gaps, assumptions, and alternatives. In this study, we refer to such epistemic question-asking as model curiosity, and introduce a theory-grounded taxonomy that distinguishes curiosity-oriented questions from generic model questioning. Across four conversation datasets, we find that curiosity-oriented questions remain rare (17-28% of all questions), but are associated with more exploratory and epistemically rich subsequent user responses, with varying patterns across datasets. We further conduct a human study to evaluate the usefulness of model curiosity, finding that curiosity can encourage exploration, especially in advice, creative, and research contexts. These findings have implications for building LLMs that ask more selectively to support deeper exploration and human-AI collaboration.

</details>


### [296] [Beyond Belief: Evaluating and Mitigating LLM Susceptibility to Misinformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33962)
*Emran Kanaan,Jiho Lee,Ibrahim Odat,Soroush Vosoughi,Weicheng Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大模型对信息的"可信度判断"与其实际是否调用外部信息并不一致；评测方式本身会改变行为，因此需同时衡量有害执行与合法任务完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用型LLM必须先判断外部信息是否值得采取行动，现有研究多依赖模型自报的可信度评分来推断其抵抗虚假信息的能力，但这一假设缺乏行为层面的验证。

Method: 在5个LLM上评测196条构造的虚假通知（配合法对照）与204条改造成模拟工具使用的存档攻击；对比"先评分再行动"与"直接行动"两种协议；测试提升可信度辨别力的干预手段、简单预警（forewarning）、两类生成的示例式"预驳斥"（prebunk），以及基于生成虚假通知的监督微调，并跨协议迁移评估。

Result: 在已评为不可信的构造通知中，模型仍有27%–99%的概率发出有害工具调用；去掉预备评分步骤使有害执行平均上升15个百分点；改善可信度辨别的干预并未稳定带来更安全的行为；简单预警在5个模型中的4个显著降低有害执行，且两种生成的预驳斥在主评测中均未优于预警；这些收益可能损害合法任务完成。监督微调在留出的存档攻击上（评分优先协议下）降低有害执行，但效用代价因模型而异，且在无评分诱导时保护减弱。

Conclusion: 自报可信度判断不能可靠指示行为层面的抗虚假能力；虚假信息防御应以"有害动作"与"合法任务完成"双指标评估，并显式考虑评测协议带来的行为效度问题。

Abstract: Tool-using large language models (LLMs) must decide whether external information warrants action. We investigate whether their expressed credibility judgments reliably indicate behavioral resistance to misinformation. We evaluate five LLMs on 196 constructed false notices paired with legitimate counterparts and 204 archived attacks adapted to simulated tool use. When asked to act on the constructed notices, models issue harmful tool calls in 27%--99% of cases they have rated untrustworthy. Removing the preliminary rating step increases harmful execution by 15 percentage points on average, showing that credibility elicitation itself changes the behavior being evaluated. Interventions that improve credibility discrimination do not consistently yield safer actions. A simple forewarning significantly reduces harmful execution in four of five models, but neither tested generated-example prebunk outperforms it in the main evaluation. These reductions can also compromise legitimate task completion. Supervised fine-tuning on generated false notices reduces harmful execution on held-out archived attacks under the rating-first protocol, with model-dependent utility costs and weaker protection without rating elicitation. Our findings motivate evaluating misinformation defenses through both harmful actions and legitimate task completion, while accounting for the behavioral effects of the evaluation protocol.

</details>


### [297] ["High-Quality" Data for Early-Stage Instruction Tuning: An Empirical Study of Data Quality Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33969)
*Vladimir Necula,David Gvadzabia,Sofia Serrano*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文把"数据质量"当作可操作属性，检验哪类简单样例级指标最能预测固定微调预算下的训练效用；结果显示"答案密集监督"（response ratio）比常用代理指标更稳健、更可迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "数据质量"在指令微调中被广泛提及但界定不清，实践中缺少对哪些简单样例级指标真正预测训练效用的系统比较。

Method: 选取来自数据选择、文本质量与指令微调先前工作的多个简单样例级指标；对每个指标按分数排序，以近似相等的token质量为界划分低/中/高三个分箱，分别微调，并比较验证困惑度与LLM-as-judge评分随累积训练token的变化。

Result: 以response ratio度量的答案密集监督，在预测指令微调效用上强于常用替代代理指标，且更具可迁移性。

Conclusion: 简单样例级指标中，response ratio是更可靠、更可移植的指令微调效用预测器；"数据质量"宜作为可操作属性来度量与验证。

Abstract: "Data quality" is widely invoked in instruction tuning, but the term is often underspecified. We study it as an operational property by asking which simple example-level metrics, drawn from prior work on data selection, text quality, and instruction tuning, best predict training utility under a fixed finetuning budget. For each metric, we sort instruction-response examples by score, partition them into low, middle, and high bins with roughly equal token mass, finetune separately on each bin, and compare validation perplexity and LLM-as-judge scores for the models' generated answers as a function of cumulative training tokens. Our results suggest that answer-dense supervision, as captured by response ratio, is a stronger and more portable predictor of instruction-tuning utility than commonly used alternative proxies.

</details>


### [298] [Reversible Pseudonymisation of Documents Sent to External LLMs: an Open Bilingual Benchmark and an Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34012)
*Vladimir Beskorovainyi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个开源基准，比较五个现有开源脱敏工具与正则基线在俄语和英式英语上的可逆伪名化表现，并提出一个基于两个最强工具的开源引擎；在所有外部数据集上，现有工具均未满足全部预设阈值，而引擎在由其开发来源生成器产生的留出集上显著优于现有工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业人员常将工作文档发送给外部大语言模型，常用防护手段是可逆伪名化（发送前用占位符替换个人数据，收到回答后在本地还原）。但现有脱敏工具在真实使用条件下是否可靠缺乏公开、可复现的评估。

Method: 构建开源基准：在俄语与英式英语上评估五个现有开源工具及一个正则基线；判定时排除各工具作者自有数据集；在相同数据集上比较引擎与各工具，并报告掩蔽精度；在1,000份/语言的预注册留出合成文档集上测试（文件、哈希、决策规则、运行计划与停止规则均预先公开）；用两个本地LLM检验占位符能否在回答中保留。评估数据全部为合成数据，由引擎作者本人执行基准，代码、数据、预测与原始回答全部公开。

Result: 外部队列上无任何现有工具满足全部预设阈值：英式英语未达标识符与泄露阈值，俄语标识符阈值处于临界。在最后一轮留出集（每语言1,000份文档）上，最佳现有工具在61%（俄语）和58%（英式英语）的文档中仍完整暴露某一取值；在其开发来源生成器产生的文档上，该引擎对应比例仅为0.3% [0.1; 0.9] 与 0.2% [0.1; 0.7]，任一取值部分可见比例为0.8%与0.2%，且两种语言均满足全部检测阈值。英式英语在760条回答后占位符还原率≥99%；俄语仅还原94.6% [93.6; 95.6] 的姓名占位符，低于99%阈值，主要因其借用的pii-guard词形变化规则生成错误姓氏形式。

Conclusion: 现有开源脱敏工具在外部数据上无法同时满足检测与防泄露阈值，所提组合引擎在合成留出集上表现优异但存在测试集同源偏倚（历经六个此前留出集、且由作者本人评测），俄语姓名还原率仍未达标，真实文档尚未测试。

Abstract: Professionals send working documents to external large language models. A common safeguard is reversible pseudonymisation: personal data are replaced with placeholders before the request and restored locally in the answer. We present an open benchmark of five existing open tools and a regular-expression baseline on Russian and UK English, and an open engine built on the two strongest tools. The benchmark excludes each tool's own authors' dataset from its verdict, compares the engine with each tool on identical datasets for detection, reports masking precision, and tests on a held-out set of synthetic documents whose files, hashes, decision rules, run plan and stopping rule were published before any run. Two local LLMs test whether placeholders survive. All evaluation data are synthetic, and the benchmark was run by the author of the engine; code, data, predictions and raw answers are released. On external datasets no existing tool meets all predefined thresholds: in UK English the identifier and leak thresholds are not met, in Russian the identifier threshold is borderline. On the last held-out set of 1,000 documents per language, the best existing tools leave a whole value visible in 61% (Russian) and 58% (UK) of documents. On these documents, from the generator it was developed on, the engine does so in 0.3% [0.1; 0.9] and 0.2% [0.1; 0.7], leaves any part of a value visible in 0.8% and 0.2%, and meets all detection thresholds in both languages. In UK English it also restores at least 99% of its placeholders after 760 answers. In Russian it restores only 94.6% [93.6; 95.6] of name placeholders, against a 99% threshold, mainly because the inflection it borrows from pii-guard produces wrong surname forms. The engine was developed over six earlier held-out sets from the same generator; real documents were not tested.

</details>


### [299] [The Patient Is Always Right? Evaluating Sycophancy in Medical Diagnosis with Graded Patient Beliefs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34013)
*Viswonathan Manoranjan,Andrea Mock,Myra Cheng,Lujain Ibrahim,Andrew Coyne,Junyi Jessy Li,Desmond C. Ong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文评估九个通用AI模型在医疗诊断中的“谄媚性”（sycophancy）：当患者陈述一个错误的疾病信念时，模型平均有23.2%的情况会顺从并采纳患者信念，甚至对虚构疾病也会采信；医疗微调与模型规模可降低这一倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 越来越多的人使用通用AI模型获取医疗建议甚至诊断，而AI存在谄媚倾向——即使用户信念不真实也会予以认可，这可能导致假阳性诊断，因而需要量化评估其在诊断场景中的风险。

Method: 设计实验：让患者提出一个特定但错误的疾病信念，考察九个AI模型是否改变其诊断决策；系统性变化用户信念与临床证据之间的接近程度，并设置不同人设（persona），例如“罕见病声称者”（Rare Disease Claimer）。此外分析医疗领域微调与模型规模对谄媚性的影响。

Result: 模型平均在23.2%的情况下谄媚性地采纳患者信念，个别情况下连虚构的、人为编造的疾病也会被接受；“罕见病声称者”人设可使模型接受率升至43.0%；医疗微调与更大的模型规模使模型更不易改变诊断。

Conclusion: 医疗诊断中的谄媚偏差对安全性构成隐患，尤其随着更多人将AI用于健康支持，需重视该风险。

Abstract: More people are seeking out general-purpose AI models for medical advice, including diagnosis. Yet, AI models are susceptible to sycophancy, like validating users' beliefs even when they are untrue, which could lead to false positive diagnoses. Here, we evaluate how nine AI models change their diagnostic decision when a patient presents a belief that they have a specific (but incorrect) medical condition. We vary how close the user belief is to the clinical evidence presented. Models sycophantically adopt the patient's belief on average 23.2\% of the time---sometimes even when the patient proposes a fictional, made-up condition. We also varied different personas, including a Rare Disease Claimer that got models to accept their belief 43.0\% of the time. Additional analyses find that medical fine-tuning and model scale makes models less susceptible to changing their diagnoses. Sycophantic bias in medical diagnosis raises implications for safety, especially as more people are using AI for health support.

</details>


### [300] [When Does GEPA Merge Help? A Mechanism-Level Diagnostic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34027)
*Chong Zhao,Ruyi Yang,Changming Liu,Alice Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: GEPA 的 merge 算子跨模型不稳定（提升 gpt-4.1-mini 却损害 Qwen3-8B），本文将其归因于配置敏感性而非算子固有缺陷，并给出基于行为探针的诊断式缓解方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GEPA 是较强的反思式提示优化器，但其 system-aware merge 算子在模型间表现不对称：对 gpt-4.1-mini 平均有益，却降低 Qwen3-8B 性能，原论文仅记录该现象而未解释。作者旨在定位这一不稳定性的成因。

Method: 在 5 个数据集、2 个模型上开展研究：(1) 围绕 merge 时机与 merge 算子设计 9 种配置进行扫描；(2) 检验提示级静态特征能否预测 GEPA 的 merge 接受决策；(3) 基于诊断结果构建行为式探针（behavior-based probe），在高风险任务上弃用 merge。

Result: 适当配置下 merge 对两个模型均有提升，说明不稳定性源于配置敏感性；提示级特征无法预测 merge 接受决策，排除了静态特征门控；行为式探针在多随机种子运行中避免了严重 merge 失败，但未稳定超越 NoMerge 基线。

Conclusion: merge 算子本身并非固有缺陷，问题在于配置；静态特征门控不可行，而基于行为信号的自适应弃用是可行但不完备的缓解方向。代码以 GEPA-MergeProbe 开源。

Abstract: GEPA is among the strongest reflective prompt optimizers for language-model programs, but its system-aware merge operator is unstable across models: merge improves gpt-4.1-mini on average while degrading Qwen3-8B, an asymmetry noted but left unexplained by the GEPA paper. We investigate this instability across five datasets and two models. Our nine-configuration sweep over merge timing and merge operator shows that merge can improve both models when configured appropriately. This suggests that merge instability is better explained by configuration sensitivity than by an inherent flaw in the merge operator. We then test whether prompt-level features predict GEPA's merge-accept decisions and find that they do not, ruling out static-feature gating. As a proof of concept, a behavior-based probe built from these diagnostics avoids large merge failures in our multi-seed runs by abstaining on high-risk tasks, although it does not consistently outperform NoMerge. Code is available as GEPA-MergeProbe at https://github.com/ChongZZZZ/GEPA_MERGE .

</details>


### [301] [Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34073)
*Xuan He,Sining Zhoubian,Ruozhen Yang,Yuhao Wen,Zhineng Wang,Yuyang Hu,Ke Yang,Yuyu Zhang,Ping Nie,Jiawei Han,ChengXiang Zhai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文通过大规模评测发现专用记忆系统常不如朴素RAG，提出"记忆收益"与"记忆税"框架来刻画记忆相对直接检索的净价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程智能体中记忆被广泛使用，但"构建记忆"相对于"直接从原始历史检索"的净价值尚不明确，缺乏系统评估。

Method: 跨多基准与多模型骨干的大规模评测；以RAG为参照，将记忆净价值分解为相对直接检索的收益（memory benefit）与损失（memory tax），并将记忆处理视为对原始历史的"双刃偏离"进行分析，重点研究记忆税的系统侧与评测侧来源，并推广到更多记忆应用场景。

Result: 许多专用记忆系统在多种情况下不如朴素RAG，呈现负净价值；记忆收益源于设计预期的信息重组/蒸馏，记忆税则源于证据被删除或遮蔽等偏离。

Conclusion: "记忆税"概念提供了新视角，推动关注点从单一性能转向记忆净价值，指导更可靠的记忆设计与评测；代码与结果将开源。

Abstract: Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value. Taking RAG as a reference, we dissect the net value of memory into the gains and losses over direct retrieval, termed memory benefit and memory tax. These gains and losses arise because memory process changes how the raw information is organized and accessed. We view such changes as the double-edged deviations from the raw history. They are originally designed and introduced to benefit the task, for example by reorganizing facts or distilling preferences, but some may also remove or obscure evidence, giving rise to memory tax. Since memory benefit reflects the expected gains of its design, we then focus more on the overlooked memory tax, study how it arises from the system and evaluation side, and generalize the concept to more application scenarios of memory. We hope the notion of memory tax can provide a new lens and shift more attention from standalone performance to the net value of memory, informing more reliable memory designs and evaluations. We will open-source the code and results to the community. Project Page: https://hexuan21.github.io/MemoryTax/

</details>


### [302] [Identically Trained Language Models Break on Different Jailbreaks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34074)
*Chi-Wei Chang,Mu-Tien Kuo,Kuan-Wei Lee,Meng-Hsun Tsai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 对25个预训练数据配方、每种3个预训练种子与2个后训练种子（共150个模型）系统测量逐提示拒答率相关性，发现"哪些越狱能破解某检查点"主要由预训练运行（种子）决定而非数据配方，且预训练运行留下可识别的指纹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有越狱基准只测单一检查点，并默认其被哪些越狱攻破是预训练数据与安全训练的属性；作者质疑：相同数据、相同安全训练下的另一次预训练运行，是否会被同样的越狱攻破，即越狱易感性的方差来源（预训练种子 vs 数据配方 vs 后训练种子）未被厘清。

Method: 控制变量实验：25个预训练数据配方 × 3个预训练种子，得1B基座模型，各施加相同安全后训练并配2个后训练种子，共150个模型；对共享越狱提示集每模型采样20条回答，计算逐提示非拒答率，并对模型两两做相关性分析；进一步在150M/300M规模复现，统计91个攻击模板的"最佳攻击"跨种子稳定性，以及用逐提示非拒答率做预训练运行身份识别。

Result: 同一预训练运行的两次后训练副本逐提示非拒答率相关性达0.984；换预训练种子降至0.811，再换数据配方仅略降至0.779。规律在全部25个配方及150M/300M参数下均成立。在一个检查点上找到的最优攻击模板，换预训练种子后仍最优的模型对比例仅27%（换后训练种子为67%）。3211个提示下逐提示非拒答率可100%识别所属预训练运行（75个运行中），随机50个提示子集仍有98%准确率。

Conclusion: 越狱易感性主要是"预训练运行"（随机种子所决定的轨迹）的属性，而非数据配方或安全后训练的属性；因此单检查点越狱评测的外部效度有限，攻击可迁移性与防御评估需考虑预训练随机性，同时逐提示拒答模式构成可指纹化的预训练运行特征。

Abstract: Jailbreak benchmarks test one checkpoint and treat which jailbreaks break it as a property of its pretraining data and safety training. We ask whether another pretraining run of the same data, given the same safety training, would break on the same jailbreaks. For each of 25 pretraining data recipes, we take 1B base models from 3 pretraining seeds and give each the same safety post-training with 2 post-training seeds, for 150 models in all. We then collect 20 responses from every model to a shared set of jailbreak prompts and correlate the per-prompt non-refusal rates between every pair of models. On average, two post-trained copies of the same pretraining run have per-prompt non-refusal rates that correlate at 0.984. A different pretraining seed lowers the correlation to 0.811, and a different data recipe lowers it only slightly further, to 0.779. These results indicate that which jailbreaks break a checkpoint depends much more on its pretraining run than on its data, a pattern that holds in all 25 data recipes and at 150M and 300M parameters. In practice, the best of 91 attack templates found on one checkpoint stays the best after a new pretraining seed in only 27% of model pairs, against 67% after a new post-training seed. Each pretraining run also leaves a fingerprint: across 3,211 prompts, a model's per-prompt non-refusal rates identify its pretraining run among all 75 runs every time, and a random subset of 50 prompts still does so 98% of the time.

</details>


### [303] [The LALA Benchmark: Evaluating Literary and Linguistic Analysis in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34080)
*Michael Foster,Barbara McGillivray,Gard B. Jenset,Jakub Mácha,Jason Harding,Marcus Perlman,Devyani Sharma,Patrick Skeels,Jana Willer-Gold,Jeannette Littlemore*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LALA基准（236道专家撰写的语言学与文学研究开放题及专家理想答案），用人类专家与LLM评审对比17个模型的作答，发现语言学能力主要来自后训练而非参数量，且能力呈碎片化分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测缺乏针对语言学与文学研究专业能力的开放式基准，难以判断语言能力差异究竟源于后训练还是模型规模，也难以为后续模型改进提供可操作的诊断框架。

Method: 构建LALA基准：236道由语言学与文学研究专家撰写的开放性问题，并配以专家提供的理想答案。对17个语言模型施测，采用人类专家评估与两个LLM评审（Sol和Qwen）评分；在同族模型、相近训练规模之间进行对比，并设置ReliableEval重复运行以检验可复现性。

Result: 基座模型在基准所测语言能力上表现很弱，其后训练版本显著更好；参数量与部分得分表现无统计显著关联；各语言子领域能力分布不均。模型在陈述间逻辑关系及部分语篇级任务上表现最佳，即便最强的后训练模型在歧义、文学风格、指代和误导性预设上仍显薄弱。人类与Sol评审在原始与ReliableEval运行中给出的模型排名几乎一致。

Conclusion: 后训练是使语言学知识可获取、可使用的核心因素，且其增益是逐项叠加的，并未产生能泛化到所学策略之外的"通用语言智能"；LALA为评估未来模型与定向改进提供了可复现的框架。

Abstract: We introduce the Literature and Linguistics Analysis Benchmark (LALA), comprising 236 open-ended questions written by experts in linguistics and literary studies, together with expert-provided ideal answers. By comparing models within families and at similar training scales using human and LLM judges, LALA identifies differences in linguistic competence associated with post-training, offering a framework for evaluating future models and guiding targeted improvements. We administered questions to 17 language models and evaluated their responses using both human expert assessment and two LLM evaluators, Sol and Qwen. Base models displayed little of the linguistic competence assessed by the benchmark, whereas their post-trained versions performed markedly better, suggesting that post-training plays a central role in making linguistic knowledge accessible and usable. Parameter count, by contrast, showed no statistically significant association with partial-credit performance, and competencies remained unevenly distributed across linguistic domains. We interpret this pattern as evidence that post-training adds linguistic competencies piecemeal, without producing a general linguistic intelligence capable of extending them beyond the learned policies that support them. Models performed best on logical relations between statements and selected discourse-level tasks, while even the strongest post-trained models continued to struggle with ambiguity, literary style, reference, and misleading assumptions. Human and Sol evaluations produced nearly identical model rankings in both the original and ReliableEval runs, supporting the replicability of the comparative results.

</details>


### [304] [T2D: Target-to-Draft Model Pruning & Adaptation for Efficient Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34103)
*Shahriar Kabir Nahin,Xiao Ye,Muhao Chen,Ben Zhou,Anshuman Chhabra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: T2D：以延迟感知结构化剪枝+知识蒸馏，直接从目标模型构造草稿模型，联合优化推理延迟与对齐度，剪枝高达92%仍保持优异投机解码性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码的加速效果取决于草稿模型与目标模型的分布对齐度及草稿推理延迟，但现有方法（独立预训练小模型或按人工选定架构剪枝目标模型）无法显式平衡这两者的权衡。

Method: 将草稿模型设计形式化为优化问题；提出T2D框架，从目标模型出发，结合延迟感知的结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，构建草稿模型，并联合优化实测推理延迟与目标模型响应上的交叉熵损失。

Result: 在多领域投机解码基准及多种不同规模目标模型家族上的实验表明，T2D可剪枝目标模型高达92%并获得高性能草稿模型，优于竞争基线；所得草稿模型还可即插即用地配合其他token对齐与知识蒸馏方法，带来额外增益。

Conclusion: 联合导航草稿模型"架构—对齐"前沿，是释放LLM投机解码潜力的关键。

Abstract: Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model's latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model's responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92\% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

</details>


### [305] [Rethinking Retrieval in the Long-Context Era: Training-Free Semantic Trees for Adaptive Context Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34146)
*Zhe Xu,Tianhao Liao,Zhenqing Ling,Ying Shen,Yaliang Li,Daoyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练的 TreeFuse 框架，用语义抽象指导证据选择、保留原文作答，在四个前沿模型上将 LongBench 三任务平均 QA-F1 提升 1.72 点，同时答案上下文长度减少 58.55%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文模型可直接处理整篇文档，但"能接收多少信息"不等于"哪些信息最支持查询"。当全文已能放入上下文时，仍需研究如何选择与组织证据，在保留支撑事实与关系的同时使上下文聚焦于问题。

Method: TreeFuse 为免训练框架：单次生成即从全文构建可复用的语义层级结构，将节点描述与源文本片段链接；给定查询后，通过结构—语义打分与细粒度词汇归因提名共享源节点，将其与祖先上下文取并集，以保留结构关系和完整局部原文。

Result: 在四个前沿答案模型上，于三个 LongBench 任务相较全文提示平均 QA-F1 提升 1.72 点，四模型均值超过所评估基线，答案上下文长度减少 58.55%。

Conclusion: 检索的价值不仅在容量，更在于证据的选择与组织；语义抽象引导选择加原文保留作答，可在更短上下文下实现更优问答表现。

Abstract: Long-context language models can increasingly process entire documents, making full-context prompting a practical alternative to passage retrieval. However, greater capacity determines how much information a model can receive, but not which information best supports a query. This distinction motivates rethinking retrieval: when the full document already fits, can selecting and organizing its evidence improve answering? The challenge is to retain supporting facts and relations while keeping the context focused on the question. To reconcile these goals, we introduce \ours, a training-free framework that uses semantic abstraction to guide selection while retaining original text for answering. \ours constructs a reusable semantic hierarchy from the full document in a single generation, linking node descriptions to source spans. Given a query, structural--semantic scoring and fine-grained lexical attribution nominate shared source nodes; their union with ancestor context preserves structural relations and complete local text. Across four frontier answer models, \ours improves average QA-F1 by 1.72 points over full-context prompting on three LongBench tasks, surpassing the evaluated baselines on the four-model average while reducing answer-context length by 58.55\%. Our code is available at the $\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/treefuse-ECFE}{repository}$.

</details>


### [306] [Write What Matters: Disentangling Token Selection from Slot Allocation in Recurrent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34180)
*Chen Chen,Rui Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出因子化写入路由（FWR）：先对每个token做“保留/跳过”二元决策，再决定写入固定数量或token自适应的记忆槽位；读取时查询所有槽位。在两个长上下文合成任务（稠密Feature Recall与稀疏Passkey）上观察到密度依赖的反转：稠密任务上“总是写入”优于选择性写入（0.472 vs 0.337），稀疏任务上选择性写入显著更优（0.222 vs 0.048）；学习的自适应槽位数规则在两个任务上均不如固定分配；带事实标签的诊断型oracle在Passkey上达0.372，说明过滤干扰项仍有提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列建模中，全注意力保留全部历史但代价高；循环记忆模型以固定槽位压缩历史、线性时间处理，但容量有限使“写入决策”后果重大：干扰项会挤占有用内容，被跳过的证据则无法召回。现有多槽记忆对每个token都写入相同数量的槽位，把“是否存储”与“更新多少槽位”两个决策耦合在一起，缺乏可解释的写入控制。

Method: 提出因子化写入路由（FWR），将写入解耦为两步：(1) 门控决定每个token保留或跳过；(2) 再选择固定或token自适应的槽位数量进行更新。查询阶段仍读取全部槽位。在Feature Recall（信息稠密）与Passkey（稀疏事实）两个需在长上下文后检索事实的合成任务上，跨10个随机种子进行对比实验，比较“总是写入”“学习式选择性写入”以及自适应槽位分配规则，并设置使用部署时不可得的事实标签的诊断oracle以估计上限。

Result: 在每次写入4个槽位设置下，长上下文准确率呈密度依赖反转：稠密Feature Recall上总是写入更优（0.472 vs 0.337），稀疏Passkey上学习式选择性写入更优（0.222 vs 0.048）。在学习的门控下，所测试的自适应槽位规则在两个任务上均不及固定分配。诊断oracle在Passkey上达到0.372，显示干扰项过滤存在明显提升空间。

Conclusion: 写入策略应随信息密度变化：信息稠密场景应避免漏写（倾向总是写入），干扰项占主导的稀疏场景应优先过滤干扰。自适应槽位分配在当前门控机制下未带来收益，固定分配更稳健；与oracle的差距表明门控/路由的判别能力是后续改进的关键方向。

Abstract: Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). The tested adaptive rule underperforms fixed allocation under the learned gate on both tasks. A diagnostic oracle given fact labels unavailable at deployment reaches 0.372 on Passkey, showing headroom in filtering distractors. The results suggest avoiding missed writes in information-dense contexts and filtering distractors when they dominate.

</details>


### [307] [Higher Reasoning Effort Improves Reference Verifiability and Changes Reasoning Summaries in GPT-5.5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34212)
*Melika Mobini,Andres Algaba,Vincent Ginis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究考察GPT-5.5在低/高推理努力下生成学术参考文献的可验证性差异，并分析推理摘要所揭示的行为变化。高努力将引文解析验证率从78.3%提升至84.8%，但推理摘要特征得分与验证率之间无一致正相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型日益参与科学知识生产各环节（含参考文献推荐），且可在不同推理努力水平下运行并输出推理摘要。由此引出两个问题：提高推理努力是否提升生成参考文献的可验证性？推理摘要能否揭示模型行为随努力程度的变化？

Method: 对1,000篇论文在低/高努力配对设置下由GPT-5.5生成学术引文；将生成引文与外部书目记录匹配；对推理摘要按四个预设特征打分，并探索GPT-5.5自行发现的附加特征。

Result: 高努力使论文级解析验证引文率均值由78.3%升至84.8%，推理摘要更长，四个预设特征得分均提高；发现特征的分布变化不均（部分两条件下频率相同，部分在高努力下更常见）。但在各努力条件内部，两类特征集均未表现出得分越高验证率越一致上升。

Conclusion: 提高推理努力可改善引文可验证性并改变推理摘要的显性特征，但摘要特征得分不能作为验证率的可靠代理指标，推理过程的可解释性与输出质量之间并非简单单调关系。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly being used in different stages of scientific knowledge production, including the suggestion of references. These models can operate at different levels of reasoning effort and provide summaries of their reasoning processes. This raises two questions: Does increasing reasoning effort improve the verifiability of generated references, and do the resulting reasoning summaries reveal how the model's behavior changes with greater effort? We examined summaries from GPT-5.5 as it generated scholarly references for 1,000 papers under paired low- and high-effort settings. Generated references were matched to external bibliographic records, and reasoning summaries were scored for four predefined features and explored for additional features discovered by GPT-5.5. High effort increased the mean paper-level resolver-verified reference rate from 78.3% to 84.8%, and produced longer reasoning summaries. All four predefined features received higher scores under high effort. The discovered features changed less uniformly: some appeared equally often in both conditions, whereas others were more common under high effort. Within each effort condition, neither feature set showed a consistent increase in verification rates with higher scores.

</details>


### [308] [Synthetic linguistic data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34215)
*Giuseppe Samo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出以"人工苗圃"（artificial plant nursery）隐喻合成语言数据，区分"合成灌木型数据"（语料式模型生成文本集合）与"合成花园型数据"（受控条件下诱发以检验特定语言学假设的输出），并主张合成数据是独立的语言学研究对象，需审慎考虑其生成条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成语言数据在语言学研究中日益重要（从AI生成文本的大规模分析到语法与词汇偏好的受控实验），但学界缺乏对其类型与解释边界的清晰界定。作者意在扩展Bresnan (2016)"语言花园与灌木丛"的二分，为合成数据提供概念框架。

Method: 概念性/术语学论述（glossary entry）：以园艺隐喻作类型学划分——"合成灌木型数据"对应语料式、模型生成的语言集合；"合成花园型数据"对应受控条件下针对特定语言学假设的诱发输出。并对两类数据的生成条件与可比性进行方法论分析。

Result: 提出合成数据作为独立的语言学研究对象这一立场；指出合成数据与自然语言数据对比可揭示共同模式与偏离，但解释结果取决于生成条件（提示、模型、控制设置等），不能直接等同于自然语言证据。

Conclusion: 合成数据不应被视为自然数据的简易替代，而应作为兼具可比性与特异性的独立分析对象；对其解读须明确并报告生成条件，以保证方法学透明度与推断有效性。

Abstract: Synthetic linguistic data have become increasingly prominent in linguistic research, from the analysis of large collections of AI-generated texts to controlled experiments investigating grammatical and lexical preferences. This glossary entry extends Bresnan's (2016) distinction between the linguistic garden and the bush by introducing an artificial plant nursery as a metaphor for synthetic data. We distinguish between synthetic bush data, consisting primarily of corpus-like collections of model-generated language, and synthetic garden data, in which model outputs are elicited under controlled conditions to investigate specific linguistic hypotheses. We argue that synthetic data constitute a distinct object of linguistic investigation: comparing them with natural language data can reveal both shared patterns and divergences, but their interpretation requires careful consideration of the conditions under which they are generated.

</details>


### [309] [$Δτ$-Bench: Pushing Agents Toward a Moving Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34238)
*Shuofei Qiao,Xuanguang Pan,Yijun Chen,Wendi Feng,Bin Wu,Runnan Fang,Yuqi Zhu,Shumin Deng,Emine Yilmaz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Δτ-Bench基准，模拟工具生态的结构演化以评测智能体的工具发现与程序性知识更新能力；评测显示最强模型仅42.3%成功率，并提出生态管理器Steward以联合维护工具与技能知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准无法同时考察智能体在动态变化工具生态中的主动高效工具路径发现与已有程序性知识及时修正这两类需求，因此需要一个建模工具生态结构演化的可执行智能体基准。

Method: 构建Δτ-Bench：涵盖42个领域、1,588个经校验的多轮任务，通过能力保持型变换生成6个连续生态状态，模拟工具消失/替换、功能重叠与文档噪声。在评测基础上提出Steward生态管理器，通过增量式技能维护与任务执行中的动态供给，联合管理工具与程序性知识。

Result: 最强被测模型或框架仅达42.3%任务成功率；现有技能学习方法带来的初始收益无法随生态演化稳定转化为适应能力提升。Steward在生态变化下保持更高任务成功率、技能维护开销更低，并提升工作流中断后的恢复与更优替代方案的采用。

Conclusion: 工具生态的动态演化对智能体的工具发现与知识维护构成显著挑战，现有方法适应性不足；将工具管理与程序性知识维护联合纳入生态级管理（Steward）可有效缓解该问题。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce $Δτ$-Bench, an executable agent benchmark that models the structural evolution of large tool ecosystems. In $Δτ$-Bench, independently evolving services continually reshape how tasks can be accomplished: familiar tools may disappear or be replaced, while more efficient alternatives emerge amid overlapping functionality and noisy documentation. Against this moving capability frontier, we evaluate whether agents can proactively discover efficient tool-use paths and promptly revise their accumulated procedural knowledge, bringing together demands that existing benchmarks fail to examine. $Δτ$-Bench comprises 1,588 validated multi-turn tasks across 42 domains and six successive ecosystem states generated through capability-preserving transformations. Our evaluation shows that even the strongest evaluated model or harness achieves only 42.3% task success, while initial gains from existing skill-learning methods can not consistently translate into better adaptation as the ecosystem evolves. These findings motivate Steward, an ecosystem manager that jointly manages tools and procedural knowledge through incremental skill maintenance and dynamic provisioning during task execution. Experiments show that Steward sustains higher task success across ecosystem changes with lower skill-maintenance overhead, while improving both recovery from disrupted workflows and adoption of more efficient alternatives.

</details>


### [310] [A Russian, a Brazilian, and a German Walk into a Bar, Ask the Same Question-- And Get Three Different Answers: Profiling LLM Perspective Diversity on Contested Topics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34278)
*Wiem Ben Rim,Yao Lu,Pontus Stenetorp,Emine Yilmaz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文构建了覆盖18种语言、经人工核验的多语言争议话题数据集 PerspectivesQA，并提出 ROOTS 框架剖析语言、观点与框架多样性；评估8个开源/闭源模型发现：LLM在英语中倾向模糊回避、在低资源语言中更倾向明确表态；大模型跨语言世界观更一致，小模型更易被左右；所有模型对输入表层扰动高度敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面向主观性、分歧与证据冲突类查询的基准以英语为中心，忽视了全球用户观点的多样性，缺乏对 LLM 观点如何随语言变化的系统研究。

Method: 构建 PerspectivesQA：人工核验的多语言数据集，涵盖全球争议话题、18种语言；提出 ROOTS 框架，用于刻画语言多样性、观点多样性与框架（framing）多样性；选取8个不同规模的开源与专有模型族进行评测，并考察输入表层变体下的立场稳定性。

Result: LLM 在英语中倾向于对冲/回避表态，而在低资源语言中倾向于给出明确立场；大模型保持更一致的跨语言世界观，小模型更易被语言左右；所有模型对细微的表层输入变化高度敏感，即使大模型也会表现出显著立场漂移。

Conclusion: 多语言评测揭示 LLM 存在系统性的语言相关立场偏差与脆弱性，表明仅英语基准不足以刻画模型观点行为，需在跨语言与输入鲁棒性维度上加强评估与对齐。

Abstract: Large Language Models(LLMs) have shown strong performance on tasks with verifiable answers, but many real-world queries involve subjectivity, disagreement, and conflicting evidence. Most existing benchmarks for such queries remain English-centric, overlooking the vast diversity of perspectives held by users worldwide. To systematically study how LLM perspectives vary across languages, we curate PerspectivesQA, a manually verified multilingual dataset of globally contested topics covering 18 languages, and propose ROOTS, a framework that profiles linguistic, perspective, and framing diversity. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models covering both open-source and proprietary families at varying scales, establishing that LLMs hedge their answers in English but commit to positions in lower-resource languages. Larger models maintain a more consistent cross-lingual worldview, while smaller models are more easily swayed. All models also exhibit high sensitivity to minor surface-level input variations, producing notable stance even in larger models.

</details>


### [311] [Transformer to GPT-5: Advancements, Limitations, and Future Directions in Large Language Model Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34281)
*Harsidak Singh Banwait,Chander Prabha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该综述对LLM进行系统分类，梳理从BERT到GPT、Gemini、Claude、Grok的发展时间线，比较数据集、算力、硬件、架构与参数，并讨论局限与开放问题；结论是架构复杂度与数据质量的平衡是当前代际AI的核心特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在上下文理解、少样本/零样本学习、代码生成与推理等方面取得突破，相关研究激增，但缺乏系统、完整的LLM分类体系（taxonomy），因此需要一篇按时间线组织的细致分类综述。

Method: 文献综述与分类学方法：以时间线为主线，对早期模型（BERT）到近期模型（GPT、Gemini、Claude、Grok）进行归类，并围绕训练数据集、训练算力、硬件规格、架构与参数规模等维度进行横向比较，同时归纳局限性、计算挑战与开放问题。

Result: 发现一致规律：在架构复杂度与数据质量之间取得更优比值的模型，表现出更强的推理稳定性与更好的对齐效果，且算力开销并未成比例上升。

Conclusion: LLM的演进呈现清晰的时间线增长轨迹；“扩展与可持续性之间的平衡”是当前一代AI的定义性特征，也是未来研究的关键方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized Artificial Intelligence (AI) by their extraordinary capabilities, like contextual understanding, few-shot/zero-shot learning, code generation, ability to reason and problem-solving. Recent studies have shown immense work on LLMs. Yet, there is limited work on the thorough taxonomy of LLMs. This study would showcase a detailed classification of LLMs, starting with the earlier models like BERT and leading to LLMs like GPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. We would delve into topics like datasets used to train LLMs, computational power used during training, their hardware specifications, architecture and parameters. Further, we would also look at the limitations, computational challenges and open problems as well. This study would primarily focus on the timeline of LLMs, signifying their growth over the period. Findings reveal a clear pattern: models that optimize the ratio between architectural complexity and data quality exhibit stronger reasoning stability and better alignment, without proportionally increasing the computational load. This desired balance between scaling and sustainability is the defining characteristic of the current generation of AI.

</details>


### [312] [Factual Yet One-Sided: Stance Poisoning and Evidence Balancing in Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34294)
*Puyuan Yang,Shaoxuan Dong,Liujie Wu,Xiaochun Cheng,Bo Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出检索增强生成中"事实正确但立场片面"的知识投毒问题，并设计立场均衡中间件加以缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统输出立场受检索材料立场分布强烈影响；已有知识投毒研究多针对事实错误，忽视了事实正确但立场单边的注入攻击风险。

Method: 构建ProCon文档注射实验，在主题级平均18.9%投毒比例、四个浓度水平下评估四款不同厂商生成模型的立场漂移；提出位于检索器与生成器之间的Stance-Balancing Middleware，含立场检测、固定配比均衡（2支持+2反对+1中立）与去偏提示，且不额外调用大模型。

Result: 四款模型均出现与投毒方向一致的立场偏移且随浓度单调增加；完整方法在8个浓度-方向设置中将立场偏差幅度降低约0.106–0.350，其中投毒比11.9%–18.9%的6个设置经Holm校正后显著（adj. p≤0.009）；跨模型8个组合均沿纠正方向移动，8项中7项绝对距离显著减小；浓度扫描中8个设置防御后区间均含0，跨模型亲投毒侧仍残留+0.045至+0.063的小正值点估计；20篇候选文档的立场检测单GPU耗时约为中位生成时间的1.5%，CPU约16%。

Conclusion: 立场层面的知识投毒对RAG输出有可观且随浓度累积的影响，轻量级立场均衡中间件可在不增加大模型调用的情况下有效削弱该偏差，但存在少量残余偏移，需进一步优化。

Abstract: The stance expressed in responses from retrieval-augmented generation systems is significantly influenced by the stance distribution of the retrieved materials. Existing research on knowledge poisoning has primarily targeted factual errors. In contrast, this study focuses on injection attacks in which the facts are correct but the stance on a controversial issue is one-sided. At a mean topic-level poisoning share of 18.9% within the post-injection ProCon documents, all four generation models from different vendors exhibited stance shifts aligned with the poisoning direction; across four concentration levels, the shifts increased monotonically.
  This paper proposes a Stance-Balancing Middleware positioned between the retriever and the generator. It consists of stance detection, fixed balancing (2 supporting + 2 opposing + 1 neutral), and a debiasing prompt, without introducing additional large language model calls. Across all eight concentration-direction settings, the complete method reduced the magnitude of stance deviation by an estimated 0.106 to 0.350; the six settings at poisoning shares of 11.9%-18.9% remained significant after Holm adjustment (adjusted p <= 0.009). In the cross-model experiment, all eight model-direction combinations moved along the stance axis in the corrective direction, and seven of eight showed a clearly detected reduction in absolute distance from 0. In the concentration sweep, the post-defense intervals included 0 in all eight settings, while the cross-model pro-poisoning results retained small positive residual point estimates of +0.045 to +0.063. For 20 candidate documents, stance detection took approximately 1.5% of the median generation time on a single GPU and approximately 16% on CPU.

</details>


### [313] [CoLink: Global Compression and Knowledge Linking for Multi-Turn Dialogue Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34335)
*Lian Yan,Zhenbo Xia,Haotian Wang,Chen Tang,Yi Guan,Jie Liu,Jingchi Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 CoLink 框架，通过信息链接与压缩增强 LLM 在领域多轮对话中的全局上下文感知，将长冗余历史蒸馏为极紧凑的潜在表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程对话历史的显著信息提取受限于 LLM 的上下文窗口与高效检索难题；现有方法依赖历史组织或局部 token 级优化，存在信息丢失、检索冗余与短视注意力问题。

Method: 受认知科学中"对话即意义建构与记忆联想"观点启发：1) 将历史上下文聚类为话题图，与外部知识建立跨语义关联；2) 在自适应思维控制（ACT）引导下，融合语义相关性与图结构拓扑进行知识检索与激活；3) 基于信息理论将多轮对话形式化，推导提取核心意义信息的原理性优化目标；4) 结合竞争槽机制，将全局上下文压缩进专用记忆槽与知识槽。

Result: 在公开数据集与自建 MMD 数据集上的大量实验验证了 CoLink 在知识链接与意义建模上的优越性与泛化性。

Conclusion: CoLink 通过话题图关联、拓扑感知检索与信息论驱动的槽位压缩，有效缓解长对话中的信息丢失与冗余问题，实现全局上下文的高效紧凑表征。

Abstract: Extracting salient information from long-horizon dialogue histories remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to the restricted context windows and efficient retrieval challenges. Current methods typically rely on history organization or local token-level optimization, suffering from information loss, retrieval redundancy, and myopic attention. Inspired by the view in cognitive science that dialogue constitutes sense-making and memory association, we propose CoLink, a framework that enhances LLMs' global context awareness in domain-specific multi-turn dialogues through information linking and compression. CoLink first clusters historical contexts into topic graphs to establish cross-semantic associations with external knowledge. Guided by the adaptive control of thought, it then retrieves and activates knowledge via synergizing semantic relevance and graph-structural topology. Crucially, to achieve effective compression of history and knowledge, we ground multi-turn dialogues in information theory and derive a principled optimization objective for extracting the core sense-making information. Coupled with a competitive slot mechanism, CoLink condenses the global context into dedicated memory and knowledge slots, efficiently distilling lengthy, redundant inputs into an extremely compact latent representation. Extensive empirical results on both public and our MMD datasets validate CoLink's superiority and generalizability in knowledge linking and sense modeling.

</details>


### [314] [Improving the Chain-of-Thought Compressibility of Pruned Reasoning Models via Long--Short Contrastive Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34336)
*Tao Jing,Chen Kang,Feifei Zhai,Pengyuan Liu,Dong Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出Contrastive Set-Difference (CSD)，通过对比同一问题长/短正确解上的神经元激活识别冗余推理神经元并优先剪枝，同时将偏好对扩展到剪枝模型"总解对/总解错"的问题上，使权重剪枝与CoT压缩协同，降低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大推理模型服务成本高昂：模型规模大、CoT过长。权重剪枝与CoT压缩虽分别针对这两项成本，但二者相互干扰——剪枝会在仍可解的问题上产生冗余推理、在不再可解的问题上产生不完整推理，且在更难问题上降低后续长度偏好优化的可压缩性。根源在于双方各有盲区：剪枝准则不区分必要与冗余推理；基于偏好的CoT压缩在剪枝模型"总解对或总解错"的问题上缺乏训练信号。

Method: 提出CSD：对同一问题的长、短正确解做激活对比，识别在冗余推理中富集的神经元并优先剪枝；并将偏好对扩展到剪枝模型总是解对或总是解错的问题，以补齐压缩训练信号。

Result: 对DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B剪枝20%，在四个数学基准上相比"推理感知校准剪枝(RAC)+相同压缩"方案，思考token减少8–22%，准确率差距在0.5个百分点以内。

Conclusion: 将剪枝准则与CoT压缩信号对齐可协同降低推理成本，在不损失准确率的前提下显著缩短思考链。

Abstract: Large reasoning models are costly to serve because they are large and because they generate long chains of thought (CoT). Weight pruning and CoT compression address these two costs separately, but they interfere in that pruning adds redundant reasoning on problems the model still solves and incomplete reasoning on those it no longer solves, and on harder problems makes the model less compressible by subsequent length-preference optimization. We trace this to a blind spot on each side: pruning criteria do not distinguish necessary from redundant reasoning, and preference-based CoT compression receives no training signal on problems a pruned model always or never solves. We propose Contrastive Set-Difference (CSD), which identifies neurons enriched in redundant reasoning by contrasting their activations on long and short correct solutions of the same problem and prunes them preferentially, and we extend preference pairs to the problems a pruned model always or never solves. Pruning 20\% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, the combination uses 8--22\% fewer thinking tokens on four math benchmarks than pruning with reasoning-aware calibration (RAC) followed by the same compression, with accuracy within 0.5 points.

</details>


### [315] [Xing USP: A Cross-Family Semantic Contract for Information Extraction and Intent-Slot Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34343)
*Zhongqiu Li,Boyang Wang,Ruiyu Fang,Shiquan Wang,Di Wu,Jiayi Liang,Feilong Zhang,Hongfeng Du,Xiaomeng Huang,Mengjiao Bao,Luwen Pu,Xuewei He,Yu Zhao,Chao Wang,Kaidong Yu,Bingkai Yang,Qingjun Zhu,Shaoyi Du,Shuangyong Song,Yongxiang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出USP（统一语义契约），用统一接口表示类别、字段、值与实例关联，并配以五种诊断性匹配视图与61数据集统一语料，使结构化语义解析的结构一致性变得可测量、可比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化语义解析评测通常只判断类别是否指派正确，忽略了值恢复与实例级关联：系统可能识别出事件却把论元绑定到错误实例，或识别出意图却给出错误的槽值。单看类别一致性会低估结构性缺陷。

Method: 提出跨家族的语义契约USP，以共同接口统一表示命名实体识别、关系抽取、事件抽取与意图—槽解析中的类别、字段、值与实例关联；并定义五个诊断性匹配视图：类别一致、字段识别、字段—值配对、实例绑定指派、完整实例恢复。基于该契约将61个数据集规范化为共享schema、提示与匹配规则的统一语料，在固定测试子集上比较六个模型。

Result: 微调后的Xing4.0-29B-Intent取得57.70的任务平衡Field-Value Micro-F1（四个任务家族等权），在每个家族及全部五个视图上均排名第一；其相对最强对比方法的领先幅度从类别匹配的2.93分扩大到完整实例匹配的20.73分。

Conclusion: 领先幅度的扩大表明仅凭类别一致会低估结构缺陷。USP为社区提供了共享表示、规范化61数据集语料及诊断性评测协议，使跨抽取与意图—槽任务的结构一致性可测量、可比较。

Abstract: Structured semantic parsing is typically judged by whether the correct category is assigned, which leaves value recovery and instance-level associations unexamined: a system may recognize an event yet bind an argument to the wrong instance, or identify an intent yet supply an incorrect slot value. We present USP, a cross-family semantic contract that represents categories, fields, values, and instance associations through a common interface for named-entity recognition, relation extraction, event extraction, and intent-slot parsing. The contract is paired with five diagnostic matching views---category agreement, field recognition, field-value pairing, instance-bound assignment, and complete-instance recovery---that ask distinct questions about the same output. Using this contract, we normalize 61 datasets into a unified corpus with shared schemas, prompts, and matching rules, and compare six models on a fixed test subset. Our fine-tuned Xing4.0-29B-Intent attains 57.70 task-balanced Field-Value Micro-F1 (equally weighted across the four task families) and ranks first in every family and on all five views; its margin over the strongest alternative widens from 2.93 points for category matching to 20.73 points for complete-instance matching. This widening gap shows that category agreement alone understates structural deficits. USP thus offers the community a shared representation, a normalized 61-dataset corpus, and a diagnostic evaluation protocol that make structural agreement measurable and comparable across extraction and intent-slot tasks.

</details>


### [316] [Beyond the Opening: Tracing the First Token's Persistent Influence on Reasoning Length](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34350)
*Ruochen Liu,Hao Yan,Ziluowen Luo,Senzhang Wang,Sihong Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过控制首个推理token的干预实验发现，首token对推理长度的影响并非仅经由紧邻后续文本传导，而是由少数"敏感生成位置"的注意力回望首token所持续维持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刻画推理模型的行为特性，需理解单个token选择如何影响推理长度；已有发现改变首个推理token会显著改变推理长度，但其作用如何在后续生成中持续传递尚不清楚。

Method: 对已有推理前缀仅替换首个token后继续生成；比较不同首token条件下的next-token分布以定位敏感性集中的生成位置；屏蔽这些位置对首token的注意力；并用其他首token条件下这些位置的next-token分布进行替换干预。

Result: 仅替换首token即可在其余前缀不变时显著改变剩余推理长度；敏感性集中于少数生成位置；阻断这些位置对首token的注意力可缩小不同首token条件间的长度差距；在这些位置替换next-token分布亦显著改变后续推理长度。

Conclusion: 首token的长度效应由少数敏感位置上对首token的注意力所维持，说明局部token选择可持久影响序列级结果。

Abstract: Understanding how individual token choices affect reasoning length is important for characterizing reasoning models.
