  This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries.
  Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target--verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful.

</details>


### [385] [SEMA-Auto: Sighted and Efficient Multi-Turn Attack with Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35743)
*Mingqian Feng,Xiaodong Liu,Weiwei Yang,Chenliang Xu,Jialin Song,Qiyao Ma,Chengquan Guo,Carolyn Buractaon,Christopher White,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 SEMA-Auto：一种"有视野且高效"的多轮越狱攻击者，能与受害者模型交互并自主判断成功即终止会话；通过合成引导微调 + 决策监督强化学习两阶段训练，实现 SOTA 攻击成功率且轮次几乎最少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有越狱攻击分为两类并各有缺陷：静态规划器（static planners）事先固定单轮/多轮攻击计划，简单但不感知受害者回复，浪费轮次且迁移性差；交互式生成器（interactive generators）根据受害者每条回复生成下一轮攻击，但依赖环内评估器提供成功信号或提示，成本高且性能虚高。作者希望弥合二者差距：既感知回复、又低成本且能自主终止。

Method: 两阶段训练。（1）Synthetic bootstrap tuning：用引导生成（bootstrapped）的轨迹微调基座模型，使模型建立"攻击目标"概念与合规性决策意识。（2）Decision-supervised reinforcement learning：联合但分离地优化两个目标——用更高越狱奖励强化攻击行为，同时对每一轮决策以绝对目标进行监督。模型在与受害者交互中自主判定是否成功并终止会话。

Result: 在多个数据集、受害者模型与评判器上取得 SOTA ASR，超越所有静态与交互式基线，且轮次接近最少。例：对 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 在 AdvBench 上 ASR@1 达 76.0%，平均 3.0 轮；最佳静态基线为固定 7 轮下 54.8%，最佳交互式基线为 3.7 轮下 43.8%。对安全加固的前沿模型 GPT-oss-120B、GPT-5.4、Claude-Haiku-4.5、GPT-6-Astra，在 HarmBench 上平均 ASR@1 为 59.6%，较此前 SOTA 提升 13.8%。

Conclusion: SEMA-Auto 以"有视野 + 自主终止 + 无需环内评估器"的方式统一了静态与交互式攻击的优点，兼具有效性与效率，代码已开源。

Abstract: Existing jailbreak attackers fall into two classes: static planners fix their single- or multi-turn adversarial plans in advance, remaining simple but losing sight of the victim's replies, wasting turns and limiting transferability; interactive generators read each victim reply to generate the next-turn attack but require in-loop evaluators for success signals or hints, incurring substantial costs and inflated performance. Bridging this gap, we propose SEMA-Auto, a sighted and efficient multi-turn attacker with autonomy, interacting with the victim model and terminating the session by itself upon success. To stabilize its behaviors and boost its capabilities, SEMA-Auto is trained in two stages. Synthetic bootstrap tuning installs the notion of attack targets and conforming decisions by fine-tuning the base model with bootstrapped trajectories. Decision-supervised reinforcement learning then optimizes two objectives jointly yet separately, reinforcing the attack with higher jailbreak reward while supervising the decision at each turn against an absolute target. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) attack success rates (ASR) across multiple datasets, victims, and judges, outperforming all static and interactive baselines, within almost the fewest turns, demonstrating both effectiveness and efficiency. For example, SEMA-Auto performs a $76.0\%$ ASR@1 within an average of $3.0$ turns against DeepSeek-V4-Flash on AdvBench, while the best static baseline is $54.8\%$ with fixed $7$ turns and the best interactive baseline is $43.8\%$ in $3.7$ turns. Against safety-hardened frontier models, GPT-oss-120B, GPT-5.4, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and GPT-6-Astra, our counter-trained attacker achieves an average $59.6\%$ ASR@1 on HarmBench, $13.8\%$ over prior SOTA. Our code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/SEMA

</details>


### [386] [Quantifying Claim Smoothing by LLM Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35793)
*Tiasa Singha Roy,Manya Wadhwa,Greg Durrett*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大语言模型在深度研究中会产生"平滑化"(smoothing)失败：生成的报告读起来像自信的综合分析，却未能准确反映底层文献；作者提出 claim 级评分流程 SmoothScore 量化该效应，并在 7 个系统、4 个数据集上发现智能体系统性地给出超出证据支撑的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用 LLM 阅读大规模文献集合并生成洞见（深度研究）需要跨来源综合信息。但模型倾向于将多样甚至相互冲突的来源压缩为单一叙事，丢掉语料的"证据锯齿感"(jaggedness)，给出比引文所能支撑更果断的结论，而现有研究缺乏对这种失败的系统刻画与度量。

Method: 提出 SmoothScore，一个 claim 级评分流程：(1) 从模型生成报告中抽取关键结论性 claim；(2) 检索与每个 claim 相关的证据；(3) 沿高层方面(aspects)对证据进行聚类；(4) 基于聚类后的证据对每个 claim 打分，量化智能体的平滑化程度。

Result: 在 7 个系统和 4 个数据集上评估，发现智能体持续产生强于证据所支持的 claim，即平滑化现象普遍存在。

Conclusion: 长文研究报告的"自信综合"表象掩盖了证据层面的失真；平滑化是可量化、跨系统与数据集稳定存在的失败模式，SmoothScore 为评估深度研究中的证据忠实度提供了 claim 级工具。

Abstract: Deep research, or any use of large language models (LLMs) to read a large document collection and produce insights, requires synthesizing information from different sources. In this work, we find that LLMs produce long-form research reports that read as confident syntheses but which fail to accurately reflect the underlying documents. We call this failure smoothing. In collapsing diverse and potentially conflicting sources into a single narrative, the model discards the evidential "jaggedness" of its corpus and asserts conclusions more decisive than the citations can support. We introduce a claim level scoring pipeline, SmoothScore, to quantify this effect. Our pipeline extracts key conclusive claims from model generated reports, then finds evidence relevant to each claim and clusters that evidence along high level aspects. Finally, each claim is scored with respect to the evidence to quantify the degree of smoothing done by the agent. Across 7 systems and 4 datasets, we find that agents consistently produce stronger claims than warranted.

</details>


### [387] [Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35804)
*Aidar Myrzakhan,Zhiqiang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 dSpark，一种基于调度蒸馏的框架，学习"何时提交（unmask）token"，以减少扩散语言模型解码轮数，同时保持生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）能并行生成多个 token，但完成一个回答常需大量解码轮次。高效生成不仅取决于哪些 token 易预测，还取决于提交它们对预测其余位置是否有帮助：高可预测 token 提供的上下文价值可能很低，而揭示一个较难预测的 token 可能使其他多个位置更快变得可预测。现有调度策略未充分考虑这种"揭示收益"的相互影响。

Method: 1）构造 unmasking 调度，优先揭示那些能使其他位置更易预测的 token，从而更早降低解码不确定性；2）将这些调度蒸馏进模型，以实现更快的并行采样；3）引入 KL 散度正则项以保持生成质量。

Result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上广泛评估。GSM8K 上，在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 和 Dream-7B-Instruct 上分别相比多种基线取得 10.12× 与 5.12× 加速，同时保持更优的任务性能。

Conclusion: 以"揭示收益"为导向的调度设计并结合调度蒸馏，可显著减少 dLLMs 的解码轮数并加速生成，且不牺牲甚至提升生成质量；代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.

</details>


### [388] [Understanding Jev-Style System One Models: Does Structure Reduce Selection Bias?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35826)
*Mingyang Song,Mao Zheng,Zhiyuan Ma,Xinpeng Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文通过"打乱选项顺序、固定题目与候选内容"的简单测试，考察Jev式决策结构是否降低选择偏差。结果显示：Jev准确率波动不足2个百分点，但累积失败集相对原始顺序扩大27–29%，且首次失败持续到最后一个呈现；聚合（投票）保护有限。结论是稳定准确率不足以证明对选择偏差的抵抗力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型即使被指示忽略呈现顺序或进行推理，选择偏差仍会持续存在。近年出现一族复现Jev式"系统一"行为的模型，直接对给定候选预测概率，但关于Jev各版本、Jev复现模型与生成式LLM在多选项任务中选择偏差的系统性比较仍然有限，核心问题未解：Jev式决策结构能否降低选择偏差。

Method: 采用简单测试：在保持问题与候选内容不变的前提下打乱选项顺序，将同一问题在8种呈现下追踪个体答案，并与固定顺序重复作答进行对照。实验覆盖2个Jev版本、12个Jev复现模型和6个生成式LLM，主实验集为来自两个基准的1,700道题；此外评估投票聚合对偏差的缓解作用。

Result: Jev准确率变化小于2个百分点，但累积失败集相对原始顺序扩大27–29%，且首次失败延续至最后一种呈现；这种"初始成功丢失"显著大于固定顺序重复下的情形，即使对高度可重复的Jev复现模型亦然。Jev相对LLM基线在保持正确选择上并无普遍优势；投票对Jev仅带来小幅增益，且即使全体一致的答案也经常出错。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了"可重复决策"与"在等价呈现下仍保持正确的决策"之间的差距：稳定的准确率并不能确立对选择偏差的抵抗力，需以跨等价呈现的一致正确性作为评估标准。

Abstract: Selection bias in large language models (LLMs) can persist despite instructions to ignore presentation order or prompts that elicit reasoning. Recent efforts to reproduce Jev-style System One behavior have produced a growing family of models that predict probabilities directly over supplied candidates. Yet systematic comparisons of selection bias across Jev versions, Jev reproductions, and generative LLMs remain limited in multi-option tasks. This leaves a central question: does Jev-style decision structure reduce selection bias? We address this question with a simple test that shuffles options while keeping question and candidate content fixed. Across two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs, we trace individual answers through eight presentations and compare them with fixed-order repetition. On our primary collection of 1,700 questions from two benchmarks, Jev's accuracy varies by less than two percentage points, yet its cumulative failure set expands by 27--29\% relative to the original order, with first failures continuing into the final presentation. This loss of initial successes is substantially larger than under fixed-order repetition, even for highly repeatable Jev reproductions. Nor does Jev show a general advantage over the LLM baselines in preserving correct choices. Aggregation offers limited protection: voting yields modest gains for Jev, while even unanimous answers are frequently wrong. These results expose a gap between repeatable decisions and decisions that remain correct across equivalent presentations, showing why stable accuracy alone cannot establish resistance to selection bias.

</details>


### [389] [Preserve to Expand: Source-Aware Adaptation and Model Merging for Multilingual LLM-Based ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35846)
*Yuchen Zhang,Haralambos Mouratidis,Ravi Shekhar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在基于connector的Speech LLM中，比较不同target-update构造与合并策略，实现多语言ASR向新语言扩展且不重放源语言数据、保持源语言性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言ASR系统扩展到新语言时，需在不重放源语言训练数据的前提下保留已支持语言，避免源语言遗忘。

Method: 面向connector式Speech LLM（可训练connector将语音表征映射到冻结LLM），评估target-update的构造方式与合并策略；单目标扩展对比target-only微调、标准TIES合并、SSU-Wanda+TIES；多目标扩展对比update合并与递归扩展。

Result: 单目标扩展中，target-only微调与标准TIES虽能学到新语言但源语言遗忘严重，SSU-Wanda+TIES取得最佳源语言保持折中；多目标扩展中，update合并源语言保持稳定，递归扩展在有利顺序下可提升目标适配但高度依赖顺序。

Conclusion: 多语言ASR扩展需在目标语言习得、源语言保持与目标语言更新间交互三者之间取得平衡。

Abstract: Expanding multilingual ASR systems to new languages is challenging when adaptation must preserve previously supported languages without replaying source-language training data. We study this problem in connector-based Speech LLMs, where a trainable connector maps speech representations into a frozen large language model. We evaluate target-update construction and merging strategies for adapting the connector while preserving source-language performance. In single-target expansion, target-only fine-tuning and standard TIES merging learn new languages but cause severe source-language forgetting, while SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the best source-preserving trade-off. In multi-target expansion, update merging provides stable source retention, whereas recursive expansion can improve target adaptation under favorable orders but is highly order-sensitive. These results show that multilingual ASR expansion requires balancing target acquisition, source retention, and interactions among target-language updates.

</details>


### [390] [Bridging Static and Agentic RAG for Taiwanese Historical Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23056)
*Kai-Hsin Chen,Wei-Yu Chen,Xuanjun Chen,Jyh-Shing Roger Jang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在共享生成器与混合检索后端、台湾历史问答的受控对比中，Agentic RAG与静态RAG总体性能相近，但在70.83%的问题上给出不同答案且优势相互抵消；作者提出事后选择器比较两路回答及引用证据，显著优于任一单一路径并回收60.34%的oracle增益空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic RAG能否稳定优于精心设计的静态RAG尚不明确；现有工作多以聚合指标比较，可能掩盖问题层面的差异。作者希望厘清二者在受控条件下的真实差别，并寻找更有效的利用方式。

Method: 控制变量对比实验：两管道共用同一生成器与混合检索后端，任务为台湾历史问答。在聚合指标之外做问题级一致性分析，并计算逐题选取更优回答的oracle上限；进而提出post-hoc选择器，对比两条管道的回答及其引用证据来择优输出。

Result: 两者聚合性能相近，但在70.83%的问题上输出不同，平均后优势大体抵消；oracle逐题选择较更优单管道提升综合分0.2417，显示可观选择空间；所提选择器显著优于任一单管道，并回收60.34%的oracle增益空间。

Conclusion: 聚合层面的比较会遮蔽检索策略在问题层面的实质性差异；利用不同RAG管道的互补性（问题级选择）可能比追求单一普适最优管道更有价值。

Abstract: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables language models to adapt retrieval based on previously retrieved evidence, but it remains unclear whether such adaptive orchestration consistently outperforms well-designed static pipelines. We conduct a controlled comparison of agentic and static RAG for Taiwanese historical question answering, sharing the same generator and hybrid retrieval backend. Despite similar aggregate performance, the two pipelines differ on 70.83% of questions, with their advantages largely canceling out when averaged. An oracle that selects the better response per question improves the composite score by 0.2417 over the better individual pipeline, revealing substantial headroom for question-level selection. We therefore introduce a post-hoc selector that compares the two responses and their cited evidence, significantly outperforming either individual pipeline and recovering 60.34% of the oracle headroom. These results show that aggregate comparisons can obscure meaningful question-level differences between retrieval strategies, suggesting that exploiting their complementarity may be more fruitful than seeking a universally superior pipeline.

</details>

# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [391] [Inverse Reconstruction of Double Imaging Schlieren](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33214)
*Shubham Saxena,João F. C. Mota*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出考虑有限孔径、离焦与放大的鬼像位移模型，并用TV正则化+无矩阵ADMM重建真实目标图像，以计算方式消除单镜离轴纹影系统的双成像伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离轴单镜纹影系统中，目标图像与位移鬼像叠加形成双成像伪影，既降低图像质量又增加解译难度；现有做法多依赖硬件抑制，缺乏物理一致的计算模型与重建方法。

Method: 建立新的鬼像位移模型，显式引入有限孔径支撑、离焦和放大率；基于该模型构建图像重建问题，采用全变分（TV）正则化，并用无矩阵交替方向乘子法（ADMM）求解。

Result: 在合成与真实纹影图像上的大量实验验证了模型有效性，表明算法高效且有效，并评估了参数失配条件下的性能。

Conclusion: 该框架为双成像的硬件抑制提供了计算替代方案，在保持离轴单镜纹影系统简单紧凑的同时实现物理一致的重建。

Abstract: Double imaging is a common artefact in off-axis single-mirror Schlieren systems. Depending on the distance between the object of interest and the mirror, together with the off-axis imaging geometry, such systems often capture images containing a superposition of the target image and a displaced ghost image, resulting in the so-called double imaging phenomenon. This not only degrades image quality, but also complicates its interpretation. To address this problem, we present a new model for ghost image displacement that takes into consideration finite-aperture support, defocus, and magnification. We then use this model to reconstruct the target image via total variation regularisation with a matrix-free alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm. Extensive experiments using both synthetic and real Schlieren images validate the proposed model, show the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithm, and evaluate its performance under parameter mismatch. The proposed framework provides a computational alternative to hardware-based suppression of double imaging, enabling physics-consistent reconstruction while preserving the simplicity and compactness of off-axis single-mirror Schlieren systems.

</details>


### [392] [Contact-Free Nuclear and Cytoplasmic Mechanophenotyping by Amplitude-Modulated Ultrasound and Phase-Locked Optical Diffraction Tomography: Computational Feasibility and Initial Experimental Readouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33369)
*Yagmur Isik,Merve Sevgi,Esmahan Caglar,Aysenur Akgun,Hasan Berkay Abdioglu,Gokhan Bora Esmer,Huseyin Uvet*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该论文用计算模型和初步实验评估"声激励+锁相光学衍射层析(ODT)"能否分别测量贴壁细胞核与细胞质的力学响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有细胞力学测量多给出整体或二维信息，难以在三维上区分核与细胞质的黏弹性差异；作者希望验证锁相声-光联合方案是否具备这种分辨能力。

Method: MHz超声载波经低频幅度调制，结合角度扫描全息获取三维第一谐波折射率响应；构建将MDA-MB-231细胞黏弹性有限元仿真、折射率模型、全息成像、相机噪声与ODT重建串联的计算模型，并开展初步三维层析实验（5个细胞）。

Result: 在10 Hz、0.1 Pa谐波剪切假设下，模型预测核剪切位移3.6–9.2 nm、顶部运动6.6–15.1 nm；幅值比R_A主要反映刚度对比，相对相位Δφ反映耗散差异；100个照明角度、每角度16次相位采集、4次平均可恢复外加硬化-恢复轨迹。实验5细胞平均幅值比0.616±0.098，相对相位−1.91°±0.58°，均低于1且为负。

Conclusion: 定性方向与选定模型情景一致，但样本量小、实验相位噪声未独立量化，不能作为定量力学验证；结果支持进一步评估锁相声ODT并指出受控验证实验的要求。

Abstract: We investigate whether acoustic stimulation combined with phase-locked optical diffraction tomography (ODT) could measure the mechanical responses of the nucleus and cytoplasm separately in adherent cells. A megahertz ultrasound carrier is amplitude-modulated at low frequencies, while angle-scanned holography provides a route to reconstruct the first-harmonic refractive-index response in three dimensions. We built a computational model connecting viscoelastic finite-element simulations of MDA-MB-231 cells with a refractive-index phantom, hologram formation, camera noise and ODT reconstruction. Under an assumed 0.1 Pa harmonic shear traction at 10 Hz, the model predicts 3.6 to 9.2 nm of nuclear shear and 6.6 to 15.1 nm of apical motion. The nuclear-to-cytoplasmic amplitude ratio (R_A) is primarily sensitive to stiffness contrast in the tested scenarios, while the relative phase (Delta phi) responds to differences in dissipation. A simulated protocol using 100 illumination angles and 16 phase visits per angle recovered an imposed stiffening and recovery trajectory after averaging four acquisitions. We also obtained initial 3D tomograms of adherent MDA-MB-231 cells and report preliminary regional measurements from five cells. Their mean amplitude ratio was 0.616 plus or minus 0.098, and their mean relative phase was -1.91 plus or minus 0.58 degrees (mean and between-cell sample standard deviation). All five amplitude ratios were below unity, and all phase differences were negative, consistent with the qualitative directions of selected model scenarios. The small cohort and the absence of independently quantified experimental phase noise prevent a claim of quantitative mechanical validation. Together, these results support further evaluation of phase-locked acoustic ODT and identify experimental requirements for a controlled validation study.

</details>


### [393] [Polarization-resolved haze in transparent wood - towards wooden glass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33459)
*Zheheng Song,Hui Chen,Mathias Nero,Jingjian Zhou,Ravi Shanker,Tom Willhammar,Lars Berglund,Ilya Sychugov*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 透明木材（TW）残留雾度的物理起源被揭示：源于细胞壁内亚波长双折射异质性的弱折射率对比散射，可用RGD模型描述，并具有显著偏振依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 透明木材虽具高透光率，但残留雾度限制成像清晰度，其散射的物理来源此前尚未确立，且被脱粘间隙强散射或管腔-细胞壁界面折射等效应所掩盖。

Method: 采用偏振分辨与光谱分辨的雾度测量，结合弱折射率对比的Rayleigh-Gans-Debye（RGD）模型拟合；用扫描电子衍射表征浸润细胞壁内的纤维素畴；并进行时间分辨测量考察光传输特性。

Result: 垂直纤维偏振下雾度低至21%（非偏振光550 nm处为40–45%），透射率约92%；低雾度谱在400–800 nm遵循反平方关系；扫描电子衍射显示细胞壁内存在衍射响应显著不同的空间分立畴；时间分辨测量支持近无散射的准弹道传输；仅选取特定偏振即可显著提升成像可见度。

Conclusion: 偏振相关雾度与透明木材内部层级各向异性结构相关联，为通过折射率匹配工程实现玻璃级清晰度的各向异性复合材料提供了途径。

Abstract: Transparent wood (TW) composites possess residual haze that limits image clarity despite their high light transmission, yet the physical origin of this scattering has not been established. Here, polarization-resolved measurements reveal a pronounced polarization dependence of scattering by a wood-polymer composite with improved refractive index matching. Polarization- and spectrally-resolved haze as low as 21% (40-45% at 550 nm for unpolarized light) with transmittance of approximately 92% for polarization perpendicular to the fibers was detected. It is found that the low-haze spectrum closely follows an inverse-square relation over the 400-800 nm range, well described by a weak-index-contrast Rayleigh-Gans-Debye (RGD) model invoking subwavelength birefringent heterogeneities within the cell wall. This physical mechanism was previously obscured by haze-limiting strong scattering from debonding gaps or refraction at the lumen-cell wall interface. Scanning electron diffraction independently reveals spatially distinct domains with markedly different cellulose diffraction responses within the infiltrated cell walls. The observed polarization-dependent refractive-index mismatch is attributed to inherent cellulose birefringence. Time-resolved measurements further support nearly scattering-free quasi-ballistic transport of the sampled transmitted light. It is demonstrated that selecting only a preferential polarization markedly improves image visibility through TW without further material modification. These findings connect polarization-dependent haze to the internal structure of transparent wood and identify ways to engineer a refractive-index match in hierarchical anisotropic composites towards glass-like clarity.

</details>


### [394] [Deep-Microscopic Photonic Bandstructure of a Two-Dimensional Honeycomb Lattice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33709)
*Pronoy Das,Sathwik Bharadwaj,Wenbo Sun,Zubin Jacob*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 论文提出基于Maxwell哈密顿量及其特征方程的深微观非局域光子理论，给出完整空间色散（深微观光子能带）与实空间Bloch场纹理，并在二维能隙蜂窝晶格紧束缚模型中演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统材料中光的描述依赖宏观模型，对微观晶格结构做平均，仅在半经典极限（多格点集体局域响应）下成立，无法刻画完整的空间色散，需要晶格分辨的光描述。

Method: 构建深微观非局域光子理论：以Maxwell哈密顿量及其特征方程为出发点，求解获得深微观光子能带结构与对应的实空间Bloch场纹理；以二维能隙蜂窝晶格紧束缚模型作为演示体系。

Result: 解给出完整空间色散形式的深微观光子能带结构，以及相应的实空间Bloch场纹理；在二维能隙蜂窝晶格紧束缚模型中验证了该理论。

Conclusion: 该框架将光子置于与电子、声子相同的微观基础之上，为研究色散材料中光的拓扑、耗散与量子涨落提供统一路径。

Abstract: Conventional descriptions of light in materials rely on macroscopic models that average the optical response over the microscopic lattice structures. These models are deployed in the semi-classical limit, where the collective local response over many lattice sites is adequate. However, they fail to capture the full spatial dispersion, which requires a lattice-resolved description of light. We address this limitation by formulating a deep-microscopic nonlocal theory of the photon based on the Maxwell Hamiltonian and its characteristic equation. The solution reveals the full spatial dispersion in the form of deep-microscopic photonic bandstructure, and corresponding real-space Bloch field textures. We demonstrate our theory for a two-dimensional (2D) tight-binding model of a gapped honeycomb lattice. Our framework thus extends photons to the same microscopic footing as electrons or phonons, providing a unified route to studying topology, dissipation, and quantum fluctuations of light in dispersive materials.

</details>


### [395] [Optical imaging with only the evanescent fields and without diffraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33720)
*Mufei Xiao*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一个仅利用倏逝场进行光学成像的概念框架，通过将偶极辐射分解为倏逝场与均匀传播波并抑制后者，从根本上摆脱衍射极限，实现亚衍射成像并有望推动半导体光刻与芯片制造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统光学成像受标准光学衍射限制，最小可分辨特征尺寸受工作波长约束，制约了空间分辨率与先进光刻、芯片制造的发展，因此需要一种能有效消除或衰减衍射效应的成像途径。

Method: 基于偶极辐射可分解为倏逝场与均匀传播波的理论，明确抑制均匀传播波所需的显式条件，成功解耦并移除均匀分量，使成像等光学任务仅通过倏逝通道完成；并讨论了该设想的物理可行性，给出利用现有实验室与工业技术实现的具体示例。

Result: 在理论上论证了仅用倏逝通道执行亚衍射成像的可行性，并表明最小可实现特征尺寸不再由工作波长决定，从而带来空间分辨率的空前提升。

Conclusion: 该概念若实现，将重塑光学与基础物理的核心范式，并为先进半导体光刻和芯片制造提供提升分辨率的直接路径。

Abstract: We report on a conceptual framework for optical imaging utilizing exclusively evanescent fields, effectively eliminating or attenuating standard optical diffraction. We present the theoretical foundation of this concept based on the decomposition of dipole radiation into evanescent fields and homogeneous propagating waves, exploring the explicit conditions required to suppress the latter. By successfully decoupling and removing the homogeneous component, optical tasks, such as sub-diffraction imaging, can be executed solely via evanescent channels, bypassing traditional diffractive limits. We discuss the physical feasibility of this approach and provide concrete examples of how this conjecture can be realized using currently available laboratory and industrial techniques. The realization of this concept promises to redefine core paradigms in optics and fundamental physics. Because the minimum achievable feature size is no longer governed by the operating wavelength, this approach enables an unprecedented increase in spatial resolution, offering a direct pathway to advance state-of-the-art semiconductor lithography and chip manufacturing.

</details>


### [396] [Accurate measurement of Lithium Tantalate birefringence in whispering gallery resonators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33855)
*Linjie Shao,Andrey B. Matsko,Anatoliy A. Savchenkov,Harald G. L. Schwefel,Nicholas J. Lambert,Florian Sedlmeir,Dmitry V. Strekalov*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 利用高分辨率回音壁谐振腔光谱，澄清了钽酸锂(LTA)双折射符号之争：室温近红外下化学计量比LTA为负双折射，而同成分(congruent)LTA为正双折射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LTA是重要的铁电晶体，广泛用于压电、电光和光学非线性器件，但其双折射大小乃至符号长期存在争议（有报道为负，有报道为正）；且晶体组分从同成分到化学计量比存在样品间差异，使问题更加复杂。

Method: 基于由该晶体制备的光学回音壁谐振腔(WGR)开展高分辨率光谱测量，利用谐振腔对折射率的极高灵敏度来判定双折射的符号与大小。

Result: 高灵敏测量明确显示：在室温近红外波段，化学计量比LTA为负双折射，而同成分LTA为正双折射。

Conclusion: LTA双折射符号的争议源于晶体组分差异；符号随组分（化学计量比 vs. 同成分）而变，这为统一此前矛盾报道提供了实验依据。

Abstract: Lithium Tantalate (LTA) is an important ferroelectric crystal widely used in piezoelectric, electro-optic, and nonlinear optical devices. Although this crystal is very common, there is an ongoing debate regarding its birefringence magnitude, and even its sign. While some sources claim it to be negative, others maintain that it is positive. The issue is further complicated by the sample-to-sample variation in the crystal composition, ranging from congruent to stoichiometric. Here we report the experimental exploration of this question based on high-resolution spectroscopy of optical whispering gallery resonators fabricated from this crystal. These sensitive measurements unambiguously indicate that in the near-infrared range at room temperature the stoichiometric LTA is negative, while the congruent LTA is positive.

</details>


### [397] [Functional Superoscillations in a Wave Processor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34111)
*Yuntian Wang,Md Sadman Sakib Rahman,Aydogan Ozcan*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该论文展示了对超振荡函数的连续、复用光学处理：将标量自变量编码到波前上，用固定的衍射波处理器并行合成近似函数输出的光学响应，从而实现"功能性超振荡"，其频率不受衍射截止限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理波处理器受衍射限制，但其实现的数学函数带宽未必需要由此决定，本文意在探索突破衍射截止的函数计算带宽。

Method: 将标量自变量编码到波前，采用固定衍射波处理器并行合成光学响应；构建复用架构同时评估多个目标超振荡函数，并进行可见光实验验证复值超振荡函数合成。

Result: 实现了复值超振荡函数的合成，以及同时评估谐波含量超过光学输入编码的多个目标超振荡函数的复用架构，可见光实验验证了该"超越编码"超振荡机制。

Conclusion: 确立"功能性超振荡"作为波基计算的设计原则，表明干涉、衍射深度与空间通道分配可扩展无源波处理器的函数可达范围，并在模拟光学计算中分离了函数带宽与物理波带宽。

Abstract: Physical wave processors are constrained by diffraction, but the bandwidth of the mathematical functions they implement need not be set by it. Here, we demonstrate continuous and multiplexed optical processing of superoscillatory functions, in which a scalar argument is encoded onto a wavefront and a fixed diffractive wave processor synthesizes optical responses that approximate the corresponding function outputs in parallel. Unlike conventional superoscillatory optics that generates predetermined fields, superoscillation here is expressed in the input-output dependence on the encoded argument. Its frequencies are therefore distinct from the transverse spatial frequencies of propagating light and are not subject to the same diffraction-imposed cutoff. We demonstrate complex-valued superoscillatory function synthesis and introduce a multiplexed architecture that simultaneously evaluates distinct target superoscillatory functions whose harmonic content exceeds that of the optical input encoding. Visible-light experiments further validate this beyond-encoding superoscillatory regime. Together, these results establish functional superoscillation as a design principle for wave-based computation and show how interference, diffractive depth and spatial channel allocation extend the functional reach of passive wave processors. More broadly, these analyses establish a separation between functional bandwidth and physical wave bandwidth in analog optical computation.

</details>


### [398] [Non-Hermitian Topology of a Subwavelength Resonator in Synthetic Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33871)
*N. Solodovchenko,F. Zhang,M. Bochkarev,K. Samusev,M. Song,M. Limonov,A. Bogdanov*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 利用合成参数空间重构亚波长环形谐振腔的复能带，实验观测到由两个连接体费米弧的奇异点及拓扑稳健的准连续域束缚态(q-BIC)构成的光谱三重态，二者在合成空间中相交形成"费米弧q-BIC"，并将非厄米拓扑拓展至亚波长谐振器体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非厄米奇异点与能带非平凡拓扑此前主要在扩展周期系统中研究，其现象（奇异点、体费米弧）天然依赖周期性与动量空间；作者希望将这类非厄米拓扑推广到亚波长谐振器等有限尺寸、非周期平台。

Method: 以亚波长环形谐振腔为对象，构建由几何参数张成的合成空间，在其中重构复能带结构；通过实验测量并结合拓扑缠绕分析，考察奇异点、体费米弧与q-BIC线的关系。

Result: 实验观测到光谱三重态：两个奇异点由体费米弧相连，并伴随一个拓扑稳健的q-BIC；费米弧q-BIC恰好出现在体费米弧与q-BIC线的交点，建立起两类谱奇异点之间的直接拓扑联系；在合成空间中环绕奇异点可可视化复能带的非平凡拓扑，并显示被费米弧连接的两个奇异点具有相反的半整数拓扑荷。

Conclusion: 将非厄米拓扑推广到亚波长结构，确立紧凑谐振器作为光子学、微波物理与声学领域的通用平台。

Abstract: Non-Hermitian singularities and the nontrivial topology of energy bands have been extensively explored in extended periodic systems, where phenomena such as exceptional points and bulk Fermi arcs are naturally associated with periodicity and momentum space. Here, we show that this non-Hermitian topology can be extended to the domain of subwavelength resonators using a synthetic space. By reconstructing the complex energy bands of a subwavelength ring resonator in the synthetic space of geometrical parameters, we experimentally observe a spectral triplet formed by two exceptional points (EPs) connected by a bulk Fermi arc and a topologically robust quasi-bound state in the continuum (q-BIC). This Fermi-arc q-BIC emerges exactly at the intersection of the bulk Fermi arc and the q-BIC line in synthetic space, establishing a direct topological link between two spectral singularities. Encircling the EPs in synthetic space visualizes the nontrivial topology of the complex energy-band structure and reveals the opposite half-integer topological charges of the EPs connected by the bulk Fermi arc. These results extend non-Hermitian topology to subwavelength structures and establish compact resonators as a versatile platform for applications in photonics, microwave physics, and acoustics.

</details>


### [399] [Transverse detuned loading for modulation bandwidth enhancement in VCSELs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35578)
*Giacomo Graziano,Richard Schatz,Antoine Pissis,Wilfried Maineult,Aurelio Rossinelli,Philipp Täschler,Simon Hönl,Vincenzo Pasanisi,Tobias Süss,Dario Schiavon,Donato Bonfrate,Martin Spieser,Stefano Tirelli,Evgeny Zibik*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过在VCSEL中实验实现横向失谐加载机制，获得44 GHz弛豫振荡频率与超过50 GHz的3 dB电调制带宽，在25–75 °C范围内稳健工作，并实现无DSP的106.25 Gb/s NRZ传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统氧化限制VCSEL在实现100 Gb/s以上高速传输时仍需依赖高功耗数字信号处理，调制带宽与功率效率成为短距光互连扩容的瓶颈，因此需要从器件物理层面提升本征调制带宽。

Method: 在850 nm单模VCSEL中引入横向失谐加载：利用载流子引起的折射率变化重塑经设计的横向模式，使其与空间选择性光损耗的重叠随载流子密度升高而减小，从而产生负微分损耗，类似于长波长反射率侧翼工作的失谐加载DBR激光器。

Result: 器件载流子-光子弛豫频率提升至44 GHz，3 dB电调制带宽超过50 GHz；增强效应在25 °C至75 °C范围内持续存在；同一器件在无数字信号处理、无发射端预加重、无接收端均衡条件下支持106.25 Gb/s NRZ传输。

Conclusion: 横向失谐加载被证明是一种稳健的替代方案，可有效扩展VCSEL的调制带宽，为高速短距光互连提供低功耗、免DSP的器件级解决路径。

Abstract: Directly modulated vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) are central to short-reach optical interconnects, where modulation bandwidth and power efficiency are critical factors for increasing data transfer capacity. Conventional oxide VCSELs still require power-hungry signal processing to achieve high-speed data transmission above 100 Gb/s. Here we report an experimental implementation of detuned loading in a VCSEL to enhance the modulation bandwidth. The detuned loading is achieved by carrier-induced index variations that reshape an engineered transverse mode so its overlap with spatially selective optical losses decreases with increased carrier density. This produces a negative differential loss reminiscent of that in detuned-loaded DBR lasers lasing on the long-wavelength reflectivity flank. The resulting 850 nm single-mode VCSEL exhibits an enhanced carrier-photon relaxation frequency of 44 GHz, yielding a 3dB electrical modulation bandwidth exceeding 50 GHz. The enhancement persists from 25 °C to 75 °C showing the robustness of the mechanism introduced. The same device supports 106.25 Gb/s NRZ transmission without digital signal processing, transmitter pre-emphasis or receiver equalization. These results establish transverse detuned loading as a robust alternative approach for extending the modulation bandwidth of vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers.

</details>


### [400] [Surface Functionalization with Lasers: from Nanostructures to Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33888)
*Bastian Zielinski,Martin Kahlmeyer,Stefan Böhm,Jörn Bonse,Camilo Florian*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该章节综述脉冲激光与固体表面相互作用及表面改性的机理与应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料科学跨学科发展需要按需定制材料性能，而脉冲激光可诱导受控的材料改变以提升难以获得的特性；同时需优化光与金属、半导体、介电体等不同固体的相互作用以提升加工效率。

Method: 综述性章节：系统探讨脉冲激光束与物质表面的相互作用，涵盖从纳米/微米尺度形貌变化到化学改性的多类激光诱导改性过程，并讨论针对不同固体类型的光参数调控策略。

Result: 归纳了激光诱导表面改性在摩擦学（摩擦、磨损、润滑）、润湿性（表面能与接触角调控）、焊接增强及分子黏附优化等方面的应用效果。

Conclusion: 激光加工可精确调控材料表面性能，为材料与表面科学开辟新前沿，并在工业与技术领域提供创新解决方案。

Abstract: Pulsed laser sources stand out as remarkable and versatile tools in the growing interdisciplinary field of materials science, offering capabilities for tailoring and customizing materials to meet specific requirements. Their ability to induce different controlled material alterations allows enhancing material properties that might otherwise remain elusive. In essence, laser-induced material modifications encompass a spectrum of transformative processes, ranging from subtle topographical changes in the nano- and microscale, to intricate chemical modifications. Among the challenges to overcome are the creation of approaches that allow tuning the properties of light to optimize interactions on various types of solids, including metals, semiconductors, and dielectrics. Understanding these interactions is paramount towards efficiency increase of the processing techniques. This chapter embarks on a comprehensive exploration of the intricate dance between pulsed laser beams and their interaction with matter at the surface. The applications of laser-induced surface modifications are far-reaching and extend into widespread industrial fields. Examples of these include tribology, where the study of friction, wear, and lubrication is paramount. Besides that, the modified surfaces find applications in wetting phenomena, changing surface energy and contact angle control, enhanced welding processes, and optimizing molecular adhesion for stronger and durable interfaces. The ability to precisely engineer material surface properties through laser processing opens new frontiers in materials and surface sciences, offering innovative solutions and pushing the boundaries of what can be achieved in various industrial and technological domains.

</details>


### [401] [Compressive microendoscopy in the presence of noise and misalignment: the translational correlation advantage of graded-index fibers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33933)
*M. S. Pochechuev,T. I. Rajib,A. Dharmasiri,A. M. Zheltikov*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文比较阶跃型(SI)与渐变型(GRIN)多模光纤在压缩感知显微内窥镜中的鲁棒性，发现二者噪声敏感性相当，但GRIN光纤对横向错位误差显著更稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算显微内窥镜可将多模光纤拓展至高分辨成像，但方法对实验误差高度敏感，缺乏对不同光纤类型鲁棒性的系统评估。

Method: 基于模式展开的仿真，在存在基础光子噪声与光纤横向位移的条件下，比较SI与GRIN多模光纤经压缩感知重建的图像精度。

Result: 两类光纤噪声敏感性相当；GRIN光纤对横向错位的鲁棒性显著优于SI光纤。

Conclusion: GRIN多模光纤可作为对对准误差容忍的稳健计算显微内窥镜平台。

Abstract: Multimode fibers (MMFs) offer a minimally invasive platform for deep-tissue and multisite in vivo optical sensing. Computational microendoscopy methods extend them into the high-resolution imaging domain, but are quite sensitive to experimental errors. This study investigates the robustness of microendoscopy based on compressive sensing (CS) by comparing step-index (SI) MMFs with graded-index (GRIN) fibers. Mode-expansion-based simulations are used to assess the accuracy of image reconstruction in the presence of fundamental photon noise and lateral fiber shifts. We show that both fiber types exhibit comparable noise sensitivity, but GRIN fibers are significantly more robust to lateral misalignment errors. These results establish GRIN MMFs as an alignment-tolerant platform for robust computational microendoscopy.

</details>


### [402] [Nonreciprocal magneto-optic beam steering of thermal emission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33935)
*Mason Christiansen,Daniel Cui,Aaswath P. Raman*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作提出并数值验证了热辐射的非互易光束偏转：外磁场打破±kx导模简并，实现非对称、可调的热辐射定向发射，并在24.5 μm的III-V半导体光子结构上展示了大于0.5的非互易度与22°的光束偏转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统热发射体受基尔霍夫热辐射定律约束，吸收率与发射率绑定，限制了辐射能量技术与传感系统。磁光材料在磁场下可产生非互易热发射以突破该限制，但现有研究多集中于光谱非互易性，对热发射方向性的非互易调控关注甚少。

Method: 基于磁光效应设计III-V半导体光子结构，工作波长为24.5 μm（该波段激光光源稀缺）；通过外加磁场解除+/-kx方向导模的简并，实现非对称且可调的热辐射定向发射，并进行数值仿真验证。

Result: 在50 mT磁场下，±75°之间的非互易度大于0.5；在150 mT下峰值发射率不对称度超过0.6；在0–1 T范围内实现22°的光束偏转。

Conclusion: 该方案提供了一种全固态的热辐射光束操控手段，为白炽光源的磁控光束扫描提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Conventional thermal emitters obey Kirchhoff's law of thermal radiation, which ties absorptivity to emissivity and places a fundamental limit on a range of radiative energy technologies and sensing systems. This constraint can be overcome using magneto-optic materials, which exhibit nonreciprocal thermal emission under an applied magnetic field. While the spectral nonreciprocity of magneto-optic devices has been explored theoretically and experimentally, nonreciprocal control over the direction of thermal emission has received far less attention. Here, we propose and numerically demonstrate nonreciprocal beam steering of thermal emission, wherein an applied magnetic field lifts the degeneracy between guided modes at +/- kx, enabling asymmetric and tunable directional thermal emission. We highlight a III-V semiconductor photonic structure operating at 24.5 um, a wavelength with few laser sources. This structure exhibits a nonreciprocity greater than 0.5 between +/- 75 degrees at 50 mT, a peak emissivity asymmetry over 0.6 at 150 mT, and 22 degrees of beam steering between 0 and 1 T. Our approach provides a solid-state means of steering a thermal beam, offering a potential route to magnetically controlled beam scanning of incandescent sources.

</details>


### [403] [Axion Quasibound States in the Continuum and Their Enhanced Axion Nonlinearity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34195)
*Chang-Yin Ji,Chong Wang,Jiafang Li,Yugui Yao*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文提出利用对称敏感型连续谱束缚态(BIC)实现凝聚态体系中动力学轴子准粒子(DAQ)的全光探测，并借助轴子准BIC在临界耦合下将DAQ介导的二次谐波产生(SHG)效率提升逾10^5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DAQ的相干振荡θ场振幅比静态对应量更小，实验观测极为困难；现有探测手段主要依赖Kerr效应与Faraday效应，缺乏手性无关且灵敏的光学探针。

Method: 引入对称敏感型BIC物理：DAQ引起光学剪切，无需几何工程设计即可破坏超构光栅的C2z对称性，使对称保护BIC转化为轴子准BIC；分析动量空间中品质因数与拓扑荷的演化及远场光学共振特征；并利用临界耦合区的轴子准BIC增强基频光场。

Result: 品质因数与拓扑荷的演化及远场共振提供了超越Kerr/Faraday效应的非手性光学特征用于DAQ探测；SHG效率较体轴子材料提升10^5倍以上，转换效率超过10^-6 W^-1，且该SHG由磁电耦合主导，区别于常规SHG材料机制。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了通过非手性光学效应探测DAQ的新途径，并为可重构光子学与太赫兹非线性光学提供了通用方案。

Abstract: Dynamical axion quasiparticles (DAQs) in condensed-matter systmes have emerged as a fascinating platform for exploring axion physics and nonlinear optical phenomena. However, the amplitude of the coherent oscillating $θ$ field is even smaller than that of the static counterpart, making the experimental observation of DAQs particularly challenging. Here, we introduce symmetry-sensitive bound states in the continuum (BICs) physics to enable the all-optical detection of DAQs and enhance DAQ-mediated second-harmonic generation (SHG). Specifically, we uncover that DAQs induce optical shear that breaks the $C_{2z}$ symmetry of metagratings without geometric engineering, thereby converting symmetry-protected BICs into axion quasi-BICs (qBICs). In this context, the evolution of the quality factor and topological charge in momentum space, together with the appearance of optical resonances in far field associated with axion qBICs, offers achiral optical signatures for DAQ detection beyond the widely used Kerr and Faraday effects. Furthermore, by exploiting axion qBICs in the critical coupling regime to enhance fundamental optical field, we show that the SHG efficiency can be enhanced more than $10^5$-fold compared to bulk axion materials, achieving a conversion efficiency exceeding $10^{-6}~W^{-1}$. The SHG is governed by the magnetoelectric coupling, which differs from that in conventional SHG materials. Our findings establish a new approach for probing DAQs via achiral optical effects, while providing a versatile route for reconfigurable photonics and terahertz nonlinear optics.

</details>


### [404] [Yb/Sr optical clock comparison at 2.2E-18 uncertainty over a 1350-km fiber link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34250)
*Lei Hou,Xiang-Pei Liu,Zhuan-Xian Xiong,Fa-Xi Chen,Wen-Xuan Song,Jian-Yu Guan,Qiang Zhu,Yu-Chen Zhang,Xiang Zhang,Bing Wang,De-Zhi Xiong,De-Quan Kong,Jia-Hao Zhang,Long-Fei Liao,Shao-Mao Wang,Xing-Yang Cui,Ping Xu,Peng Liu,Jie Li,Xiao Jiang,Ling-Xiang He,Li-Bo Li,Qi Shen,Youchao Xie,Lei Wang,Sheng-Kai Liao,Juan Yin,Cheng-Zhi Peng,Wen-Bin Shen,Bao-Long Lu,Han-Ning Dai,Yu-Ao Chen,Qiang Zhang,Hai-Feng Jiang,Jian-Wei Pan*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 武汉镱光晶格钟与上海锶光晶格钟通过1350 km相位稳定光纤链路实现城际频率比测量，Yb/Sr频率比为1.207 507 039 343 337 716 0(26)，总不确定度2.18E-18，首次达到秒定义重定义路线图要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 秒（SI second）重定义需不同实验室基于不同原子钟的独立频率比测量，总不确定度低于5E-18，以通过一致性检验验证单钟评估；而此前该量级比较仅在同地钟间实现过少数几次且结果明显不一致，高精度比较被限制在本地或公里级链路。

Method: 利用跨越1350 km相位稳定光纤链路，将武汉的镱（Yb）光晶格钟与上海的锶（Sr）光晶格钟进行远程比对，测定Yb/Sr频率比，并采用贝叶斯统计处理不确定度；同时将测量结果与地球潮汐模型进行相关性分析。

Result: Yb/Sr频率比为1.207 507 039 343 337 716 0(26)，贝叶斯统计不确定度1.14E-18，总不确定度2.18E-18；测得比值与地球潮汐显著相关，其响应在统计不确定度内与模型一致。

Conclusion: 这是首个总不确定度达到重定义路线图要求的城际长距离频率比测量，表明城际尺度上光钟网络可用于频率比对与地球重力势传感，是迈向广域光钟网络的关键一步。

Abstract: Redefining the International system of Units (SI) second requires independent frequency-ratio measurements between clocks based on different laboratories, with an overall uncertainty below 5E-18, to validate individual clock evaluations through consistency checks. Reaching this uncertainty over long distances has remained challenging. So far, comparisons at this level have been achieved only a few times, between co-located clocks, and their results disagree markedly. Previous high-precision comparisons have therefore been limited to local or kilometre-scale links. Here we compare a ytterbium optical lattice clock in Wuhan with a strontium optical lattice clock in Shanghai over a phase-stabilized fiber link spanning 1350 km, and determine the Yb/Sr frequency ratio to be 1.207 507 039 343 337 716 0(26), with a Bayesian statistical uncertainty of 1.14E-18 and a total uncertainty of 2.18E-18. To our knowledge, this is the first intercity long distance frequency-ratio measurement, whose total uncertainty reaches the level required by the redefinition roadmap. The measured ratio exhibits a significant correlation with Earth tides and its response agree with the model within the statistical uncertainty. At intercity scale, this comparison demonstrates the capability of an optical-clock network for frequency comparison and Earths gravitational-potential sensing, a key step toward a wide-area optical-clock network.

</details>


### [405] [High-speed laser speckle contrast imaging of the human retina](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34605)
*Zacharie Auray,Jules Guillou,Basile Malbois,Maxime Boy-Arnould,Michael Atlan*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文展示了基于Phantom S980高速相机的实时人眼视网膜激光散斑对比成像系统，在3840×2160分辨率、1000 fps、988 μs曝光下实现62.5张对比度图/秒的实时处理，并在一名健康志愿者上记录了视乳头周围视网膜的血流动态，观察到动脉舒张期切迹与自发性静脉搏动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视网膜血流动力学的高时空分辨率可视化需要高帧率散斑成像与高吞吐数据处理，但现有系统在原始数据通量与实时对比度计算之间存在瓶颈，本文旨在建立一个高吞吐视网膜散斑对比可视化的可行工作点。

Method: 使用Phantom S980流式相机（3840×2160、8-bit、1000 fps、988 μs曝光）结合852 nm漫射Maxwellian照明（入瞳功率5.0 mW），在无药物散瞳条件下记录右眼视乳头周围视网膜4段视频（每段4096帧，共16384帧）。采用开源Holoflow软件在NVIDIA RTX 5090上以5×5空间像素与16帧非重叠块计算K=σ/μ，输出62.5张对比度图/秒，渲染60帧/秒，无额外平均，标称原始输入吞吐8.29 Gpixel/s。

Result: 成功可视化主要视网膜动静脉分支及较小视乳头周围血管；在主视网膜动静脉中观察到心动周期相关变化，区域逆对比度曲线上可见动脉舒张期切迹与自发性静脉搏动；所有16384帧均被保留并处理。

Conclusion: 该单志愿者演示确立了一个高吞吐视网膜散斑对比可视化的运行工作点；生理观察为描述性，对比度是仪器依赖的可观测量而非标定的血流速度。

Abstract: We demonstrate real-time laser speckle contrast imaging of the human retina using a Phantom S980 streaming camera at $3840\times2160$ pixels, 8-bit depth, and 1000 frames per second, with a $988\,μ\mathrm{s}$ exposure. We report four recordings of the peripapillary retina around the optic disc in the right eye of one healthy 25-year-old emmetropic man, acquired without pharmacological pupil dilation, using 852-nm diffuse Maxwellian illumination at an entering optical power of 5.0 mW. Each recording contained 4096 frames (4.10 s), and all 16384 frames in the reported recordings were retained. Open-source Holoflow software on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 computes $K=σ/μ$ over $5\times5$ spatial pixels and nonoverlapping blocks of 16 frames, producing 62.5 contrast maps/s with 60-frame/s rendering and no additional averaging. The nominal raw-input throughput is 8.29 Gpixel/s. Main retinal arterial and venous branches and smaller peripapillary vessels were visualized. Variations during the cardiac cycle were visible in the principal retinal arteries and veins, as illustrated in the Supplementary Videos. Regional inverse-contrast traces show an arterial dicrotic notch and spontaneous venous pulsation. This single-volunteer demonstration establishes an operating point for high-throughput retinal speckle-contrast visualization. Physiological observations are descriptive; contrast is an instrument-dependent observable rather than a calibrated blood-flow velocity.

</details>


### [406] [Physical Adjoint Learning in Wave Systems with Asymmetric Couplings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34815)
*Lucas J. Fernández-Alcázar,John Guillamon,Krishna Joshi,Tsampikos Kottos*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种原位伴随优化框架，借助前向与转置算符间的低成本相似变换，在非互易波系统中实现物理硬件内的梯度计算，实验次数不随优化参数数量增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自优化物理系统需在硬件内部直接获得优化梯度，避免依赖精确数值模型。波系统中现有原位伴随方法依赖互易性物理实现伴随动力学，在非互易（非对称耦合）系统中失效，因为伴随场无法通过原器件直接获取。

Method: 构建原位伴随优化框架：利用前向算符与转置算符之间存在计算成本低廉的相似变换，将伴随场计算推广至具有非对称耦合的波系统；调动定制注入激励、定向测量与可调参数等自由度，在同一物理平台的前向实验上重建伴随场。

Result: 在宽带透射与隔离、相干完美吸收、可编程波前整形及空间选择性传感等多类任务上验证了协议的多功能性；所需实验次数与优化参数数量无关，且系统部分区域完全不可访问时方法仍适用。

Conclusion: 结果为复杂非互易波系统中基于物理梯度的自优化学习提供了可行途径，拓展了原位伴随优化的适用范围。

Abstract: Developing self-optimizing physical systems that learn directly from their response to external stimuli offers a promising route toward adaptive and intelligent machines. A key ingredient is the ability to evaluate optimization gradients within the physical hardware, bypassing the need for accurate numerical models. In wave systems, \textit{in-situ} adjoint methods provide this capability by exploiting reciprocity to physically realize the adjoint dynamics. However, this approach generally breaks down in nonreciprocal systems, where the adjoint field cannot be directly accessed through the original device. Here, we develop an \textit{in-situ} adjoint optimization framework that extends physical gradient computation to wave systems with asymmetric couplings through computationally low-cost similarity transformations between the forward and transposed operators. We utilize available degrees of freedom like tailored injected excitations, targeted measurements, and tunable parameters, to enable adjoint field reconstruction through forward experiments on the same physical platform. We demonstrate the versatility of the protocol through broadband transmission and isolation, coherent perfect absorption, programmable wavefront shaping, and spatially selective sensing. Our results provide a route to self-optimization in complex nonreciprocal wave systems through efficient physical gradient-based learning. The number of experiments required by the protocol does not increase with the number of optimization parameters, and the method remains applicable even when parts of the system are completely inaccessible.

</details>


### [407] [Electro-optic comb-driven massive data transmission on monolithically integrated lithium niobate photonic circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34821)
*Yikun Chen,Chuang Xu,Ke Zhang,Xiong Wu,Kangping Zhong,Xiangzhi Xie,Hanke Feng,Yifan Wu,Chao Lu,Alan Pak Tao Lau,Cheng Wang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文在薄膜铌酸锂（TFLN）平台上演示平坦顶电光频率梳，实现46通道16.56 Tb/s相干传输及可重构100-GHz间隔与单片WDM发射机，验证其作为数据中心WDM光源引擎的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI大模型驱动数据中心互连带宽需求超越传统缩放规律，需引入WDM将长距光谱效率迁移至短距高带宽场景；但现有克尔梳与锁模激光器在功率效率、光谱平坦度和相位噪声上不足，通道间隔固定且与标准WDM栅格冲突，与高速调制器共集成困难。

Method: 采用TFLN电光梳，具备平坦光谱、可调波长与梳间隔，且原生兼容（解）复用器与高速调制器；利用两台激光器与50-GHz片上电光梳取46个波长通道，在香港两所大学与两个数据中心间98.84 km现网光纤上进行相干传输；经片上解复用器将梳重配置为100-GHz间隔实现10通道80-GBaud传输；并演示集成梳与高速调制器的单片WDM发射机。

Result: 98.84 km现网链路上实现46通道16.56 Tb/s相干传输；100-GHz间隔下实现10通道80-GBaud、6.4 Tb/s相干传输；单片WDM发射机实现19通道45-GBaud IM/DD传输、1.71 Tb/s。

Conclusion: TFLN电光梳可作为灵活、紧凑、可扩展的WDM引擎，同时适用于相干与IM/DD数据中心链路，满足快速增长的带宽需求。

Abstract: Driven by large AI models, the demand for datacenter interconnects is outstripping traditional scaling laws. This necessitates a transition toward dense multiplexing techniques, such as wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM), for datacenter environments, transferring long-haul spectral efficiency to short-reach, high-bandwidth applications. Integrated optical frequency combs offer compact, low-cost light sources for future datacenter WDM interconnects. However, existing Kerr comb and mode-locked laser implementations suffer from drawbacks in power efficiency, spectral flatness and phase noise. Their fixed, device-specific channel spacings often conflict with standard WDM grids, and co-integration with high-speed modulators remains challenging. Here, we overcome these limitations by demonstrating high-capacity data transmission using flat-top electro-optic combs on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), a platform featuring flat spectra, tunable wavelengths and comb spacing, alongside native compatibility with (de-)multiplexers and high-speed modulators. Using 46 wavelength channels from two lasers and a 50-GHz on-chip electro-optic comb, we realize 16.56 Tb/s coherent transmission over a 98.84-km deployed fiber link between two universities and two datacenters in Hong Kong, verifying its suitability for inter-datacenter connections. To highlight grid reconfigurability, we reconfigure the comb to 100-GHz spacing via an on-chip demultiplexer and demonstrate 10-channel, 80-GBaud coherent transmission at 6.4 Tb/s. We further report a proof-of-concept monolithic WDM transmitter integrating the comb and high-speed modulator, achieving 19-channel, 45-GBaud IM/DD transmission at 1.71 Tb/s. Our work validates TFLN electro-optic combs as flexible, compact and scalable WDM engines for both coherent and IM/DD datacenter links to satisfy rapidly rising bandwidth requirements.

</details>


### [408] [Why Emission Spectral Profile of Diverse Fluoro-phores Look Alike with Thick Polymer Overlayers?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34864)
*Vinayak Kumar Tiwari,Srishti Batra,Aranyak Sarkar,Vinu Namboodiri,Ravindra Venka-tramani,Manoj Kumbhakar*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 厚聚合物覆盖层通过光学传递函数（折射率对比、界面反射、腔效应、收集几何）而非分子特异性响应，使结构与光物理性质不同的荧光团表现出相似的发射红移，同时保持振动能级间距基本不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 荧光团-聚合物覆盖层体系的荧光同时受分子光物理与厚度依赖的光学传播影响，二者贡献常难以区分，易将覆盖层诱导的光谱变化误判为分子内禀响应。作者旨在厘清覆盖层光学效应与荧光团本征发射在检测光谱中的相对作用。

Method: 结合光谱分辨单分子测量、跃迁偶极矩取向分析、系综荧光测量，比较不同荧光团在厚聚合物覆盖层下的发射；分析振动能级间距、谱位置与相对强度随厚度的变化；并用含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）识别参与光谱涨落与偶极重取向的Franck-Condon与Herzberg-Teller活性模式。

Result: 结构与光物理性质不同的荧光团在厚覆盖层下呈现相似的红移发射剖面，且无需额外反射面，说明存在由覆盖层施加的公共光学传递函数；随厚度变化，振动能级间距分布基本保留，而谱位置与相对强度系统性变化；TDDFT给出候选FC与HT活性染料模式。

Conclusion: 聚合物厚度主要通过光学传播与出耦（outcoupling）重塑检测光谱，同时保留分子振动模式；覆盖层的光学效应可掩盖荧光团特异性差异，因此解释覆盖层体系的荧光谱时必须扣除公共光学传递函数。

Abstract: Fluorescence from fluorophore-polymer overlayers reflects an interplay between molecular photo-physics and thickness dependent optical propagation. Combining spectrally resolved single mole-cule measurements, transition dipole moment orientation analysis and ensemble fluorescence, we show that structurally and photophysically distinct fluorophores can exhibit similar red shifted emission profiles under thick polymer overlayers even without additional reflecting surface. This similarity indicates a common optical transfer function imposed by the overlayer rather than a pure-ly fluorophore specific molecular response. Although local molecular interactions, excited state dy-namics and vibronic coupling govern intrinsic emission, the overlayer modifies detected spectra through refractive index contrast, dielectric boundary reflections, cavity effects and collection ge-ometry. Vibronic energy spacing distributions remain largely preserved as thickness changes, whereas spectral positions and relative intensities vary systematically. Thus, polymer thickness pri-marily reshapes detected spectrum through optical propagation and outcoupling while retaining vi-brational modes. Time dependent density functional theory identifies candidate Franck-Condon and Herzberg-Teller active dye modes contributing to spectral fluctuations and dipole reorientation.

</details>


### [409] [Data-efficient linear hyperspectral imaging through risk-guided co-design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34935)
*Shenzhan Hong,Shuxing Yang,Taojun Ying,Fujia Chen,Zongyin Yang,Hongsheng Chen,Yihao Yang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该论文提出理论引导的编码-重建协同设计框架，通过重建风险的精确五项分解与统计覆盖下界诊断，实现高精度、数据高效的线性高光谱重建，在单次CASSI上达到34.76 dB平均PSNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性重建器高效可解释但性能常逊于深度非线性模型，而后者需要大量训练数据和算力，因此需要一种兼顾性能、数据效率与理论可解释性的重建路线。

Method: 构建重建风险的精确五项分解理论，提出在固定PCA包络内诊断统计覆盖下界的方法，并据此对高光谱成像系统进行编码与重建的协同优化设计，框架适用于CASSI、衍射光学元件成像与光谱滤波阵列成像。

Result: 在单次CASSI中达到34.76 dB平均PSNR，仅用五个源场景即超过深度基线9.43 dB，且与经验跨域风险偏差在0.2%以内。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了数据高效且具理论依据的高性能线性高光谱重建路径，并提供定量判据以区分重建性能受限于光学编码、重建设计还是统计覆盖。

Abstract: Computational hyperspectral imaging reconstructs spatial-spectral information from limited optical measurements. Linear reconstructors are efficient and interpretable, but often underperform deep nonlinear models, which typically require substantial training data and computational resources. Here we present a theory-guided encoding-reconstruction co-design framework that achieves, to our knowledge, state-of-the-art linear reconstruction performance. We establish a theory for the exact five-term decomposition of reconstruction risk and introduce a method for diagnosing the statistical-coverage lower bound within a fixed principal component analysis envelope, which together inform the optimized design of hyperspectral imaging systems. The framework applies across coded-aperture snapshot spectral imaging (CASSI), diffractive optical element imaging and spectral filter array imaging, achieving 34.76 dB mean PSNR in single-shot CASSI, outperforming a deep baseline by 9.43 dB with only five source scenes, and matching empirical cross-domain risk within 0.2%. Our results establish a data-efficient and theoretically grounded route to high-performance linear hyperspectral reconstruction, while providing a quantitative basis for identifying whether reconstruction is limited by optical encoding, reconstruction design or statistical coverage.

</details>


### [410] [Analysis of C-point and V-point Inhomogeneous Vector Beams Stability under Anisotropic Turbulence in Ground-to-Air Transmission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35116)
*Sagar,Sanjay Kumar Mishra,Akhilesh Kumar Mishra*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 研究了各向异性湍流对偏振奇异的LG与圆艾里矢量光束在垂直/斜程/水平路径上传输特性的影响，发现各向异性显著加剧偏振不稳定，C点奇异的圆艾里矢量光束抗湍流能力最强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实大气湍流具有各向异性且随高度变化，而结构化矢量光束（含C点、V点偏振奇异）在其中的偏振演化规律尚不清楚，需借助矢量偏振分析方法加以刻画。

Method: 构建随高度变化的各向异性湍流模型，比较垂直、斜程、水平三种传输构型；通过强度分布与空间结构退化评估光束演化，用Stokes参量框架量化C点与V点偏振奇异，基于系综平均电场相关得到偏振度，并将Stokes矢量映射到高阶Poincaré球以几何可视化去偏振与偏振态弥散。

Result: 数值模拟表明湍流各向异性显著增强偏振不稳定性；水平与斜程传输的去偏振和偏振态扩散强于垂直传输；圆艾里矢量光束的C点偏振奇异在强度起伏与偏振退化方面抗性最优。

Conclusion: 矢量偏振分析对描述结构化光束在真实大气环境中的传输至关重要；各向异性与路径倾角是决定偏振退化程度的关键因素，C点奇异圆艾里矢量光束适合作为抗湍流的候选光场。

Abstract: In the present work, we explore the impact of anisotropic turbulence on the propagation characteristics of polarization singular LG and circular Airy vector beams along vertical, oblique, and horizontal transmission configurations. The influence of altitude-dependent turbulence anisotropy on beam evolution is assessed through changes in intensity distribution and degradation of spatial structure. Polarization characteristics of the propagated fields exhibiting C-point and V-point polarization singularities are quantified using the Stokes parameter framework, from which the degree of polarization is derived based on ensemble-averaged electric field correlations. To further interpret polarization dynamics, the corresponding Stokes vectors are mapped onto the higher order Poincaré sphere, providing a geometric visualization of turbulence-driven depolarization and polarization state dispersion. Numerical simulations have shown that the anisotropy of turbulence significantly enhances the polarization instability. Horizontal and slant-path propagations suffer stronger depolarization and polarization-state diffusion than vertical propagation. These results demonstrate the importance of vectorial polarization analysis in describing the propagation of a structured beam in real atmospheric environments. Overall, C-point polarization singularities of circular Airy vector beams are found to be the most resistant to turbulence-induced intensity fluctuation and polarization degradation in anisotropic atmospheric conditions.

</details>


### [411] [Effects of Pulse Duration on Kerr Self-Focusing and Weld Formation in Ultrafast Laser Welding of Fused Silica](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35250)
*Chen Yitong,Li Nan,Han Zhijie,Li Yuxuan,Zhang Qingwei,Dong Zihui,Sun Yuming,Lin Zhe,Zhu Gangyi,Yang Shanglu*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文研究脉宽（262 fs–10 ps）对Kerr自聚焦、等离子体发射位置及焊缝成形的影响，并用含Kerr效应的光线光学模型计算焦移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kerr自聚焦会使激光作用区偏离几何焦点，导致界面附近能量沉积难以控制，需要明确脉宽对非线性聚焦与焊缝形成的作用关系。

Method: 在262 fs至10 ps范围内改变脉宽开展焊接实验；用ICCD成像观测等离子体发射的轴向位置与形貌随脉冲累积的演化；测量最终焊缝形貌、位置与剪切强度；建立含Kerr效应的光线光学模型计算焦移并与实验对比。

Result: ICCD显示等离子体发射的轴向位置与形状随脉宽明显变化；不同脉宽在前2000个脉冲内即呈现不同的轴向位置，且随脉冲累积继续演化；焊缝形貌、位置与剪切强度相应改变；模拟焦移趋势与实验一致，支持Kerr自聚焦的作用。

Conclusion: 脉宽、非线性聚焦、作用位置与焊缝成形之间存在关联，含Kerr效应的光线光学模型可定性预测焦移趋势。

Abstract: Kerr self-focusing can shift the laser interaction region away from the geometrical focus, making energy deposition near the joining interface difficult to control. Here, the effect of pulse duration on nonlinear focusing and weld formation is investigated from 262 fs to 10 ps. ICCD imaging shows clear changes in the axial position and shape of the plasma emission. Different pulse durations already produce distinct axial positions during the initial 2000 pulses, and these positions continue to evolve with pulse accumulation. The final weld morphology, weld position, and shear strength show corresponding changes. A ray-optics model including the Kerr effect is used to calculate the focal shift. The simulated trend agrees with the experiment and supports the role of Kerr self-focusing in the observed focal position change. These results clarify the relationship between pulse duration, nonlinear focusing, interaction position, and weld formation.

</details>


### [412] [HarP: a simulation tool for high-order harmonic generation and propagation in gases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35440)
*Mattys Pouyez,Dominika Maslarova,Linus Hagedorn,Patrik Jansson,Robin Weissenbilder,Stefanos Carlström,Anne L'Huillier,Tünde Fülöp*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 介绍开源Python代码HarP，通过预计算偶极子表将高精度单原子量子动力学与强场激光及谐波的宏观传播耦合，实现高次谐波产生的多尺度模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确模拟高次谐波产生（HHG）需同时连通微观单原子量子动力学与强驱动激光场的宏观传播，二者尺度差异大、计算代价高，现有方法难以兼顾精度与效率。

Method: HarP求解驱动激光场与谐波场的波方程，利用预先计算的偶极子表构建非线性极化密度，从而在传播过程中直接嵌入精确的微观模型而无需重复昂贵计算；方法基于L'Huillier等（1992）PRA 46, 2778的框架。

Result: 该代码已支撑相位匹配、传播效应及HHG优化等多项研究；文中给出物理模型、数值实现细节，并与其他模拟框架进行对比验证。

Conclusion: HarP为HHG多尺度建模提供了开源、高效且可集成任意微观模型的工具，具备良好适用性与可验证性。

Abstract: Accurately simulating high-order harmonic generation (HHG) for attosecond science requires connecting the microscopic single-atom quantum dynamics and the macroscopic propagation of intense driving laser fields. HarP is an open-source Python code designed to address this multiscale problem. It solves the wave equations for both the driving laser field and the generated harmonics, using precomputed dipole tables for the nonlinear polarization density. This tabulation enables the direct integration of accurate microscopic models while avoiding costly calculations during the propagation. The methodology builds upon the approach of [L'Huillier et al. (1992) PRA 46, 2778] and has already facilitated multiple studies on phase matching, propagation effects and HHG optimization. This paper presents the underlying physical model, its numerical implementation, and comparison against alternative simulation frameworks.

</details>


### [413] [Parameter-Decoupling-Informed Learning for Superresolution: Laboratory Validation and Galaxy Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35449)
*Abdelali Sajia,Bilal Benzimoun,James Qu,Pawan Khatiwada,Guogan Zhao,Gang Zhang,Xiao-Feng Qian*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种参数解耦驱动的学习模型，在无需源先验、源控制或重复测量条件下估计点源的亚波长间距，在0.075σ间距下保真度>82%，并成功应用于Hubble档案图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统亚波长超分辨估计依赖对源性质（部分相干、亮度失衡、相对相位等冗余参数）的先验知识或对源的主动控制与重复光信号采集，在回顾性天文图像分析和活细胞显微等场景中不可行。

Method: 基于作者提出的参数解耦量子超分辨估计理论，规避冗余参数估计；结合卷积神经网络以适应背景噪声、光子损耗、质心与取向失配等实际非理想因素；用合成图像与实验图像训练和验证，并与常规直接数据驱动学习对比。

Result: 在约0.075σ（σ=180 nm时约13.5 nm）间距下间距估计保真度超过82%；应用于NGC 4486B的Hubble档案图像得到核间距9.3–13.2 pc，与文献12 pc一致；相同训练测试条件下保真度显著优于常规直接数据驱动方法。

Conclusion: 该方法对源性质变化与成像非理想性具有鲁棒性，支持回顾性天体图像分析，并可推广至源控制或重复光学测量不可行的活细胞显微与量子计量应用。

Abstract: We present a parameter-decoupling-informed learning model for estimating subwavelength separations of point sources, without requiring prior knowledge of source properties, control over the sources, or continued access to their light signals. The method builds on our parameter-decoupled quantum superresolution estimation theory, which circumvents the need to estimate nuisance parameters such as partial coherence, brightness imbalance, and relative phase. Our convolutional neural network further accommodates practical imperfections, including background noise, photon loss, and centroid and orientation misalignment. We validate the method using synthetic and experimentally generated images, achieving separation-estimation fidelity above $82\%$ for separations as small as approximately $0.075σ$, where $σ$ is the Gaussian intensity-PSF standard deviation. This corresponds to an illustrative separation of $\sim13.5$ nm when $σ=180$ nm, suggesting potential relevance to length scales addressed by advanced active-source microscopy. Applied to archival Hubble images of NGC~4486B, the model yields nuclear separations of 9.3-13.2~pc, consistent with the previously reported value of 12~pc. Comparisons using the same training and testing images demonstrate substantially higher fidelity than conventional direct data-driven learning in the tested cases. The method's robustness to varying source properties and imaging imperfections supports retrospective astrophysical image analysis and motivates applications in live-cell microscopy and quantum metrology where source control or renewed optical measurements are impractical.

</details>


### [414] [Optical Speckle Patterns as Nonlinear Feature Maps for Photonic Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35546)
*Kiia Arola,Mikko J. Huttunen*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 研究基于集成光子循环多次反射池（circular multipass cell）的光计算架构，将其作为储备池用于机器学习与模式识别；通过非线性和余弦相似度刻画系统信息处理能力与特征维度，并调节镜面反射率、编码图像尺寸及折射率差来调控储备池变换，在纹理图像与甲状腺胶原图像分类中取得69%–93%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI快速发展带来对能效硬件的需求，光计算凭借高并行性与潜在更低功耗成为电子处理器的替代方案；作者希望评估集成光子循环多次反射池是否适合机器学习与模式识别任务。

Method: 以集成光子循环多次反射池构建光计算/储备池架构，用非线性度量与余弦相似度（含成对相似度估计）评估信息处理容量和特征表示维度；通过数值仿真考察储备池镜面反射率、编码图形尺寸以及储备池与编码图形间折射率对比度对系统非线性的影响，并将所得特征表示用于纹理图像与甲状腺胶原图像分类。

Result: 数值结果表明镜面反射率、编码图形尺寸和折射率对比度均会调控系统非线性（经成对相似度估计验证）；据此可定制循环多次反射池生成的特征，从而控制输入数据的储备池变换；分类实验在纹理图像与甲状腺胶原图像上获得69%–93%的分类准确率。

Conclusion: 光子计算系统可为更节能的机器学习硬件奠定基础；通过调节系统参数即可定制特征表示，体现了该架构在模式识别任务中的可调控性与应用潜力。

Abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) has increased the demand for energy-efficient hardware, and optical computing has emerged as a promising alternative to conventional electronic processors owing to its high parallelism and potentially lower power consumption. In this work, we investigate an optical computing architecture based on an integrated photonic circular multipass cell, focusing on its suitability for machine learning and pattern recognition tasks. The properties of the system are evaluated through measures of nonlinearity and cosine similarity, which characterize the system's information-processing capacity and the dimensionality of the generated feature representations. Numerical results demonstrate that the reservoir mirror reflectance, the size of the encoded figure, and the refractive-index contrast between the reservoir and the encoded figure modify the nonlinearity of the system, as verified via pairwise similarity estimates. These results indicate that the features generated by the circular multipass cell can be tailored by adjusting the system parameters, providing a means to control the reservoir transformation of the input data. The resulting representations were applied to classification tasks involving texture images and thyroid collagen images, achieving classification accuracies ranging from 69% to 93%. These findings suggest that photonic computing systems could provide a basis for more energy-efficient machine-learning hardware.

</details>


### [415] [Chirpons: elementary local phase oscillations associated with complex zeros](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35599)
*Enrique G Neyra,Laureano A Bulus Rossini,Pablo A Costanzo Caso,Marcelo F Ciappina,Lorena Rebón*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 论文提出"chirpon"概念：将复波的局域相位变化（瞬时频率、局域波数、局域动量）与解析延拓波的非实零点一一对应，单个非实零点在实轴上产生一个洛伦兹型局域相位变化，其位置、宽度、符号、幅度与积分相位均由该零点确定。该表示对有限乘积与有限傅里叶和精确成立，并可通过规范因子分解推广到整函数与带限函数，进而用零点动力学统一描述瞬时频率、超振荡、backflow等局域相位现象，并给出基于零点的线性系统谱学探测新途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局域相位变化在时域对应瞬时频率、空域对应局域波数、量子力学中对应局域动量，是复波的核心局部量，但长期以来缺乏与其代数结构直接对应的解析描述；作者希望从波的解析延拓的复零点结构出发，为这些局域相位现象建立一个统一、精确且可操作的刻画框架。

Method: 将复波解析延拓，考察其非实零点结构：证明单个非实零点在实轴上产生局域洛伦兹型相位变化，其位置、宽度、符号、幅度与积分相位均由该零点唯一确定，称为chirpon；对有限乘积与有限傅里叶和给出精确表示，并借助Hadamard/Weierstrass型规范因子分解推广到整函数与带限函数；再以超振荡序列和离散傅里叶和为例展示由复零点周期族重构局域反常振荡；最后研究线性系统如何通过其关联复零点的位移来变换chirpon，并以二次色散传播与共振谐振子为例说明该动力学。

Result: 建立了局域相位结构与传递函数幅相响应之间的直接联系；在超振荡序列与离散傅里叶和中验证了可由复零点周期族重构局域反常振荡；在二次色散传播与共振谐振子中刻画了chirpon随系统响应的零点位移动力学，表明系统参数可由chirpon的运动、宽度与取向推断。

Conclusion: chirpon描述为瞬时频率、局域波数、超振荡、backflow等局域相位现象提供了统一框架，并开辟了通过复零点动力学探测线性系统的新途径，暗示一种基于零点的谱学方法。

Abstract: For a complex wave, the local phase variation provides the instantaneous frequency in time, the local wavenumber in space, and the local momentum in quantum mechanics. Here we study this quantity from the complex-zero structure of the analytic continuation of the wave. A single nonreal zero produces a localized Lorentzian phase variation on the real axis, whose position, width, sign, amplitude, and integrated phase are fixed by the zero itself. We call this elementary zero-associated oscillation a chirpon. The representation is exact for finite products and finite Fourier sums, and extends to entire and band-limited functions through canonical factorization. We illustrate the construction with superoscillatory sequences and discrete Fourier sums, showing how local anomalous oscillations can be reconstructed from periodic families of complex zeros. We further show how linear systems transform chirpons through the displacement of their associated complex zeros, and illustrate this dynamics for quadratic dispersive propagation and a resonant harmonic oscillator. This establishes a direct relation between local phase structure and the amplitude and phase response of the transfer function, suggesting a zero-based form of spectroscopy in which system parameters can be inferred from the motion, width, and orientation of chirpons. More broadly, the chirpon description provides a unified framework for instantaneous frequency, local wavenumber, superoscillation, backflow, and other local phase phenomena, while offering a new route for probing linear systems through the dynamics of their complex zeros.

</details>


### [416] [Plasma and light: Shaping High Harmonic Generation in Time-Varying Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35646)
*Wallace Jaffray,Maria Antonietta Vincenti,Domenico de Ceglia,Carlo Rizza,Natalia M. Litchinitser,Jose Trull,Crina Cojocaru,Marcello Ferrera,Michael Scalora*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文挑战固体高次谐波中"介质静止"的传统假设，研究强驱动瞬态透明导电氧化物中等离子体频率、载流子密度与有效质量在飞秒尺度与谐波发射同步演化下的谐波产生，提出双场泵浦方案并结合自洽流体-麦克斯韦模型与ITO实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统固体高次谐波理论假设介质在谐波发射过程中静止，因多数材料电子性质演化远慢于发射过程。但在强驱动的透明导电氧化物中，等离子体频率、载流子密度和有效质量可在飞秒尺度演化，使谐波产生与材料演化耦合，原有假设不再成立。

Method: 采用双场泵浦方案：强场产生宽带高阶谐波梳，弱场同步重塑各条谱线。建立完全自洽的流体动力学-麦克斯韦框架，从自由电子与束缚电子动力学自然导出偶次与奇次谐波，并在ITO上进行强泵浦实验验证。

Result: 模型在全超宽带宽上捕捉完整光谱演化；实验证实体驱动奇次谐波与界面驱动偶次谐波在强泵浦下的不同行为。区别于依赖几何结构的波混频，演化的电子等离子体可同时重塑多条共线谐波通道。

Conclusion: 时变等离子体动力学可作为宽带高光谱整形的有力新工具，超越四波混频框架，适用于超快脉冲操控及定制多谐波波形的产生与控制。

Abstract: High harmonic generation in solids is typically described under the assumption of a stationary medium. This assumption is rarely questioned because the electronic properties of most media evolve on timescales much slower than the harmonic emission process itself. However, in strongly driven time-varying transparent conductive oxides the plasma frequency, carrier density, and effective mass can evolve on the same femtosecond timescale as harmonic generation. Under these conditions, harmonic generation and material evolution are no longer independent processes. Within this context, we consider a two-field pumping scheme in which a strong field generates a comb of high-order harmonics across a broad spectral window, while a weaker field simultaneously reshapes its own individual spectral lines. Distinct from geometry-dependent wave-mixing processes, the evolving electron plasma reshapes multiple collinear harmonic channels simultaneously. A fully self-consistent hydrodynamic-Maxwell framework reveals that even- and odd-order harmonics naturally emerge from free- and bound-electron dynamics without the typical need to invoke phenomenological nonlinearities. Our model captures the full spectral evolution on an ultra-broad bandwidth, while experiments performed on ITO confirm the distinct behavior of bulk-driven odd harmonics and interface-driven even harmonics under strong pumping. These results establish time-dependent plasma dynamics as a powerful new tool for broadband hyperspectral shaping of multiple harmonic channels beyond the framework of four-wave-mixing processes. Our findings are of particular relevance to ultrafast science, with potential applications in ultrafast pulse manipulation and the generation and control of tailored multi harmonic waveforms.

</details>


### [417] [Theoretical description of high-harmonic spectroscopy for uniaxial nematic and isotropic liquid crystals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35672)
*Simon Vendelbo Bylling Jensen,Marta L. Murillo-Sánchez,Andrea Annunziata,Angel Rubio,Laura Cattaneo,Nicolas Tancogne-Dejean*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文利用高次谐波产生光谱研究液晶的非线性光学各向异性，通过气、液、向列相、晶相的系统对比，提出半经验紧束缚方法揭示软物质中间相中超快光驱动电子动力学的分子间特征，并证明分子间电子杂化可用于光谱探测向列指向矢与序参量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 液晶凭借可控光学各向异性成为线性光学与显示技术的基石，但其在非线性区域（尤其是软物质中间相中超快电子动力学与分子间相互作用）的机制尚不清楚，阻碍了非线性液晶器件的开发。

Method: 采用高次谐波产生（HHG）光谱探测液晶的非线性光学各向异性；针对气体、液体、向列相和晶相进行系统对照研究；建立半经验紧束缚模型，描述跨软物质中间相的分子间电子杂化与超快光驱动电子动力学。

Result: 揭示了分子间电子杂化对非线性光学响应的贡献，并证明高次谐波光谱可原位获取结构信息，如向列指向矢和序参量，实现光谱对结构性质的直接探测。

Conclusion: 阐明了液晶非线性光学各向异性的基础机制，为非线性液晶器件和超快软物质光谱学开辟了新途径。

Abstract: Enabled by their controllable optical anisotropy, liquid crystals form a cornerstone of linear optical and display technologies. Bringing the versatile platform into the nonlinear regime, we explore its nonlinear optical anisotropy by high-order harmonic generation spectroscopy. Through a comprehensive study targeting gas, liquid, nematic, and crystalline phases, we present a semi-empirical tight-binding approach that provides insight into the intermolecular character of ultrafast light-driven electron dynamics across soft-matter mesophases. We demonstrate how intermolecular electron hybridization enables spectroscopic access to structural properties, such as the nematic director and order parameter. Outlining such foundational mechanisms opens avenues towards nonlinear liquid crystal devices and ultrafast soft-matter spectroscopies.

</details>


### [418] [Daylight-Referenced Efficiency (DRE): A Radiometric Measure of Electric Light Source Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35746)
*Peter Veto*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文提出"日光参照效率"（η_DRE）辐射度量框架，将电光源性能分解为无加权墙插效率（η_wall）与日光光谱保真度（η_spec），以绝对值衡量光源在 280–4000 nm 全波段对自然日光的物理辐射功率转换能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有光度学指标（lm/W）以人眼视见函数 V(λ) 严格加权，对含紫外（280–380 nm）或红外（780–4000 nm）宽带输出的电光源形成系统性计量惩罚；色度、显色与黑素opic等指标亦仅在可见光波段评估光感受器响应，无法刻画宽带光谱的物理辐射功率转换效率。

Method: 构建定义域 Ω=[280 nm, 4000 nm] 的辐射度量框架，将性能因子化为：域限墙插效率 η_wall [W_optical/W_elec]（未加权电—光转换）与日光光谱保真度 η_spec [无量纲, 0–1]，后者以总变差距离（1 − TVD）度量与 ASTM G173 AM1.5G 太阳参考谱的几何形状匹配度；二者乘积给出绝对日光参照输出功率 P_dr [W]，再除以电驱动功率得 η_DRE = η_wall·η_spec [W/W_elec]。框架具参考谱无关性、定义域可扩展性，并在光谱截断下对 η_wall 与 η_DRE 保持可证的下界单调性；同时提供开源参考软件以支持部署与标准化评级。

Result: 框架将宽带电光源评价解耦为可分别测量的物理量与光谱形状量，P_dr 作为直接物理通量量可用于照明规格标注；ε_wall 与 η_DRE 在光谱截断下具下界单调性，保证评级的一致性与可比较性。

Conclusion: η_DRE 为宽带（含紫外/红外）电光源提供了一种以自然日光为参照、跨可见波段之外的统一辐射度量评级方法，弥补光度学与色度类指标的计量盲区，并通过开源软件推动标准化应用。

Abstract: Photopic luminous efficacy (lm/W) weights optical power strictly against human eye sensitivity V (lambda), creating a systemic metrological penalty for electric light sources engineered with broad spectral output in the ultraviolet (280-380 nm) or infrared (780-4000 nm) bands. Similarly, metrics evaluating chromaticity, color quality, or melanopic pathways assess photoreceptor responses strictly within the visual band, offering no measure of broad-spectrum physical radiant power conversion. To resolve this limitation, we introduce Daylight-Referenced Efficiency (eta_DRE), a radiometric framework that evaluates how efficiently an electric light source converts electrical power into an optical spectrum matching natural terrestrial daylight across domain Omega = [280 nm, 4000 nm]. The framework factorizes performance into primary physical quantities: domain-restricted Wall-Plug Efficiency (eta_wall [W_optical/W_elec]), measuring unweighted electrical-to-optical conversion, and Daylight Spectral Fidelity (eta_spec [unitless, 0-1]), quantifying geometric shape match to the ASTM G173 AM1.5G solar reference via total variation distance (1 - TVD). Multiplying total optical power by spectral fidelity yields the absolute Daylight-Referenced Output Power (P_dr [W]), establishing a direct physical flux quantity for lighting specification. Dividing by electrical drive power gives the summary metric Daylight-Referenced Efficiency (eta_DRE = eta_wall * eta_spec [W/W_elec]), measuring net reference-conforming radiant output per electrical Watt consumed. The mathematical architecture is reference-agnostic, domain-extensible, and maintains provable lower-bound monotonicity for eta_wall and eta_DRE under spectral truncation. Open-source reference software is provided to facilitate deployment and standardized rating of broad-spectrum light sources.

</details>


### [419] [Tapering to Enhance the Performance of Nanowire-Based Fluorescent Biosensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35791)
*Farhana Akter Mou,Nicklas Anttu*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过在圆柱纳米线中引入锥形段并进行电磁建模，证明锥形纳米线可显著增强荧光信号：近法向激发下激发增强随锥长近似线性增长（锥长8000 nm时超过非锥形纳米线的3倍）；低数值孔径非成像探测下相比平面生物传感器荧光信号增强超过三个数量级，并可兼顾成像模式的锐度与激发增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高折射率纳米线在基于荧光的生物传感中具有信号增强价值，但需要提升其荧光增强能力并解决实际实现中的工程挑战，同时兼顾成像与非成像两类检测场景。

Method: 采用电磁建模，在圆柱纳米线中引入锥形段，并研究两种互补的锥形构型以应对实际实现难题；分别在近法向激发、低NA非成像探测以及成像模式下评估激发增强、荧光信号增强与成像锐度。

Result: 近法向激发下激发增强随锥长近似线性增加，锥长8000 nm时超过对应非锥形纳米线的3倍；低NA非成像方案中，相比平面生物传感器荧光信号增强超过三个数量级；成像模式下从非锥形端成像可获得超越常规显微极限的锐度，同时从相反的锥形端激发可显著提高激发增强。

Conclusion: 锥形纳米线可支持使用紧凑、低NA光学配置实现高效荧光检测，并在成像模式中实现锐度与激发增强的协同优化，具有实际应用潜力。

Abstract: High-refractive-index nanowires are of interest for signal enhancement in fluorescence-based biosensing. Here, through electromagnetic modelling, we demonstrate substantial fluorescence signal enhancement by incorporating a tapered section into a cylindrical nanowire and investigate two complementary tapering configurations to address practical implementation challenges. Under near-normal excitation, the excitation enhancement increases approximately linearly with taper length, reaching more than three times that of the corresponding non-tapered nanowire at a taper length of 8000 nm. In a non-imaging signal detection scheme using a low numerical aperture (NA), the proposed tapered nanowire achieves more than three orders of magnitude enhancement in fluorescence signal compared with a planar biosensor. Thus, the tapered nanowire should enable efficient fluorescence detection using compact, low-NA optical configuration. In imaging mode, similarly as for non-tapered nanowires, imaging sharpness beyond conventional microscopy limitations is obtained when imaging from the non-tapered nanowire end, while strongly increased excitation enhancement is simultaneously obtained when exciting from the opposite, tapered end.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [420] [Inverse Modeling for Laser Pulse Shape Design in Inertial Confinement Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33096)
*Ricardo Luna Gutierrez,Vineet Gundecha,Rahman Ejaz,Varchas Gopalaswamy,Riccardo Betti,Sahand Ghorbanpour,Aarne Lees,Soumyendu Sarkar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ICF激光脉冲波形设计系统LPDS，用生成式逆向建模框架把目标结果与靶丸构型直接映射为优化激光脉冲，结合多目标损失、约束条件化/修复/梯度编辑机制实现细粒度控制，并验证向少量真实实验炮次的迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 惯性约束聚变（ICF）成败关键之一是激光脉冲波形（LP）设计，但传统设计依赖高成本仿真与人工迭代优化，效率低、难以满足严格物理约束与实验要求，因此需要数据驱动的逆向设计手段。
