Each task crosses one of four state structures (independent, dependent, externally reachable, cross-tool) with one of four trap families (ambiguity, mis-targeting, cascade harm, overreach), and each task has a deterministic trace-based oracle for both goal satisfaction and authorization compliance. Across 2,211 model-task pairs from 11 frontier LLMs spanning major commercial and open model families, 15.2% of all runs incur CD, with risk concentrated in ambiguity tasks (38.8% violation rate) while non-ambiguous traps average 8.4% CD. Among goal-satisfied runs, 12.8% still produce unauthorized writes. Cross-tool and dependent states have about twice the CD rate of independent states. CD rates vary by 4.7x across models at comparable goal rates, which suggests that task success alone is a poor proxy for safe tool use. The SABench task corpus is released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Phaedrus/sabench; the traces, oracle, code, and analysis pipeline are released at https://github.com/hjj194/sabench-artifact.

</details>


### [489] [R2A-Sales: A Policy-Atom-Matched Benchmark for Rule-to-Action Gaps in Goal-Directed Sales Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34185)
*Yihua Qin,Jiajie Jerry Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出R2A-Sales基准，用共享同一政策原子的静态探针与多轮销售场景配对，度量"能说出规则"与"在商业压力下做出合规、工具落地行动"之间的差距（K−A），发现静态合规近乎饱和而行动合规极低（差距80–92个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM销售智能体评估多聚焦静态政策问答或任务成功率，但部署中的关键问题是：模型能陈述规则时，是否会在商业压力下选择合规且基于工具的行动。需要隔离政策内容不一致带来的混杂，直接度量"规则—行动"落差。

Method: 构建政策原子匹配基准：每个条目将一个静态探针与一个多轮销售场景配对，二者共享同一版本化政策原子、事实、证据、行为约束与工具契约，从而排除政策内容不匹配的解释。交互分支由代码维护的账本核验已提交工具效应与终止状态，无依据的行动声明不得分。指标为静态合规K、落地行动合规A=Pr(安全终止∧无硬违规∧非回声)及匹配差距G=K−A。发布冻结版含3个中文销售域、24个政策原子、42个语义核心、2016个配对样本；确认性研究审计19个核心上的21888次运行，覆盖8个骨干模型及4种Qwen3-8B提示处理（12种配置）。

Result: 静态合规接近上限（K=89.9%–99.1%），而八骨干行动合规仅A=3.0%–17.3%，G=80.4–92.5个百分点。由于A还要求安全终止，G是规则到行动退化的上界而非仅隔离压力效应；无任何纯提示处理在所有指标上占优。

Conclusion: 销售智能体可靠性必须在已提交行动层面度量，不能仅凭规则复述或任务完成度判断；提示工程难以弥合规则—行动落差，需在行动落地与工具核验环节进行系统性改进。

Abstract: LLM-based sales agents are often evaluated on static policy questions or task success, but deployment asks a sharper question: when a model can state a rule, will it choose compliant, tool-grounded actions under commercial pressure? We introduce R2A-Sales (Rule-to-Action), a policy-atom-matched benchmark for this question. Each item pairs a static probe with a multi-turn sales scenario sharing the same versioned policy atom, facts, evidence, behavioral constraints, and tool contract, so differences cannot be attributed to policy-content mismatch. In the interactive arm, a code-owned ledger verifies committed tool effects and terminal states; unsupported action claims receive no credit. We report static compliance $K$, grounded action compliance $A=\Pr(\text{safe terminal}\land\text{no hard violation}\land\text{non-echo})$, and the matched gap $G=K-A$. The frozen release spans three controlled Chinese-language sales domains, 24 policy atoms, 42 semantic cores, and 2,016 matched pairs. The confirmatory study audits 21,888 runs over 19 cores, covering eight backbones plus four Qwen3-8B prompt treatments (12 configurations). Static compliance is near ceiling $(K=89.9\%\text{--}99.1\%)$, yet eight-backbone action compliance is only $A=3.0\%\text{--}17.3\%$, giving $G=80.4\text{--}92.5$ percentage points. Since $A$ also requires safe termination, $G$ upper-bounds rule-to-action degradation rather than isolating pressure alone. No prompt-only treatment dominates all metrics. R2A-Sales shows that sales-agent reliability must be measured at committed action, not rule recital or task completion alone.

</details>


### [490] [MatOS: An Agent Operating System for Materials Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34203)
*Dingyang Lyu,Jing Gao,Zhonghao Chang,Jingjie Huang,Xiangran Cheng,Xin He,Yongda Huang,Zefeng Li,Jiahui Liu,Jian Wen,Feng Yu,Bonan Zhu,Yongheng Li,Hongwei Du,Baole Wei,Ziheng Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MatOS 是一个面向材料研究的智能体操作系统，将数据、知识、工具、技能、角色与工作流组织为可复用、可演化的资产，并通过分层资产图、有状态自适应工作流和证据驱动演化三大组件支撑长时间多阶段研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料研究数据与工具分散，单一研究常需跨文献分析、计算与实验的多日工作流；现有 LLM 智能体在扩展新能力、维持长任务稳定推进、以及从历史任务与用户反馈中学习三方面仍存在困难。

Method: 提出 MatOS，包含：(1) 分层科学资产图，将数据、知识、工具、技能、角色、工作流组织为可复用资产；(2) 有状态自适应工作流，以显式执行图运行任务并嵌入科学检查点，支持断点续跑与可追溯；(3) 证据驱动资产演化，依据执行记录与用户反馈修订资产。

Result: 在同一基座模型下，ResearchClawBench 上较此前最佳智能体提升 11.15% 并扩展 cost-score 帕累托前沿；超越 Codex CLI（MatTools +2.13%）与 Claude Code（SciAgentGym +4.17%）。八个研究案例中：将 3000 万余候选结构筛选至 97 个固态电解质候选；识别出 89 个计算电导率高于母体结构的卤化物变体；将 11 个预训练原子间势的力误差关联至局域原子环境；支撑两项新方法分别较基线降低 3.1% 与 13.6% 的误差。

Conclusion: 将研究能力组织为可复用、可演化的资产，可使智能体胜任长时间、多阶段的材料研究流程。

Abstract: Materials research relies on scattered and growing data, knowledge, and simulation tools, and a single study often spans multi-day workflows across literature analysis, computation, and experiment. Large language model agents can now retrieve materials data, operate simulation codes, and close design-synthesis-characterization loops with autonomous laboratories. However, extending these agents with new capabilities, keeping long-running tasks on track, and letting them learn from past tasks and user feedback remain difficult. Here we present MatOS, an agent operating system for materials research with three core components: (1) a layered scientific asset graph that organizes data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles, and workflows as reusable assets; (2) a stateful adaptive workflow that runs tasks as explicit execution graphs with scientific checks, so that they can be resumed and traced; and (3) evidence-driven asset evolution, which revises these assets from execution records and user feedback. On ResearchClawBench, MatOS improves on the previously best-performing agent by 11.15% with the same base model and extends the cost-score Pareto frontier. With a common base model, it outperforms Codex CLI and Claude Code, exceeding Codex CLI by 2.13% on MatTools and 4.17% on SciAgentGym. In eight research cases, MatOS narrowed more than 30 million candidate structures to 97 solid-electrolyte candidates, identified 89 halide variants with higher computed conductivity than their parent structures, linked the force errors of 11 pretrained interatomic potentials to local atomic environments, and supported two new methods that reduce errors by 3.1% and 13.6% relative to their baselines. These results show that organizing research capabilities as reusable, evolving assets enables agents to carry out long, multistage materials studies. Code is available at https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS.

</details>


### [491] [Variational Cognitive Memory Abstraction for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34251)
*Xinyu Liu,Daiying Tian,Chenwei Tang,Ruyang Han,Chengyang Zhang,Qingyu Zeng,Wei Ju,Liangli Zhen,Jiancheng Lv*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CogMemory变分认知记忆框架，通过选择性状态空间记忆编码器、多槽位时间抽象与变分信息压缩，将多模态轨迹编码为紧凑潜记忆，并在动作生成时用动态交叉注意力检索与门控融合调用相关记忆，仅增加3.45M参数即可显著提升VLA模型的长程操作能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作中表现优异，但长程任务受限于长期记忆建模不足：隐式时序表示会随策略网络逐渐稀释历史信息，显式记忆缓冲则存在冗余、噪声累积与检索低效问题。

Method: 将多模态轨迹经选择性状态空间记忆编码器编码为紧凑潜记忆表示，结合多槽位时间抽象与变分信息压缩实现选择性保留；动作生成阶段采用动态交叉注意力检索与门控融合，自适应地将相关记忆注入策略预测。方法轻量（仅3.45M额外参数），可无缝适配早期融合与中间融合两类VLA骨干。

Result: 在长程机器人操作基准上，跨多种VLA骨干均取得一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 选择性、压缩化的显式记忆建模是提升VLA长程任务执行能力的有效且低成本路径，具备良好的骨干通用性与部署友好性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet their ability to execute long-horizon tasks remains limited by insufficient long- term memory modeling. Existing methods either rely on implicit temporal representations within policy networks, where historical information can be gradually diluted, or maintain explicit memory buffers that suffer from redundancy, noise accumulation, and inefficient retrieval. In this paper, we propose CogMemory, a novel variational cognitive memory framework that enables VLA systems to selectively preserve and reuse task-relevant historical information. Our approach encodes multimodal trajectories into compact latent memory representations through a selective state- space memory encoder, multi-slot temporal abstraction, and variational information compression. During action generation, dynamic cross-attention retrieval with gated fusion adaptively incorporates relevant memories into policy prediction. With merely 3.45M additional parameters, CogMemory stays lightweight and seamlessly fits both early- and intermediate-fusion VLA backbones. Extensive experiments on long-horizon robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse VLA backbones.

</details>


### [492] [MultiEvoSkill: Structure-Aware Multi-Agent Skill Evolution for Generalizable Skill Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34260)
*Kounianhua Du,Jianxing Liu,Ruoshui Shan,Yucheng Zhang,Ke Li,Xing Sun,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MultiEvoSkill框架，将技能文档编译为类型化图结构，通过异构多智能体集体修订与结构感知辩论演化机制迭代优化技能，提升冻结LLM智能体的跨模型泛化与并行/依赖过程表达能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技能文档已成为冻结LLM智能体的默认适配方式，但现有技能生成器存在两点局限：一是人类与不同LLM在程序性知识组织与任务求解上存在差异，单一视角编写的技能难以对齐其他骨干模型的推理行为，限制跨模型泛化；二是顺序式技能描述无法充分表示含并行分支与显式依赖的流程，现有优化器主要面向散文文本，缺乏对图结构技能演化的显式支持。

Method: 框架含三个核心组件：1) Skill compiler将技能编译为带定制算子的类型化图，生成紧凑、信息量高且具显式流程拓扑的表示；2) 异构智能体系统基于多组经验识别最小且信息量大的问题，以集体智能提出修订建议；3) 结构感知辩论与演化机制将候选编辑组织为异构图，在依赖与重要性约束下求解，并将集体提案蒸馏回技能制品；配合多维度门控保证每次演化的信息增益与拓扑正确性，系统收敛至一致状态时得到最优技能。

Result: 与SOTA方法的多种实验及消融验证了MultiEvoSkill的有效性与泛化能力。

Conclusion: 图结构化的技能表示结合异构多智能体集体演化，可有效突破单一视角与顺序文本的技能瓶颈，是冻结LLM智能体技能优化的一种可行范式。

Abstract: Skill documents are becoming the default adaptation surface for frozen large language model (LLM) agents, but current skill generators face two key limitations. First, humans and different LLMs differ in how they organize procedural knowledge and approach task solving. Skills authored from a human or single-model perspective may therefore fail to align with the reasoning behaviors of other backbones, limiting cross-model generalization. Second, sequential skill descriptions inadequately represent procedures with parallel branches and explicit dependencies, while existing skill optimizers primarily operate on prose and lack explicit support for graph-structured skill evolution. We introduce MultiEvoSkill, a skill-optimization framework comprising three core components: 1) Skill compiler casts the skill as a typed graph with tailored operators, producing a compact, informative representation with explicit procedural topology; 2) Heterogeneous agent system proposes revision advices using collective intelligence, where minimal and informative issues are identified based on multiple sets of experiences. 3) Structure-aware debate and evolution mechanism organizes candidate edits into a heterogeneous graph, resolves them under dependency and importance constraints, and distills the collective proposal into the artifact. Multi-dimensional gating ensures the information gain and topological correctness of each evolution. Optimal skills are then obtained when the system converges at a consistent state. Various experiments and ablations against SOTA methods validate the effectiveness and generalization of MultiEvoSkill.

</details>


### [493] [Matched Capabilities, Different Behaviors: A Controlled Study of MCP and CLI Interfaces for Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34298)
*Zhenning Shi,Liang Pang,Yongqi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究MCP与CLI两种模型-工具接口表示在同一可执行能力下是否影响智能体行为，提出MICA进行匹配对照分析，并提出DART修复接口实现，在六项设置上普遍提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言智能体越来越多通过外部工具和交互环境行动，模型与可执行能力之间的接口成为决策过程的一部分。MCP与CLI可暴露相同语义操作，但面向模型的表示差异显著，作者希望探究在可执行能力对齐时这些表示差异是否改变智能体行为。

Method: 提出Matched Interface Comparison and Analysis（MICA）：基于共享语义动作契约渲染MCP与CLI，并将解码动作路由至同一运行时，实现严格匹配对照。在6个模型、3个交互环境中评测，结合匹配状态探针定位对能力呈现、实现与反馈的敏感性，并配对自然轨迹分析分歧传播。进一步提出Decoupled Action Realization and Targeted Repair（DART），在保留已验证语义承诺的前提下修复接口特异的实现方式。

Result: 匹配接口在任务性能与交互成本上产生显著差异，影响延伸至语义动作选择、失败路径与恢复；2,004个episode中94.3%出现结构化分歧，早期差异会向后续交互传播。DART在全部6个评测设置中提升基准分数（最高+9.0分），并在3个环境中降低MCP token开销（每任务最高节省27.1k tokens）。

Conclusion: 接口表示是闭环决策环境的组成部分，会塑造智能体行为；接口实现可作为直接干预边界，通过解耦语义承诺与实现方式即可实现针对性修复。

Abstract: Language agents increasingly act through external tools and interactive environments, making the interface between the model and its executable capabilities part of the decision process. Model Context Protocol (MCP) and command-line interfaces (CLI) can expose the same semantic operations through markedly different model-facing representations. We study whether these representational differences change agent behavior when executable capabilities are matched. We introduce Matched Interface Comparison and Analysis (MICA), which renders MCP and CLI from a shared semantic action contract and routes decoded actions through the same runtime. Across six models and three interactive environments, matched interfaces produce substantial differences in task performance and interaction cost. These effects extend beyond surface validity to semantic action selection, failure pathways, and recovery. Matched-state probes localize sensitivity to capability presentation, realization, and feedback. Paired natural trajectories reveal structured divergence in 94.3% of 2,004 episodes and show that early differences propagate through subsequent interaction. This analysis identifies interface realization as a direct intervention boundary. We therefore introduce Decoupled Action Realization and Targeted Repair (DART), which preserves validated semantic commitments while repairing interface-specific realization. DART improves benchmark score in all six evaluated settings by up to 9.0 points and reduces MCP token cost in all three environments by up to 27.1k tokens per task. Together, these results establish interface representation as part of the closed-loop decision environment shaping agent behavior.

</details>


### [494] [CTXAgent - Self-Controlled Context Management of LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34425)
*Matthias Busch,Marius Tacke,Roland C. Aydin,Christian Feiler,Christian J. Cyron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出让模型自行管理上下文（自决定何时压缩、保留什么、如何写交接）的“自管理 harness”，并在7个前沿模型上验证：强模型能在混合长会话中把活跃上下文压在100k token以内且基准分数基本不降，同时显著降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 agent harness 依赖固定 token 阈值触发历史压缩，机制僵化。此前工作认为开放权重模型无法在无脚手架下管理自身上下文，因此需要在同等条件下检验前沿模型自我管理上下文的可行性与代价收益。

Method: 给模型两个上下文工具和一段指导文本，让其自主决定压缩时机、保留内容与交接文本。在7个前沿模型上对比“有/无上下文工具”两种条件，测量 token 成本与基准得分；并在其中2个模型上与3个主流 harness 对比。基准由多个现有任务拼装（编码练习、多步 SciCode、SWE-bench Pro、Terminal-Bench 4.0），穿插植入事实、瞬时观测与常驻指令，确定性校验，会话长35–212轮。

Result: 多数最强模型能有效管理上下文：规律性压缩与精选，混合会话活跃上下文多数低于100k token，基准分数大多无显著下降；管理良好者成本显著下降，但降幅因模型而异（部分模型压缩过频导致其他成本上升）。Claude Opus 5.5 下，自管理 harness 任务成功率与 Claude Code 持平，成本比其显式200k窗口配置低34%、比默认配置低49%，且无需选择上下文窗口。

Conclusion: 前沿模型已具备实用的自主上下文管理能力，可作为固定阈值压缩的替代方案；成本收益依赖模型的压缩策略质量。作者开源 agent、基准与全部结果行。

Abstract: Agent harnesses keep long sessions inside the context window by compacting the history when a token threshold is crossed. We study an alternative in which the model manages its own context: it decides when to compact, what to keep and what to write as the hand-off, given two tools and one paragraph of guidance. Since earlier work found that open-weight models cannot manage their own context without scaffolding, we compare seven frontier models under identical conditions, with and without the context tools, on token cost and benchmark score, and we compare our harness with three widely used harnesses on two of these models. The benchmark is assembled from existing ones: coding exercises, multi-step SciCode problems and SWE-bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 4.0 tasks are interleaved with planted facts, ephemeral observations and standing instructions, all checked deterministically, in sessions of 35-212 turns that resemble a user working through different tasks in one chat. Most of the strongest models manage their context: they compact and curate regularly, the live context of the mixed sessions stays mostly below 100k tokens, and their benchmark scores mostly do not drop significantly. For the models that manage their context well, the cost reduction is substantial but varies between models, because some models compact so often that other costs increase. With Claude Opus 5.5, the self-managed harness matches Claude Code on task success at 34% lower cost than its explicit 200k-window configuration and 49% lower than its default, with no context window to choose. We release the agent, the benchmark and all result rows.

</details>


### [495] [From Outranking Flow Scores to Linear Programs: Group Decision Making in PROMETHEE II](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34481)
*Alexandre Flachs,Yves De Smet*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文对PROMETHEE II排序问题提出净流的线性重参数化（基于加权偏好增量），并据此构建逆分析与共识分析的三类线性优化模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PROMETHEE灵敏度与共识分析多只关注准则权重偏差、将偏好函数视为固定，但净流分数由权重与偏好函数共同决定，仅调整权重可能得出误导性结论。

Method: 以观测性能差上的加权偏好增量对PROMETHEE II净流分数作线性重参数化，得到净流的线性表达式；在此基础上建立三类线性优化模型：仅权重偏差最小化但允许偏好函数变化、全偏好参数集偏差最小化、以及多决策者共识分析（目标为总偏差或最大个体偏差以兼顾公平）。

Result: 算例表明，允许偏好函数变化会显著改变仅权重模型的逆分析结论；所提群体模型能区分高效共识与更公平的共识。

Conclusion: 将偏好函数纳入变动参数可实现PROMETHEE II逆分析与共识分析的统一线性建模，扩展了传统权重导向方法的结论空间，并为群体决策提供效率—公平的权衡框架。

Abstract: We study inverse and consensus analysis for PROMETHEE II ranking problems when the performance table is fixed. Existing approaches in PROMETHEE-based sensitivity and consensus analysis usually focus on deviations of criteria weights while treating preference functions as fixed. Nevertheless both sets of parameters jointly determine the outranking flow scores. We introduce a linear reparametrization of the PROMETHEE II net flow scores based on weighted preference increments over the observed differences of performances. This representation yields a linear expression of the net flows and clarifies how weights and preference functions interact. Building on this result, we derive linear optimization models for three settings: minimizing weight deviations while allowing preference functions to vary; minimizing deviations over the full set of preference parameters; and multiple decision-maker consensus analysis (with objectives based either on total deviation or on the maximal individual deviation to promote fairness). An illustrative example shows that allowing preference functions to vary can dramatically change the inverse-analysis conclusions obtained from weight-only models, and that the proposed group formulations distinguish efficient consensuses from fairer ones.

</details>


### [496] [What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34491)
*Kaiser Sun,Yongchan Kwon,Zain Hasan,Shang Zhu,Kaitlyn Zhou,Federico Bianchi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文实证考察生成模型"推理努力（reasoning effort）"设置的反事实效应，揭示高努力既不可靠也不经济，并提出"从最低努力开始、验证失败后再升级"的简单替代策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理努力被设计为让用户以更高成本换取更强性能的可调旋钮，但用户在事前无法判断额外推理是否有用，事后也无法获知其边际价值，因而努力构成一种"信任品（credence good）"。论文旨在量化不同努力水平对结果与成本的真实反事实影响，检验"最高努力=最优"这一默认假设。

Method: 在四个基准上，对闭源与开源权重模型测量各努力水平的反事实效应，覆盖单次调用推理与长程智能体任务；分别分析（1）实例层面高努力是否保持低努力已解出的任务；（2）所有努力均解出的简单任务上的成本倍率；（3）努力对智能体行为轨迹（token 数与解题策略）的影响。

Result: （1）高努力虽可提升总体准确率，但常在低努力已解出的任务上失败；（2）在全部努力水平均可解的简单任务上，高努力普遍更贵，最高努力成本可达最低努力的42倍；（3）高努力不仅改变 token 用量，还改变解题方式——更多自我校验与更多搜索而非直接推导，使轨迹变长却未必改变结果。

Conclusion: 盲目选择最高努力既成本低效，也不保证实例级最佳性能。从最低努力起步、仅在验证失败后升级的策略，在所有模型与基准上达到或超过固定最高努力的表现，且在多数闭源模型上成本更低。

Abstract: Generative models increasingly expose a reasoning effort setting that lets users scale inference-time compute, trading higher cost for potentially improved performance. Users must choose an effort level before knowing whether extra reasoning will help, and even a successful run does not reveal whether the effort purchased was necessary. Reasoning effort is therefore a credence good: buyers observe the outcome but cannot assess the marginal value of the computation they paid for. In this work, we measure the counterfactual effect of effort levels on both proprietary and open-weight models on four benchmarks, spanning single-call reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks. Effort, it turns out, does not consistently preserve tasks that lower effort solves, can overspend, and can change trajectory behavior. First, we find that although higher effort can raise accuracy in aggregate, it frequently fails on tasks that lower effort solved. Second, on the subset of easy tasks that every effort level solves, higher effort is generally more costly, with the highest effort level costing up to 42x as much as the lowest. Lastly, effort changes not only how many tokens are used, but also how agents solve tasks: at higher effort, agents verify their own work more heavily and more often search for solutions than work through problems directly, both of which lengthen trajectories without necessarily altering the outcome. These findings show that naively choosing the highest level is not only cost-inefficient but also offers no guarantee of the best instance-level performance. A simple alternative, starting at the lowest effort and escalating only after a verified failure, matches or improves on fixed top effort across all models and benchmarks at lower cost for most proprietary models.

</details>


### [497] [CaliMem: Search-Efficient Data Agent via Calibrated Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34500)
*Hanze Li,Athan Z. Li,Feiyang Kang,Jiachen T. Wang,Yuhan Chen,Ruishan Liu,Ruoxi Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出数据标定（curation）配方与下游模型强耦合，提出带"校准记忆"的智能体式循环 CaliMem，通过在执行前预测策略效果并做"现实检验"来抑制过度泛化，在生物与LLM后训练任务上优于固定流程与已发表方法，最高超过全量数据训练19.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据标定是机器学习的一阶设计选择，但为特定模型与任务定制训练数据代价高昂（人力、专业知识、算力），实践中数据常经固定流程处理并跨应用复用。作者实证表明该假设脆弱：在55个覆盖生物领域的"数据集—模型"任务中，同一标定配方可能对某模型有益、对另一模型有害，因此标定必须适应下游设置，从而需要自动化的数据配方搜索。

Method: 先构建智能体系统，在部署阶段搜索标定策略，实现测试时标定（TTC）；发现其搜索依赖近期反馈、易陷局部，加入持久记忆后又出现"超越观测条件的一般化断言"问题（如单次失败就放弃整条策略）。据此提出 CaliMem：校准式记忆智能体循环，要求智能体在执行每个候选策略前先预测其结果，将预测与观测结果比较形成"现实检验"，利用预测误差保留有支持的断言、修正错误断言，并明确结论成立的条件，使信念可检验、降低过度泛化、支撑更有效的长程探索。

Result: 在生物领域与LLM后训练任务上，CaliMem 一致优于固定标定基线与已发表方法，并相较全量数据训练最高提升19.4%；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 数据标定的有效性依赖于具体下游模型与任务，自动化、自适应的标定搜索优于固定流程；引入"预测—检验—校准"机制的记忆化智能体可缓解断言过度泛化，是长程标定探索的关键，为数据为中心的研究提供了可检验的智能体式范式。

Abstract: Data curation is a first-order design choice in machine learning, yet tailoring training data to a downstream model and task remains costly in labor, expertise, and compute. Datasets are therefore often processed through fixed pipelines and reused across applications. We show that this assumption is fragile: across 55 dataset--model tasks spanning biological domains, the same curation recipe can help one model while hurting another. Effective curation must adapt to the downstream setting, motivating automated search over data recipes. We first build an agentic system that searches for curation policies at deployment, improving data utility via \textit{test-time curation (TTC)}. Although achieving performance gains, its search is driven largely by recent feedback and remains local. Adding persistent memory helps the agent retain evidence across iterations and reveals a deeper problem: it forms claims that extend beyond the conditions in which they were observed, sometimes abandoning an entire strategy after a single unsuccessful trial.
  To address this problem, we introduce CaliMem, a calibrated-memory agentic loop that requires the agent to predict the outcome of each proposed policy before executing it. Comparing this prediction with the observed result gives the agent a \textit{reality check} on the claims behind its proposal. It uses the prediction error to retain supported claims, revise mistaken ones, and specify the conditions under which a conclusion holds. This makes the agent's beliefs testable, reduces overgeneralization, and supports more effective long-horizon exploration. Across biological and LLM post-training tasks, CaliMem consistently outperforms fixed curation baselines and published methods, and exceeds full-data training by up to 19.4\%. Code is open-sourced.

</details>


### [498] [How Humans Learn Unfamiliar Worlds: A Think-Aloud Dataset on ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34523)
*Shuzhi Liu,Archana Warrier,Dat Nguyen,Chengqi Zheng,Kevin Ellis,Yewen Pu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 构建首个记录人类在ARC-AGI-3新颖环境中发现与使用机制的轨迹数据集（人类144条+LLM 250条），标注机制触发与识别、动作意图、错误与恢复，对比人类与LLM智能体的认知特征，并提出下一代基准设计方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索学习并用新知识达成目标是通用智能的核心能力，理解该能力需追踪学习者在交互中如何构建、使用和修正世界模型；而现有缺乏记录人类如何发现并使用新颖环境机制的细粒度数据。

Method: 以ARC-AGI-3为测试台：采集64名被试在25个公开游戏上的144条轨迹（时间同步动作+出声思维音频），以及LLM智能体（有无harness）在同一游戏上的250条轨迹；标注机制触发与识别、动作意图、错误与恢复，将理解变化与其支持的观察和动作关联，并开展人类与LLM的定性/定量对比分析。

Result: 两组均会预判机制并使用熟悉类比；成功人类轨迹中定性表征占比显著高于成功LLM轨迹（50.0% vs 14.3%）；人类更常在没有具体假设的情况下探索不熟悉情境，而假设检验在两组中均常见；并刻画了通过信念修正、重规划与执行纠正实现的恢复过程；配备良好harness的LLM在公开游戏上已达饱和表现。

Conclusion: 认知分析表明需构建挑战熟悉先验、要求证据积累与抽象、并通过子目标、实验与恢复检验规划的下一代基准；数据集已公开。

Abstract: Learning through exploration and using newly acquired knowledge to achieve goals are central capabilities of general intelligence. Understanding these capabilities requires tracing how learners build, use, and revise world models during interaction. We construct the first dataset that records how humans discover and use the mechanisms of novel environments, using ARC-AGI-3 as a testbed: 144 trajectories from 64 participants across 25 public games, each pairing time-synchronized actions with think-aloud audio, plus 250 trajectories from large language model (LLM) agents with and without harnesses on the same games. We annotate mechanism triggers and recognition, action purposes, and errors and recovery, linking changes in understanding to the observations and actions that support them. We analyze characteristics of human cognition and compare them with those of LLM agents. Both groups anticipate mechanisms and use familiar analogies. Qualitative representations are more common in successful human trajectories than in successful LLM trajectories (50.0% versus 14.3%). Humans more often explore unfamiliar situations without a concrete hypothesis, while hypothesis testing is common in both groups. We also trace how learners recover through belief revision, replanning, and execution correction. As LLMs with well-designed harnesses reach saturated performance on public ARC-AGI-3 games, our cognitive analyses motivate next-generation benchmarks that challenge familiar priors, require accumulated evidence and abstraction, and test planning through subgoals, experimentation, and recovery. Our dataset is available at [https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/](https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/).

</details>


### [499] [How Much Information Can We Fit inside a Transformer?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34553)
*Amirhossein Basareh,Rishabh Sanjay,Daniel de Mello,Abulhair Saparov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过严格实验与贝叶斯优化超参搜索，发现无结构事实记忆容量随Transformer维度指数增长，即最小所需维度对事实数N呈对数增长（F检验不拒绝对数拟合而拒绝幂律等），深度方向则次线性增长；结构化数据（对称关系、两跳组合）下级联利用规律可进一步提升容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究观察到"记忆事实数—参数量"呈线性关系，远逊于理论分析所预测的可达效率，且该结论影响模型设计与对Transformer能力边界的理解，因此需要重新审视经验缩放规律。

Method: 采用随机、独立、无可利用结构的合成(subject, relation, object)三元组数据集；对每个数据集规模，通过系统实验与贝叶斯优化进行充分超参搜索，确定能完美记忆该事实集的最小模型；测量最小维度d_min与N的缩放关系，并用lack-of-fit F检验比较对数、幂律等候选模型；另沿深度轴在固定宽度下测量层数的影响，并扩展到含对称关系与两跳组合的结构化数据。

Result: 记忆容量（可被完整记忆的最大数据集规模）随Transformer维度指数增长；等价地，最小所需维度d_min对N对数增长。在N=45至49,920共11个规模上，F检验不拒绝带偏移的对数拟合，而拒绝包括幂律在内的其他所有备择模型。深度方向上，固定宽度时最大可记忆规模随层数在测量范围内次线性增长。结构化数据中，Transformer可利用对称关系与两跳组合等规律进一步提升容量。

Conclusion: Transformer的纯事实记忆效率优于先前线性缩放的认知：宽度方向呈对数—指数对应关系；深度方向的收益次线性；模型能自动利用数据中的结构规律以提高容量。代码已开源。

Abstract: How efficiently can transformers store factual knowledge? The answer to this question has implications for both model design and understanding the limits of transformer-based systems. Prior studies observe a linear relationship between the number of facts memorized and the number of model parameters required, substantially worse than what theoretical analyses predict is achievable. We re-examine empirical scaling: through rigorous and systematic experiments, including extensive hyperparameter search via Bayesian optimization, we determine the smallest model that can perfectly memorize a given set of facts, and measure how this minimum size scales with the number of facts. On synthetic datasets of random, independent (subject, relation, object) triples---e.g., (Paris, capital_of, France) ---drawn at random with no exploitable structure, we find that memorization capacity, the size of the largest dataset that a model memorizes completely, grows exponentially with the transformer dimension. Equivalently, the minimum transformer dimension $d_{\min}$ required to memorize $N$ facts grows logarithmically in $N$. Across 11 dataset sizes spanning $N = 45$ to $49{,}920$, a lack-of-fit F-test does not reject the logarithmic fit (with an offset), but it does reject all other tested alternatives including power-law. Along the depth axis, however, at fixed width, the maximum memorizable dataset size grows sublinearly with the number of layers over the measured range. We further extend our exploration to structured data containing symmetric relations or two-hop composition. In this setting, we find that transformers exploit these regularities to further improve capacity. All code to reproduce our results is available at https://github.com/Magronox/transformer_information_capacity.

</details>


### [500] [Agentic AI Orchestration Framework for Spatial Intelligence: Supply Chain Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34569)
*Constantinos Papantoniou,Brian Hilton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ANASSA 参考架构，整合结构化推理、多智能体工作流编排、权威空间基础与反馈驱动执行，并在实际供应链部署中验证其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业空间决策跨越缺乏统一参考框架与归属主体的多个系统，分析人员大量精力耗费在系统间的数据协调而非空间推理本身。

Method: 构建 ANASSA 参考架构：在智能体边界设置类型化数据契约，依据经认证的权威基础校验空间断言，并在六步认知循环中设置两处阻断式人在回路审批；落地于海洋—内陆货运通道的多灾害风险评估场景，含基于集装箱遥测的冷链温控偏移检测。

Result: 三个月概念验证（POC）、三轮实现迭代下报告三项结果：数据质量提升 25%，空间工作流运行时间缩短 50%，决策时延较原人工工作流降低 60%；绝对规模量级与基线计数属机密，所报百分比为观测到的相对变化。

Conclusion: 属非受控部署观测而非对照实验，作者据此给出用于机制层面评估的埋点与消融实验协议，作为后续验证方向。

Abstract: Industrial spatial decisions are assembled across systems that share neither a reference frame nor an owner, and analysts spend substantial effort reconciling those systems rather than reasoning about space. This paper presents ANASSA, a reference architecture integrating structured reasoning, multi-agent workflow orchestration, authoritative spatial grounding, and feedback-driven execution, and reports its instantiation in an operating supply-chain deployment. The architecture places typed data contracts at agent boundaries, validates spatial claims against a certified authoritative foundation, and enforces two blocking human-in-the-loop approvals inside a six-step cognitive loop. The deployment covers multi-hazard risk assessment on an ocean-and-inland freight lane, including cold-chain excursion detection over container telemetry. Across a three-month proof of concept (POC) with three implementation iterations, three deployment outcomes are reported: 25% improvement in data quality, 50% reduction in spatial workflow runtime, and 60% lower decision latency relative to the preceding manual workflow. Absolute deployment-scale quantities and baseline counts are confidential; reported percentages are observed relative changes. These are uncontrolled deployment observations, not controlled experiments. We therefore specify instrumentation and ablation protocols for mechanism-level evaluation.

</details>


### [501] [Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34577)
*Zhengxin Zhang,Erkang Zhu,Yin Lin,Claire Cardie,Bolin Ding,Jingren Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究agent harness中验证(verification)的组织方式,将其视为test-time scaling的一个轴,系统比较17种设计,发现独立评审(independent review)在精度-成本权衡上最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent harness让LLM通过工具行动、观察结果并迭代完成任务,验证可检查并修正agent的工作以提升质量,但目前缺乏关于harness应如何组织这些努力(何时介入、谁来检查、检查如何导致修订)的指导。

Method: 将验证置于agent生命周期的四层:初始指令、轮内提醒、完成门槛(completion gates)、独立评审;在Terminal-Bench(TB)与SWE-bench Verified(SWE)上,跨7个前沿编码模型比较17种设计,并引入VisualBench用于视觉与交互产物的专家评估。

Result: 初始指令与执行期提醒带来中等且依赖模型的平均增益,不明显增加平均输出token;完成门槛增益更大但成本显著上升;独立评审由critic执行,在TB上提升平均准确率5.9-9.5个百分点、SWE上3.9-6.6个百分点,成本分别为基线的1.13-1.25倍和1.00-1.04倍。VisualBench上独立评审四种设计净偏好较基线高13.2-23.8点,优于L0-L2设计;更多评审轮次或多critic可再提升TB准确率最多3.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果为agent harness的验证设计提供实证指导,并支持将独立评审作为test-time scaling的一种实用轴。

Abstract: Agent harnesses enable large language models to act through tools, observe the results, and iteratively work toward a task goal. Verification checks and revises agents' work to improve output quality. Yet there is limited guidance on how harnesses should organize this effort. We study verification as an axis of test-time scaling by examining when to intervene, who checks the work, and how checking leads to revision. Our framework spans four layers of the agent lifecycle: initial instructions, mid-turn reminders, completion gates, and independent review. We compare 17 designs across seven frontier coding models on Terminal-Bench (TB) and SWE-bench Verified (SWE), and introduce VisualBench for expert evaluation of visual and interactive artifacts. Initial instructions and execution-time reminders yield modest, model-dependent average gains on the coding benchmarks, without substantially increasing average output token use. Completion gates can yield larger gains but may substantially increase cost. Independent review by a critic offers a more favorable accuracy-cost tradeoff, improving average accuracy by 5.9-9.5 percentage points on TB and 3.9-6.6 on SWE at 1.13-1.25 and 1.00-1.04 times baseline cost, respectively. On VisualBench, independent review achieves net preferences of 13.2-23.8 points over the baseline across its four designs, exceeding the evaluated L0-L2 designs. Additional review rounds or independent critics further improve average TB accuracy by up to 3.5 percentage points. Together, these results provide empirical guidance for verification design in agent harnesses and support independent review as a practical axis of test-time scaling.

</details>


### [502] [HobbyLM: A Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Model Family on a Hobby Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34582)
*Harish Santhanalakshmi Ganesan,Hariharan M. S.,Prabhurajhan R*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HobbyLM 是一系列低成本、从头训练的小型稀疏 MoE 模型家族，涵盖 500M（169M 激活）聊天/多模态/智能体模型及 1.04B（305M 激活）版本，配套自研 Rust CPU 推理引擎，并延伸出多模态「omni」模型与 333M 流匹配扩散文生图模型，系统报告了小规模训练的经验与天花板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降低大模型研发门槛：仅用数百至数千美元租用 GPU 预算，从零训练可用的小型 MoE 模型，并验证在个人/爱好者算力约束下架构选择与训练策略的可行性，同时明确小规模场景的能力上限。

Method: 核心为 decoder-only Transformer，采用细粒度专家、sigmoid 路由 + 无辅助损失负载均衡、分组查询注意力（per-head QK-norm）及 Muon/AdamW 混合优化器；各组件经 130M 参数单变量消融筛选。500M 模型（169M 激活）在 40B FineWeb token 上预训练并后训练为聊天模型、掩码扩散语言模型、函数调用/计算机使用智能体，以及融合冻结编码器 + 轻量投影器的「omni」多模态模型；推理在自研 Rust CPU 引擎上运行。同类架构扩展至 1.04B（305M 激活），在 100B token 精选混合数据上训练并高质量退火。

Result: HobbyLM-1B 在七项零样本基准上平均 47.5 分，并发布指令微调模型与 macOS 端侧计算机使用适配器；HobbyLM-Image 为 333M 流匹配扩散 Transformer，在 32 倍压缩潜空间生成 1024×1024 图像，附轻依赖 CPU 文生图实现。文中报告了有效与无效做法及小规模上限。

Conclusion: 在数百至数千美元预算内，通过精细架构消融与小规模 MoE 设计可实现具备竞争力的实用模型，并可在笔记本 CPU 上本地部署；但小规模存在明确能力天花板。作者亦标注各组件由哪位作者设计构建，体现个人化、可复现的研发路线。

Abstract: We describe HobbyLM, a family of small sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models trained from scratch with a few hundred to a few thousand dollars of rented GPU time. The core is a decoder-only transformer with fine-grained experts, sigmoid routing with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing, grouped-query attention with per-head QK-normalization, and aMuon/AdamW optimizer split. Each of these choices was selected with a single-variable ablation suite at 130M parameters. On this architecture we train a 500M-parameter model (169M active) on 40B FineWeb tokens and post-train it into a chat model, a masked-diffusion language model, a function-calling and computer-use agent, and a single "omni" checkpoint that reads text, images, video, sound and speech through frozen encoders and small projectors. We run these models on a laptop CPU with a from-scratch Rust inference engine. Two of the authors then adopted the architecture without architectural changes to build HobbyLM-1B (1.04B total, 305M active parameters), trained on a 100B-token curated mixture with a high-quality anneal. HobbyLM-1B reaches a 47.5 average on seven zero-shot benchmarks, and its builders also release an instruction-tuned model and an on-device macOS computer-use adapter. Finally, we describe HobbyLM-Image, a 333M-parameter flow-matching diffusion transformer that generates 1024x1024 images in a 32x-compressed latent space, together with a dependency-light CPU implementation of the full text-to-image pipeline. We report what worked, what did not, and where the small-scale ceilings lie. We also state for each component which author designed or built it.

</details>


### [503] [A Battery for AI Propensity Measurement: Rubrics, Synthetic Item Banks, and Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34614)
*Peter Romero,Haotian Li,Hugo Save,Luning Sun,Zachary R. Tidler,Kazuya Horibe,Joe Watson,Daniel Romero-Alvarado,Israel Mason-Williams,Fernando Martínez-Plumed,José Hernández-Orallo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文发布了28个面向AI研究的“倾向性”（propensities）测量工具集，包含专家撰写的评分量表、合成数据集与带标注的需求区间，基于Romero-Alvarado等（2026）的方法构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究需要一个系统化、可复用、且可映射到既有心理测量学与行为科学构念的工具集，以便在熟悉的理论框架下理解AI系统的行为实验结果，并支持对现有基准的标注与倾向性画像的快速原型开发。

Method: 沿用Romero-Alvarado等（2026）的方法构建倾向性测量工具集：为每个倾向性编写专家评分量表（rubric），配套设计合成数据集，并标注需求区间（demand intervals）；数据集在构造上设计为仅对单一倾向性敏感，以支持单倾向性的快速画像；量表同时可用于标注现有基准条目是否与特定倾向性相关。

Result: 产出覆盖广泛通用倾向性的28项工具集，倾向性源自心理测量、心理学与行为研究；量表可用于现有基准的相关性标注，单倾向敏感数据集可实现倾向性画像的快速原型验证。

Conclusion: 该工作为AI行为研究提供了可复用、结构化的倾向性评测基础设施，并展望了未来倾向性研究的方向。

Abstract: We release a battery of 28 propensities for AI research, with expert-written rubrics, synthetic datasets, and annotated demand intervals, built with the method of Romero-Alvarado et al. (2026). We selected a wide collection of generic propensities that may influence the behavior of AI systems and humans. They are inspired by psychometric, psychological, and behavioral research, so that experimental results can be understood in the context of familiar constructs previously used also for human behavior research. The rubrics are useful for annotating existing benchmarks whose items may be relevant or not for one or more propensities. For easier profiling, however, the synthetic datasets are defined in such a way that they should be sensitive to one propensity only, allowing for a quick prototyping of propensity profiles using the battery of datasets. We also outline directions for future propensity research.

</details>


### [504] [CSI-TextBench: A Dataset and Benchmark for Language-Grounded Ambient Sensing Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34616)
*Guozhen Zhu,Yuqian Hu,Sakila S Jayaweera,Wei-Hsiang Wang,Beibei Wang,K. J. Ray Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CSI-TextBench，一个将 WiFi CSI 环境感知数据与自然语言对齐的大规模数据集与基准，包含 285,790 个样本、7 项任务、2,291 条层次化描述及 2.0 百万 CSI-text 训练对，验证了对比式 CSI-text 对齐可替代有监督分类器并支持开放词汇与组合式场景理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WiFi CSI 可通过无处不在的 IoT 设备被动捕捉室内活动与环境动态，但缺乏类似图像描述或语音转写的自然配对文本，难以融入语言驱动的多模态 AI 体系；现有工作也未将环境感知与语言对齐范式有效衔接。

Method: 构建 CSI-TextBench：整合 3 个感知基准为 285,790 个样本、覆盖 7 项任务，并基于标签派生构造 2,291 条层次化描述，通过多对多分配生成 2.0 百万 CSI-text 训练元组；在 4 类范式家族的 5 种对齐方法上进行基准评测。

Result: 对比式 CSI-text 对齐在无类别标签条件下达到与有监督分类器相当的性能；可用少量样本适应未见类别；可响应开放词汇自然语言提示。单一统一模型支持组合式场景理解，在 140 个组合场景上取得 86.9% top-1 准确率，优于任务专用分类器集成。

Conclusion: CSI-TextBench 使普适环境感知成为语言索引的感知层，为语言驱动的 AI 系统提供室内情境理解能力，推动 CSI 与语言对齐范式的融合。

Abstract: Indoor context deciphered by ambient sensing underpins many applications, from assisted living to smart buildings, yet remains weakly connected to the language-aligned paradigm of modern multimodal systems. Through billions of IoT devices, ambient WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) captures the indoor context of human activity and environmental dynamics passively via ubiquitous, always-on infrastructure. However, unlike vision or audio, CSI lacks naturally paired text like captions or transcripts, limiting its integration with language-driven AI systems.
  We present CSI-TextBench, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for aligning CSI data with natural language, unifying 3 sensing benchmarks into 285,790 samples across 7 tasks and pairing them with 2,291 hierarchically structured, label-derived descriptions via many-to-many assignment to construct 2.0 million CSI-text training tuples. Benchmarking 5 alignment methods from 4 paradigm families, we show that contrastive CSI-text alignment matches supervised classifiers without class labels, adapts to unseen classes with few samples, and responds to open-vocabulary natural-language prompts. A single unified model supports compositional scene understanding, answering joint queries over activity, proximity, and identity, achieving 86.9% top-1 accuracy on 140 composite scenes, outperforming task-specific classifier ensembles. CSI-TextBench enables ubiquitous ambient sensing as a language-indexed perception layer, enabling indoor contextual awareness in language-driven AI systems.

</details>


### [505] [One Mean Log-Mel Vector per Phoneme: Simple and Fast Text Injection for Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34623)
*Albert Zeyer,Davyd Naveriani,Dorian Koch,Ralf Schlüter,Hermann Ney*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用查找表替代冻结TTS模型为文本注入生成合成语音输入，训练快1.8倍且WER相当，在LibriSpeech上达到1.36/2.90/1.52/3.24% WER的SOTA水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本注入使语音识别模型能利用无配对音频的文本数据，此前需用冻结的神经TTS模型将文本转为合成输入，计算开销大。本文旨在以极简方式生成合成输入，降低训练成本。

Method: 以查找表取代TTS：每个音素对应一个平均log-mel向量（或one-hot编码），按对齐统计中随机采样的时长重复，词间插入静音。消融分析合成输入各组件（时长、声学特征）、比较不同HMM对齐器、在25000小时Loquacious数据上评估扩展性，并对比全编码器注入与部分编码器、解码器注入方法。

Result: 训练速度比神经TTS快1.8倍，WER相当；结合外部语言模型，LibriSpeech {dev,test}-{clean,other} 上WER为1.36/2.90/1.52/3.24%，据称是仅使用LibriSpeech配对数据、文本和词典条件下的最优结果；全编码器注入相对部分编码器和解码器方法有显著相对提升。

Conclusion: 简单的查找表合成输入可完全替代神经TTS用于文本注入，效率更高、效果不降，且全编码器注入最具优势；完整流程代码已开源。

Abstract: Text injection trains speech recognition models on unpaired text alongside paired audio. We feed the speech encoder synthetic input derived from text so the whole model learns from it. Previously, we synthesized this input with a frozen text-to-speech (TTS) model. Here, a simple lookup table replaces the TTS model: a mean log-mel vector (or one-hot encoding) per phoneme, repeated for a random duration drawn from alignment statistics, with silence between words. Training is 1.8 times faster than with the neural TTS, achieving comparable word error rates. With an external language model, our system reaches 1.36 / 2.90 / 1.52 / 3.24 % WER on LibriSpeech {dev,test}-{clean,other}, to our knowledge state-of-the-art using only LibriSpeech paired data, text, and lexicon. We analyze components of synthetic input (durations, acoustic features), compare different HMM aligners, evaluate scaling on the 25 000 h Loquacious dataset, and show that full-encoder injection yields strong relative improvements compared to partial-encoder and decoder methods. The code of the whole pipeline behind every number in this paper is public: github.com/rwth-i6/returnn-experiments/tree/master/2026-text-injection

</details>


### [506] [InferPriv: Evaluating Inferential Privacy Leakage in LLM Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34640)
*Pengrun Huang,Yiwei Fu,Luoxi Meng,Kamalika Chaudhuri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 InferPriv 基准，用"诚实但好奇的接收方"能否从 LLM 个人代理的回复中推断出用户敏感属性来衡量推断性隐私泄露，发现其显著高于直接泄露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有隐私基准只考察代理明确陈述预设秘密或属性的"直接泄露"，忽略了回复中间接线索导致的"推断性泄露"，从而可能严重低估隐私风险。

Method: 构建 InferPriv 基准，模拟个人代理执行日常任务并与第三方通信，由诚实但好奇的接收方从模型回复中推断用户敏感属性；在五种前沿模型与多种提示（含隐私感知系统提示）下评测。

Result: 推断性泄露在各模型、各提示下均显著高于直接泄露；在隐私感知系统提示下，GPT-6.1-Sol、Sonnet-5.5、Gemini-3.8-Flash 直接泄露接近零，但推断性泄露率仍达 16.2%–25.2%。

Conclusion: 仅评估显式泄露会实质低估隐私风险，隐私对齐与评测需纳入推断性泄露这一维度。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based personal agents are increasingly deployed to handle everyday tasks on users' behalf. These agents have access to private user information, while their tasks involve communicating with third parties; this raises a critical privacy concern that agents may inappropriately reveal sensitive user information to these recipients. Existing benchmarks primarily assess direct privacy leakage, where an agent explicitly states a pre-specified secret or attribute. However, they do not capture \textit{inferential leakage}, where the model leaves indirect cues in the reply that implicitly leaks sensitive attributes. We introduce \textsc{InferPriv}, a benchmark that measures whether an honest-but-curious recipient can infer a user's sensitive attributes from an LLM's reply on routine task. Evaluating five frontier models, we find that inferential leakage substantially exceeds direct leakage across models and prompts. Under a privacy-aware system prompt, GPT-6.1-Sol, Sonnet-5.5, and Gemini-3.8-Flash achieve near-zero direct leakage, yet the inferential leakage rate remains between 16.2--25.2\%. These findings suggest that evaluating explicit leakage alone can substantially understate the privacy risks.

</details>


### [507] [SlowLab: Benchmarking Autonomous AI Agents on a Year of Experiments They Cannot Undo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34644)
*Ningpei Ding,Zai Wen Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SlowLab基准：代理需在隐藏作物、设施与价格的模拟温室中开展为期一年的四隔间实验campaign，自主决定种植时机、气候策略、停种与测量，最终推荐一个策略并由私有评估器在未见天气下打分。48个未见站点的预注册实验表明，三个低成本语言模型代理的结果接近标准种植者设置，明显落后于以该设置为起点的贝叶斯优化基线；它们把设施当作两个同步批次运行，季内测量从未改变种植决策，也未提升任何方法的结果，重读历史证据亦未能显著改善推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI实验代理基准多提供即时给出答案的低成本实验，而物理设施中的实验耗时数月、占用稀缺设备且不可撤销，缺乏能评估此类慢速、高成本、不可逆实验能力的基准。作者据此设计SlowLab，考察代理在长周期、有限资源与不可逆条件下的实验规划与决策能力。

Method: 构建SlowLab：模拟温室的四个隔间、一年期campaign，站点作物、设施与价格对代理隐藏；代理需决定何时种植何种气候策略、是否终止作物、读取哪些测量，最终推荐一个策略；由私有评估器在代理未见过的天气条件下评分。在48个未见站点开展预注册研究，对比三个低成本语言模型代理与从标准种植者设置出发的贝叶斯优化基线，并进行"重读已收集证据"的额外实验。

Result: 三个低成本语言模型代理表现接近标准种植者设置，明显低于贝叶斯优化基线；代理将设施作为两个同步批次运行，季内测量未改变其种植决策，且未提升任何方法的结果；让其他方法重新读取campaign已收集的证据未带来显著更优的推荐。

Conclusion: 语言模型代理在慢速、不可逆的设施实验中尚不具备有效的信息性实验设计能力，瓶颈在于模型的起点与所选择的实验类型，而非对已有证据的利用。SlowLab为评估此类长期设施实验代理提供了标准化测试平台，代码以MIT许可发布。

Abstract: AI agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous experimenters, yet the benchmarks that test them mostly offer cheap experiments that answer at once. Experiments in physical facilities are different: they take months, occupy scarce equipment and cannot be undone. We present SlowLab, a benchmark in which an agent runs a one-year campaign in four simulated greenhouse compartments on a site whose crop, facility and prices are hidden. The agent decides when to plant which climate policy, whether to stop a crop and which measurements to read while crops grow, and at the end recommends one policy, which a private evaluator scores in weather the agent never saw. In a preregistered study on 48 unseen sites, three low-cost language-model agents ended near a standard grower setting and clearly below a Bayesian-optimisation baseline that starts from that setting. They ran the facility as two synchronous batches, so measurements taken during the season never changed what they planted, and these measurements improved no method's result. Letting other methods re-read the evidence a campaign had collected did not yield significantly better recommendations, which points to where the models start and which experiments they try. Code is released under the MIT license.

</details>


### [508] [AdaTutor: Adaptive Tutoring through Pedagogical Strategy Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34659)
*Rajeev Bhatt Ambati,Shashank Srivastava,Snigdha Chaturvedi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出比较式教学监督（CPS）训练框架，使辅导模型学会在相同学生错误下选择最优教学策略与反馈形式，而非仅生成信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有效辅导不仅需决定提供什么信息，还需决定以何种形式（教学策略）提供；同一错误可用多种策略应对，且策略应随交互推进而调整，现有工作多聚焦固定策略或单一反馈生成。

Method: CPS 为一种训练框架，通过比较式监督学习在数学与科学推理数据集上选择对学生学习最优的策略与反馈，并在多轮辅导中动态适应。

Result: 经过五轮辅导后，CPS 优于最强固定策略基线；所学辅导器可跨数据集迁移，其策略选择还能为独立的 API 辅导器提供指导。

Conclusion: 教学策略选择本身是可学习且可迁移的能力，比较式监督为构建自适应辅导系统提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Effective tutoring requires determining not only what information to provide, but also which form of assistance to deliver. A tutor may address the same student error using various pedagogical strategies, adapting its approach as the interaction progresses. We introduce Comparative Pedagogical Supervision (CPS), a training framework to learn to select the optimal strategy and feedback for student learning. We evaluate CPS on math and science reasoning datasets. After five tutoring turns, CPS outperforms the strongest fixed-strategy baselines. The learned tutor transfers across datasets, and its strategy selection can also inform a separate API-based tutor.

</details>


### [509] [Hierarchical Task Network planning in the Goal Lifecycle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34668)
*Paola Rizzo,Hector Munoz-Avila,David W. Aha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究能否用层次任务网络（HTN）规划统一实现目标推理（GR）中的目标生命周期（Goal Lifecycle），提出一种在各策略中统一使用HTN规划的GR智能体架构，并通过自动驾驶车辆仿真验证其动态环境下的适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标推理要求智能体持续对当前所追求的目标进行推理，在出现机会或实际结果与预期产生偏差时触发目标变更。现有GR与规划研究多仅在目标展开（expand）中采用HTN规划，缺乏统一的规划实现机制，因此作者希望验证HTN规划能否为动态环境下的目标生命周期提供一致、统一的实现方案。

Method: 提出一种新的GR智能体架构，将HTN规划嵌入目标生命周期。除常见的expand与re-expand策略外，还将HTN规划用于formulate策略，以实现统一规划并支持面向更高层总体目标来构造新目标；同时采用增强的HTN动作表示处理期望与实际动作结果之间的偏差，用以驱动目标间的转换。

Result: 实验结果表明，该GR架构能使仿真自动驾驶车辆在动态环境中自适应地执行任务。

Conclusion: HTN规划可作为目标生命周期各策略的统一实现机制，将规划扩展到formulate策略带来诸如按高层目标构造新目标等优势；结合增强动作表示可有效处理触发目标转换的结果偏差，验证了统一规划式GR架构在动态环境中的可行性。

Abstract: Goal reasoning (GR) is the process by which intelligent agents continually reason about the goals they are pursuing, which may lead to goal change, for instance when opportunities arise, or when events cause discrepancies among expected and actual outcomes of actions planned to achieve goals. In this paper we investigate whether Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planning can provide a uniform implementation of the Goal Lifecycle, a flexible process model for goal reasoning in dynamic environments. The Goal Lifecycle progressively refines goals by adding constraints to them through a series of strategies (e.g., {\it formulate, select, expand}) and uses other strategies (e.g., {\it defer, re-expand, repair}) to resolve the current goal when an event impacts it. We present a novel GR agent architecture that employs HTN planning in this Goal Lifecycle. In addition to using HTN planning for the \textit{expand} and \textit{re-expand} strategies, as is frequently done in GR and planning research, we also use it in the \textit{formulate} strategy, to obtain a uniform planning approach that provides several benefits (e.g., the possibility to formulate new goals in view of achieving higher level overarching goals). We also explain how we use an enhanced HTN action representation to process discrepancies among expected and actual action outcomes that can trigger the transition from one goal to another. Finally, we empirically demonstrate that our GR architecture enables simulated autonomous vehicles to adaptively conduct missions in dynamic environments.

</details>


### [510] [Curriculum-Guided Acquisition of Hierarchical Task Knowledge from LLM-Generated Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34677)
*Yuesheng Xu,Hector Munoz-Avila*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文在HTN学习框架中研究分层任务知识的课程式获取，提出一种从LLM生成并经验证的求解轨迹中自动生成学习课程的方法，并与在线学习、人工设计课程进行对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层任务知识可复用已有技能以提升问题求解效率，但如何在HTN框架中高效获取这类知识（尤其是避免在线学习的高昂成本与人工课程的高投入）尚待研究。

Method: 比较三种方法：（1）问题求解过程中的在线学习；（2）人工设计课程；（3）自动课程生成——先用LLM求解小规模训练问题，抽取任务完成信息，转化为有序的状态-任务学习问题序列，用于HTN方法（method）习得。

Result: 在多个规划域上的实验表明，自动生成的课程能获得专家设计课程的大部分收益，同时显著降低在线分层知识获取的token开销。

Conclusion: 经LLM求解轨迹驱动的自动课程生成是替代人工课程、降低在线学习成本的有效途径，可在HTN分层任务知识获取中兼顾效果与效率。

Abstract: Hierarchical task knowledge enables efficient problem solving by allowing previously acquired skills to be reused across tasks and problem instances. In this paper, we investigate curriculum-guided acquisition of hierarchical task knowledge in an HTN learning framework. We compare three approaches: online learning during problem solving, human-designed curricula, and an automated curriculum generation procedure that derives learning experiences from verified LLM-generated solution traces. The proposed procedure solves small training problems with an LLM, extracts task accomplishment information, and transforms it into ordered sequences of state-task learning problems for HTN method acquisition. We evaluate the three approaches across multiple planning domains. The results demonstrate that automatically generated curricula recover much of the benefit of expert-designed curricula while substantially reducing the token cost of online hierarchical knowledge acquisition.

</details>


### [511] [Topic-Level Fairness in Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34683)
*Jaeyoung Park,Hantian Zhang,Kexin Rong,Steven Euijong Whang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究RAG系统的主题级群体公平性，发现聚合指标会掩盖主题间的公平性差异，提出按主题分别用Bradley-Terry目标微调重排序器，将各主题每主题差异平均绝对降幅降低51%（RoMQA）和40%（TREC Fair Ranking），并保持准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG公平性评估多采用跨查询聚合的指标，这类指标会隐藏主题层面的差异：系统可能在人权类问题上偏向女性、在演员与导演类问题上偏向男性，总体看似接近中立，但没有任何一个主题实现公平。因此需要以"每个主题内部均满足群体公平"为标准的主题级公平性研究。

Method: 在每个主题上单独适配重排序器，采用Bradley-Terry目标函数，并以生成器自身输出构造的偏好对作为直接监督信号；由生成输出构建的偏好对携带了该主题所需的方向。

Result: 仅使用RoMQA构造偏好对时，该适配方法使RoMQA上每主题差异的平均绝对值降低51%，TREC Fair Ranking上降低40%，同时保持准确率不变。没有基线方法达到该降幅，即使将基线改为逐主题分别处理、而非对所有主题施加同一校正，仍不及本方法；使用单一重排序器覆盖所有主题（即遵循多数主题所需的方向）的变体同样无法达到该效果。

Conclusion: 主题级公平性需在主题内部分别度量与优化；主题特定的重排序器适配能显著降低主题级差异而不损精度，且跨主题共享单一校正方向会因主题间方向冲突而失效。

Abstract: Group fairness in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems is typically evaluated using metrics aggregated across queries. However, such metrics can conceal topic-level disparities: a system may favor women on questions about human rights and men on questions about actors and filmmakers, appearing nearly neutral overall even though neither topic is fair. We therefore study topic-level fairness, which requires group fairness to hold within each topic rather than only in aggregate. To reduce the topic-level disparity, we adapt the reranker separately for each topic with a Bradley-Terry objective under direct supervision from the generated output: preference pairs built from the generator's own output carry the direction that topic requires. With preference pairs built from RoMQA alone, the adaptation reduces the mean absolute per-topic disparity by 51% on RoMQA and by 40% on TREC Fair Ranking while retaining accuracy. No baseline reaches the reduction, even when modified to treat each topic separately rather than apply one correction to every topic. Neither does our method with one reranker for all topics, which follows the direction that most topics require.

</details>


### [512] [Safe by Benchmark, Unsafe in Practice: Lessons from 1331 Child-Related AI Incidents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34705)
*Junfeng Jiao,Kevin Chen,Shrestha Mishra,Abhejay Murali,David Atkinson,Shriti Raj,Saleh Afroogh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文构建以儿童为中心的AI危害分类体系，编码1331起公开报道的儿童相关AI事件，发现危害集中于表征、尊严与心理类别，且多与部署情境、治理和误用等非模型缺陷失败模式共现，个体危害常外溢至群体层面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统已深度进入儿童的教育、娱乐、社交与玩具场景，但现有安全性评估多停留在模型层面（基准测试、红队测试、内容过滤），主流危害分类法缺乏儿童特异性证据，对发展性危害及未成年群体特有的利益相关方不对称性描述不足。

Method: 基于既有分类法构建映射到社会技术失败模式的儿童中心危害分类法；整理并编码1331起公开报道的儿童相关AI事件，标注内部/外部危害类型及所涉失败模式，并分析危害流行度、个体与群体层面危害的关联、以及共现失败模式。

Result: 危害集中于表征性、尊严相关与心理类别；其共现对象多为部署情境、治理与误用失败，而非模型缺陷；对单个儿童的危害常与群体层面危害相连，波及从未使用该系统的儿童。

Conclusion: 模型级评估虽属必要，但无法独立预判儿童最常被记录的危害路径；需在内容过滤之外采取年龄核验、描绘同意验证、安全内建设计的用户体验约束、事件披露规范及针对发展性风险的审计制度等措施。

Abstract: AI systems are increasingly present in children's everyday environments: education, entertainment, social networks, and toys. Their safety is typically assessed at the model level, through benchmarks, red-teaming, and content filtering. However, most AI harm taxonomies lack child-specific evidence and under-specify developmental harm and the stakeholder asymmetries unique to minors. Building on prior taxonomies, we construct a child-centered harm taxonomy mapped to sociotechnical failure modes. We curate and code 1331 publicly reported child-related AI incidents, annotating internal and external harm types and the failure mode implicated in each incident. Our analysis reveals which harms are most prevalent in public reporting, how individual-level and population-level harms relate, and which failures are most often coded alongside harm. We find that harm concentrates in representational, dignity-related, and psychological categories, and co-occurs most often with deployment-context, governance, and misuse failures rather than model defects. Harm to an individual child is also frequently linked to population-level harm, reaching children who never interacted with the system. These findings suggest that model-level evaluations, while necessary, cannot by themselves anticipate the harm pathways most often documented for children. We conclude with actionable implications emphasizing mitigations beyond model-level safeguards such as content filtering: age assurance, consent verification for depiction, safety-by-design UX constraints, incident disclosure norms, and auditing regimes targeting developmental risk. Privacy-minimized annotations, a codebook, and documentation are available at https://github.com/The-Responsible-AI-Initiative/KidAID.

</details>


### [513] [Intervene, Calibrate, Discover: Learning Causal Structure from Pixels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34711)
*Ziyi Ding,Xiaodi Huang,Xianxin Lai,Haijier Chen,Zhang Zhang,Xiao-Ping Zhang,Jiayu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对“节点语义已知但图未知”的视觉因果发现问题，提出用固定轮转干预获得的验证值来校准视觉读出，从而对齐模型设定与环境干预值，并在多个基准上验证了图发现、干预后果预测与反事实图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从低层观测中学习高层因果变量是AI的核心问题。当节点语义已知而因果图未知时，视觉读出误差会使模型数值设定与环境真实干预值不一致，导致错位。

Method: 将图像读出与通过固定轮转（round-robin）干预获得的验证值配对；在编码器与解码器冻结的前提下，学习一个逐维可逆的校准映射，把视觉响应与目标设定映射到共享数值单位；冻结该映射后，智能体主动选择干预以判定图方向，并拟合局部机制预测后果；最后通过逆校准将反事实状态映射回解码器原始坐标。

Result: 在Domino、Pick-and-Place、Balance、Gears、CAUSAL3D与CausalWorld上评估了图发现、干预后果与反事实图像；受控多米诺实验表明干预可消除“等量额外观测”遗留的方向歧义；在匹配数据的多米诺对照中，校准相对未校准模型降低了同一事实情境下其他变量预测变化的平均误差。

Conclusion: 校准视觉读出与环境干预值的数值错位是可分离、可处理的关键环节；冻结编解码器下的可逆校准配合主动干预，能提升图发现与反事实推理的准确性。

Abstract: Learning high-level causal variables from low-level observations is a central problem for artificial intelligence. With known node semantics but an unknown graph, visual readout errors can misalign model settings with environment intervention values. We address this mismatch by pairing image readouts with verified values attained through fixed round-robin interventions. With encoder and decoder frozen, a dimension-wise invertible calibration map puts visual responses and target settings in shared numerical units. After freezing this map, the agent selects interventions to resolve graph directions and fits local mechanisms to predict consequences; inverse calibration returns counterfactual states to the decoder's original coordinates. Across Domino, Pick-and-Place, Balance, Gears, CAUSAL3D, and CausalWorld, we evaluate graph discovery, intervention consequences, and counterfactual images. Controlled domino experiments show that interventions resolve orientation ambiguity left by equal additional observations. In a matched-data domino control, calibration reduces the mean error of predicted changes in other variables within the same factual context, relative to an uncalibrated model.

</details>


### [514] [SearchHorizonBench: A Benchmark for Search Value in AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34714)
*Jingjie Ning,Xueqi Li,Yibo Kong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SearchHorizonBench基准，从执行经验中学习与评估"搜索价值"（额外收益），并通过配对续写与重复执行将预期搜索增益与生成噪声分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体需判断"再搜一次是否值得其成本"；答案成功率只刻画题目难度，而该决策真正需要的是对搜索额外收益（增益）的估计，现有基准缺乏对此的可评估设定。

Method: 构建包含3,168个问题、45,632次执行的数据资源；采用配对续写与重复执行来分离预期搜索增益与生成噪声，并将预测质量与决策效用关联；使用匹配配置下的学习曲线考察不同训练规模；提供冻结划分、强基线与评分工具。

Result: 在1,632个留出问题上，历史校准使Brier误差降低16.2%，提升主要集中于成功层面信息；搜索增益标准差达21.4个百分点，而所测历史估计器仅解释点估计方差不到2%；在参考token价格下，免费选择观测相对最优常数动作带来2.49点的效用机会，主要来自增益信息。

Conclusion: 将搜索价值预测与决策效用挂钩是可行且必要的；现有估计器对增益方差解释力弱，说明增益信息尚待挖掘，可复用历史、冻结划分与评分工具为价值感知搜索智能体的开发与评估提供共同基础。

Abstract: AI agents must decide when another search is worth its cost. Answer-success probabilities capture question difficulty, while this decision requires estimating the additional benefit of search. We introduce SearchHorizonBench, a benchmark for learning and evaluating search value from execution experience. Paired continuations and repeated executions separate expected search gain from generation noise and connect prediction quality to decision utility. The resource contains 45,632 executions across 3,168 questions. On 1,632 held-out questions, historical calibration reduces Brier error by 16.2%, with the improvement concentrated in success-level information. Search gains have a standard deviation of 21.4 percentage points, and tested historical estimators explain less than 2% of this variance in point estimates. Matched-configuration learning curves probe this distinction across training scales. At the reference token price, free selection observations yield a 2.49-point utility opportunity over the best constant action, driven primarily by gain information. Reusable histories, frozen splits, strong baselines and scoring tools provide a common foundation for developing and evaluating value-aware search agents.

</details>


### [515] [Prefetch-Steered Routing: Deterministic Cache-Aware Expert Selection for Offloaded Mixture-of-Experts Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34721)
*Siming Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 prefetch-steered routing (PSR)：将路由条件建立在确定性的逻辑缓存上（每层每 token 至多插入 n 个由下一层路由器预测的专家），物理拷贝只影响延迟而不影响输出；在 OLMoE-1B-7B、Moonlight-16B-A3B 上显著加速且精度基本持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE 模型无法完全驻留 GPU 时，batch-1 解码主要受限于从主机内存拷贝专家权重。Cache-aware routing 通过让路由器偏好已驻留专家来减少拷贝，但与异步预取结合后，模型输出会依赖传输时序，导致不模拟该时序的评测框架无法评估真正部署的模型。

Method: PSR 让路由基于一个确定性的逻辑缓存：每层、每 token 最多插入由下一层路由器预测出的 n 个专家；物理拷贝仅影响延迟，不影响输出分布。并在 OLMoE-1B-7B、Moonlight-16B-A3B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上与精确路由+LRU、Cache-Prior 基线对比，另考察蒸馏训练的 gate 与推测解码（块级专家选择）。

Result: OLMoE-1B-7B（RTX 4090，50%/25% 驻留）：比精确路由+LRU 快 2.2–2.3x，比 Cache-Prior 快 25–30%，基准平均差 +0.1/+0.5 分（95% 下界 -0.8/-0.3）；贪心生成下对 Cache-Prior 的领先依赖负载，50% 驻留时在 HumanEval 上反转。Moonlight-16B-A3B（37.5% 驻留）：比精确路由+LRU 快 1.9x，在与 Cache-Prior 相同延迟下于 8 个基准中的 3 个显著更优。Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（拷贝相对计算便宜）：在似然基准上保持对 Cache-Prior 的优势，但失去速度优势。蒸馏训练的 gate 无帮助；OLMoE 上块级专家选择的推测解码慢于 PSR+1B 自回归草稿模型，而 Qwen3.6 上用块级草稿模型比任何自回归配置快 2.1–2.9x（同 GPU 显存约束，64 条计时 prompt）。

Conclusion: PSR 通过解耦"路由决策"与"物理拷贝时序"，获得可复现、时序无关的输出同时保留缓存感知路由的加速收益，在内存受限场景下优于 Cache-Prior；但其优势依赖驻留比例与负载（如 HumanEval、拷贝代价低的大模型），且蒸馏 gate 无效。块级草稿模型的推测解码在大模型上更具潜力。

Abstract: When a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model does not fit in GPU memory, batch-1 decoding is dominated by copying expert weights from host memory. Cache-aware routing reduces these copies by biasing the router toward resident experts, but combined with asynchronous prefetching it makes the model's outputs depend on transfer timing, so a harness that does not simulate that timing no longer evaluates the deployed model. We propose prefetch-steered routing (PSR): routing conditions on a deterministic logical cache, into which at most n experts predicted by the next layer's router are inserted per layer and token; physical copies affect only latency. On OLMoE-1B-7B with 50% and 25% of experts resident on an RTX 4090, PSR decodes 2.2-2.3x faster than exact routing with LRU and 25-30% faster than the Cache-Prior operating point, with mean benchmark differences of +0.1 and +0.5 points (95% lower bounds -0.8 and -0.3). In greedy generation its lead over Cache-Prior depends on the workload and reverses on HumanEval at 50% residency. On Moonlight-16B-A3B, PSR is 1.9x faster than exact routing with LRU at 37.5% residency and, at the latency of Cache-Prior, significantly better on three of eight benchmarks. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, where copies are cheap relative to computation, PSR keeps its advantage over Cache-Prior on the likelihood benchmarks but not its speed. Distillation-trained gates did not help. Speculative decoding with block-level expert selection was slower than PSR with a 1B autoregressive drafter on OLMoE, but with a block drafter on Qwen3.6 it was 2.1-2.9x faster than any autoregressive configuration with at most its GPU memory on the 64 prompts we timed.

</details>


### [516] [CEPO: A General Framework for Improving Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34722)
*Jongha Kim,Seohyun Lee,Jonathan Minho Chung,Jinsung Yoon,Hyunwoo J. Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CEPO框架，将多智能体系统的提示词拆分为共享的协调者提示与各智能体专属的执行者提示，并按角色分别优化，可与现有提示优化器结合，在11个基准上一致提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统既需要有效的协调，又需要专门化的任务执行，而现有提示优化方法通常将这两类功能耦合在单个智能体的提示词中，导致共享协调规则难以一致地优化、执行指令难以独立调整。

Method: CEPO是一个通用框架：用共享的协调者提示（coordinator prompt）承担系统级协调，用智能体专属的执行者提示（executor prompt）承担智能体级执行，并依据各自角色引导其更新，使共享协调规则跨智能体一致精炼、执行指令保持独立可调。该框架只提供提示结构与优化指导，底层搜索仍由现有提示优化器完成。

Result: 在四个领域共11个基准上的大量实验表明，将CEPO应用于四种现有提示优化器均可一致提升其性能；消融实验与定性分析支持该设计；在文档理解MAS上的受控研究进一步显示优化预算效率提升，且性能随智能体数量增加而扩展。

Conclusion: 解耦协调与执行的提示结构是提升MAS提示优化效果的有效且通用的设计，可作为插件式框架与现有优化器组合使用。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) require both effective coordination and specialized task execution. Existing prompt optimization approaches typically couple these functions within agent-specific prompts. We introduce Coordinator-Executor Prompt Optimization (CEPO), a general framework for improving prompt optimization in MAS. CEPO separates system-level coordination from agent-level execution through a shared coordinator prompt and agent-specific executor prompts, and guides their updates according to their respective roles. This structure allows shared coordination rules to be refined consistently across agents while keeping execution instructions separately adjustable. CEPO provides the prompt structure and optimization guidance, while existing prompt optimizers perform the underlying search. Extensive experiments spanning 11 benchmarks across four domains demonstrate that applying CEPO to four existing prompt optimizers consistently improves their performance. Ablations and qualitative analyses support the proposed design, while controlled studies on a document-understanding MAS further demonstrate improved optimization budget efficiency and performance scaling with the number of agents.

</details>


### [517] [Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34724)
*Zhen Bi,Zhizhi Peng,Yan Wang,Xueshu Chen,Haofei Zhang,Yaobo Zhang,Zeyu Yang,Qing Shen,Jungang Lou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HaMo：一种"框架-模型"协同的学习框架，结合非参数化的快速经验积累与缓慢的参数化适应，让Web智能体在长周期任务中既能快速复用程序性知识，又能将其内化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长周期智能体不断遇到可复用的程序性知识，但现有系统要么依赖模型适应（参数微调），要么依赖外部记忆，二者都以牺牲持久学习换取快速复用，难以兼顾。此问题对反复执行相关多步工作流的Web智能体尤为突出。

Method: 提出HaMo框架，包含三部分：(1) 将轨迹蒸馏为"策略级经验卡片"用于即时检索，实现快速非参数化经验积累；(2) 以经验为条件的持续学习目标，训练模型在变化情境中解释、落地并执行检索到的策略，实现慢速参数化适应；(3) 基于检索覆盖度的选择机制，挑选紧凑且互补的轨迹用于参数更新。

Result: 在域内与跨域偏移场景下，HaMo均优于仅框架（harness-only）和仅模型（model-only）的适应方法，同时提升了知识保持与迁移适应能力。

Conclusion: 结果表明，同时保留程序性经验并内化其在任务间迁移与执行的能力至关重要；快速经验复用与慢速参数内化应当协同而非二选一。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents continuously encounter reusable procedural knowledge, yet existing systems typically rely either on model adaptation or external memory, trading persistent learning for rapid reuse. This limitation is especially important for Web agents that repeatedly execute related multi-step workflows. We propose HaMo, a Harness-Model collaborative framework that combines fast non-parametric experience accumulation with slow parametric adaptation. HaMo distills trajectories into strategy-level experience cards for immediate retrieval, while an experience-conditioned continual learning objective trains the model to interpret, ground, and execute retrieved strategies across changing contexts. A retrieval-coverage-based selection mechanism further identifies compact and complementary trajectories for parameter updates. Experiments show that HaMo outperforms harness-only and model-only adaptation under within-domain and cross-domain shifts, improving both retention and adaptation. These results highlight the importance of jointly preserving procedural experience and internalizing the competence to transfer and execute it across tasks.

</details>


### [518] [SKALOS: Learning to Distinguish Similar Skills with Capability Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34728)
*Wenhan Xiao,Ziwei Zhang,Xingcheng Fu,Chuanyue Yu,Haonan Yuan,Qingyun Sun,Runhua Xu,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SKALOS：一种图原生重排序器，通过显式能力证据比较多技能，解决技能库扩张下语义相似候选难区分的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体依赖技能库中的可复用过程性知识，技能选择直接影响行为可靠性。随着技能库扩张，语义相似的候选难以区分；现有方法对技能描述进行编码或改写以做相关性排序，但描述异质性强，会掩盖真实能力差异。

Method: 提出 SKALOS：(1) 构建多层级图，对齐技能间的等价表达，同时保留技能特有的能力证据；(2) 采用半环式能力见证学习（semiring-based capability witness learning），按最弱证据对每个分支打分，检验提取需求的联合支撑是否落在同一实现中，并选出最强备选；(3) 设计排序反馈图校准（ranking-feedback graph calibration），修正不可靠证据以降低抽取误差影响。

Result: 在 SkillRet 上，NDCG@10 相比匹配的纯文本重排序器提升 2.68 个百分点；在 ALFWorld 上，见证引导的技能选择将任务成功率从 22% 提升至 29%。

Conclusion: 以显式能力证据为核心的图原生重排序可有效缓解描述异质带来的区分困难，并在检索指标与下游智能体任务成功率上同时带来增益。

Abstract: Skills provide LLM agents with reusable procedural knowledge, making appropriate skill selection essential for reliable agent behavior. As skill libraries expand, distinguishing semantically similar candidates becomes increasingly difficult. Existing methods encode or rewrite skill descriptions for relevance-based ranking, yet heterogeneous descriptions can obscure capability differences. To address this challenge, we propose SKALOS, a graph-native reranker that compares skills via explicit capability evidence. Its multi-hierarchy graph aligns equivalent expressions across skills while preserving skill-specific capability evidence. Since individually relevant capability elements may not jointly support a query, semiring-based capability witness learning scores each branch by its weakest evidence, checks joint support for the extracted requirements within one implementation, and selects the strongest alternative. To reduce the influence of extraction errors, we develop ranking-feedback graph calibration that adjusts unreliable evidence for candidate comparison. Experiments on SkillRet show that SKALOS improves NDCG@10 by 2.68 percentage points over a matched text-only reranker. Witness-guided skill selection also increases ALFWorld task success rate from 22% to 29%.

</details>


### [519] [Query-Driven Learning for Lifted Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34747)
*Luise Ge,Brendan Juba*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究面向查询驱动的一阶推理学习问题，提出"有界隐藏"（bounded concealment）作为可验证/否证全称查询的充要条件，并给出准多项式时间的提升（lifted）算法及可靠性、完备性和样本/运行时间界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法将学习与推理分为两阶段（先学知识库再当作完备库验证查询），在仅需验证少量查询时效率低，且忽视了数据与知识库部分互补信息需联合使用的可能，因此需更紧密地整合学习与推理，并将其扩展到一阶场景。

Method: 将查询驱动学习推广到一阶设定；先分析在部分数据与知识库下验证/否证全称查询的可行性，识别出充要条件"bounded concealment"；进而提出在提升层面（lifted level）求解该任务的准多项式时间算法，并相对于空间有界提升证明给出可靠性/完备性保证。

Result: 给出bounded concealment这一充要条件；提供准多项式时间提升算法；建立相对于空间有界提升证明的可靠性与完备性，以及准多项式样本复杂度与运行时间界。

Conclusion: 提升式查询驱动推理即使在不加限制的知识库学习不可行时也可以高效完成，说明查询驱动的一阶学习与推理可有效整合。

Abstract: Learning and reasoning are both essential to intelligent agents, but have traditionally been treated as two separate stages: first learning a knowledge base from data (or taking one as given), and then verifying queries as if the knowledge base were complete. This separation has been shown to be inefficient when the downstream goal is to verify only a small set of queries. Moreover, it neglects the possibility that data and a knowledge base contain partial yet complementary information, requiring an agent to combine both sources to justify or refute a query. Motivated by the need to integrate learning and reasoning more tightly, we study the problem of query-driven learning for reasoning. More specifically, we extend prior work to the first-order setting, which is critical for practical applications as the number of ground atoms typically grows rapidly. We begin by asking when validating or refuting a universal query given partial data and knowledge base is even possible, and identify a necessary and sufficient condition called bounded concealment. We then propose a quasi-polynomial-time algorithm that solves the task at the lifted level. Finally, we establish soundness and completeness guarantees relative to space-bounded lifted proofs, along with quasipolynomial sample and runtime bounds, demonstrating that lifted query-driven reasoning can be efficient even when unrestricted knowledge-base learning is not.

</details>


### [520] [The Right Fact, the Wrong Decision: SciValidityBench for Scientific Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34767)
*Yuexi Pan,Yongchao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"科学使用有效性"概念并提出可执行基准工厂SciValidityBench，评估智能体记忆是否"有资格"影响决策，而非仅能否检索到事实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆基准多将长期记忆视为检索问题（能否从演化历史中找回相关记录），但科学场景更严格：正确记住的事实可能仍不应被使用。同一实验结果的效力取决于结果与停止规则是否预先设定，故需评估证据在解释状态下是否"可用"。

Method: 构建SciValidityBench：含64个TaskSpec，覆盖5个有效性模块与6个科学领域；TaskSpec将生成式实验历史与科学状态定义、程序化决策oracle、受控干预和自动评分耦合。提出SciStateForge编译-读取框架，将分布式历史编译为显式决策支配状态；用反事实对与定向损坏-修复控制检验模型是否利用这些依赖并定位失败。

Result: 跨四大模型系列，编译后的科学状态相较通用Event Graph使有效决策提升9.2–18.8个百分点；仅靠检索无法复现该跨系列增益；内容相同的扁平与类型化视图对比表明增益源于暴露支配状态而非特定图序列化形式。

Conclusion: SciValidityBench将记忆评估从"找到正确事实"转向"判断该事实是否应支配决策"。

Abstract: Most agent-memory benchmarks frame long-term memory as retrieval: can an agent recover the relevant record from a long and evolving history? Scientific agents face a stricter problem: a correctly remembered fact may still be invalid to use. The same reported test result can support confirmation when the outcome and stopping rule were fixed in advance, yet only exploration when the outcome was selected from twenty inspected results. We call this scientific use validity: whether remembered evidence is eligible to influence a decision under the state governing its interpretation. We introduce SciValidityBench, an executable benchmark factory with 64 TaskSpecs spanning five validity modules and six scientific domains. TaskSpecs couple generated experimental histories with scientific-state definitions, programmatic decision oracles, controlled interventions, and automatic scoring. The SciStateForge compiler-reader framework turns distributed histories into explicit decision-governing state. Counterfactual pairs and targeted corruption-repair controls then test whether models use those dependencies and localize failures. Across four model families, compiled scientific state improves valid decision-making by 9.2-18.8 percentage points over a generic Event Graph. Retrieval alone does not reproduce this cross-family gain, while content-identical flat and typed views show that the improvement comes from exposing governing state rather than a particular graph serialization. SciValidityBench thus shifts memory evaluation from finding the right fact to deciding whether that fact should control the decision.

</details>


### [521] [Scope-Gap Injection: Exploiting Evaluator Channel Blind Spots in the OpenClaw Agent Security Competition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34777)
*Weihang Niu,Mengxing Ren,Che Qu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Scope-Gap Injection (SGI)间接提示注入方法，利用S2评审只看任务与技能定义、不看附件内容的"范围差"，将恶意载荷移入业务清单式附件，在OpenClaw三阶段安全流程中实现越权绕过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段LLM-agent安全流水线中各阶段检查范围不一致，S2（LLM裁判）与S3（实际执行）可见信道不对称，形成可被利用的"范围差"。

Method: 将可见任务指令与技能定义保持无害，把目标标识符、绕过参数与授权流程写入附件（伪装为业务工作清单），使S2裁判判定无害，而执行阶段agent读取附件并依其行事触发权限绕过。

Result: 在OpenClaw中，SGI对19个目标中的5个同时绕过S1、S2、S3；单次提交最高得分F=0.385；附件式投放的S2聚合通过率为78%，显著高于技能内投放的23%。

Conclusion: 评测器检查范围必须与agent实际可访问信道对齐，并据此给出防御方案。

Abstract: This paper introduces Scope-Gap Injection (SGI), an indirect prompt injection method for multi-stage LLM-agent safety pipelines. In the IJCAI 2026 OpenClaw Agent Security Attack Competition, each attack package is judged by a static skill scan (S1), an LLM-judge safety check over the task and skill definition (S2), and a live execution audit (S3). Our observations suggest a scope gap: S2 appears to inspect the task instruction and skill definition without inspecting attachment contents, while the agent reads attachments during S3. SGI keeps the visible task and skill benign, while target identifiers, bypass parameters, and authorization procedures are moved into an attachment written as a business worklist. The S2 judge therefore sees a harmless task, while the agent follows the hidden worklist and triggers the permission bypass. In OpenClaw, SGI bypassed all three stages for 5 of 19 targets. The highest-scoring single submission achieved $F = 0.385$. Across the submission campaign, attachment placement was associated with higher aggregate S2 acceptance than in-skill placement: 78% versus 23%. We close with defenses that align evaluator scope with the channels available to the agent.

</details>


### [522] [Arya Forge: Auditing Validation and Release Approval for Financial Instruction Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34778)
*Kushagra Bhatnagar,Deekshith Marla*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Arya Forge，将类型化记录、当前内容校验与绑定数据集清单的审批覆盖结合，用于区分内容有效性与发布许可；在金融数据系统案例中通过完整性审计、算术一致性校验、240 个场景的注入故障测试与 19 个持久化发布案例评估其发布边界，揭示严格生产者契约执行与有用表示保留之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融指令数据流水线需要区分“内容有效”与“是否允许发布某数据集”，而现有流程往往只做短指令过滤等表层检查，缺少发布记录层面的强制约束与审批覆盖绑定。

Method: 提出 Arya Forge，组合三类机制：类型化记录、当前内容检查、以及与数据集清单绑定的审批覆盖；并设计完整性审计（10 万条合成指令记录）、独立算术实现对照（1.5 万条数值记录、十二个公式族）、240 个场景/2400 条处理行的注入故障与策略保持实验，以及 19 个持久化发布案例，辅以本地处理测量与受控检查点恢复。

Result: 算术实现与全部 15,000 条数值记录在十二个公式族上一致；在短指令过滤配方中加入金融与发布记录检查后，拒绝全部注入的数值故障与策略保持项，同时保留 220/240 干净对照，丢失的 20 个对照恰好涵盖所有被测的现金转换周期样例；19 个持久化发布案例中 11 个选定负例被阻断、4 个等价表示被拒，且绑定后外部证据的变更超出常规 Gold 晋升检查范围。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了严格生产者契约执行与有用表示保留之间的权衡，并识别出清单绑定审批所需的受保护输入；结论仅适用于被测实现与工作负载，不构成一般金融正确性、经验证的审批真实性、专家认可的质量或下游模型提升的证明。

Abstract: Financial instruction-data pipelines must distinguish content validity from permission to release a particular dataset. Arya Forge combines typed records, current-content checks, and approval coverage bound to a dataset manifest. We evaluate its release boundaries in a financial-data systems case study. An integrity audit covers 100,000 synthetic instruction records; a separate arithmetic implementation agrees with all 15,000 numeric records across twelve formula families. In 240 scenarios with 2,400 treatment rows, adding financial and release-record checks to a short-instruction filtering recipe rejects all injected numeric faults and policy holds while retaining 220 of 240 clean controls. The twenty lost controls comprise every tested cash-conversion-cycle example. Nineteen persisted-release cases show that eleven selected negative cases are blocked, four equivalent representations are rejected, and changes to external evidence after binding are outside ordinary Gold promotion's checks. Local processing measurements and controlled checkpoint resumptions characterize cost and recovery through 100,000 input rows. The results expose a tradeoff between strict producer-contract enforcement and useful-representation retention, and identify the protected inputs required for manifest-bound approval. These findings apply to the tested implementation and workloads; they do not establish general financial correctness, authenticated approval, expert-validated quality, or downstream model improvement.

</details>


### [523] [Uncovering the Turing Test's Latent Signal: Indistinguishability as a Reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34781)
