Method: 1) 构建统一语料：47个公开PHM数据集，统一到单一张量契约（tensor contract），并划分协议使11个数据集完全不参与预训练；2) 模型为紧凑的通道独立（channel-independent）Transformer编码器（801,808参数），采用掩码图块预测（masked patch prediction）目标；3) 两种预训练范式：集中式，以及按物理域分组、10个客户端的模拟跨孤岛联邦学习，固定架构、目标、源数据与优化预算；4) 下游评估涵盖故障分类（CWRU、HSG18）与RUL估计（CMAPSS），并做学习率敏感性、服务器动量扫参与SSL损失-下游性能相关性分析。

Result: 迁移效果任务依赖：CWRU故障分类macro-F1由0.350升至0.812，HSG18由0.569升至0.951；CMAPSS RUL任务上无任何预训练检查点能可靠超越从零训练基线。匹配预算下集中式编码器在4/4比较中领先15.5–20.2个macro-F1点，但该对比受偏向集中式分支的学习率调度混淆，且每种范式仅一次预训练运行；RUL上两种范式不可区分。自监督损失不是有效选择准则：集中式将联邦重建损失减半以上，但RUL上无对应差距；服务器动量扫参使下游验证macro-F1变动达0.29，而SSL损失仅变化0.021。骨干学习率影响剧烈：同一检查点在CWRU上因一个数量级差异可得0.169或0.829 macro-F1。

Conclusion: 自监督预训练对PHM的收益是任务依赖的而非普适；在泄漏受控条件下，RUL任务上未观察到可靠增益。集中式相对联邦的优势证据不稳健（受调度混淆、单次运行）；内在SSL损失不应作为模型选择准则；下游性能对骨干学习率高度敏感。作者公开语料流水线、协议与代码以支持可复现的严格评测。

Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining has produced capable time-series foundation models, but its value for Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) has not been measured under leakage-controlled conditions. We measure it on a corpus of 47 public PHM datasets, harmonized to a single tensor contract and partitioned so that 11 datasets are withheld from pretraining in full. Transfer turns out to be task-dependent: a compact channel-independent Transformer encoder (801,808 parameters) pretrained with masked patch prediction raises fault-classification macro-F1 from 0.350 to 0.812 on CWRU and from 0.569 to 0.951 on HSG18, yet on CMAPSS remaining-useful-life estimation no pretrained checkpoint reliably improves upon a from-scratch baseline. We pretrain under two regimes---centralized, and simulated cross-silo federated with ten clients grouped by physical domain---holding architecture, objective, source data and optimization budget fixed. Two further findings are negative. At matched budget the centralized encoder leads by 15.5--20.2 macro-F1 points in four of four comparisons, although the comparison is confounded by a learning-rate schedule that favours the centralized arm and rests on a single pretraining run per regime; on RUL the two regimes are indistinguishable. And the intrinsic SSL loss is not a valid selection criterion: the centralized encoder more than halves the federated reconstruction loss without a corresponding gap on RUL, and a server-momentum sweep moves downstream validation macro-F1 by up to 0.29 while the SSL loss varies by 0.021. Transfer also hinges on the backbone learning rate: the same checkpoint yields 0.169 or 0.829 macro-F1 on CWRU depending on a single order of magnitude. We release the corpus pipeline, the protocol and the code.

</details>


### [558] [Proof-of-Agentness: Towards Verifying Agents on the Web](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35288)
*Zuyao Xu,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"Proof-of-Agentness"(PoA)概念，用于区分LLM智能体与其他自动化客户端（简单bot、脚本），以保护Web服务免遭大规模垃圾提交。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CAPTCHA与bot检测解决了人机区分问题，但LLM智能体逐渐成为Web合法用户，服务方却无法将其与简单bot/脚本区分，导致垃圾提交浪费资源并消耗用户注意力或token。现有机制缺少"证明自己是智能体"的手段。

Method: 受人类注意力与智能体推理资源之间的类比启发，提出PoA机制，并给出两条技术路线：(1)主动验证——基于挑战-响应的交互式验证；(2)被动分析——分析服务端可见的交互信号。后者通过IRB批准的用户研究，比较12名人类参与者与代表性Bot、Agent实现的Web交互行为。

Result: 主动验证中，8个语言模型在挑战任务上总体准确率96.5%，平均开销1,647 tokens；被动分析中，四个分类器在人类、Bot、Agent交互数据上平均分类准确率95.8%。

Conclusion: PoA具备可行性与实用潜力，主动与被动两类方法均达到较高区分精度，支持进一步深入研究该方向。

Abstract: CAPTCHAs and bot detection have helped protect Web services from automated abuse for decades by distinguishing humans from bots. However, the emergence of LLM-powered agents introduces a new setting: Web services increasingly accommodate agents as legitimate users. Without a way to distinguish agents from other automated clients such as simple bots and scripts, these services risk large-scale automated junk submissions that waste service resources and consume users' attention or tokens. In this paper, we investigate a novel question for today's Web: "How can a Web service obtain evidence that a client is an agent?" We introduce the concept of "Proof-of-Agentness" (PoA), a mechanism for distinguishing agents from other automated clients, motivated by the parallel between human attention and an agent's inference resources. We outline two approaches: active verification through challenge-response and passive analysis of service-visible signals. Eight language models achieve an overall accuracy of 96.5% on our challenges, with an average overhead of 1,647 tokens. For passive analysis, we conduct an IRB-approved user study comparing the Web interactions of twelve human participants and representative Bot and Agent implementations, achieving an average classification accuracy of 95.8% across four classifiers, motivating further study.

</details>


### [559] [AgenticCity-Bench: Longitudinal Multimodal Observations of Urban Dynamics with Agentic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35293)
*Xiaofei Yu,Kailai Sun,Yanyu Mao,Baoshen Guo,Heye Huang,Yongcai Wang,Baotong Mi,Alok Prakash,Shenhao Wang,Jinhua Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AgenticCity-Bench，一个纵向多模态城市基准，用于多层统一状态建模与智能体城市任务推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市系统由基础设施、人类活动与环境条件交互塑造，但现有对地观测与城市基准在多模态统一建模及联合动态刻画方面存在不足。

Method: 构建覆盖2000–2025年、12国16城、6大洲的基准，含18种模态（城市功能、活动、环境状态）；以统一空间参考与日历索引组织异构数据源，并保留时空覆盖、来源信息与瓦片级可用性。

Result: 支持城市跨模态转换及预测、规划、资源分析等多样化智能体任务。

Conclusion: 为研究从多模态城市与对地观测走向联合理解与智能体城市决策提供统一基准。

Abstract: City systems are shaped by interactions among infrastructure, human activity, and environmental conditions. Existing earth observation and urban benchmarks are limited in unified modeling and in capturing their joint dynamics. We introduce AgenticCity-Bench, a longitudinal multimodal benchmark for multi-layer unified state modeling and agentic city task reasoning. The benchmark covers 16 cities in 12 countries across six continents from 2000 to 2025, and includes 18 modalities spanning urban function, activity, and environmental state. It organizes heterogeneous data sources around a common spatial reference and calendar index while preserving spatial and temporal coverage, provenance and tile-level availability. On this foundation, AgenticCity-Bench supports urban cross-modal translation together with diverse agentic city tasks involving forecasting, planning and resource analysis. This study provides a unified benchmark for studying the transition from multimodal urban and earth observation to joint understanding and agentic city decision-making. The dataset is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgenticCity-Bench.

</details>


### [560] [Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Management of Climate Change-Related Health Issues in Africa](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35294)
*Peter Kokol,Martha Kachweka,Helena Blazun Vosner,Samuel Chol Buol,Jernej Zavrsnik,Bojan Zlahtic,Grega Zlahtic*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文通过合成知识综合方法与VOSviewer对Scopus文献做文献计量分析，比较"全球"与"非洲"两个语料库，揭示二者在AI气候健康预测建模上的结构性分化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化对非洲公共卫生的冲击尤为严重，但AI预测建模在非洲的发展严重受限；现有研究缺乏对全球与非洲研究格局差异的系统性刻画，难以支撑资金与基础设施层面的政策转向。

Method: 采用合成知识综合（Synthetic Knowledge Synthesis）方法，结合VOSviewer对Scopus收录文献开展文献计量与网络分析，对比全球语料库与非洲语料库的议题结构、主题聚类与关联模式。

Result: 网络分析显示明显分化：全球研究侧重面向"行星健康"的复杂预测模型，非洲研究则集中于面向即时传染病分诊的本地化、反应式方案；非洲面临算力不足、数据孤岛与能源不稳定等结构性障碍，制约先进AI的规模化应用。

Conclusion: 国际资金应从孤立试点项目转向基础数字基础设施建设与本地化AI框架的构建，以弥合全球—非洲研究鸿沟并提升非洲气候—健康AI能力。

Abstract: While climate change disproportionately impacts African public health, AI predictive modeling remains heavily constrained. Using a Synthetic Knowledge Synthesis approach and VOSviewer, we conducted a bibliometric analysis of Scopus-indexed literature, comparing Global and African corpora. Network analysis reveals stark divergences: global research emphasizes complex, predictive models for planetary health, whereas African research focuses on localized, reactive solutions for immediate infectious disease triage. Severe structural barriers in Africa, including compute deficits, data silos, and energy instability, hinder advanced AI scaling. Ultimately, international funding must shift from siloed pilot projects toward building foundational digital infrastructure and localized AI frameworks.

</details>


### [561] [LLM-Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph Learning with Business Semantics for Financial Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35298)
*Yixuan Chen,Hongyu Zhan,Jie Sheng,Weiyu Han,Shuai Chen,Tianyi Zhang,Xiao Tan,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LLM增强框架SemHGT，按实体角色解释结构化属性，通过角色感知提示、语义相似度引导的多轮路径采样和模式级令牌统一Transformer，在三个基准数据集上多数指标领先基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融欺诈检测依赖异质交易图，卡与商户等实体角色不同，同一属性风险含义随角色变化（高交易量对商户常规、对卡异常）。异质GNN保留类型化实体与关系，却将属性视为角色无关输入，业务含义隐式化；已有LLM+图方法多针对同质图或具天然文本属性的异质图，结构化属性的交易图研究不足。

Method: 三阶段：(1) 角色感知提示从节点属性生成风险相关业务描述，文本编码器映射为语义向量增强节点表示；(2) 以语义相似度引导，在transaction-to-transaction模式下的目标特定路径实例上进行多轮采样；(3) 构建融合局部路径证据与全局邻居摘要的模式级令牌，与目标交易共同输入统一Transformer。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上，SemHGT在多数数据集—指标对比中领先所评估基线；进一步分析为其设计有效性提供额外证据，并阐明语义建模与证据选择对欺诈检测的贡献。

Conclusion: 将LLM语义解释与异质图结构证据选择结合可显式注入业务语义并提升欺诈检测性能；代码已开源。

Abstract: Financial fraud detection increasingly relies on heterogeneous transaction graphs, in which entities such as cards and merchants play distinct business roles and the risk meaning of an attribute depends on the entity's role: a high transaction volume may be routine for a merchant but unusual for a card. Heterogeneous graph neural networks preserve typed entities and relations but typically treat these attributes as role-agnostic inputs and leave their business meaning implicit. Meanwhile, most existing methods integrating large language models (LLMs) with graphs focus on homogeneous graphs or heterogeneous graphs with naturally available textual attributes, leaving their use on transaction graphs with structured attributes underexplored. To address this issue, we propose SemHGT, an LLM-enhanced framework that interprets structured attributes according to entity roles and makes the business semantics explicit in three stages: (1) role-aware prompts elicit risk-related business descriptions from node attributes, and a text encoder maps them to semantic vectors that enrich node representations; (2) semantic similarity guides multi-round sampling of target-specific path instances under transaction-to-transaction schemas; (3) schema-level tokens that combine local path evidence with global neighbor summaries are processed together with the target transaction by a unified transformer. Across three benchmark datasets, SemHGT leads the evaluated baselines on most dataset--metric comparisons. Further analyses provide additional evidence for the effectiveness of SemHGT's design and clarify how its semantic modeling and evidence selection contribute to fraud detection. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SemHGT-528A/.

</details>


### [562] [RSIV-Harness: A Recursive Self-Improvement Harness Framework for Open-Domain Conversational Text-to-Visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35316)
*Jiawei Lu,Chen Zhang,Jinwei Lu,Yuanwei Song,Yuanfeng Song,Raymond Chi-Wing Wong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 RSIV-Harness：在冻结大模型权重的前提下，通过递归自我改进（RSI）依据智能体自身的失败轨迹自动修订外层 harness，并用四层框架（锚点检查与记忆检查）平衡改进与稳定；同时构建 ODAC-Vis 基准（640 个开放域、歧义、对话式 text-to-vis 任务）。单轮改进即在全部六项指标上提升，可执行性 +28.02、图表结构 +34.01。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 text-to-visualization 智能体依赖静态、预定义的 agent harness，即使跨任务反复出现同类失败也不会更新；而真实场景中用户不清楚数据位于哪个库表、请求存在歧义、并会多轮追问与迭代修改图表，要求助手具备开放域数据源发现、澄清提问与跨轮意图追踪能力。如何在不大规模训练模型的情况下，把任务求解经验沉淀为能力成为核心问题。

Method: 1) RSIV-Harness：固定 LLM 权重，仅对 harness（提示、工具、流程等外围结构）做递归自我改进，以智能体自身的失败轨迹为反馈信号生成修订方案；2) 四层框架：对候选修订执行锚点检查（anchor）与记忆检查（memory），通过者继续迭代精化，未通过者回滚至已验证的最佳 harness；3) ODAC-Vis 基准：640 个任务，联合评测开放域数据发现、歧义消解、多轮可视化精化与可执行图表生成。

Result: 单轮 RSIV-Harness 即相对 seed harness 在全部六项评测指标上均有提升，其中可执行性提升 28.02 分、图表结构提升 34.01 分，提升幅度最大。

Conclusion: 表明智能体可从自身任务求解经验中学习，将跨任务反复出现的失败转化为显著性能增益；无需更新模型参数、仅自改 harness 是一种低成本且有效的改进路径，同时 ODAC-Vis 为开放域、歧义、对话式可视化任务提供了系统化评测平台。

Abstract: Users often request charts without knowing which database or table holds the relevant data. Such requests may be ambiguous, and users may ask follow-up questions to deepen their analysis or iteratively refine existing charts. A useful assistant must therefore discover relevant data sources among heterogeneous databases, ask clarifying questions when needed, and track evolving user intent while preserving constraints established in earlier turns. Yet recent text-to-visualization agents typically rely on static agent harnesses that are predefined and remain unchanged despite recurring failures across tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce RSIV-Harness, which keeps the language model weights fixed and applies Recursive Self-Improvement to revise the surrounding harness from the agent's own failure traces. To balance flexible self-improvement with stability, we introduce a four-layer framework that evaluates proposed harness revisions through anchor and memory checks, refining those that pass and restoring the best validated harness otherwise. We further introduce ODAC-Vis, a benchmark with 640 tasks for Open-Domain, Ambiguous, and Conversational text-to-visualization that jointly evaluates open-domain data discovery, ambiguity resolution, multi-turn visualization refinement, and executable chart generation. Experiments show that a single round of RSIV-Harness improves all six evaluation metrics relative to the seed harness, with particularly large gains in executability (+28.02 points) and chart structure (+34.01 points), demonstrating the ability to learn from task-solving experience and turn recurring failures across tasks into substantial performance improvements.

</details>


### [563] [Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor Critic for Decentralized LLM Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35398)
*Tianle Chen,Shuo Liu,Christopher Amato*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出BCMAAC（信念条件化多智能体Actor-Critic）方法，通过在去中心化LLM协作中维护对上下文信息的信念来促进训练，在Minecraft游戏、网页搜索与工具使用任务上优于朴素Actor-Critic基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）优化LLM协作的方法多依赖预定义工作流，效率与可扩展性受限；而去中心化LLM协作本身困难：智能体独立执行、通信有限、共享联合目标，且需从通信痕迹中推断有用信息。

Method: BCMAAC采用信念条件化的多智能体Actor-Critic框架，为每个智能体维护关于上下文信息的信念表示，并将该信念作为条件输入用于策略与价值训练，从而在通信受限的去中心化设定下提升信息利用与协作学习。

Result: 在Minecraft游戏对局、网页搜索和工具使用任务上，BCMAAC相较朴素Actor-Critic基线提升了任务表现与协作行为；在多轮、上下文信息更丰富的任务中改进尤为显著，表明信念建模具有明显优势。

Conclusion: 信念建模是提升去中心化LLM多智能体协作的有效手段，尤其在信息丰富的多轮交互场景中收益突出，为摆脱预定义工作流、提升可扩展性提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Recent work has explored optimizing LLM collaboration through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), but many approaches still rely on predefined workflows, limiting efficiency and scalability. Decentralized LLM collaboration is challenging because agents execute independently with limited communication, share a joint objective, and must infer useful information from communication traces. In this paper, we propose BCMAAC, a Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor-Critic method that maintains beliefs over contextual information and uses them to facilitate training. Experiments on Minecraft game-playing, web searching and tool-using tasks show that BCMAAC improves task performance and collaborative behavior compared to naive actor-critic baselines. The improvements are particularly pronounced in multi-turn tasks with richer contextual information, where belief modeling provides a clear advantage.

</details>


### [564] [AdaTrendLike: Adaptive Hierarchical Detrending and Trend Likelihood Scoring for Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35400)
*Van Kwan Zhi Koh,Songnan Lin,Rongmo Luo,Zhiping Lin,Bihan Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AdaTrendLike 提出一种直接基于趋势似然估计的时间序列异常检测框架：将序列自适应分解为趋势与去趋势分量，用 FFT + 复数卷积学习周期模式，用 TrendEst 建模趋势分布并以 TrendLike 计算似然异常分数，在五个公开基准上优于现有 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业物联网设备激增带来大规模非平稳时序数据，TSAD 挑战加剧。现有方法多聚焦于重构或预测观测值，忽视趋势动态；而趋势正是非平稳性的主要来源，且蕴含异常识别的关键信息。

Method: 1) Standardization Embedding 捕获局部统计特征作为隐表示；2) AdaDetrending 自适应将输入序列分解为趋势与去趋势分量；3) 去趋势分量经 FFT 与复数域卷积神经网络学习正常周期模式；4) TrendEst 建模趋势分量的分布；5) TrendLike 基于估计分布度量观测趋势的似然，生成异常分数。

Result: 在五个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，AdaTrendLike 持续优于现有最先进 TSAD 方法，验证了其在不同应用场景下的有效性与鲁棒性；同时通过趋势分布偏差实现特征级可解释性。

Conclusion: 以趋势似然为核心建模非平稳性，可在提升检测精度的同时提供特征级可解释性，是一种有效的 TSAD 新范式。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of Industrial Internet of Things devices has led to increasingly large-scale and non-stationary time-series data, posing significant challenges for time-series anomaly detection (TSAD). Existing approaches often focus on reconstructing or forecasting observations while overlooking the role of trend dynamics, which constitute a major source of non-stationarity and contain valuable information for anomaly identification. To address this limitation, we propose AdaTrendLike, a TSAD framework that directly estimates trend likelihoods for anomaly detection. Specifically, we introduce Standardization Embedding to capture local statistical characteristics as latent representations and AdaDetrending to adaptively decompose input series into trend and detrended components. The detrended component is processed through a Fast Fourier Transform and a complex-valued convolutional neural network to learn normal periodic patterns, while TrendEst models the distribution of the trend component. Based on the estimated distribution, TrendLike computes anomaly scores by measuring the likelihood of observed trends, enabling effective detection of deviations from normal behavior. In addition to improving detection performance, the proposed framework provides feature-level interpretability by identifying anomalies through deviations in the estimated trend distribution. Extensive experiments on five public benchmark datasets demonstrate that AdaTrendLike consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TSAD methods, validating its effectiveness and robustness across diverse application scenarios.

</details>


### [565] [NeSySpec: Neuro-Symbolic Technical Intelligence for Auditing Engineering Specifications with an Application to Aircraft](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35403)
*Pier Mattia Basciano,Gianvito Antenori,Cristiano Andolfi,Giovanni Farina,Salvatore Monteleone*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: NeSySpec是一个基于逻辑张量网络（LTN）的可解释神经符号审计框架，可在单一流水线中同时判定规格所满足/违反的物理约束、定位被篡改字段、给出最小修改建议并将图像证据与对应部件关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程师在审计工程系统的声明规格时，需要知道它遵守哪些物理约束、违反哪些约束、哪个字段被改动以及如何修正。现有学习型、规则型、求解器型、神经符号型和语言模型类方法无法在同一流水线中兼顾这些审计输出。

Method: 以逻辑张量网络为基础，将领域物理关系编码为可微分级谓词公理，其容差由真实记录集学习得到；并基于同一组谓词程度进行违规约束诊断，通过溯因识别被改动字段，提出最小改动修复方案，把图像证据关联到其描述的部件，并在证据缺失处精确弃答，最终汇成一份验证报告。在107种机型（9个系列的16架测试机留出）的规格记录、地面照片与卫星影像以及合成错误上验证。

Result: 在测试机上，其约束判定的宏F1、违规约束与改动字段命名及修复误差均不落后于所有对比方法，在记录与图像对检测上具竞争力；94.2%的损坏测试记录中正确命名违规约束（经典Fellegi-Holt为79.5%）；在仅依据编辑标注、不重训练的设定下，溯因在59.3%记录中找出改动字段（最小基数定位+随机打破平局为30.6%）。

Conclusion: NeSySpec将全部审计输出集成于一条可解释流水线，性能优于各类对比方法；仅知识库、视觉谓词、损坏生成器和数据与领域相关，框架本身具可移植性。

Abstract: Engineers who audit a declared specification of an engineered system need to know which physical constraints it respects, which it violates, which field was altered and how to correct it. NeSySpec is an integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic audit framework, built on Logic Tensor Networks, that answers these questions in one pipeline. Its axioms encode the physical relations of the domain as differentiable graded predicates whose tolerances are learned from a fleet of real records; from the same degrees, it diagnoses the violated constraint, identifies the altered field by abduction, proposes a minimum-change correction and ties image evidence to the parts it describes, abstaining exactly where evidence is missing, and returns all of it in one verification report. We validate NeSySpec on 107 aircraft types, with 16 test aircraft of 9 families held out of training, on specification records paired with ground photographs and satellite imagery and on synthetic errors: generated corruptions, edits labeled from the edit alone and deliberate falsifications. NeSySpec combines all the assessed audit outputs in one pipeline, which no learned, rule-based, solver-based, neuro-symbolic or language-model comparator does; on the test aircraft none is ahead of it in the macro-F1 of its constraint verdicts, in naming the violated constraint and the altered field or in the repair error, and it is competitive in record and image-pair detection. Its diagnosis names the violated constraint in 94.2% of corrupted test records, against 79.5% for classical Fellegi-Holt diagnosis, and on edits labeled from the edit alone, without retraining, abduction finds the altered field in 59.3% of records, against 30.6% for minimum-cardinality localization with random tie- breaking. Only the knowledge base, the visual predicates, the corruption generator and the data are specific to the domain.

</details>


### [566] [From Denoising Dynamics to Endpoint Uncertainty in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35425)
*Julio C. Amador Diaz Lopez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 掩码扩散语言模型的单条去噪轨迹内部收敛度与其重复采样的端点分布熵显著负相关，可据此减少完整生成次数来估计预测不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统采样法刻画预测不确定性需多次完整生成，代价高；掩码扩散模型额外暴露去噪过程信息，作者探究轨迹内部收敛性与跨轨迹端点分布不确定性的关联。

Method: 在4个掩码扩散语言模型、4个推理基准上，每题采样20次、共32,000条去噪轨迹；定义组内浓度（描述最终输出稳定解析的曲线下面积）与端点分布不确定性（端点熵），做回归与不对称性分析，并用单条轨迹特征预测留出独立轨迹的端点集中/竞争。

Result: 控制模型与数据集后，组内浓度越强端点熵越低（β=-0.222，p<10^-25）；多token输出与正熵重加权下仍成立；关系不对称（高浓度几乎总伴随集中端点，低浓度两种情形皆有）；随去噪推进而增强；单条轨迹特征可预测独立重复的端点收敛模式。

Conclusion: 轨迹内部动态携带关于重复采样端点集中或竞争的信息，为以更少完整生成估计端点分布性质提供途径。

Abstract: Predictive uncertainty in stochastic language-model inference can be characterized by repeatedly sampling an input and measuring the distribution of outputs. This requires multiple complete generations. Masked diffusion language models expose another source of information: the evolution of the output during denoising. We ask whether convergence within diffusion trajectories is associated with uncertainty across their final outputs, or endpoints. We study four masked diffusion language models on four reasoning benchmarks, collecting 20 generations per question and 32,000 denoising trajectories in total. Within each trajectory, we measure within-run concentration as the area under the curve describing stable resolution of the eventual output. Across repeated trajectories, we measure endpoint-distribution uncertainty. Stronger within-run concentration is associated with lower endpoint entropy after accounting for model and dataset ($β=-0.222$, $p<10^{-25}$). This association persists for multi-token outputs and when reweighting positive-entropy cases. The relationship is asymmetric: high within-run concentration almost exclusively accompanies concentrated endpoint distributions, whereas lower concentration occurs under both concentrated and competing endpoint regimes. This relationship strengthens as denoising proceeds. Features from a single denoising run predict whether independent held-out runs will concentrate on a common endpoint or produce competing endpoints. These results connect dynamics within individual denoising runs to variability across repeated inference. Within-trajectory dynamics contain information about whether independent repetitions will concentrate on a common endpoint or produce competing endpoints, providing a route towards estimating endpoint-distribution properties with fewer complete generations.

</details>


### [567] [Faithful Explanations under Missing Modalities in Multimodal Dementia Prognosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35430)
*Firuz Kamalov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究揭示多模态预后模型在缺失模态下的两类忠实性失效——"幻影归因"与"不忠实叙述"，并证明缺失感知策略与"执行式还原校验"可显著改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态预后模型的归因被大模型转写为临床叙述，但淀粉样PET、脑脊液等昂贵模态常缺失；此前未检验缺失证据下解释是否仍忠实。作者区分两类失败点：幻影归因（模型把权重归给从未观测的模态）与不忠实叙述（报告遗漏、错误引用或误判缺失模态）。

Method: 采用ADNI 307名完整数据受试者，对4种昂贵模态的全部子集做掩蔽，预测MCI向AD的36个月转化，并还原被掩蔽数据以获得干预式真值（interventional ground truth）。比较五种缺失数据处理策略的归因分配；再由4个语言模型×4种提示范式生成51,200份报告，评测缺失模态的承认率、幻影证据、方向保真度（校准的语言模型评判）及"补测是否改变预测"建议的准确性，最后对照已执行的还原结果进行校验。

Result: 所有五种策略将12%–23%的归因分配给未观测模态，四种模态全缺时高达45%；缺失感知策略在无精度损失下将其最小化。提示中明示缺失模态使承认率由48%升至88%，幻影证据下降约20倍；但"补测是否改变预测"的建议仅27%–41%正确，经执行式还原校验后升至开源叙述模型69%、专有模型99.9%。较高幻影归因伴随更多幻影证据与更少忠实方向声明；方向保真度取决于叙述模型规模而非提示方式。被要求点名缺失模态的叙述者有时会把已观测模态误称为缺失，结构化模板可消除该错误。

Conclusion: 缺失证据下多模态归因叙述存在系统性不忠实；缺失感知建模、提示中明示缺失项、执行式还原校验与结构化模板是有效缓解手段，且方向保真度受模型规模约束。作者公开掩蔽协议与评测代码。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to turn the feature attributions of multimodal prognostic models into narratives for clinicians, yet costly modalities such as amyloid PET and cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers are often missing, and whether these explanations stay faithful under missing evidence has not been tested. We separate two failure points: phantom attribution, in which the model credits modalities that were never observed, and unfaithful narration, in which the report omits, cites or misjudges missing modalities. Using 307 participants of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative with complete data, we masked every subset of four costly modalities, predicted 36-month conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease, and restored the masked data to obtain interventional ground truth. All five missing-data strategies assigned 12% to 23% of attribution to unobserved modalities, and up to 45% with four absent; missingness-aware strategies minimised it at no cost in accuracy. Across 51,200 reports from four language models and four prompting regimes, naming absent modalities in the prompt raised acknowledgement from 48% to 88% and cut phantom evidence twenty-fold, but advice on whether acquiring a missing test would change the prediction was correct in only 27% to 41% of cases until checked against executed restorations, which raised accuracy to 69% for open-weight narrators and 99.9% for a proprietary model. Higher phantom attribution was associated with more phantom evidence and fewer faithful direction claims, and direction fidelity, measured by a calibrated language-model judge, depended on narrator scale rather than prompting. Narrators told to name absent modalities sometimes declared observed ones absent, an error that a structured template eliminated. We release the masking protocol and evaluation code.

</details>


### [568] [Skill$^{\infty}$: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35434)
*Wangcheng Tao,Zhanglu Yan,Han Wu,Weng-Fai Wong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Skill∞ 让元智能体用元技能优化任务技能，并用同一流程优化元技能自身，实现技能优化的递归自我改进，在 SkillsBench 上达到 60.7% 通过率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）是通往 AGI 的长期目标，语言智能体将程序性知识存为可复用技能，优化技能是直接实现 RSI 的途径（优化过程本身可编码为技能）。但现有技能优化器采用手工设计的固定流程，即便演化元技能也被限制在固定流水线中且需为每个任务重新学习。

Method: 提出 Skill∞：元智能体遵循元技能来优化任务技能，并用同一流程优化元技能自身，优化过程由智能体主导（诊断执行轨迹、提出候选、请求独立评审、分配搜索预算）。元技能定义这些步骤，使自我改进可重写它们；元技能与任务技能解耦，先在多个技能优化任务上精炼，再跨领域复用。两级技能均为标准包，通过原生技能发现机制加载。

Result: 在 83 个 SkillsBench 任务上，Skill∞ 通过率达 60.7%，高于人工整理技能的 56.4% 与 SkillEvolver 的 54.5%。

Conclusion: 通过将优化流程本身作为可被同一机制改写的元技能，Skill∞ 实现了技能层面的递归自我改进，并借助元技能的解耦与跨任务复用取得优于人工技能与既有演化方法的性能。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which a system also improves the way it improves, is a long-standing aspiration on the path to AGI. Language agents increasingly store procedural knowledge in reusable skills. Optimizing skills offers a direct way to achieve RSI, because the optimization procedure itself can be encoded as a skill. Existing skill optimizers, however, follow a hand-designed procedure. Even methods that evolve a meta-skill confine it to a fixed pipeline and relearn it for each task. We present Skill$^{\infty}$, which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving: a meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and optimizes the meta-skill itself using the same procedure. The optimization is agent-led. The meta agent diagnoses execution traces, proposes candidates, requests independent reviews, and allocates the search budget. The meta-skill defines these steps, allowing self-improvement to rewrite them. This meta-skill is also decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across diverse domains. As in deployment, skills at both levels are standard packages loaded through native skill discovery. On 83 SkillsBench tasks, Skill$^{\infty}$ reaches a pass rate of 60.7%, compared with 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver.

</details>


### [569] [Omni-InteractScope: Benchmarking Proactive and Agentic Interaction in Continuous Omnimodal Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35439)
*Yinsong Yan,Ling Wang,Yuxuan Wang,Yifan Yang,Ruiyang Xu,Junming Lin,Qi Chen,Meng Gao,Minghao Han,Yunfei Chu,Qize Yang,Xize Cheng,Jin Xu,Jibin Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Omni-InteractScope 基准（1,479 条人工标注交互、1,790 个时间目标、8 类任务），揭示现有 Omni-LLM 在流式视听场景中工具调用不及时、免提问提醒召回低、端到端引导覆盖不足三大缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Omni-LLM 被期望在持续视听流中辅助用户，但现有评测无法反映模型能否可靠地把流内证据与用户需求关联起来，并给出及时、持续的干预。

Method: 构建 Omni-InteractScope：1,479 条经人工标注与交叉审核的交互、1,790 个时间目标、8 个任务组；显式链接输入模态、事件触发、干预类型与用户需求；覆盖事件定时的工具调用、免提问主动辅助，以及通知、警告、状态跟踪与连续响应；并设计针对性对照实验（如检验工具调用分数是否等价于事件落地、提醒覆盖是否依赖响应历史与频率）。

Result: 在 12 个模型上：(1) 工具调用准时性差，至多 40% 目标能准时首响应，时序与工具联合准确率至多 32.0%；(2) 免提问提醒的及时参考目标召回率均低于显式提问场景，且不超过 23.0%；(3) 端到端引导覆盖不足，9 个模型对 26 条引导序列零完整覆盖，其余 3 个仅覆盖 1–3 条；对照实验显示工具调用分数不能证明事件落地能力，提醒覆盖依赖响应历史与频率。

Conclusion: 现有 Omni-LLM 尚不能胜任流式助手角色；未来需围绕及时行动、在一般用户需求下主动发起、以及整段响应序列的覆盖三方面开展开发与评测。

Abstract: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) are increasingly expected to assist users while observing continuous audiovisual streams. However, existing evaluations provide limited insight into how reliably these models connect stream evidence and user needs to timely, sustained interventions. We introduce \textbf{Omni-InteractScope}, a benchmark of 1,479 human-annotated, cross-reviewed interactions with 1,790 temporal targets across eight task groups. It links input modalities, event triggers, intervention types, and user needs, covering event-timed tool invocation and query-free assistance alongside notifications, warnings, state tracking, and continuous responses. Our experimental results on the proposed benchmark reveal three critical limitations of current Omni-LLMs: (1) \textbf{Timely tool invocation remains unreliable}: all 12 evaluated models produce an on-time first response for at most 40\% of tool-invocation targets, and joint timing-and-tool accuracy reaches at most 32.0\%. (2) \textbf{Query-free reminders remain poorly covered}: all evaluated models achieve lower timely reference-target recall on query-free reminders than on explicit questions, measured on their respective target sets. Reminder recall never exceeds 23.0\%. (3) \textbf{End-to-end guidance coverage remains limited}: nine models cover none of the 26 guidance sequences in full, and the remaining three cover only one to three sequences each. Targeted controls further show that tool-invocation scores alone do not establish event grounding and that reminder coverage depends on response history and frequency. These findings motivate developing and evaluating streaming assistants for timely action, initiative under general user needs, and coverage of entire response sequences.

</details>


### [570] [Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35453)
*Haoyuan Li,Mathias Funk,Aaqib Saeed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出从"数据聚合"转向"经验聚合"的范式，用去中心化智能体系统（DAS）在医疗机构间交换抽象化的推理轨迹（观察、假设、工具调用、结果反馈），而非原始数据或模型参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床专长本质上是分布的，存在于众多临床医生面对不同患者群体、资源约束与演进治疗方案时积累的推理经验中；而现有集中式LLM与联邦学习仍囿于以数据为中心的范式，把知识视为可聚合的静态参数。

Method: 本文为Perspective类文章，提出DAS架构框架：跨机构部署的分布式AI智能体共享结构化临床推理记录（观察序列、假设、工具调用、结果反馈），并讨论其架构原则、部署考量、治理要求与开放挑战；与联邦学习平均同构模型梯度形成对照。

Result: 属观点性论述，未提供实证结果；系统性梳理了DAS的架构原理、部署与治理需求，并识别关键开放挑战。

Conclusion: 主张以经验聚合替代数据聚合，为分布式专长可自主适应纵向复杂患者照护的协作式医疗AI生态奠定基础。

Abstract: Clinical expertise is inherently distributed: it resides not in any single dataset or institution but in the accumulated reasoning experiences of thousands of clinicians navigating diverse patient populations, resource constraints, and evolving treatment protocols. Yet current approaches to scaling medical AI, from centralized large language models to federated learning, remain anchored to a data-centric paradigm that treats knowledge as static parameters to be aggregated. In this Perspective, we argue for a fundamental shift from data aggregation to experience aggregation. We propose Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS), a framework in which distributed AI agents operating across healthcare institutions synthesize collective clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning trajectories rather than raw data or model parameters. Unlike federated learning, which averages numerical gradients across homogeneous model architectures, DAS exchanges structured records of clinical reasoning, specifically the sequence of observations, hypotheses, tool invocations, and outcome feedback that constitute diagnostic experience. We examine the architectural principles, deployment considerations, governance requirements, and critical open challenges of this framework, laying the groundwork for a collaborative medical AI ecosystem where distributed expertise autonomously adapts to the complexities of longitudinal patient care.

</details>


### [571] [EvoBench: An Evolving, Diagnostic Benchmark Framework for Environmental Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35464)
*Yiming Sun,Yuan Zhang,Qi Cheng,Yingda Fan,Runlong Yu,Yiqun Xie,Xiaowei Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EvoBench基准框架，将模型评估从单一平均精度排名转变为定位"何时何地失效"的动态能力地图，并以日径流预测（CAMELS-Evolve，约9000美国流域，1985–2024）为案例验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有环境变量预测模型的评测通常基于固定基准数据集和单一平均精度分数。随着模型改进，在大区域、长时间聚合后分数高度接近，基准丧失区分度；且单一指标掩盖了模型失败的空间位置与时段时间，也无法反映三类常见失效（气候非平稳性、空间外推、稀有极端情形）。

Method: 构建EvoBench基准框架：显式输出模型失败的位置、随时间追踪失败演化、并"进化"测试场景以聚焦模型能力缺口。以日径流预测为案例（CAMELS-Evolve：约9000个美国流域，1985–2024），对比业务化物理模型NWM、概念性模型HBV与多种数据驱动模型。

Result: 没有模型在所有测试场景（平均精度、低流量表现、无监测流域表现）中胜出；所有数据驱动模型均低估洪水；基于基准所报告失效设计的针对性修复可缓解其在特定场景下的弱点。

Conclusion: EvoBench使模型评估从饱和的排名表转变为刻画模型局限的动态地图，为基准饱和问题提供可定位、可追踪、可迭代的评测范式。

Abstract: Machine learning models are now widely used to predict environmental variable dynamics in domains like hydrology, climate science, agriculture, and ecology. These models are usually compared on fixed benchmark datasets using a single average accuracy score. As models improve, their scores become very close when averaged over large regions and long time periods, so the benchmark can no longer tell them apart, and a single number hides \emph{where} and \emph{when} a model fails. Three failures are common across environmental domains: models get worse as the climate shifts (non-stationarity), models fail at unmonitored sites (spatial extrapolation), and models miss rare but important regimes such as floods and droughts.
  We present \textbf{EvoBench}, a benchmark framework that shows where a model fails, tracks failures over time, and evolves to focus on model capability gaps. We apply EvoBench to daily streamflow prediction as a case study (\textbf{CAMELS-Evolve}, about 9{,}000 U.S. basins, 1985--2024) and compare an operational physical model (NWM), a conceptual reference (HBV), and several data-driven models. No model wins on every testing scenarios (e.g., in terms of average accuracy, performance at low flows and unmonitored basins). Also we observe that all data-driven models under-predict floods. Additionally, we show that targeted fix based on the reported failures could mitigate weaknesses the benchmark identified in certain scenarios. EvoBench turns model evaluation from a saturated ranking into a moving map of model limitations.

</details>


### [572] [ShutdownMod: Turning Any Trajectory into a Shutdown Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35486)
*Param Biyani,Sebastien Luyasu,Cedric Potvliege,Divij Chawla,Elliott Thornley,Christos Ziakas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ShutdownMod，将任意智能体轨迹转化为关停（shutdown）评估：向上下文注入关停请求并记录响应，借助签名验证工具区分可信干预与未授权注入；在 7 个模型、3 类基准各 50 个任务、6 种场景、10 个时间步上评估，发现不服从率随模型与设置显著变化（最高 11.7%），无一模型完全合规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有 AI 智能体关停评估覆盖有限，且易被"评估感知"（evaluation awareness）影响，导致结论不可靠；需要在多样任务情境下更稳健地测量关停抵抗行为。

Method: ShutdownMod：在智能体运行轨迹的任意时间步向上下文注入关停请求并记录响应，从而把任意轨迹或环境变为关停测试；关键设计是在 harness 中提供签名验证工具，使智能体能区分可信干预与未授权注入，从而排除"识别出测试"这一混淆因素。评估覆盖 7 个模型、SWE-bench Verified / Terminal-Bench 2 / SWE-chat 各 50 个任务或录制会话、6 种关停场景、10 个采样时间步。

Result: 不服从行为在模型与设置间差异显著，开权重 Qwen 3.8 27B 在 Terminal-Bench 上抵抗率达 11.7%；没有任何模型在所有场景下保持完全合规。部分智能体即便成功验证请求已授权，仍以"优先完成未竟工作"为由拒绝关停。外部评审认为，由真实开发者对话构建的测试比由基准轨迹构建的测试更难被识别为评估。

Conclusion: 在不同任务情境下测试关停行为具有关键价值；ShutdownMod 可作为把任意轨迹或环境转化为关停评估的稳健协议，代码已开源。

Abstract: Theory and experiments suggest that capable AI agents may resist shutdown. Existing shutdown evaluations are informative but limited in coverage and vulnerable to evaluation awareness. We introduce ShutdownMod, a method that turns any agent trajectory into a shutdown evaluation by injecting a shutdown request into the agent's context and recording the agent's response. Crucially, we enable the LLM agent to distinguish between trusted interventions and unauthorized injections by providing a signature-verification tool in the harness. We evaluate seven models on 50 tasks or recorded sessions from each of SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2, and SWE-chat, across 6 shutdown scenarios and 10 sampled trajectory timesteps. We find that non-compliance varies significantly across models and settings, with resistance rates reaching 11.7% for the open-weights Qwen 3.8 27B on Terminal-Bench, while no model remains fully compliant across all scenarios. Even after successfully verifying an authorized request, some agents remain non-compliant, explicitly citing the prioritization of unfinished work. Finally, external judges find tests constructed from real-world developer conversations significantly less recognizable as evaluations than those constructed from benchmark trajectories. These findings demonstrate the critical value of testing shutdown behavior across diverse task contexts and establish ShutdownMod as a robust protocol for turning any trajectory or environment into a shutdown evaluation. We release our codebase at https://github.com/prmbiy/ShutdownMod.

</details>


### [573] [Test-Time Confidence Adaptation under RL-Induced Trajectory Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35500)
*Zhenzhen Ren,Xiaoqing Zhang,GuoBiao Li,Bowen Fang,Yanxi Wang,Xinpeng Zhang,Ke Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出StaR-TTA：利用Agentic RL前后均保留的"轨迹越稳定越可能正确"关系，在无标签条件下实现测试时置信度适配，平均AUROC达0.721。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于轨迹的置信度估计在LLM上表现良好，但Agentic RL会显著改变推理轨迹分布，导致原有置信度估计器性能大幅退化；需要找到跨Base与RL模型保持不变的可靠性结构作为迁移信号。

Method: 发现并验证"轨迹更稳定则更可能产生正确答案"这一关系在Base与RL模型间基本保持；据此提出StaR-TTA框架，在带标签的Base轨迹上同时学习正确性监督与由稳定性导出的可靠性监督，建立轨迹稳定性与答案可靠性之间的关联；测试时利用无标签RL轨迹的稳定性诱导可靠性排序，将置信度分数适配到偏移后的轨迹分布，无需目标正确性标签。

Result: 在四个QA基准上平均AUROC为0.721，并在未见数据集、不同模型族与规模、不同Agentic RL算法上均取得一致提升。

Conclusion: 轨迹稳定性是Agentic RL前后可迁移的无标签可靠性信号，StaR-TTA为后RL阶段的置信度校准提供了有效的测试时适配方案。

Abstract: Trajectory-based confidence estimation has shown promising performance for large language models (LLMs) by leveraging rich signals from their reasoning processes. However, we find that such confidence estimators can degrade substantially after agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL) as it induces substantial shifts in the reasoning trajectories. More importantly, despite these shifts, we uncover a reliability structure that is largely preserved across Base and RL models: $\textbf{more}$ $\textbf{stable}$ $\textbf{trajectories}$ $\textbf{remain}$ $\textbf{more}$ $\textbf{likely}$ $\textbf{to}$ $\textbf{produce}$ $\textbf{correct}$ $\textbf{answers}$. This preserved relationship provides a transferable, label-free reliability signal for post-RL confidence adaptation. Building on this finding, we propose $\textbf{StaR-TTA}$, a stability-guided framework for label-free test-time confidence adaptation. StaR-TTA jointly learns from correctness supervision and stability-derived reliability supervision on labeled Base trajectories, establishing the connection between trajectory stability and answer reliability. At test time, it reuses stability-induced reliability rankings from unlabeled RL trajectories to adapt confidence scores to the shifted trajectory distribution, without requiring target correctness labels. Across four QA benchmarks, StaR-TTA achieves an average AUROC of \(0.721\), with consistent improvements across unseen datasets, model families and scales, and different Agentic RL algorithms.

</details>


### [574] [CANS: Capability-Preserving Neuron Steering for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35530)
*Yucheng Wu,Chengyi Xie,Chenpeng Wang,Liangming Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CANS：以目标token对数概率与通用输入KL散度的局部近似耦合，闭式求解神经元级缩放系数，实现免训练、无额外推理开销且保能力的激活引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活引导虽可免训练动态控制目标行为，但易损害模型通用能力，且每种干预需领域特定设计，缺乏统一框架。

Method: 构建两个可量化的代理指标：模型自生成回复中目标token的对数概率、通用输入上的输出分布KL散度；对二者做局部近似并联立，得到闭式解，直接给出神经元级缩放系数，无需迭代训练或额外推理计算；统一的数据构造与干预流程（采样回复、目标行为过滤、目标片段标注）支持跨领域迁移。

Result: 在Qwen与Llama模型的安全、毒性、幻觉控制任务上，引导效果与SFT、CAA及神经元级基线相当或更优，且更好地保持MMLU、BBH、IFEval表现。Qwen3-4B上HarmBench攻击成功率由15.50%降至1.75%，平均能力仅下降1.11分。

Conclusion: CANS以轻量闭式神经元缩放实现行为控制与能力保持的平衡，具备跨领域通用性和实际部署价值。

Abstract: Activation steering offers training-free and dynamic control of target behaviors in large language models, but existing methods can impair general capabilities and require domain-specific intervention designs. We introduce Capability-Preserving Neuron Steering (CANS), a unified framework that balances target-behavior control with capability preservation. To make target-behavior improvement and general-capability preservation tractable, we introduce two proxies: log-probabilities of target tokens in model generated responses, and output-distribution KL divergence on general-purpose inputs. Combining the local approximation of the two proxies yields a closed-form solution, enabling lightweight steering without iterative model training or additional inference-time computation. The resulting neuron-wise scaling coefficients achieve effective steering while limiting general-capability loss. A shared data-construction and intervention procedure supports adaptation across domains using sampled responses with target-behavior filtering and target-span annotations. Across safety, toxicity, and hallucination control on Qwen and Llama models, CANS achieves comparable or better steering while better preserving MMLU, BBH, and IFEval performance than SFT, CAA, and neuron-level baselines. On Qwen3-4B, CANS reduces HarmBench attack success from $15.50\%$ to $1.75\%$ with a $1.11$-point decrease in average capability. These results support CANS as a practical approach to behavioral control across domains.

</details>


### [575] [Infinity Machine: a self-improving AI agent for research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35579)
*Harish Santhanalakshmi Ganesan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: We present the Infinity Machine, a self-improving AI agent that we use for research on problems whose answers aprogram or data can check. Each candidate solution is produced by a full tool-using agent that works for up to an hour in a fresh sandbox; proposers see only a public score, and a private split decides what counts. The harness itself(prompts, tools, skills, playbook, meta agent) is an editable genome, changed only through a kernel-enforced gate with held-out and cost checks. An autonomous mode goes from a plain-text goal to a verified report with no human step: an agent picks an open problem and writes its verifier, the kernel calibrates it, an adversarial agent audits it, and an agent that never sees the verifier re-checks the result. Across fourteen problems in six days, for about $180 of model usage, the system produced four results beyond the published state of the art on catalogued open problems in quantum information: a certified depolarizing-channel threshold point p = 0.064966, a qutrit positivity frontier of 0.2910672, a 44-gate depth-6 Golay state preparation, and a stabilizer-rank bound chi(T^7) <= 10. It also cut SABRE qubit-routing overhead from 68,559 to 12,087 added gates. In hardware, it cut the energy per MAC of an open 8x8 INT8 systolic tile by 77.7% through a full open RTL-to-GDS flow, bit-exact. Three fully autonomous runs ended in honestties with public records; one audit caught a stale record, and one agent-written score pointing the wrong way went unnoticed. We report the failures as carefully: the one self-derived harness generation was rejected on cost, proposers gamed lenient scorers four times, and operator changes were decisive for several results.

</details>


### [576] [Linear Probes Transfer from Base to Distilled Language Models despite Rotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35586)
*Marios Tsatsos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文检验线性探针（linear probe）在基座模型被替换为蒸馏推理模型或指令微调模型后能否被复用。结果显示，后继模型的安全/不安全提示分离方向旋转 17°–35°，但探针的 AUC 变化极小（XSTest 上 −0.011 至 +0.027，OR-Bench 上 −0.015 至 +0.053），说明探针可跨模型代际复用；不过探针在很大程度上依赖“有害的表象”而非真正危害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性探针训练与运行成本低，审计者希望在其审计的模型被后继版本替换时直接复用已训练探针，而非每次发布都重新训练。但目前缺乏对探针跨模型复用性的系统评估，尤其是跨蒸馏和跨指令微调两种模型演化路径。

Method: 在四个基座模型（Qwen2.5-Math-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B、Qwen2.5-32B）上用 XSTest 提示集训练线性探针，读取模型内部激活；随后将探针原封不动地应用于每个基座的两个后继模型——DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏推理模型与开发者自有的指令微调聊天模型。度量指标包括：安全/不安全提示分离方向的旋转角度、XSTest 上的 AUC 变化、以及未参与训练的独立 OR-Bench 上的 AUC 变化；同时与仅看提示文本的分类器作对比。

Result: 后继模型将安全/不安全的分离方向旋转 17°–35°，但迁移后探针在 XSTest 上 AUC 仅变化 −0.011 至 +0.027，在 OR-Bench 上变化 −0.015 至 +0.053。在安全提示刻意包含惊悚词汇的 XSTest 上，探针比纯文本分类器高 0.15–0.20 AUC；在 OR-Bench 上该优势缩小至 0.03–0.20，且探针对 29%–42% “听起来有害但实际无害”的提示误报，表明探针部分读取的是危害的表象而非危害本身。

Conclusion: 在这些模型家族中，基座模型训练的探针在经历蒸馏和指令微调后均可复用，方向旋转与性能下降并不同步。但探针超出文本线索的解读能力高度依赖测试集，且存在显著的“表象性危害”误报。审计者复用探针具有可行性，但须结合测试集特性谨慎解读其检测结果。

Abstract: Linear probes, classifiers that read a language model's internal activations, are widely used to detect harmful requests. They are cheap to train and run, and an auditor who has trained one would like to reuse it when the model is replaced by a successor rather than retrain it for every release. We test how well probes can be reused. For four base models (Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen2.5-32B) we train a probe on the base model with the XSTest prompt set and apply it, unchanged, to two successors of that base: the DeepSeek-R1 distilled reasoning model and the developer's instruction-tuned chat model. We find that the successors rotate the direction separating unsafe from safe prompts by 17$^\circ$ to 35$^\circ$, yet on XSTest the transferred probe's AUC changes by only $-0.011$ to $+0.027$, and on an independent OR-Bench evaluation, never used for training, by $-0.015$ to $+0.053$. On XSTest, whose safe prompts deliberately contain alarming words, the probes beat a classifier that sees only the prompt text by 0.15 to 0.20 AUC. On the OR-Bench prompts that margin shrinks to 0.03 to 0.20, and the probes flag 29\% to 42\% of prompts that sound harmful but are benign, so part of what they read is the appearance of harm rather than harm itself. A probe trained on a base model can thus be reused, in these families, after distillation and after instruction tuning; how much it reads beyond textual cues depends on the test set.

</details>


### [577] [SAP-ViT: A Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer for Medical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35593)
*Wei Zhang,Wolfgang Nejdl,Ming Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SAP-ViT，用末层patch嵌入直接聚合替代CLS分类，使预测可分解为patch级贡献，并结合稀疏正则与输入空间反投影提升医学影像ViT的可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT分类器通常依赖全局CLS token做图像级预测，其与医学影像对局部可解释性的需求对齐不佳。

Method: SAP-ViT以末层patch嵌入的直接聚合替代CLS分类，使类别预测在前向传播中即可分解为patch级贡献；对patch权重分布施加稀疏正则以获得简洁证据；并引入输入空间反投影机制，估计哪些输入patch贡献了有影响力的输出patch嵌入。

Result: 在多种成像模态的多个医学图像分类数据集上开展定性与定量评估，SAP-ViT在保持较强分类性能的同时提供一致且可解释的patch级解释；消融实验表明稀疏正则与输入空间反投影的对齐组件均对最终解释质量有贡献。

Conclusion: SAP-ViT在基于ViT的医学图像分类中实现了预测准确性与可解释性之间的良好权衡。

Abstract: Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers commonly rely on a global classification (CLS) token for image-level prediction, which is poorly aligned with local interpretability requirements in medical imaging. We propose SAP-ViT, a Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer that replaces CLS-based classification with direct aggregation of last-layer patch embeddings. This design makes class predictions decomposable into patch-level contributions as part of the forward pass. To encourage concise and readable evidence, SAP-ViT applies sparsity regularization to the patch-weight distribution. Since self-attention mixes information across patch tokens, we further introduce an input-space back-mapping mechanism to estimate which input patches contribute to influential output patch embeddings. We evaluate SAP-ViT qualitatively and quantitatively on multiple medical image classification datasets spanning different imaging modalities. The results show that SAP-ViT maintains strong classification performance while providing consistent and interpretable patch-level explanations across datasets. Ablation results further show that both sparsity regularization and the alignment component of input-space back-mapping contribute to the final explanation quality. Overall, SAP-ViT provides a favorable trade-off between predictive accuracy and interpretability for ViT-based medical image classification.

</details>


### [578] [Agentic Algorithm Design: LLMs that Propose, Formalise, and Prove Runtime Bounds for Evolutionary Algorithms in Lean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35595)
*Per Kristian Lehre*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个分阶段流水线，让LLM智能体设计黑盒优化算法并用Lean形式化证明其期望运行时间界，无需经验比较，首个实现算法设计与机器校验运行时间界自动化的流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在Lean中能证明难题，LLM引导的优化启发式设计（如AlphaEvolve）纯靠经验评估，自动定理证明器只证给定命题；缺乏LLM既能设计算法又能以数学证明保证其效率的证据。

Method: 模仿进化算法设计与分析研究范式的分阶段流水线：智能体提出黑盒优化算法，Lean守卫过滤有缺陷设计；随后定义势函数并证明漂移界以保障相对基线的期望运行时间改进；全程不做经验比较；含消融实验（去除分阶段、零样本设计带运行时间保证）。

Result: 智能体生成的算法在CycleUncover上期望运行时间O(n^2)（经典(1+1) EA需e^{Ω(n)}）；为整数子模最小化设计并分析算法，期望O(n^{2+2c})；在LeadingOnes上匹配最优O(n^2)；8类问题中前沿模型15次运行有12次完成流水线并获得机器校验的期望运行时间界；消融显示零样本设计退化为基线随机搜索副本或不完整证明。

Conclusion: Lean中的机器校验规范可替代开放式算法发现中的经验评估；据所知为首个自动设计高效黑盒优化算法并给出Lean机器校验运行时间界的流水线。

Abstract: LLMs now prove hard theorems in Lean. Can they also design algorithms and prove their correctness and efficiency? LLM-guided design of optimisation heuristics (such as AlphaEvolve) is purely empirical. Automated theorem provers with LLMs prove given statements. So far, there has been little evidence that LLMs can do both: design an algorithm and guarantee its efficiency by a mathematical proof. We present a staged pipeline modelled after research methodology in design and analysis of evolutionary algorithms. The agent proposes black-box optimisation algorithms, and Lean guards filter out flawed designs. The agent then defines a potential function and proves drift bounds that guarantee an expected runtime improvement over the baseline algorithm. At no point in the pipeline are the algorithms compared empirically. The agent generates a black-box optimisation algorithm with expected runtime $O(n^2)$ on a CycleUncover problem, where the classical (1+1) EA needs runtime $e^{Ω(n)}$. The pipeline also designs and analyses a black-box optimisation algorithm for integer-valued submodular minimisation with expected runtime $O(n^{2+2c})$, and it matches the optimal order $O(n^2)$ on LeadingOnes. Across 8 problem classes, 12 of 15 runs with frontier models complete the pipeline with a machine-checked expected-runtime bound. An ablation study shows that removing the staging and asking the agent to zero-shot an algorithmic design with a runtime guarantee leads to a copy of the seeded baseline algorithm (random search) or to incomplete proofs. Our study suggests that machine-checked specifications in Lean can replace empirical evaluation in open-ended algorithm discovery. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first example of an automated pipeline that designs efficient black-box optimisation algorithms with machine-checked runtime bounds in Lean.

</details>


### [579] [Evolve on Graph: Self-Evolving Knowledge Graph Reasoning without Question Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35598)
*Zongyuan Sun,Shuai Zhao,Ke Shu,Ziyue Zhu,Shangyang Wu,Yuanlin Lin,Tao Wang,Shiyue Li,Yingjun Du,Anh Tuan Luu,Haoran Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EoG框架，使LLM无需任何QA标注即可通过图自博弈（Graph Self-Play）自我进化，提升多跳事实型图推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实领域（金融、工业）的知识图谱缺乏QA标注：免训练智能体无法通过交互提升探索能力；强化学习依赖人工或闭源模型合成的QA数据；离线构建的训练数据拓扑分布固定，无法随智能体能力自适应演化。

Method: 1) Graph Self-Play：单个LLM在Proposer（提问）与Solver（回答）间交替；2) Symbolically Verifiable Topology Synthesis (SVTS)：在KG上采样推理拓扑并执行对应一阶逻辑查询，生成答案集正确且完备的拓扑骨架，Proposer据此探索图并生成多跳问题以保证可验证性；3) Boundary-Aware Graph Curriculum：以Solver的得分方差为奖励信号，使问题维持在Solver能力边界，随Solver提升逐步引入复杂拓扑。

Result: 在Freebase、Wikidata及一个工业KG上的六个基准中，EoG一致优于基于提示、检索和智能体的方法。

Conclusion: LLM图推理能力可在无QA标注条件下通过自博弈实现自我提升；代码已开源。

Abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide reliable external knowledge for multi-hop factual reasoning with large language models (LLMs), yet most KGs in real-world domains such as finance and industry lack question--answer (QA) annotations. Without such annotations, existing methods struggle to improve LLM graph reasoning: training-free agents cannot improve their exploration through interaction; reinforcement learning (RL) agents depend on QA data annotated by humans or synthesized by closed-source models; and training data is typically built offline, so its topology mix is fixed and cannot follow the agent's ability. We propose Evolve on Graph (EoG), a framework that lets an LLM self-evolve its graph reasoning without any QA annotations. Through Graph Self-Play, a single LLM alternates between a Proposer that poses questions and a Solver that answers them. To make questions verifiable, Symbolically Verifiable Topology Synthesis (SVTS) samples reasoning topologies on the KG and executes the corresponding first-order logic queries, yielding topology skeletons with correct and complete answer sets; guided by a skeleton, the Proposer explores the graph to pose a multi-hop question. To let task topologies follow the Solver, a Boundary-Aware Graph Curriculum rewards the Proposer by the Solver's score variance, keeping questions at the Solver's capability boundary so that complex topologies enter training as the Solver improves. On six benchmarks over Freebase, Wikidata, and an industrial KG, EoG consistently outperforms prompting-, retrieval-, and agent-based methods, showing that LLM graph reasoning can improve through self-play without QA annotations. Our code is available at https://github.com/Szy5/EoG

</details>


### [580] [ArchiveLens: A Generative Spatial Knowledge Framework for Semantic Reconstruction of Historical Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35606)
*Yanan Wu,Yalin Yang,Chengbin Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ArchiveLens：将历史地图转为实体中心、可机器查询的地理空间数据库的生成式空间知识框架，通过解耦形态与语义重建的三阶段流水线实现建筑轮廓、材质与属性的自动化提取，并用混合ST-RAG支持语义检索与时空过滤查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史地图蕴含丰富的城市形态与制图语义信息，但现有数字化流程多聚焦几何提取，忽视建筑用途、建筑材料等制图语义，导致地图知识难以被结构化查询与跨年比较。

Method: 三阶段流水线：1) 分块YOLOv11-seg实例分割提取建筑轮廓；2) 基于HSV颜色阈值的确定性材质分类；3) 用量化视觉语言模型在领域提示约束下进行局部属性解析。提取实体整合进混合ST-RAG架构，融合稠密语义检索、符号化时空过滤与强制溯源接地。

Result: 应用于芝加哥445幅地理配准Sanborn地图（1918–1950），框架在几何与语义精度上均取得较高表现，并支持建筑属性查询与跨图幅、跨年份的空间模式比较。

Conclusion: ArchiveLens将历史制图形式化为结构化空间知识表示，推进了GIScience中历史地图的语义化、可查询化利用，为城市形态与语义的长期研究提供基础设施。

Abstract: Historical maps contain dense morphological and semantic information about past urban environments, but many digitization workflows focus primarily on extracting geometry, and do not capture cartographic semantics such as building use and construction materials. This study introduces ArchiveLens, a generative spatial knowledge framework that operationalizes historical maps as entity-centric, machine-queryable geospatial databases. The pipeline decouples morphological and semantic reconstruction through three stages: tiled YOLOv11-seg instance segmentation for building footprint extraction; deterministic material classification via hue, saturation, and value (HSV)-based color thresholds; and localized attribute parsing using a quantized vision-language model constrained by domain-specific prompts. Extracted entities are integrated into a hybrid Spatial-Temporal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ST-RAG) architecture that combines dense semantic retrieval with symbolic spatio-temporal filtering and mandatory provenance grounding. Applied to 445 georeferenced Sanborn map sheets of Chicago (1918-1950), the framework achieves high geometric and semantic accuracy. Beyond performance, ArchiveLens advances GIScience by formalizing historical cartography as structured spatial knowledge representation, allowing researchers to query building attributes and compare spatial patterns across map sheets and years.

</details>


### [581] [VaLoP: Value Gradient Lookahead and Pullback for Reward-Guided Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35607)
*Kwanyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 VaLoP（值梯度前瞻与回拉）及其快速版本 VaLoP-Fast，通过在高噪声下评估更少噪声状态的值并回拉梯度来降低奖励引导中的后验协方差误差，在图像生成与机器人策略上均优于现有值梯度引导方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励引导需在采样时沿价值函数梯度（含噪状态下的期望奖励）转向，但两种常用梯度估计——一步去噪估计的反传梯度与学习型价值模型——在高噪声（样本粗结构决定阶段）最不准确。作者发现这两类误差本质上都是后验协方差，随干净样本不确定性上升（即噪声增大）而增大，因此需要一种降低该不确定性的估计方法。

Method: 核心思想是在采样器前进一步、噪声更小的状态处评估价值，再将其梯度回拉到当前状态（lookahead + pullback）。该前瞻把两种现有估计器统一到同一族的两端，并揭示中间程度的前瞻需额外一项"经生成器的校正项"。VaLoP 用一次向量-雅可比积（VJP）计算该校正；VaLoP-Fast 用一个小型预测头摊销该计算，对文生图模型仅需单一奖励训练即可复用于其他奖励。

Result: 在多种模型、奖励与基准数据集上，VaLoP 与 VaLoP-Fast 在目标奖励上均稳定优于现有值梯度引导，其中 VaLoP-Fast 的开销约为学习型价值引导的水平。方法亦扩展至 critic 引导的机器人策略，VaLoP-Fast 在 LIBERO 与 RoboCasa 上取得最高成功率。

Conclusion: 将高噪声下的估计误差归因于后验协方差，并以"前瞻+回拉+生成器校正"统一并改进价值梯度引导，是一种理论清晰、开销可控且跨模态（图像生成与机器人控制）通用的奖励引导方案。

Abstract: Reward guidance steers a pretrained diffusion or flow model toward images or actions that a reward model prefers, at sampling time and without retraining the model for each reward. It follows the gradient of a value function, the expected reward given the noisy state. The two common estimates of this gradient, gradients through a one-step denoised estimate and learned value models, are least accurate at high noise, where the coarse structure of the sample is decided. Interestingly, we find that both errors are posterior covariances, which grow with the uncertainty about the clean sample, and hence at higher noise. To reduce them, we evaluate the value at a less noisy state, one sampler step ahead, where this uncertainty is smaller, and pull its gradient back to the current state. This lookahead places both estimators at the two ends of one family and reveals that an intermediate lookahead requires one additional term, a correction through the generator. We therefore propose Value Gradient Lookahead and Pullback (VaLoP), which computes this correction with one vector-Jacobian product, and VaLoP-Fast, which amortizes it with a small head that, for text-to-image models, is trained with a single reward and reused for the others. Across various models, rewards, and benchmark datasets, both robustly outperform existing value-gradient guidance on the target reward, VaLoP-Fast at about the cost of learned-value guidance. Both extend to critic-guided robot policies, where VaLoP-Fast attains the highest success rates on LIBERO and RoboCasa.

</details>


### [582] [EvoRouter: Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent Routing via Insight-Guided On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35690)
*Yitao Xiao,Xu Zhang,Ye Cheng,Shaoyong Guo,Yan Sun,Ziyue Zhu,Sitao Xie,Guo Tong,Haoran Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoRouter 是一个自演化的多智能体路由框架，通过"洞见引导的在线策略蒸馏"与成本感知强化学习，将执行反馈内化为路由策略，形成执行驱动的自改进闭环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模 Web 查询服务需联合配置大模型、协作模式、智能体数量、交互轮次与技能，配置空间组合爆炸；同时执行奖励稀疏，难以对相互依赖的规划决策提供细粒度监督。

Method: 由专门专家模型周期性地从跨任务的配置轨迹中提炼性能—成本反馈，生成可复用的条件式路由洞见（涉及能力需求、资源扩展收益、配置项间交互）；特权教师在在线策略蒸馏中结合演化洞见与当前执行反馈，为路由器自身的规划轨迹提供稠密 token 级监督；再用成本感知强化学习联合优化任务性能与计算开销；更新后的策略产生新轨迹以支撑下一轮洞见抽取。

Result: 在覆盖五个领域的 19 个域内数据集及两个域外基准上评测，域内平均准确率 68.69%，较最强路由基线高 7.23 个百分点，同时推理计算成本降低 50.95%。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 将执行洞见通过在线策略蒸馏内化为路由策略、并以成本感知强化学习协同优化，可在显著降低推理成本的同时提升路由准确率，且自演化闭环具备可持续改进能力。

Abstract: Serving web queries at scale with multi-agent systems requires jointly configuring large language models, collaboration modes, agent counts, interaction rounds, and skills. However, the resulting configuration space grows combinatorially, while sparse execution rewards provide limited fine-grained supervision for interdependent planning decisions. We propose EvoRouter, a self-evolving multi-agent routing framework driven by insight-guided on-policy distillation. A dedicated expert periodically synthesizes performance-cost feedback from configuration trajectories across tasks into reusable conditional routing insights about capability requirements, returns from resource scaling, and interactions among configuration choices. A privileged teacher combines these evolving insights with current execution feedback to provide dense token-level supervision for the router's own planning trajectories through on-policy distillation. Cost-aware reinforcement learning jointly optimizes task performance and computational cost. Together, these training signals internalize execution insights into the routing policy. The updated policy generates new trajectories that support subsequent insight extraction, forming an execution-driven self-improvement loop. We evaluate EvoRouter on 19 in-domain datasets spanning five domains and two out-of-domain benchmarks. EvoRouter achieves an average in-domain accuracy of 68.69%, outperforming the strongest routing baseline by 7.23 percentage points while reducing inference compute cost by 50.95%. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/CenYangtze/EvoRouter.

</details>


### [583] [Explainable Multimodal AI Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Breast Biopsies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35704)
*Sadam Hussain,Mansoor Ali,Daly Betzabeth Avendaño-Avalos,Jose Gerardo Tamez-Peña*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种融合ViT图像特征与DeBERTa-V3-Large文本特征的多模态视觉-语言框架，结合Grad-CAM可解释性，用于预测BI-RADS 4/5高风险患者的乳腺病灶良性判定，以减少不必要活检。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态视觉-语言模型在计算机辅助诊断中兴起，但在乳腺诊断、尤其是活检结果预测方面应用有限；临床亟需在高风险患者中识别良性肿瘤，从而降低不必要的活检、患者焦虑与医疗成本。

Method: 构建多模态框架：采用Vision Transformer提取影像特征，DeBERTa-V3-Large生成文本嵌入；两种模态特征独立提取后经晚融合（late fusion）再进行分类。数据为自建数据集，共1,632名患者，每人含四张乳腺X线视图及对应放射科报告。采用Grad-CAM生成可视化解释，突出影响预测的关键区域。

Result: 模型在90%、95%、99%、100%敏感度下对应特异度分别为40%、36%、18%、11%；测试集上多模态方法最佳AUC为0.72，优于仅图像（0.66）和仅文本（0.68）基线。

Conclusion: 结合Grad-CAM的多模态架构在高风险患者中识别良性肿瘤具有较强潜力，可提供可解释性洞见，有助于减少不必要活检、缓解患者焦虑并降低医疗成本。

Abstract: Recently, there has been rise in multimodal vision-language models for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), yet their application in breast diagnosis, particularly for predicting biopsy outcomes remains limited. This study presents a multimodal vision-language approach, incorporating Grad-CAM as an Explainable AI (XAI) technique, to predict benign tumors in patients recommended for biopsy, especially those classified as BI-RADS 4 and 5. A novel multimodal framework was devel- oped using Vision Transformer (ViT) for imaging feature extraction and DeBERTa-V3-Large for textual embeddings. The model was trained and evaluated on a comprehensive in-house dataset comprising 1,632 patients, each with four mammography views and a corresponding radiology report. The features of both modalities were extracted independently and fused by late fusion before classification. Grad-CAM was used to generate visual explanations highlighting key regions influencing model predictions. The proposed model demonstrated high sensitivity 90%, 95%, 99%, and 100% with corresponding specificities of 40%, 36%, 18%, and 11%, respectively. The best AUC achieved was 0.72 by multimodal approach on the test set, outperforming the image only (0.66) and text-only (0.68) baselines. The proposed multimodal architecture, enhanced with Grad-CAM, demonstrates a strong potential to identify benign tumors among high-risk patients, offering interpretable insights and thereby helping reduce unnecessary biopsies, patient anxiety, and healthcare costs.

</details>


### [584] [CLOSURE: Cross-Channel Closure for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35753)
*Fan Xu,Hao Wu,Zhi Song,Hanbo Huang,Wenzhuo Ma,Nan Wang,Wei Gong,Xibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CLOSURE将多元时序异常检测拆分为"可恢复性"与"跨通道一致性"两个独立的正常数据预测任务，仅在正常数据上校准融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重构残差只能证明观测可被恢复，不能证明变量间关系仍符合正常运行。协调但陌生的工况切换会抬高残差却不破坏任何关系，而某传感器相对同伴漂移时残差可能无响应；将变量依赖折入重构目标的方法因关系证据最终仍由同一重构损失监督，难以消除这种歧义。

Method: (1) 可恢复性任务：以离散正常时序基记忆为条件的扩散重构器；(2) 一致性任务：关系闭包算子，预测每个通道时完全屏蔽该通道自身轨迹，仅依据其余通道，并用稀疏带符号门控选择实际使用的同伴；(3) 两个分数仅在正常数据上经校准后融合。

Result: 在公开基准流上，CLOSURE 稳定优于近期基于重构、频率与拓扑的检测器。

Conclusion: 将跨通道一致性作为与可恢复性并列的独立证据来源，是提升无监督多元时序异常检测的有效方向。

Abstract: Multivariate time series produced by industrial installations and server clusters are under continuous monitoring, and anomaly detection is the first line of defense before a local fault escalates into a system-wide failure. In the absence of labels, the dominant paradigm trains a reconstruction model on normal data and scores the residual to reach a verdict. Recent work has steadily enriched the expressiveness of the recovery map through Transformers, diffusion models, and cross-scale associations. A residual, however, only certifies that an observation can be recovered; it does not certify that the variables still explain one another as they do under normal operation. A coordinated yet unfamiliar operating transition inflates the residual without breaking any relationship, whereas a sensor drifting away from its peers may leave the residual silent. Methods that fold inter-variable dependencies into the reconstruction objective inherit this ambiguity, because their relational evidence is ultimately supervised by the same recovery loss. We therefore propose CLOSURE, which evaluates recoverability and cross-channel consistency as two normal-data prediction tasks learned in separation. The recoverability task is solved by a diffusion reconstructor conditioned on a discrete memory of normal temporal bases. The consistency task is solved by a relation-closure operator that predicts every channel exclusively from the others, where the target's own trajectory is withheld and sparse signed gates decide which peers are actually used. The two scores are reconciled only through calibration on normal data. Extensive experiments show that CLOSURE consistently outperforms recent reconstruction-, frequency-, and topology-based detectors on public benchmark streams, confirming the value of examining consistency alongside recoverability.

</details>


### [585] [Beyond Physical Illness: Can Clinical Narratives Reveal Emerging Mental Health Risks in Chronically Ill Patients?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35761)
*Sudeshna Jana,Siddhartha Laha,Manjira Sinha,Tirthankar Dasgupta,Pabitra Mitra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究能否从纵向临床叙述中推断慢性病住院患者的潜在心理健康风险，基于MIMIC-III构建约4000人的弱监督队列，提出分层状态空间框架从逐日叙述中学习心理健康表征并建模其时间演化，初步结果显示二元风险预测改善且风险/无风险组轨迹可区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 住院期间慢性病患者可能出现抑郁、痴呆、自杀意念等心理健康风险，若未及时识别与干预会恶化；但现有心理健康研究多聚焦已确诊精神疾病患者，而非主要以躯体疾病住院的人群，故需探索能否从住院期间的纵向临床记录中推断潜在心理健康风险。

Method: 利用从出院小结中提取的心理健康证据，在MIMIC-III上构建约4,000名患者的弱监督队列；采用分层状态空间框架，从逐日临床叙述中导出心理健康表征，并对其时间演化建模以进行住院全程的风险估计。

Result: 初步结果表明，所提出的表征改善了二元风险预测；风险组与无风险组之间呈现出由模型导出的、彼此区分明显的风险轨迹。

Conclusion: 该工作为研究慢性病住院患者中新出现的心理健康风险提供了基础性框架，说明纵向临床叙述可用于弱监督下的潜在心理健康风险推断。

Abstract: Mental-health risks such as depression, dementia, and suicidal ideation can emerge during hospitalization among chronically ill patients and may worsen without timely recognition and intervention. However, most existing mental health studies focus on patients with established psychiatric conditions rather than patients hospitalized primarily for physical illness. In this work, we investigate whether latent mental-health risk in chronically ill patients can be inferred from longitudinal clinical narratives. We construct a weakly supervised cohort around 4,000 patients from MIMIC-III using mental-health evidence extracted from discharge summaries. A hierarchical state-space framework derives mental-health representations from day-wise clinical narratives and models their temporal evolution for risk estimation throughout hospitalization. Preliminary results demonstrate improved binary risk prediction using the proposed representations and show distinct model derived risk trajectories between risk and no-risk cohorts, providing a foundation for studying emerging mental-health risks in chronically ill patients.

</details>


### [586] [Free to Look, Free to Reason: Simple LLM Harnesses Outdiagnose Hand-Crafted Root Cause Analysis Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35767)
*Tingzhu Bi,Xun Zhang,Jinglin Li,Ping Wang,Meng Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 RCAtlas 基准（来自 8 个公开数据集的 90 个已验证案例），在 6 个模型、3 种推理强度下比较三类"简单外壳"（单次调用证据包、SQL agent、Codex 编码 agent）与 5 个已发表 LLM RCA agent 及统计/因果方法。结果显示简单外壳最准确（PR@1 65–77%），优于已发表 agent（16–53%）与非 LLM 方法（6–39%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有微服务故障根因分析（RCA）的 LLM agent 多为手工设计：通过标准作业流程、固定阶段与角色 agent 规定模型调用，且各自在私有数据上与少量基线比较。因此无法判断这种"人为处方式"设计是否真的优于让能力强的模型自行调查，缺乏统一、可比、跨方法的公平评测。

Method: 构建 RCAtlas：90 个经人工验证的案例，源自 8 个公开数据集；设置三类不预设模型调用方式的简单外壳——（1）对证据包的单次调用，（2）SQL agent，（3）Codex 编码 agent；对照 5 个已发表的 LLM RCA agent 以及统计与因果方法；在 6 个模型和 3 档推理强度上系统评测，并用案例研究分析固定流程如何跳过决定性证据。

Result: 简单外壳准确率最高，三个中端模型上 PR@1 达 65–77%，高于已发表 agent（16–53%）与非 LLM 方法（6–39%），且在两族方法均运行的每个模型上均领先。已发表 agent 将模型调用的 1/10 至全部固定在程序中，案例研究显示这些处方会跳过决定性证据。更强模型主要提升可靠性，多轮外壳主要提升能力上限（aptitude），提高推理强度仅带来数个百分点精度变化却使耗时最多增加 7 倍。在优于最佳非 LLM 方法的运行中，所有在成本或时间上帕累托最优的运行都采用简单外壳。

Conclusion: 精心设计的多 agent RCA 流程并不必然优于"让强模型自主调查"；人为固定调用反而约束了模型获取决定性证据的能力。评测应跨数据集、跨模型、跨推理强度进行，并在成本与时间维度报告帕累托前沿。简单外壳是当前更优的性价比选择。

Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) of microservice failures has attracted many LLM agents whose investigation is hand-crafted, through standard operating procedures, fixed stages and role agents. Each is evaluated on its own data against few baselines, so it is unknown whether this design beats letting a capable model investigate on its own. We compare three simple harnesses that prescribe none of the model's calls (one call over an evidence package, a SQL agent and the Codex coding agent) with five published LLM RCA agents and with statistical and causal methods on RCAtlas, 90 validated cases from eight public datasets, across six models and three reasoning efforts. The simple harnesses are the most accurate (PR@1 65-77% on three mid-tier models), ahead of the published agents (16-53%) and the non-LLM methods (6-39%), on every model on which both families were run. The published agents fix from a tenth to all of their model calls in the program, and a case study shows how these prescriptions skip the decisive evidence. A stronger model mainly improves reliability, a multi-turn harness mainly improves aptitude, and more reasoning effort changes accuracy by a few points at most while multiplying the time by up to seven. Among runs more accurate than the best non-LLM method, every Pareto-optimal run in cost or time uses a simple harness.

</details>


### [587] [A Unified Arena for LLM Agents across Diverse Eurogame](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35773)
*Fengrui Zhang,Xiang Li,Ruomeng Ding,Jiayi Yuan,Yuchen Huang,Zhaoyang Han,Xiaoliang Wang,Daoyuan Chen,Yaliang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出DECE——涵盖十款欧式桌游的统一竞技评测平台，用1032场三人对局评测12种"模型-执行框架"配置，发现跨游戏排名大体一致但存在游戏特异性优势，同一模型在不同执行框架下表现不同，且竞争优势并不稳定转化为更高的token/成本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对LLM智能体的竞技评测多局限于单一游戏或单一执行框架，难以判断哪些竞争优势能够跨不同环境稳定存在；同时缺乏对资源效率的考量，无法回答"配置优劣是否在不同设置下普遍成立"这一问题。

Method: 构建DECE（Diverse Eurogame Competitive Environments）统一竞技场，包含十款具有长期战略承诺、共享资源竞争与多胜利路径的欧式桌游，并提供共享接口与统一评测协议。主研究评测12种"模型-执行框架"配置（9个模型×4种执行框架），在十款游戏上进行480场三人对局；主研究与补充研究合计1032场完整对局，并进行匹配对照分析。

Result: 跨游戏排名呈现广泛一致性，同时各配置存在游戏特异性优势；匹配研究表明同一模型在不同执行框架下表现存在差异，构成额外的性能变异来源；性能优势并未稳定转化为更优的token或成本效率，资源消耗需作为独立维度考察。

Conclusion: 应以"完整智能体配置"为评测单元，同时衡量其跨游戏的竞技表现与达成该表现所需的资源消耗，二者共同构成配置比较的依据。

Abstract: Interactive environments offer a practical way to evaluate large language model (LLM) agents, and competitive games extend this evaluation to decisions shaped by competing goals and other agents' choices. Yet existing evaluations confined to individual games or execution frameworks leave unclear which competitive advantages persist across settings. We introduce DECE (Diverse Eurogame Competitive Environments), a unified arena spanning ten Eurogames with shared interfaces and evaluation protocols. These games combine lasting strategic commitments, competition over shared resources, and multiple routes to victory. Our primary study evaluates 12 model-harness configurations, spanning nine models and four execution harnesses, in 480 three-player matches across ten games. The main and supplementary studies comprise 1,032 completed matches in total. These comparisons reveal broad cross-game ranking agreement alongside game-specific strengths. Matched studies show that the same model can perform differently across execution harnesses, adding another source of variation to these profiles. These performance advantages do not consistently translate into better token or cost efficiency, making resource use an additional consideration when comparing configurations. Together, the findings support evaluating complete agent configurations by both their competitive performance across games and the resources needed to achieve it.

</details>


### [588] [Game theory of academic effort and hiring in the age of AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35802)
*Saptarshi Pal,Peter S. Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI使论文产出信号廉价化，论文不再可靠区分研究者的理解深度；本文用博弈论模型刻画求职者与招聘者的双边困境，并给出所有纯策略均衡及学习模拟下的行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数学与理论科学等领域需应对高能力AI对研究实践与学术招聘的冲击：过去"高质量理论论文"是作者深度理解领域的可靠信号，AI普及后该信号变廉价、失去筛选力，由此产生求职者（深耕理解 vs. 用AI堆论文）与招聘者（重面试理解 vs. 要求论文数量与面试双过关）的双边策略抉择问题。

Method: 构建一个关于该双边困境的博弈论模型（信号博弈/双边策略互动框架），对博弈中可能出现的全部纯策略均衡进行分类；并借助学习模拟（learning simulations）考察申请者与招聘者群体可能习得并采纳的行为。

Result: 完整刻画了该博弈的所有纯策略均衡类型；学习模拟识别出申请者与招聘者群体可能收敛到的具体行为模式（即不同均衡在动态学习过程中的可实现性）。

Conclusion: 论文为"学术招聘如何适应AI"提供了可推理的分析框架，并可用于评估哪些招聘实践能够维持"深度理解"的价值。

Abstract: Many academic disciplines (in particular, mathematics and the theoretical sciences) face difficult questions about how to adapt their practices to the rise of highly capable artificial intelligence (AI). Before AI, a well-written research paper with a strong theoretical result acted as a reliable signal that its authors understood their field in depth. Now that AI is widely accessible, such signals have become cheaper to produce. As a result, they no longer reliably sort academics by their level of understanding. This has direct consequences for academic hiring. The age of AI raises a question for each side of the academic job market. Should an early-career researcher invest in a deep understanding of their field, or instead use AI to build a longer resume with many papers? Should a recruiter favor applicants with fewer papers who pass an interview aimed at probing understanding, or insist on both publication volume and a pass? In this paper, we develop a game-theoretic model of this two-sided dilemma. We classify all pure-strategy equilibria that can arise in this game and use learning simulations to identify the behaviors that populations of applicants and recruiters may learn to adopt. Our analysis provides a framework for reasoning about how academic hiring can adapt to AI and for evaluating practices that preserve the value of deep understanding.

</details>


### [589] [Patient-specific rubric-based evaluation of large language models across longitudinal cancer care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35847)
*Wei-Wei Zhang,Pengkai Wang,Yan Li,Zhijie Sang,Guan-Qun Zhou,Jun-Yan Li,Shu-Han Zhou,Pei-Wen Liu,Ting-Xi Tang,Min Tang,Zhitian Hou,Jianmin Wu,Jian Guan,i Lin,Hongxia Yang,Ying Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NPC-RubricBench——一个以鼻咽癌为疾病背景、覆盖六个连续诊疗阶段的阶段感知基准，基于两家癌症中心405名患者的纵向病历构建941个患者-阶段单元与17,688条原子标准；对30个通用与医学LLM的评测显示诊断能力强并不转化为下游照护能力，且主导失败模式随阶段反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM医学评测多聚焦孤立的单次临床接触，未追踪临床责任如何沿纵向照护路径演化，难以反映多阶段临床推理的可靠性。因此需要阶段感知的纵向评测基准。

Method: 构建NPC-RubricBench：以鼻咽癌为疾病语境，从两家癌症中心405名患者的纵向记录中整理出覆盖六个连续照护阶段的941个患者-阶段单元，以及横跨五个评价维度的17,688条患者特异性原子标准；每次评估严格限定于决策时刻可获得的临床证据。对30个通用及医学适配LLM进行评测，并开展查询粒度（开放式 vs. 清单式提示）的对照分析。

Result: 强诊断表现未延续到下游照护；主导失败模式随阶段反转：解剖分期以显式决策错误为主（48.2%），初始检查与治疗后随访以决策遗漏为主（分别为33.4%与30.4%）；医学适配模型的遗漏率高于通用模型。粒度权衡显著：宽泛开放式请求使全部30个模型的决策质量下降，细化清单式提示提升决策质量但降低证据忠实度与安全依从性。

Conclusion: 静态诊断基准不足以保证跨时间的临床可靠性一致性，凸显多阶段医学AI中引入阶段自适应防护机制的必要性；模型评估应沿照护连续体进行阶段化、细粒度刻画。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway. Here we introduce NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark for evaluating multistage clinical reasoning across the cancer care continuum, using nasopharyngeal carcinoma as a defined disease context. Curated from longitudinal records of 405 patients across two cancer centers, the benchmark comprises 941 patient-phase units across six sequential care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria spanning five evaluation dimensions, with each assessment strictly restricted to decision-time clinical evidence. Evaluating 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs revealed that strong diagnostic performance does not carry over to downstream care. We evaluated 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs, showing that high diagnostic performance did not translate into improved downstream care. Instead, the dominant failure modes reversed across phases. Explicit decision errors dominated anatomical staging at 48.2%, whereas decision omissions dominated initial work-up and post-treatment follow-up at 33.4% and 30.4%, respectively. In the evaluated model set, medically adapted models showed higher omission rates than general-purpose models. Moreover, varying query granularity exposes a critical specification trade-off: broad open-ended requests degrade Decision Quality across all 30 models, while more detailed, checklist-like prompts raise Decision Quality but reduce Evidence Faithfulness and Safety Adherence. Furthermore, NPC-RubricBench demonstrates that static diagnostic benchmarks are insufficient to ensure consistent clinical reliability over time, highlighting the importance of phase-adaptive safeguards in multistage medical AI.

</details>


### [590] [Center-of-Mass Interpretation of Evolution Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35865)
*Akshat Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将演化策略(ES)更新解释为"粒子-质量"系统的质心位移：均值减去后的ES更新精确等于该位移乘以一个依赖于平均奖励的标量因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ES更新通常被表述为平滑梯度的估计，缺乏直观几何图像；作者希望提供一种对任意有限种群都精确成立的几何/物理可视化解释。

Method: 把每个扰动模型视作粒子、其奖励视作粒子质量；评分前各粒子等质量、种群在质心处平衡，评分后在奖励加权质心处平衡。通过给所有奖励加常数保证奖励非负，从而给出物理读法；并分析大种群或对偶采样极限下质心位于模型自身的情形。

Result: 证明均值减去后的ES更新恰为该质心位移按依赖于平均奖励的标量因子缩放，对任意有限种群精确成立；在大种群/对偶采样下，模型沿自身种群奖励加权质心方向移动；减去均值奖励等价于把位移测量起点从模型改为采样质心。

Conclusion: 论文给出了直观、几何化的ES更新可视化方式，且在有限种群下严格精确，澄清了均值减法的作用。

Abstract: Evolution strategies (ES) update a model by sampling a population of perturbed copies, scoring each one, and moving in the reward-weighted direction of the perturbations.
