# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [819] [Double KV Cache Optimization on Apple Silicon: Block-FP4, Radial Quantization, and Fused Metal Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33076)
*Ibrokhimsho Abduchaborov*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 在 Apple Silicon M5 Max 上用 MLX 评测五种 KV 缓存路径，融合 Metal PolarQuant 实现 3.64x 压缩与 46.8 tok/s，但长上下文（32K+）因全缓存重建导致性能崩塌，需融合注意力与分块预分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文自回归推理中，KV 缓存容量与访存流量是主要瓶颈，需评估低比特 KV 压缩在统一内存硬件上的实际收益，并区分"表示压缩"与"内核/分配器"两类效应。

Method: 在 Apple Silicon M5 Max + MLX 环境对比五条路径：原生 bf16 基线、块缩放 E2M1 FP4、Python 参考实现的径向量化+QJL 风格残差、FP4→Polar 顺序组合（Double Optimization）、融合 Metal Polar 内核。

Result: 融合 Metal PolarQuant：46.8 tok/s、3,456 B/token（3.64x 压缩），比 Python Polar 参考（25.4 tok/s）快 1.84x，略优于 block-FP4（41.5 tok/s、3.62x）。顺序组合无叠加收益：4,241 B/token、15.1 tok/s，两维度均劣于单独 FP4。32K 及以上所有压缩变体跌至 1.5-14 tok/s（全缓存重建，累计 O(N²) 解码开销）；64K 时 Metal 变体因 33.5 GB 分配超过 MLX 22.6 GB Metal 缓冲上限而 OOM。

Conclusion: 径向编码在将打包、旋转与重建整合进单一设备内核时具备竞争力，但该收益不能外推到长上下文；需融合 scaled dot-product attention 直接作用于压缩 KV，并配合分块预分配，才能实现长上下文可用性。

Abstract: Key-value (KV) cache capacity and memory traffic are primary bottlenecks in long-context autoregressive inference. We evaluate five cache paths on an Apple Silicon M5 Max using MLX: a native bf16 baseline, block-scaled E2M1 FP4, a Python reference implementing radial quantization with a QJL-style residual, sequential FP4-to-Polar composition, and a fused Metal Polar kernel. On Apple Silicon M5 Max, fused Metal PolarQuant achieves 46.8 tok/s at 3,456 B/token - 3.64x compression versus the bf16 baseline and 1.84x faster than the Python Polar reference (25.4 tok/s), while slightly outperforming block-FP4 (41.5 tok/s at 3.62x compression). Sequential composition of FP4 and Polar (Double Optimization) yields no additive benefit: 4,241 B/token at 15.1 tok/s, worse than FP4 alone on both axes. The fused path establishes that radial coding can be competitive when packing, rotation, and reconstruction are placed in one device kernel, but this result does not extend to longer contexts. At 32K and above, all compressed variants collapse to 1.5-14 tok/s because the current attention path repeatedly reconstructs the full cache, retaining cumulative O(N^2) decode work. At 64K, the Metal variant runs out of memory when a 33.5 GB allocation exceeds MLX's 22.6 GB Metal buffer limit. Fused scaled dot-product attention operating directly on compressed KV, together with chunked pre-allocation, is required for long-context viability. These results separate representation-level compression from kernel and allocator effects and identify the conditions under which low-bit KV caching helps on unified memory hardware.

</details>


### [820] [AnalogPortBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Analog Circuit Porting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33088)
*Saeid Rajabi,Aly Moussa,Vishal Saxena,Chengmo Yang,Satwik Patnaik*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出 AnalogPortBench，一个包含54个任务、覆盖从电流镜到套筒式放大器共10种电路、从0.18 μm工艺迁移到开源SKY130 PDK的模拟电路工艺迁移基准，并系统评测了六个前沿LLM在两种推理等级与有无仿真反馈下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟电路设计高度依赖专家经验，将已验证设计迁移到新工艺节点是反复出现的瓶颈；供电电压下降压缩电压裕度，可能迫使拓扑重新设计甚至无法达标。现有LLM生成与优化模拟电路的基准只针对单一工艺节点且假定规格可行，缺乏对工艺迁移与不可行规格的考察。

Method: 构建 AnalogPortBench：54个任务、10种电路，由0.18 μm迁移至开源SKY130 PDK；任务难度从直接迁移、降低供电电压、加严规格直到不可行规格；每个可行任务均提供在五个工艺角（process corners）下验证的参考设计。在两种推理等级、有/无仿真反馈条件下评测六个前沿LLM。

Result: 模型能完成简单电路的迁移，但很少能对裕度敏感的放大器进行重新设计，也较少识别出不可行规格；相较增加采样数或提升推理等级，仿真反馈带来的增益更大。

Conclusion: 现有LLM在模拟电路工艺迁移上能力有限，尤其欠缺裕度敏感的重新设计与可行性判断；仿真反馈是更有效的增强手段。基准代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Analog circuit design still relies heavily on expert knowledge, and porting proven designs to new process nodes is a recurring bottleneck. As a lower supply reduces available voltage headroom, a working topology may require redesign or fail to meet specifications. While large language models (LLMs) have begun to generate and optimize analog circuits, existing benchmarks focus on one process node and assume feasible specifications. To bridge this gap, we introduce AnalogPortBench, a benchmark of 54 tasks for porting ten circuits, from current mirrors to telescopic amplifiers, from a 0.18 $μ$m process to the open-source SKY130 PDK. Tasks range from a direct port through a reduced supply and harder specifications to infeasible ones, and every feasible task has a reference design verified at five process corners. Evaluating six frontier LLMs at two reasoning levels, with and without simulation feedback, we find that models port simple circuits but rarely re-design headroom-sensitive amplifiers, seldom recognize infeasible specifications, and gain more from simulation feedback than from more samples or reasoning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/saeidrajabii/AnalogPortBench.

</details>


### [821] [EGGPlacer: Energy-Guided Generative Chip Placement with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33099)
*Qi Zhou,Guojun Liu,Juanhong Zhao,Guangzhi Qi,Zehao Chen,Ming Lu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出能量引导的扩散式宏单元布局框架 EGGPlacer，在逆向扩散中注入解析布局反馈与可微热模型反馈，实现线长与热性能的联合优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宏单元布局显著影响布线线长与热行为，但这些下游指标在布局阶段难以评估。学习型布局器多只优化仅含宏单元的半周长线长（mHPWL），忽略标准单元连接性与空间需求；解析式混合尺寸布局器虽优化可微的全网表线长与密度，却通常不考虑热效应。

Method: 将解析布局器作为在线物理响应模型，对每个中间宏布局给出标准单元分布与全网表线长代理；同时用可微热模型提供温度反馈。两类信号被构造为可组合的能量项，在逆向扩散全过程注入，且无需重训练底层生成模型。

Result: 在公开布局基准上，混合尺寸 HPWL 与强解析式及学习型宏布局器相比具有竞争力；端到端评估中取得所比较方法里最低的平均布线线长与峰值温度。消融实验表明解析引导与热引导在线长代理、布线线长和热目标上带来不同且互补的收益。

Conclusion: 在生成式宏布局中引入解析与热学能量引导，可在不重训练的前提下有效弥合布局阶段与下游布线/热指标之间的差距，两类引导具有互补性。

Abstract: Chip placement strongly affects routed wirelength and thermal behavior, yet these downstream metrics are difficult to evaluate during macro placement. Learning-based macro placers commonly optimize the macro-only half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL), denoted mHPWL, which ignores standard cell connectivity and spatial demand. In contrast, analytical mixed-size placers optimize differentiable full netlist wirelength and density objectives but are typically unaware of thermal effects. We propose EGGPlacer, an energy-guided diffusion framework that incorporates analytical placement feedback and thermal feedback into macro placement generation. An analytical placer acts as an online physical response model, exposing the standard cell distribution and a full netlist wirelength proxy induced by each intermediate macro placement, while a differentiable thermal model provides temperature feedback. These signals are formulated as composable energies and injected throughout reverse diffusion without retraining the underlying generative model. Experiments on public placement benchmarks show that EGGPlacer achieves competitive mixed-size HPWL relative to strong analytical and learning-based macro placers. In the end-to-end evaluation, EGGPlacer also obtains the lowest average routed wirelength and peak temperature among the evaluated methods. Ablation studies further demonstrate that analytical and thermal guidance provide distinct and complementary benefits across wirelength proxies, routed wirelength, and thermal objectives.

</details>


### [822] [Fast Path, Exact Path: One Library of Hardwired Operators for Streaming and Exact Canny Edge Detection on a Low-Cost FPGA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33107)
*Raj Mali*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文在低成本 Artix-7 FPGA 上用同一个硬连线 3×3 算子库同时实现 Canny 磁滞阈值的相机速率近似与分块精确实现，二者均与软件黄金模型比特一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁滞边缘跟踪沿无界长度边缘链传播，天然抗拒单遍流式处理；现有 FPGA 设计要么近似它，要么需专用标号硬件。作者希望用同一套算子库兼顾低延迟近似与精确结果。

Method: 1) 构建统一算子库：每个算子均为两时钟延迟的 3×3 硬连线算子；2) 快速路径将相机像素流经该算子与 K 个局部磁滞级（K=1–8），逐像素提交判决；3) 精确路径将 128×128 分块存入 Block RAM，用同一算子内置前向/反向就地扫描替代双缓冲迭代，减少通过次数。

Result: 快速路径判决延迟 262.15–720.63 μs（即 3+K 行后），比 30fps 帧处理器起始早 46–127 倍；不误报精确磁滞拒绝的边缘，阈值 20/40 下恢复 76.6–96.1% 精确边缘；BSDS500 200 幅图保留 ≥98.6% 边界 F-measure（ODS 0.470–0.477 vs 0.476）。精确路径在图案/照片块上把磁滞迭代从 38–82 次降至 3–7 次，加速 6.6–21.7 倍（最坏块 40 倍），整块加速 4.5–9.9 倍且输出一致。全程比特精确，50 MHz 闭合时序，≤1455 LUT。

Conclusion: 统一算子库可在低成本 FPGA 上以单遍流式方式近似磁滞并支持分块精确实现，资源与时序代价低；但在存储图像上，优化多核 CPU 仍更快，因其可在整帧到达后开始。

Abstract: Hysteresis edge tracking, the final stage of Canny edge detection, follows edge chains of unbounded length and therefore resists single-pass streaming; FPGA designs either approximate it or dedicate separate labelling hardware to it. We show that a single library of hardwired 3x3 operators, each with an identical two-clock latency, delivers both a camera-rate approximation and exact hysteresis on a low-cost Artix-7 (XC7A35T). The fast path streams camera pixels through the operators and K local hysteresis stages and commits each edge decision 262.15-720.63 microseconds after the pixel arrives (K = 1-8; system simulation with a datasheet camera model), that is, 3 + K camera lines later and 46-127x sooner than a frame-based processor can even begin at 30 frames per second. It provably never reports an edge that exact hysteresis rejects, recovers 76.6-96.1% of exact edges at thresholds 20/40, and on the 200 BSDS500 test images retains at least 98.6% of the exact path's boundary F-measure (ODS 0.470-0.477 versus 0.476). The exact path holds 128x128 tiles in block RAM, is exact within each tile, and replaces two-buffer iteration with in-place forward and reverse sweeps built into the same operator. This reduces hysteresis from 38-82 passes to 3-7 on pattern and photo tiles, accelerating the hysteresis step 6.6-21.7x (40x on a worst-case tile) and a complete tile 4.5-9.9x, with identical output. Both paths are bit-exact with software golden models at every pipeline stage and close timing at 50 MHz in at most 1455 LUTs. An optimised multi-core CPU remains faster on stored images, but it cannot begin until the frame is complete.

</details>


### [823] [How AI Load Swings Reduce Datacenter Power Conversion Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33300)
*Heetarth Joshi,Ali Alenezi,Fang Chen Lin,Prasad Enjeti,Xiaoyang Wang,Xin Chen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文用基于能量、周期平均的方法，量化AI负载功率在计算与通信阶段间摆动时，240V AC→400V DC→51V DC机架供电路径的转换效率损失，并指出按平均负载标称的效率高估实际性能，且级联级数越多惩罚越大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI训练与推理负载使GPU功率在计算与通信阶段反复摆动，机架内级联变换器随之在效率不同的工作点间切换；而按平均负载标称的效率无法反映这种动态工况下的真实损耗。

Method: 采用基于能量、周期平均的量化方法，沿240V AC→400V DC→51V DC机架供电路径建模，并使用市售GaN基PFC与LLC变换器的实测效率曲线，以1 Hz、50%占空比、在5 kW与510 W之间摆动的负载为算例评估效率。

Result: 动态负载下转换效率降至95.97%，而等效恒定平均负载下为96.82%，损失0.88%；计入51/48V→1V芯片供电点负载变换后，损失增至1.66%（89.45% vs. 90.96%）。

Conclusion: 按平均负载标称的效率高估了真实性能，且损失随电网到GPU之间每个负载相关变换级而累积增大。

Abstract: AI training and inference workloads make GPU power swing repeatedly between compute and communication phases. As a result, the cascaded converters in a datacenter rack keep moving between operating points with different efficiencies. This paper uses an energy based, cycle averaged method to quantify that effect along a 240 V AC to 400 V DC to 51 V DC rack power path, using measured efficiency curves of commercially available GaN based PFC and LLC converters. For a 1 Hz, 50% duty-cycle load swinging between 5 kW and 510 W, conversion efficiency falls to 95.97%, compared with 96.82% at the equivalent constant average load, a loss of 0.88%. When 51/48V to 1V point of load conversion to the chip rail is included, it is shown that the loss grows to 1.66% (89.45% vs. 90.96%). These results show that efficiency rated at average load overstates real world performance, and that the penalty grows with each load dependent conversion stage between the grid and the GPU.

</details>


### [824] [Operating System Support for Accelerators as First-Class Compute Elements in Heterogeneous Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33380)
*Mohammad Shahidzadeh,Lesley Shannon*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该文指出Linux等操作系统将硬件加速器视为外设，导致"O/S外设税"（通信、调用、中断、调度开销）显著削弱加速收益；作者构建FPGA框架MEERKAT支持将O/S支持从软件迁移到硬件，并针对四类开销提出缓解技术，实现通信最高260倍加速、墙钟时间2–6倍提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构SoC日益依赖领域专用硬件加速器以获得性能与能效增益，但操作系统假定处理器才是计算单元、HA仅为外设，由此产生的软件开销抵消了硬件加速的实际收益，而这一开销来源缺乏系统性的识别与量化手段。

Method: 构建MEERKAT——基于FPGA的可配置多核系统框架，允许将Linux O/S支持从SW迁移至HW，以识别、研究并量化O/S税；归纳四类主要税源并分别提出对策：虚拟内存感知（VMA）通信方法提升HA访问应用数据的效率、轻量级HA调用接口、中断策略自适应（IPA）动态选择轮询与中断、以及HA感知调度器在CPU与多HA实例间动态分配工作。

Result: 通信速度最高提升260倍；相比传统调度器，墙钟时间性能提升2–6倍。研究还表明整体系统性能不仅取决于HA速度，还取决于O/S开销、资源可用性与调度决策。

Conclusion: 应将HA视为一等计算资源，未来异构系统需要面向加速器中心的操作系统设计。

Abstract: Heterogeneous systems-on-chip (SoCs) increasingly rely on domain-specific hardware accelerators (HAs) to deliver performance and energy efficiency gains beyond what general-purpose processors can provide. However, operating systems (O/S), such as Linux, assume that processors are the Compute Elements (CEs) and HAs are peripheral devices rather than specialized CEs. As a result, HA execution incurs substantial software (SW) overheads that reduce the effective benefits of hardware (HW) acceleration.
  This work demonstrates that significant inefficiencies arise from ``O/S peripheral device taxes'' (O/S taxes), including SW stack-accelerator communication, invocation, interrupt handling, and scheduling. We built MEERKAT, a Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA)-based framework for configurable multicore systems that include HAs; it allows the user to migrate Linux O/S support from SW to HW and identify, study, and quantify the impact. Here we study four major sources of O/S tax and introduce techniques to mitigate them. These include a virtual-memory-aware (VMA) communication method that enables efficient HA access to application data, a lightweight HA invocation interface, Interrupt Policy Adaptation (IPA) for dynamic polling and interrupt selection, and an HA-aware scheduler that dynamically distributes work across Central Processing Units (CPUs) and multiple HA instances.
  Experimental results demonstrate up to $260\times$ faster communication and $2$--$6\times$ performance improvements in wall-clock time over conventional schedulers. Furthermore, our study reveals that overall system performance depends not only on HA speed, but also on O/S overheads, resource availability, and scheduling decisions. These findings highlight the importance of treating HAs as first-class computational resources and motivate a more accelerator-centric O/S design for future heterogeneous systems.

</details>


### [825] [The Analytical Investigation of Inductor-Coupled Mixers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33424)
*Arash Ghasemi*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该文放弃开关近似，从器件定律出发推导电感/变压器耦合平衡混频器的负载准静态方程，并给出其闭式解的多样数学函数形式，经37组LTspice仿真验证（12组主比较RMS误差均低于0.017%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统电感/变压器耦合平衡混频器分析依赖开关近似、转换矩阵、谐波平衡或电路仿真，缺乏从器件定律出发的严格解析解，难以直接用于设计中无参数扫描的定量计算。

Method: 保留变压器比、反射负载、偏置及决定IF共模的连接方式，从器件定律推导负载准静态方程；针对不同器件与拓扑求解闭式表达式：Shockley单平衡对用主Lambert函数W0（给定单二极管主导条件）、双平衡环在开路IF端退化为精确反双曲正切形式、真空二极管/三极管对应Cardano三次与结构化六次方程、耗尽型JFET/MESFET交叉结构仅需平方根、MOS强反型为分段二次式（IF绕组浮空时为Ferrari四次）、弱反型给出W0、实r-Lambert函数或sinh x+ρx的反函数；匹配BJT/HBT Gilbert单元中相等发射极电阻使双曲正切电流导向变为精确r-Lambert函数；傅里叶投影引入Beta/Gamma、修正Bessel与完全椭圆函数。

Result: 用七个独立Python程序对照37组LTspice仿真验证；12组主比较严格实现所设器件定律，所有RMS波形误差低于解析RMS值的0.017%；内置与厂商器件模型另行考察；两个设计示例表明闭式解可在无参数扫描下确定热离子IF负载与Gilbert单元尾电流。

Conclusion: 负载准静态方程体系为电感/变压器耦合平衡混频器提供了统一的闭式解析框架，所得解的函数族随器件与IF连接方式变化，兼具精确性与设计可用性，可作为仿真的解析补充。

Abstract: Inductor- and transformer-coupled balanced mixers are usually analyzed with switching approximations, conversion matrices, harmonic balance, or circuit simulation. This paper instead derives their loaded quasistatic equations from the device laws, keeping the transformer ratios, reflected load, bias, and the connections that set the IF common mode. The functions needed to solve these equations are surprisingly varied. A Shockley single-balanced pair is solved by the principal Lambert function $W_0$ under a quantified one-diode-dominance condition. The double-balanced ring has a unique loaded solution that reduces to an exact inverse-hyperbolic-tangent form only for an open IF port. Vacuum diodes and triodes lead to Cardano cubics and structured sextics, whereas depletion JFET/MESFET crossbars need only square roots. Bilateral MOS channels give piecewise quadratics in strong inversion, or a Ferrari quartic when the IF winding floats. In weak inversion they give an exact $W_0$, the real $r$-Lambert function, or the inverse of $\sinh x+ρx$, depending on topology and IF connection. In matched BJT and HBT Gilbert cells, equal emitter resistors turn the hyperbolic-tangent current steering into an exact $r$-Lambert function. Fourier projection brings in Beta/Gamma, modified Bessel, and complete elliptic functions. We checked the equations against 37 LTspice simulations using seven independent Python programs. In the 12 primary comparisons, which implement the assumed device laws exactly, every RMS waveform error was below 0.017% of the analytical RMS value; built-in and vendor device models were examined separately. Two design examples show how the closed forms size a thermionic IF load and a Gilbert-cell tail current without parameter sweeps.

</details>


### [826] [DiffRouter: A Differentiable Routing Framework for UltraScale FPGAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33510)
*Xiaohan Gao,Zhili Xiong,Yusu Wang,David Z. Pan*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: DiffRouter：首个可微、基于梯度的GPU加速FPGA布线框架，将布线提升到连续优化空间实现高并发与更好全局最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统FPGA布线器依赖逐网络串行处理与rip-up-reroute启发式，先天串行性限制并行度、资源利用率不佳，并在现代FPGA上显著增加运行时间。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1)资源剪枝预处理，为每个网络提取紧凑布线变量以降低内存占用与问题复杂度；(2)可微全局布线，采用梯度下降，将布线建模为拉格朗日松弛优化，在最小化线长的同时以松弛项迭代施加连通性与拥塞约束；(3)后处理，将连续布线分布映射为合法UltraScale布线解并通过详细布线补全。

Result: 在FPGA 2024 Routing Contest基准上，相对RWRoute提速超5倍、相对Vivado提速2倍、比最先进学术布线器Potter快18%，同时关键路径线长具竞争力。

Conclusion: 将布线提升为连续可微优化可有效突破串行瓶颈，在保证解质量的前提下显著提升并行度与运行效率。

Abstract: Routing has become a major bottleneck in large-scale FPGA design flows, where traditional routers rely on sequential net-by-net processing and rip-up-reroute heuristics. This inherent sequentialism limits parallelism, leads to suboptimal utilization of routing resources, and significantly increases runtime on modern FPGAs. This paper introduces DiffRouter, the first differentiable, gradient-based FPGA routing framework with GPU acceleration. By lifting routing into a continuous optimization space, DiffRouter enables highly concurrent routing and improved global optimality before projecting solutions back onto the discrete fabric. The framework consists of three key stages: (1) Resource-pruned preprocessing, which extracts compact routing variables per net to reduce memory footprint and problem complexity; (2) Differentiable global routing via gradient descent, which formulates routing as a Lagrangian-relaxed optimization that minimizes wirelength while iteratively enforcing connectivity and congestion constraints as relaxed terms; and (3) Postprocessing, which maps the continuous wire distributions to a valid UltraScale routing solution and completes solutions by detailed routing. Experiments on the FPGA 2024 Routing Contest benchmarks show that DiffRouter outperforms state-of-the-art parallel routers, achieving over 5x speedup over RWRoute and 2x over Vivado, and running 18% faster than the state-of-the-art academic FPGA router Potter while delivering competitive critical path wirelength.

</details>


### [827] [ZipFusion: Fusing Lossless KV Decompression with Attention for Efficient LLM Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33719)
*Yuetao Chen,Peng Wang,Hong Xu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: ZipFusion 通过协同设计无损压缩格式与注意力算子，使注意力直接在寄存器中消费压缩 KV cache，避免独立解压流程，并复用压缩所释放的内存以容纳更多请求，从而提升解码吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文与高并发使 KV cache 对 GPU 显存容量与带宽的压力剧增：其占用限制并发度，注意力中重复的 KV 读取使解码受显存带宽约束。已有无损 KV 压缩方法虽减少设备间传输，但在注意力前需将 KV 还原为未压缩形式放入显存，因此重复读取量不变，还需额外的解压开销与内存。

Method: 提出 ZipFusion，在 FlashInfer 上实现并集成至 SGLang。核心是压缩格式与注意力 kernel 的协同设计：kernel 用简单位操作在寄存器中直接重建原始值，省去独立解压过程，从而减少注意力期间从显存读取的字节数；同时内存管理器将压缩释放的跨层空间重新分配用于存储额外 KV cache，为正在进行的生成预留空间，并将剩余容量提供给新请求。

Result: 在 NVIDIA H100 上，解码注意力相较 FlashInfer 约 1.25× 加速；8K 上下文下，在相同显存预算内相比未压缩 SGLang 解码吞吐最多提升 26.3%；在各方法最大支持批大小下，吞吐最高可达最佳无损 KV 压缩基线的 2.76×。

Conclusion: 将无损压缩与注意力计算深度融合、而非先解压再计算，可同时缓解显存容量与带宽瓶颈，是提升长上下文大模型服务吞吐的有效路径。

Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache places growing demands on GPU memory capacity and bandwidth as large language models serve longer contexts and more concurrent requests. Its footprint limits concurrency, while repeated KV reads during attention can make decoding memory-bandwidth bound. Prior lossless KV cache compression methods reduce transfers between devices but restore the uncompressed KV cache in GPU memory before attention. They therefore leave these repeated KV reads unchanged and require additional work and memory for decompression. We present ZipFusion, which enables attention to consume the losslessly compressed KV cache directly. ZipFusion co-designs the compression format and attention kernel to reduce the bytes read from GPU memory during attention. The kernel reconstructs the original values directly in registers using simple bit operations, avoiding a separate decompression pass and easing the memory-bandwidth bound. ZipFusion also reassigns memory freed by compression across layers to store additional KV cache. Its memory manager reserves space for ongoing generation and makes the remaining capacity available to new requests. We implement ZipFusion on top of FlashInfer and integrate it with SGLang. On an NVIDIA H100, ZipFusion achieves about 1.25x speedup over FlashInfer in decode attention. With 8K context, it improves model decode throughput by up to 26.3% over uncompressed SGLang under the same GPU memory budget. At each method's largest supported batch, it also delivers up to 2.76x the throughput of the best-performing lossless KV cache compression baseline.

</details>


### [828] [Adapting DNNs to Embrace Voltage Scaling Induced Errors via Accumulation-Aware Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33824)
*Alexis Maras,Panagiotis Chaidos,Georgios Alexandris,Dimitrios Soudris,Sotirios Xydis*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出软硬件协同设计方法，通过累积感知训练、混合精度量化与剪枝、MSB掩码与时钟门控、分层动态频率缩放，在2nm工艺下实现39%能耗与23% EDP收益，精度损失<1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNN广泛部署使能效成为关键指标；电压缩放虽可显著降功耗，但在先进工艺节点下面临严重吞吐下降与工艺偏差敏感性，能耗与可靠性之间存在权衡。

Method: 基于"脉动阵列累加器中时序鲁棒的位区间随电压-频率工作点显著变化"这一观察，构建软硬件协同设计：(1) 软件层面提出累积感知训练（AAT），将位区间信息作为一阶优化约束，结合混合精度量化与非结构化剪枝，约束权重分布以规避激活硬件敏化的高秩进位链；(2) 架构层面采用选择性MSB掩码与细粒度时钟门控降低动态翻转；(3) 采用分层动态频率缩放（DFS），依据各层数值敏感度适配累加器缩减的动态范围。

Result: 在深度缩放的2nm工艺节点上评估，低压前沿下协同优化后的后布局架构相较标称电压实现，能耗降低39%，EDP降低23%，精度退化控制在1%以内。

Conclusion: 通过跨层协同优化累加器时序鲁棒性与数值特性，可在低压运行下兼顾能效与可靠性，为先进工艺节点的DNN加速器提供可行路径。

Abstract: The pervasive deployment of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) across the computing spectrum has brought growing attention to energy efficiency, alongside raw performance. While voltage scaling is a potent knob for power reduction, its application in next-generation nodes is hampered by severe throughput degradation and susceptibility to process variation. This work aims to address these energy-reliability trade-offs by introducing a hardware-software co-design methodology, based on the observation that timing-robust bit ranges within the accumulator of a systolic array vary significantly across different voltage-frequency operating points. At the software level, we propose an Accumulation-Aware Training approach that incorporates this information as a first-order optimization constraint during training. By integrating mixed-precision quantization with unstructured pruning, we effectively constrain the model's weight distribution to avoid activating the hardware's sensitized high-rank carry chains. At the architectural level, we complement this with selective MSB-masking and fine-grained clock-gating to minimize unnecessary dynamic switching activity. Furthermore, we employ a layer-wise Dynamic Frequency Scaling strategy to further adapt to the accumulator's reduced dynamic range, based on the numerical sensitivity of each layer. We experimentally evaluate the proposed solution on a deep scaled 2nm technology node and demonstrate that, when operating at a low-voltage frontier, our co-optimized post-layout architecture delivers substantial energy and energy-delay product gains of 39% and 23% respectively, relative to the nominal voltage implementation, while maintaining accuracy degradation within 1%.

</details>


### [829] [Real-Time Recurrent Qubit-State Discrimination on a Heterogeneous AI-Engine-FPGA Accelerator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33843)
*Vu Le,Yilun Xu,Neel Vora,Gang Huang,Deepak Ganesan,Phuc Nguyen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出面向AMD Versal的硬件感知LSTM读出加速器，按依赖边界将独立输入投影放在AIE阵列、循环更新放在PL，在64 ns输入节奏与1000 ns预算下实现高精度、低开销的量子比特状态判别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超导量子处理器的qubit读出是最慢、最易错的操作之一。传统积分判别器把I/Q记录压缩为单点，丢失弛豫过程证据；全分辨率前馈分类器保留信息但部署成本过高；循环分类器虽廉价，但其循环携带的隐藏状态无法塞入单个AIE tile寄存器容量而溢出至数据内存，导致随序列长度增长的延迟。

Method: 硬件感知的LSTM加速器设计：在依赖边界处划分计算——独立的输入投影映射到AIE阵列执行，循环携带的状态更新放在可编程逻辑（PL）中实现，从而避免隐藏状态溢出数据内存，满足64 ns输入节奏、1000 ns总预算。

Result: 在受读出中途态跃迁影响的qubit上，精度与全分辨率前馈网络相当（96.59% vs 96.37%），参数量少403倍、DSP少约103倍；相对误差较GMM降68.2%、较QubiCML降43.6%、较MF-NN降16.82%。仅用400个AIE tile中的4个与17个DSP58，DSP58用量较QubiCML和MF-NN少2.2–8.2倍；AIE-PL划分使暴露尾延迟较纯AIE映射降低60.3%，DSP58用量较全PL实现减少31.1倍。八个qubit上紧凑变体平均精度96.78%，为最强的硬件部署工作点。

Conclusion: 在设计低延迟量子读出加速器时，时间分辨率与循环状态放置必须联合考虑；AIE-PL按依赖边界划分为低延迟、高能效的循环分类提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Qubit readout, or qubit state discrimination, remains one of the slowest and most error-prone operations in superconducting quantum processors, making fast, accurate, and hardware-efficient classification essential for scalable quantum computing. Conventional discriminators integrate the I/Q record into a single point, discarding evidence a relaxing qubit leaves behind; full-resolution feed-forward classifiers recover it but are too costly to deploy under this constraint. Recurrent classifiers retain full resolution far more cheaply, but their loop-carried hidden state cannot fit a single AI Engine (AIE) tile's register capacity and spills to data memory, adding latency that grows with sequence length.
  We present a hardware-aware LSTM accelerator for an AMD Versal device that resolves this by partitioning at the dependency boundary - independent input projections on the AIE array, the loop-carried update in programmable logic (PL) - keeping pace with a 64 ns input cadence under a 1,000 ns budget. On the qubit affected by mid-readout state transitions, our design matches a full-resolution feed-forward network's accuracy (96.59% vs. 96.37%) using 403x fewer parameters and roughly 103x fewer DSPs while cutting relative error by 68.2% over GMM, 43.6% over QubiCML, and 16.82% over MF-NN. Using 4 out of 400 AIE tiles and 17 DSP58, it needs 2.2-8.2x fewer DSP58 blocks than QubiCML and MF-NN, and the AIE-PL partition cuts exposed tail latency by 60.3% versus a pure-AIE mapping and DSP58 usage 31.1x versus an all-PL implementation. Across eight qubits, a compact variant reaches 96.78% mean accuracy, the strongest hardware-deployed operating point. Temporal resolution and recurrent-state placement must then be treated jointly when designing low-latency quantum readout accelerators.

</details>


### [830] [Toward Near-Optimal Floorplanning with Complex Design Constraints for Modern SoCs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34046)
*Fuxing Huang,Hao Ai,Qiyuan Chen,Hao Wu,Wenxing Zhu,Xinning Liu,Ziran Zhu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出三阶段解析式SoC布局框架（SDP初始化 + 增广拉格朗日全局布局 + SOCP合法化），将布局问题建模为严格约束优化，在FloorSet基准上满足全部约束且运行最快，线长/面积平均降低90%/16%，逼近最优参考（仅差2%/1%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代SoC布局面临高度耦合的复杂设计约束；现有方法多将约束松弛为多目标优化中的目标项，易产生不可行解或解质量下降。作者希望以更严格的约束优化方式直接处理约束。

Method: 将问题形式化为约束优化任务，构建三阶段解析框架：1）两步SDP（半定规划）公式化，在非凸搜索空间中获得鲁棒初始化；2）将可微目标与约束纳入增量式增广拉格朗日方法（ALM），在全局布局阶段联合处理耦合约束；3）基于SOCP（二阶锥规划）的合法化阶段，严格保证可行性并进一步缩减面积。

Result: 在FloorSet基准上，方法满足所有约束且运行时间最短；相较SOTA方法，线长与面积平均分别降低90%和16%；结果接近最优，线长和面积仅比真值参考分别大2%和1%。

Conclusion: 以约束优化而非约束松弛的建模方式，配合SDP-ALM-SOCP的三阶段解析流程，可在保证可行性的同时显著提升布局质量与效率，且逼近理论最优参考，为复杂约束下的SoC布局提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Modern system-on-chip (SoC) floorplanning is increasingly challenged by highly coupled complex design constraints. Existing methods often relax constraints into objectives via multi-objective optimization, leading to infeasible solutions or degraded quality. To address this, we formulate the problem as a constrained optimization task and propose a novel three-stage analytical framework integrating semidefinite programming (SDP), augmented Lagrangian method (ALM), and second-order cone programming (SOCP), which enforces constraints more rigorously and achieves higher-quality solutions. First, we adopt a two-step SDP formulation to obtain a robust initialization in the non-convex search space. Next, we incorporate differentiable objectives and constraints into an incremental ALM to jointly handle coupled design constraints during global floorplanning. Finally, an SOCP-based legalization strictly enforces feasibility while further reducing area. Experiments on the FloorSet benchmark show that our method satisfies all constraints with the fastest runtime. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, it reduces wirelength and area by 90\% and 16\% on average, and achieves near-optimal results, with wirelength and area being merely 2\% and 1\% larger than the ground-truth references, respectively.

</details>


### [831] [ChroNoC: A Tableless TDM Circuit-Switched NoC With Delay-Aware Deployment for Time-Sensitive Neuromorphic Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34083)
*Mohammad Rasoul Roshanshah,Mehdi Modarressi,Saeed Safari*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出软硬件协同设计的无表TDM NoC（ChroNoC）与延迟感知部署方法DARSA，在保证确定时延的同时显著降低能耗与通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间敏感神经形态架构需可预测互连以保持事件时序，但静态TDM电路交换NoC存在配置存储随调度深度线性增长、任务放置/路由/调度联合优化搜索空间不可解、以及忽略轴突延迟导致注入拥塞等问题。

Method: 硬件上将预计算的全网格广播树嵌入组合逻辑作为固定路由基座，实现无表TDM交换，从而把部署问题简化为空间搜索；软件上提出DARSA（延迟感知预留与空间退火），将轴突延迟转化为周期性调度松弛，错开网络注入。

Result: 130nm CMOS下每跳能耗较电路交换与包交换基线降低75%以上；在UCI-HAR和N-MNIST上，每时间步通信周期相比立即传输分别减少约60%和45%，同时降低预留通信存储。

Conclusion: 轻量TDM交换设计与延迟感知部署相结合，可在保持神经事件时序的同时提升硬件效率与系统级通信性能。

Abstract: Time-sensitive neuromorphic architectures require predictable interconnects to preserve precise event timing. Statically scheduled time-division-multiplexed (TDM) circuit-switched networks-on-chip (NoCs) provide deterministic latency at the cost of linear configuration-memory scaling with schedule depth. Furthermore, jointly optimizing task placement, routing, and scheduling creates an intractable combinatorial search space. Existing deployment frameworks also ignore algorithmic axonal delays by forcing immediate spike injections that increase network contention. This paper proposes a hardware-software co-design to address these challenges. ChroNoC is a tableless TDM NoC that embeds precomputed full-grid broadcast trees into combinational logic as a fixed routing substrate. This fixed substrate reduces deployment to a spatial search via Delay-Aware Reservations and Spatial Annealing (DARSA). DARSA converts axonal delays into periodic scheduling slack to stagger network injections and reduce communication overhead. In a 130nm CMOS process, ChroNoC reduces per-hop energy consumption by more than 75% relative to the evaluated circuit- and packet-switched baselines. On UCI-HAR and N-MNIST workloads, DARSA reduces per-timestep communication cycles by approximately 60% and 45%, respectively, compared with immediate transmission, while also reducing provisioned communication memory. These results demonstrate how combining lightweight TDM switch design with delay-aware deployment improves both hardware efficiency and system-level communication performance while preserving neural event timing.

</details>


### [832] [MCF: A Memory- and Communication-Aware Co-Designed Framework for Long-Context LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34731)
*Huaizhi Zhang,Jiacheng Zhu,Xuqi Zhu,Junkyu Lee,Klaus McDonald-Maier,Xiaojun Zhai*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: MCF：面向长上下文LLM推理的内存与通信感知框架，通过阶段自适应KV-cache布局转换、内存感知复制调度（MARS）与query-centric解码，配合FPGA compute-NIC执行层，显著提升TTFT、吞吐与可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理中，KV cache 体量随上下文线性增长，带来显存压力与跨worker通信开销激增；prefill–decode边界需昂贵的布局转换，且解码阶段KV传输成本随上下文长度上升。

Method: 1) MARS：面向chunked prefill的动态编排，利用早期显存余量选择性复制高复用KV块以提升局部性并把KV传播延迟隐藏在注意力计算后；随prefill推进逐步回收冗余副本，将KV cache收敛为可解码的分片布局，避免prefill–decode边界的布局转换。2) 解码采用query-centric执行模型：KV分片固定，轻量query张量在worker间路由，将通信从KV-cache依赖转为query依赖。3) 软硬件协同：基于FPGA compute-NIC数据通路执行层，在网络路径内完成元数据驱动的KV路由与集合通信。

Result: 相比SOTA分布式推理系统，MCF在TTFT、吞吐与可扩展性上均有提升，且收益随上下文长度与集群规模增大而扩大。

Conclusion: 通过阶段自适应KV布局、query-centric解码与网内计算协同设计，MCF有效缓解长上下文推理的内存与通信瓶颈，具备良好的规模扩展性。

Abstract: This paper presents Memory- and Communication-Aware Framework for Long-Context LLM Inference (MCF) that optimizes long-context inference through communication-aware and stage-adaptive KV-cache layout transitions. At the core of MCF is {Memory-Aware Replication and Scheduling} (MARS), a dynamic orchestration mechanism for chunked prefill. MARS exploits early-stage memory headroom by selectively replicating highly reused KV blocks, improving locality and hiding KV propagation latency behind attention computation. As prefill progresses and memory pressure increases, MARS progressively drains redundant replicas and converges the KV cache into a sharded decode-ready layout, avoiding expensive layout conversion at the prefill--decode boundary. For decoding, MCF adopts a query-centric execution model in which KV shards remain stationary while lightweight query tensors are routed across workers. This changes communication from KV-cache-dependent transfer to query-dependent transfer, reducing communication growth with context length. MCF further integrates a hardware-software co-designed execution layer based on an FPGA compute-NIC datapath, enabling metadata-driven KV routing and collective operations directly in the network path. Experiments show that MCF improves TTFT, throughput, and scalability over state-of-the-art distributed inference systems, with larger benefits as context length and cluster size increase.

</details>


### [833] [SPARTA: A Sparse Ternary LLM Accelerator with Adaptive Attention and Unified Datapath for Long-Context Edge Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34824)
*Yanzhen Zhou,Zhengyu Han,Qunyou Liu,Zheyu Yan,Weihong Xu,Cheng Zhuo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: SPARTA 是一种面向边缘设备长上下文推理的稀疏三值 LLM 加速器，通过分阶段稀疏数据流、统一计算阵列和自适应两阶段注意力引擎降低 KV 缓存流量与硬件开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备上的 LLM 受限于内存与带宽。1.58-bit 三值权重虽大幅压缩存储，但长上下文推理的瓶颈已转向 KV-cache 流量与注意力计算；同时现有加速器对三值线性层与注意力采用分离数据通路，带来额外硬件与执行开销。

Method: SPARTA 整合三项设计：(1) 分阶段感知的稀疏数据流，利用计算密集的 prefill 与访存密集的 decode 之间的异构稀疏性；(2) 统一计算阵列，将三值 SpMM/SpMV 与 bit-serial 注意力映射到共享处理单元，以利用零权重和零比特稀疏性；(3) 自适应两阶段注意力引擎，用页级 Top-k 选择减少 K-cache 访问，用 token 级 Top-p 剪枝减少 V-cache 流量。

Result: KV 流量相较全注意力降低 4.1–4.8 倍，相较先进稀疏注意力方案降低 1.3–1.5 倍（有任务相关的质量损失）。相比 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin，生成吞吐提升 3.9 倍、端到端能效提升 8.3 倍；相比 AMD Ryzen 7 9700X，分别提升 5.0 倍与 81.7 倍。相比 FIGLUT、TeLLMe 与 MCBP，吞吐提升 1.6–12.0 倍、能效提升 2.0–4.2 倍、面积效率提升 1.3–51.4 倍。

Conclusion: 通过跨稀疏性、跨数据通路的统一设计与两阶段注意力剪枝，SPARTA 在边缘长上下文场景下显著缓解 KV 流量瓶颈，并在吞吐、能效与面积效率上全面优于 CPU/边缘 GPU 基线及专用三值加速器。

Abstract: LLMs on edge devices are constrained by limited memory and bandwidth. Although 1.58-bit ternary weights greatly reduce model storage, long-context inference is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache traffic and attention. Existing accelerators also use separate datapaths for ternary linear layers and attention, incurring hardware and execution overhead. We present SPARTA, a sparse ternary LLM accelerator for efficient long-context edge inference. SPARTA integrates: (1) a phase-aware sparse dataflow exploiting heterogeneous sparsity across compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decode; (2) a unified compute fabric mapping ternary SpMM/SpMV and bit-serial attention onto shared processing elements to exploit zero-weight and zero-bit sparsity; and (3) an adaptive two-stage attention engine combining page-level Top-k selection to reduce K-cache accesses with token-level Top-p pruning to reduce V-cache traffic. SPARTA reduces KV traffic by 4.1-4.8x over full attention and 1.3-1.5x over a state-of-the-art sparse-attention scheme, with task-dependent quality loss. Compared with NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, SPARTA achieves 3.9x higher generation throughput and 8.3x higher end-to-end energy efficiency on average; versus AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, the gains are 5.0x and 81.7x. It also delivers 1.6-12.0x higher throughput, 2.0-4.2x higher energy efficiency, and 1.3-51.4x higher area efficiency than FIGLUT, TeLLMe, and MCBP.

</details>


### [834] [PaFeDSE: Pareto-Feedback-Guided Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration for Efficient Pareto Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34838)
*Joonyong Park,Hyojeong Lee,Sejeong Yang,Joo-Young Kim*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: PaFeDSE是一个以Pareto反馈引导的微架构设计空间探索框架，利用Pareto命中/未命中反馈优先探索前沿改进候选并抑制无效区域，同时过滤冗余候选，从而显著减少仿真次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代乱序处理器的微架构设计需在性能、功耗、面积间权衡，穷举式评估代价高昂；现有基于机器学习的设计空间探索仍将昂贵仿真浪费在不改进Pareto前沿的候选上，并在迭代中反复处理冗余候选，效率不足。

Method: 提出PaFeDSE框架：利用Pareto-hit反馈优先处理可能改进前沿的候选；利用Pareto-miss反馈抑制对无望局部区域的探索；并对跨迭代持续低优先级的冗余候选进行自适应过滤。

Result: 在SPEC CPU 2017负载上，达到目标超体积水平所需仿真次数比最强基线最多减少49.0%，并通过自适应候选过滤实现7.1倍的探索开销降低。

Conclusion: 将Pareto命中/未命中反馈引入微架构DSE的候选选择与冗余过滤，可有效提升Pareto搜索效率，在保证前沿质量的同时大幅降低仿真与探索开销。

Abstract: Efficient microarchitecture design space exploration (DSE) is critical for optimizing performance, power, and area trade-offs in modern out-of-order processors. While machine-learning-based DSE significantly reduces the cost of exhaustively evaluating large design spaces, existing methods still waste expensive simulations on Pareto-miss candidates that do not improve the Pareto frontier and repeatedly process redundant candidates during iterative exploration. In this paper, we propose PaFeDSE, a Pareto-feedback-guided microarchitecture DSE framework for efficient Pareto search. PaFeDSE leverages Pareto-hit feedback to prioritize candidates likely to improve the frontier and Pareto-miss feedback to suppress exploration of unpromising local regions, while filtering redundant candidates that remain low priority across iterations. Evaluated on SPEC CPU 2017 workloads, PaFeDSE requires up to 49.0% fewer simulations than the strongest prior baseline to reach target hypervolume levels, while achieving a 7.1x reduction in exploration overhead through adaptive candidate filtering.

</details>


### [835] [Detection of Single Stuck-at and Bridging Faults in Cluster-based FPGA Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35026)
*Nachiketa Das,Sudip Ghosh,H. Rahaman*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于簇结构FPGA的测试技术，利用同一组由TPG电路生成的测试向量，同时检测固定型（stuck-at）与桥接（bridging）故障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 簇结构FPGA架构中需要高效的内建自测试手段，而单一测试向量集同时覆盖固定型与桥接故障可降低测试开销。

Method: 在FPGA内部生成被测模块（BUT）、测试图案生成器（TPG）与输出响应分析电路；通过测试逻辑结构配置逻辑单元，比较两个分离逻辑单元的输出以检测故障；给出TPG、BUT与输出响应分析的配置方案，并按特定顺序施加同一组测试向量。

Result: 详细分析结果表明，按特定序列施加同一测试向量集并经输出结果分析，可检测所有固定型与桥接故障。

Conclusion: 该技术以单一测试向量集实现多类故障覆盖，具有较低测试成本，适用于簇结构FPGA的内建测试。

Abstract: This paper presents a new technique for detecting single stuck-at and bridging faults in cluster-based FPGA architectures, using same set of test vectors generated by a test pattern generator circuitry. This technique is based on configuration of logic elements using test logic structure and the outputs of two separated logic elements are compared to detect a fault. To do this, block under test, TPG and output response analysis circuitry are generated in FPGAs. The configurations of test pattern generation, block under test and output response analysis are also discussed in this paper. The novelty lies in the fact that the same set of test vectors can detect all the stuck-at as well as bridging faults if the test vectors are applied in a particular sequence and analyzing the output results. We presented a detail analysis of results to detect faults as well.

</details>


### [836] [Whole-Route Planning of a Memory Bus Between Two BGAs: An Exact Model of Crossings and Layer Changes, Negotiated to DRC-Clean Copper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35601)
*Andrew Haas*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种面向PCB的BGA-to-BGA双层总线布线路由器，以精确约束规划模型统一决定所有走线的交叉位置、交叉次序与换层次序，并结合LP放置、割反馈与协商拥塞定价，在Allwinner H3与Zynq-7020实际板上实现全部走线连通、DRC干净且过孔与铜量均优于人工设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PCB上处理器与DRAM之间的总线布线仍主要依赖人工，已有算法只优化交叉数、层数等代理指标，缺乏在铺铜前对整条总线的全局规划，也难以保证结果满足生产路由器的设计规则。

Method: 核心是精确约束规划模型：一次性为所有lane决定必需交叉的发生位置、由覆盖lane三元组的规则确定的交叉次序、以及带过孔空间的换层位置；两端给定时可证模型内最优。模型可类比为worldlines、frustrated Ising spins与接触力的物理表述。随后用线性规划在毫米尺度放置lane，将违反的约束作为割返回模型，审计发现以协商拥塞价格反馈，迭代至通过生产路由器规则审计或直接布通。逃逸路径按同一目标估计选取；差分对保持极性，端部不一致时自动用过孔交叉处理。

Result: 在Allwinner H3与Zynq-7020（各接DDR3）上，两级阶梯测试全部完成，H3最多51条net（整条总线）、Zynq最多43条，均连通且DRC干净；顶层过孔数不劣于人工（80 vs 88、62 vs 100），铜量始终更少。对比工具的生产路由器在十个阶梯中有四个留下开路net，Freerouting一个也未完成。在Zynq板本体上完成45条总线net、70个过孔，人工为105个。三层、四层、六层生成总线上每次运行均完成，凡已知最优者均达到最优。

Conclusion: 该工作将双层总线的交叉与换层规划表述为可精确求解、可证最优的约束规划问题，并与LP放置、割与拥塞定价形成闭环，在实际与生成基准上稳定超越人工与现有路由器，为总线布线提供了从规划到洁净铜的一体化自动方案。

Abstract: Routing the bus between a processor and its DRAM remains largely manual in printed circuit board (PCB) design, and published algorithms optimize proxies such as crossing or layer counts. We present a router that plans every lane of a two-layer BGA-to-BGA bus before any copper is laid, and carries the plan to design-rule-clean copper. Its core is an exact constraint-programming model that chooses, for all lanes at once, where each necessary crossing occurs, in what order -- by a rule over every triple of lanes -- and where each lane changes layer, with via room; for the ends it is given, it proves its plan optimal within the model. The model reads naturally as physics: worldlines, frustrated Ising spins and contact forces. A linear program places the lanes in millimeters; the constraints it must violate return to the model as cuts, and audit findings as negotiated congestion prices, until the plan passes an audit against the production router's rules or lays clean. The escapes are chosen by an estimate of the same objective, and differential pairs carry their polarity, with an automatic via crossover where the ends disagree. On an Allwinner H3 and a Zynq-7020, each to a DDR3 device, the router completes every rung of two ladders, of up to 51 nets on the H3 (its whole bus) and 43 on the Zynq, connected and DRC-clean, never with more vias than the human designer (80 against 88 and 62 against 100 at the top rungs) and always with less copper, where the toolkit's production router leaves nets open on four of the ten rungs and Freerouting completes none. On the Zynq board itself it completes 45 of the bus's nets with 70 vias to the designer's 105. On generated buses of three, four and six routing layers every run completes, and every one with a known optimum attains it.

</details>


<div id='physics.app-ph'></div>

# physics.app-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [837] [Polarized X-rays from table-top free-electron-driven van der Waals crystals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33774)
*Nikhil Pramanik,Sunchao Huang,Ruihuan Duan,Lee Wei Wesley Wong,Qingwei Zhai,Wen Wei Lee,Zheng Liu,Liang Jie Wong*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 该文从理论与实验上证明，由自由电子驱动的范德华晶体可直接产生线偏振X射线，无需偏振器等额外光学环节；仅通过重新取向晶体即可实时、精确调控偏振，且在各偏振角下均能获得高偏振度，强度超过10^9 photons s^-1 sr^-1 mA^-1，并据此提出性能接近同步辐射的台式XANES方案（ORIXANES）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏振X射线是XANES、磁性显微与荧光成像等偏振敏感技术的基础，对光伏、催化、光电子学等清洁能源与可持续材料研究至关重要；但当前可调偏振与光子能量的偏振X射线仅能由同步辐射等大型装置提供，制约了可及性并带来较高碳足迹。

Method: 以自由电子驱动范德华晶体作为辐射源，理论预测并结合实验验证线偏振X射线的产生；通过改变晶体取向实现偏振的实时精确调控，并系统表征偏振度与强度随偏振角（从垂直至面内）的变化；进而设计基于该源的台式XANES方案，并提出利用较宽谱线宽的高质量偏振X射线开展XANES的新方法ORIXANES。

Result: 实验证实无需偏振器即可获得线偏振X射线；晶体重取向可实现偏振的实时精确控制；在所有偏振角（垂直至面内）均实现高偏振度，强度超过10^9 photons s^-1 sr^-1 mA^-1；所提台式XANES方案性能可与同步辐射装置相当。

Conclusion: 自由电子驱动范德华晶体可作为紧凑、可调偏振的X射线源，使先进X射线测量 modalities 更易获得并降低碳足迹，为台式偏振敏感X射线谱学与成像开辟新途径。

Abstract: Polarized X-rays are essential for polarization-sensitive techniques such as X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy, magnetic microscopy, and fluorescence imaging. These techniques are crucial in the study of molecular and material dynamics, which are in turn central to driving the global transition to clean energy and sustainability through research in photovoltaics, catalysis and optoelectronics. Currently, polarized X-rays with tunable polarization and photon energy are available only in large facilities like synchrotrons. Here, we theoretically predict and experimentally demonstrate the generation of linearly polarized X-rays from free electron-driven van der Waals crystals, without the need for additional optical stages like polarizers. We show that precise, real-time control over the polarization can be achieved by simply re-orienting the van der Waals crystal. Furthermore, we show that a high degree of polarization can be achieved across all polarization angles - from perpendicular to in-plane - with intensities exceeding 10^9 photons s^(-1) sr^(-1) mA^(-1). Using our findings, we present a scheme for table-top XANES, achieving performance comparable to that of synchrotron facilities. In the process, we develop a new methodology for performing XANES using high-quality polarized X-rays with larger spectral linewidths, named ORIXANES (Orientation-controlled XANES). Our findings pave the way to greater accessibility and smaller carbon footprint for advanced X-ray modalities.

</details>


### [838] [Suppression of Sedimentation in Polystyrene Microsphere Suspensions via Femtosecond Laser Irradiation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34232)
*Hafsa Moazzamia,Irem Hazal Tan,Alpan Bek,Sinan Genc*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 飞秒激光(1030 nm)辐照可在弱机械搅拌条件下减缓水中8 μm聚苯乙烯微球的沉降,机制为激光驱动的对流(光热流动),而非光力、Kerr效应或光化学作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微米级、密度大于介质的颗粒在数小时内即从悬浮液中沉降,而布朗运动不足以阻止沉降;需要一种非接触手段在不改变颗粒本身的前提下抑制沉降。

Method: 对三种浓度的8 μm聚苯乙烯/水悬浮液,在弱声学扰动或强磁力搅拌下处理至多3 h,每种条件均设与不设同步飞秒激光辐照的配对对照;以角分辨Mie散射光学定量探测体积内残留颗粒数,并监测Mie极大角位置以检验颗粒是否破碎或团聚;辅以量级分析排除光力、光学Kerr效应和瞬态光化学。

Result: 声学扰动下,12组配对比较中有11组辐照提高了颗粒保持率(各浓度均如此),平均提高0.17,而等分样品间测量散布为0.02;第12组落在该散布范围内。磁力搅拌下本身已保持大部分颗粒悬浮,辐照无可分辨变化。3 h内Mie极大角位置变化约1%以内,表明颗粒既未破碎也未团聚。

Conclusion: 飞秒激光辐照可作为一种非接触、辅助性的扰动源来减缓沉降,在机械混合较弱时最有效;其机理是水吸收激光功率所驱动的对流,流速远高于1.8 μm/s的沉降速度,而非光学力或颗粒性质改变。

Abstract: Micrometer-sized particles denser than their medium settle out of suspension within hours, and Brownian motion is too weak to prevent it. We report that femtosecond laser irradiation at 1030 nm slows this settling in suspensions of 8 um polystyrene microspheres in water, without altering the particles themselves. Suspensions at three concentrations were treated for up to 3 h under weak acoustic agitation or vigorous magnetic stirring, each with and without simultaneous irradiation, and the particles remaining in the probe volume were quantified optically by angle-resolved Mie scattering. Under acoustic agitation, irradiation raised retention in eleven of twelve paired comparisons, at every concentration, by 0.17 on average against a measured aliquot-to-aliquot scatter of 0.02; the twelfth comparison lies within that scatter. Under stirring, which already keeps most particles suspended, it produces no resolvable change. The angular positions of the Mie maxima are unchanged to within about 1% over 3 h, so the particles are neither fragmented nor aggregated and the effect arises from particle transport rather than from changes in the particles. An order-of-magnitude analysis rules out optical forces, the optical Kerr effect, and transient photochemistry, and leaves laser-driven convection: the power absorbed by the water sustains flows orders of magnitude faster than the 1.8 um/s settling velocity. Femtosecond irradiation therefore acts as a non-contact, supplementary agitation source, most effective where mechanical mixing is weak.

</details>

### [839] [Impact of Synchronization Offsets and CSI Feedback Delays on Coherent Joint Transmission in Distributed MIMO-OFDM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33181)
*Kumar Sai Bondada,Daniel J. Jakubisin,R. Michael Buehrer*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文量化了分布式MIMO-OFDM中相干联合传输对同步误差与CSI反馈时延的敏感度，推导了含残余定时/频偏/采样钟偏/相位噪声及CSI滞后信道变化下的接收信号与频谱效率模型，并给出保持SE损失可忽略的同步需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式CJT依赖跨地理分离发射机的相位、频率与定时对齐才能相干合并，因此对发射机相关的同步损伤远比集中式MIMO敏感；需明确各同步误差与CSI反馈时延对容量损失的定量影响，以指导系统设计。

Method: 建立包含残余定时偏移、载波频偏(CFO)、采样钟偏(SCO)、相位噪声以及CSI反馈时延期间信道变化的接收信号模型；据此推导频谱效率(SE)表达式，刻画残余相位旋转导致的相干合并增益损失、载波间干扰(ICI)与预编码失配对容量的影响；对SE表达式进行数值评估以确定同步需求。

Result: 起始时刻抖动服从高斯分布且标准差低于采样周期的10%时SE退化可忽略，SE损失由0 dB SNR时的0.68%降至40 dB时的0.17%；归一化CFO标准差0.001时ICI退化可忽略，SE损失由0 dB时0.05%升至40 dB时2%；在26 dB SNR、SE损失限制为5%条件下，3.5 GHz载频、30 kHz子载波间隔、15.36 MHz采样率下可行工作点为：时钟误差标准差达50 ppb、多普勒-时延积达0.1、相位跟踪误差标准差达40°。

Conclusion: 分布式CJT的SE损失随SNR升高而增大（相干合并对残余相位误差更敏感），定时抖动与CFO可用相对采样周期/归一化标准差的门限刻画；所给同步容限为分布式MIMO-OFDM系统的同步设计与参数选择提供了定量依据。

Abstract: This paper studies the impact of synchronization offsets and CSI feedback delay on coherent joint transmission (CJT) in distributed MIMO-OFDM systems. Unlike conventional co-located MIMO, distributed CJT is highly sensitive to transmitter-dependent synchronization impairments because coherent combining requires phase, frequency, and timing alignment across geographically separated transmitters. Received signal models are derived for residual timing offsets, carrier frequency offsets (CFOs), sampling clock offsets (SCOs), phase noise, and channel variations accumulated during channel state information (CSI) feedback delay. The corresponding spectral efficiency (SE) expressions quantify the degradation in capacity due to loss in coherent-combining gain caused by residual phase rotations, inter-carrier interference (ICI), and precoder misalignment. The SE expressions are numerically evaluated to determine synchronization requirements for maintaining negligible SE degradation, yielding the following findings: a Gaussian-distributed start-time jitter with a standard deviation below 10\% of the sampling period results in negligible SE degradation, with the SE loss decreasing from 0.68\% at an SNR of 0 dB to 0.17\% at 40 dB. A normalized CFO standard deviation of 0.001 also results in negligible ICI-induced degradation, with the SE loss increasing from 0.05\% at an SNR of 0 dB to 2\% at 40 dB. At an SNR of 26 dB, limiting the SE loss to 5\% yields feasible operating points with clock-error standard deviations up to 50 ppb, Doppler-delay products up to 0.1, and phase-tracking error standard deviations up to $40^{\circ}$ at carrier frequency of 3.5 GHz with 30 kHz sub-carrier spacing with 15.36 MHz sampling rate.

</details>


### [840] [Physical Layer Security in Chirp Permuted AFBM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33276)
*Pedro Schuves Marodin,Henrique L. Senger,Gustavo P. Gonçalves,Hyeon Seok Rou,Bruno S. Chang,Giuseppe Thadeu Freitas de Abreu,Didier Le Ruyet*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 论文为6G通感一体化（ISAC）波形AFBM提出一种物理层安全方案：对AFBM中两个离散仿射傅里叶变换（预编码与扩频）各使用一个密钥对chirp序列进行置乱，使错误密钥在DFT作用下退化为稠密矩阵、破坏复正交性并引入滤波器组干扰，从而在双色散信道下使窃听者误码率保持在0.5附近。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AFBM面向6G ISAC场景，其安全传输问题尚未被充分研究；需要一种不依赖上层加密、能在物理层直接抑制窃听的机制。

Method: AFBM包含两个离散仿射傅里叶变换，分别用于预编码与扩频；所提方案对每个变换各配一个秘密密钥，对变换在两个傅里叶级之间插入的chirp序列进行置换。错误密钥经离散傅里叶变换共轭后变为稠密矩阵，复正交性恢复失败，固有滤波器组干扰进入检测器。

Result: 在双色散信道下，具备完美信道状态信息、与合法接收机同址且任一密钥错误的窃听者，其误码率维持在0.5附近、速率低于0.09 bit/symbol；在盲载波相位攻击下同样有效。与单置换方案相比，双置换方案峰值平均功率比增加约2 dB，搜索空间由10^61扩大至10^93。

Conclusion: 双密钥置换为AFBM提供了一种有效的物理层安全增强，以约2 dB的PAPR代价换取更大的密钥空间与稳健的抗窃听性能。

Abstract: We propose a physical-layer security scheme for affine filter bank modulation (AFBM), a waveform proposed for sixth-generation (6G) integrated sensing and communications (ISAC). AFBM contains two discrete affine Fourier transforms, one for precoding and one for spreading, and the scheme permutes, with one secret key per transform, the chirp sequence that each transform places between two Fourier stages. A wrong key is then conjugated by a discrete Fourier transform into a dense matrix, the restoration of complex orthogonality fails, and the intrinsic filter-bank interference reaches the detector. Over a doubly-dispersive channel, an eavesdropper with perfect channel state information, co-located with the legitimate receiver and holding either key wrong, keeps a bit error rate near 0.5 and a rate below 0.09 bit/symbol, also under a blind carrier-phase attack. Compared with a single-permutation variant, the double scheme costs about 2 dB of peak-to-average power ratio and enlarges the search space from 10^61 to 10^93.

</details>


### [841] [Graph Spectral Series and Its Signatures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33348)
*Feng Ji,Jingyang Dai,Apostolos Evangelidis,Xingchao Jian,Marco Rauscher,Alexander Schell*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 针对图信号处理中许多信号并非带限的问题，作者提出将图傅里叶谱视为有序序列（图谱序列），并用路径签名对其进行表示，从而在不做频率截断的前提下捕捉全局谱结构；理论刻画了表示的连续性与信息保持性，给出扩张图序列下的渐近解释，实验表明签名特征在趋势预测和变化检测任务上优于直接基于原始图信号的表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带限性是图信号处理（GSP）的核心建模假设，但实际中大量图信号在整个图频域上都有显著能量，即非带限信号。传统谱表示依赖频率截断，难以刻画这类信号的全局谱结构。作者观察到非带限图谱常呈现粗糙的、类时间序列的行为，因此希望建立一种不做截断、能刻画全局谱结构的表示框架。

Method: 提出"图谱序列"（graph spectral series）概念，将图傅里叶谱作为有序序列处理；借鉴粗糙路径理论，用路径签名（path signatures）对该有序谱序列进行表示，以无需频率截断的方式编码全局谱结构。理论上推导该表示连续性的成立条件，刻画其信息保持（information-preserving）性质，并对扩张图序列（expanding graphs）给出图谱序列的渐近解释。

Result: 在真实世界的趋势预测与变化检测任务上，基于签名特征的方法相比直接使用原始图信号的表示取得了性能提升，验证了签名特征对非带限图信号的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作为非带限图信号分析提供了一种新的、有理论依据的基于签名的工具：通过将图谱视为序列并用路径签名表示，避免了带限假设与频率截断的限制，并具备连续性与信息保持性等理论保证，在实际任务中表现优于原始信号表示。

Abstract: Bandlimitedness is a central modeling assumption in graph signal processing (GSP), but many graph signals exhibit substantial energy throughout the graph-frequency domain. We introduce a new framework for analyzing such non-bandlimited signals by treating their graph Fourier spectra as ordered sequences and representing them with path signatures. Specifically, motivated by the observation that non-bandlimited graph spectra often display rough, time-series like behavior, we introduce the notion of graph spectral series and develop a signature-based representation that captures global spectral structure without frequency truncation. We establish conditions under which the proposed representation is continuous and characterize its information-preserving properties. We further provide an asymptotic interpretation of graph spectral series for sequences of expanding graphs. Experiments on real-world trend-prediction and change-detection tasks show that signature features can improve performance over representations based directly on the original graph signals. The proposed approach provides a novel principled signature-based tool for analyzing non-bandlimited graph signals.

</details>


### [842] [Automated screening of Parkinson's Disease using Smooth Pursuit Eye Movements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33359)
*J. Camilo Puerta-Acevedo,Maria F. Alcala-Durand,Julián D. Arias-Londoño,Elisa Luque-Buzo,Francisco Grandas-Pérez,Juan I. Godino-Llorente*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本研究利用平滑追踪任务中注视位置序列的复杂度与非线性动力学特征，结合特征选择与SVM专家混合模型，实现帕金森病（PD）的自动筛查，外部测试集AUC达0.86。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平滑追踪眼动在PD中常出现异常，但既有研究主要依赖描述注视与目标关系的常规参数，未能刻画眼动序列的复杂度与非线性动态信息，因此作者试图检验这类度量能否用于PD的自动筛查。

Method: 用视频眼动仪在12个平滑追踪任务中记录41名早期PD患者与47名健康对照的注视位置序列；比较4种实验框架与4种嵌入延迟策略，最终选定"基线漂移去除+固定嵌入延迟"的设置；经特征选择后为每个任务与轴分别训练SVM，并以专家混合（mixture of experts）方式融合输出；流程在70名受试者上开发，另在18人的外部测试集上评估。

Result: 外部测试集上流程的ROC曲线下面积（AUC）为0.86；最具判别力的特征显示PD患者的注视位置序列持续性更低、更不规则，且主要体现在水平轴上。

Conclusion: 复杂度与非线性动力学度量可作为PD筛查的候选标志物，但仍需在更大规模独立队列中验证。

Abstract: Smooth pursuit eye movements are frequently altered in Parkinson's disease, but previous studies have relied mainly on conventional parameters that describe the relationship between gaze and target. This study investigates whether complexity and nonlinear dynamics measures of the gaze position sequences can support the automatic screening of Parkinson's disease. Gaze position sequences were recorded with a video eye tracker in 41 participants with early Parkinson's disease and 47 healthy controls during 12 smooth pursuit tasks. Four experimental frameworks and four embedding delay strategies were compared. The selected experimental setting combined baseline wander removal with a fixed embedding delay. After feature selection, a support vector machine was trained for each task and axis and their outputs were combined in a mixture of experts. The pipeline was developed in 70 participants and evaluated on an external test set of 18 participants. On the external test set, the pipeline obtained an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.86. The most informative features described less persistent and more irregular gaze position sequences in Parkinson's disease, mainly along the horizontal axis. These results support complexity and nonlinear dynamics measures of smooth pursuit as candidate markers for Parkinson's disease screening, pending validation in larger independent cohorts.

</details>


### [843] [Statistical Design of Multi-BD-RIS-Assisted User-Centric Cell-Free Massive MIMO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33415)
*Mohammad Ezaz,Azadeh Vosoughi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究多BD-RIS辅助的用户中心无蜂窝大规模MIMO上行链路，在不完美CSI与导频复用的统计意义下优化BD-RIS散射矩阵，并推导MR合并下有效SINR闭式表达式与遍历SE下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BD-RIS在UC无蜂窝大规模MIMO中可增强覆盖，但频繁CSI获取与RIS重配置开销大，且共享BD-RIS传播路径导致跨AP信道统计相关，现有分析未刻画该相关性及有限导频复用下的估计与SE性能。

Method: 将BD-RIS建模为互易、无损、群连接散射网络；推导各用户到其服务AP聚合信道的MMSE估计统计量；基于长期信道统计以最小化MMSE聚合信道估计器NMSE之和为目标，在对称性与酉性约束下优化散射矩阵，提出乘积流形黎曼优化算法并分析收敛性与复杂度；在CPU端MR合并下推导有效SINR闭式表达式与遍历SE下界，计入跨AP二阶统计。

Result: 中等群连接度可保留全连接的大部分NMSE增益；BD-RIS辅助路径相对直连链路越强，优化增益越大；较低的估计NMSE并不必然带来更高的上行SE。

Conclusion: 基于长期统计的BD-RIS配置可在多个相干块内保持固定，显著降低重配置与CSI开销；群连接BD-RIS是以较低复杂度实现NMSE改善的实用折中；NMSE与SE指标需分别评估。

Abstract: We study the uplink of a user-centric (UC) cell-free massive MIMO system assisted by multiple beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (BD-RISs), under imperfect channel state information (CSI) and pilot reuse. The BD-RISs are modeled as reciprocal, lossless, group-connected scattering networks. We first derive the minimum mean-square error (MMSE) estimation statistics for each user's aggregate channel to its serving access points (APs). To avoid frequent CSI acquisition and RIS reconfiguration, we optimize the BD-RIS scattering matrices using long-term channel statistics, allowing their configurations to remain fixed over multiple coherence blocks. Specifically, we minimize the sum of normalized mean-square errors (NMSEs) of the MMSE aggregate channel estimators, subject to the symmetry and unitarity constraints of the group-connected architecture. We develop a product-manifold Riemannian optimization algorithm and analyze its convergence and computational complexity. To evaluate uplink spectral efficiency (SE), we separately derive a closed-form expression for the effective SINR under maximum ratio (MR) combining at the central processing unit (CPU) and establish a lower bound on the achievable ergodic SE. The SINR derivation accounts for the statistical dependence among channels associated with different APs due to shared BD-RIS-assisted propagation paths, including cross-AP second-order statistics under pilot reuse. Numerical results show that moderate group connectivity retains most of the NMSE improvements achieved by full connectivity, with larger optimization gains as BD-RIS-assisted paths strengthen relative to direct AP-user links. They also reveal that lower estimation NMSE does not necessarily lead to higher uplink SE.

</details>


### [844] [Extended Target Imaging in Non-Ideal Distributed ISAC Systems: A Hierarchical Off-Grid Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33500)
*Xin Tong,Yu Ge,Alireza Pourafzal,Dario Tagliaferri,Henk Wymeersch*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 面向分布式MIMO ISAC系统扩展目标成像中的连续各向异性散射、复杂遮挡与同步误差问题，提出分层两阶段计算成像框架：粗成像初始化+联合离格高分辨成像，并用BiOG-AMP算法迭代求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式MIMO ISAC具备高分辨成像潜力，但真实扩展目标存在连续各向异性表面散射与复杂遮挡，叠加系统时间/相位同步误差，使高质量重建在物理上困难。

Method: 两阶段框架。Phase I：非相干粗成像，通过LOS干扰抑制与全网拓扑约束校准时延和相位偏移，经BP反投影成像并用概率Hough变换（PHT）粗提取目标轮廓，作为可靠初始化。Phase II：建立联合目标位置与姿态的离格补偿模型，以一阶泰勒展开刻画连续面元的Lambertian漫反射与镜面反射；提出双线性离格近似消息传递算法BiOG-AMP，迭代更新表面可见性与字典矩阵以处理遮挡与网格失配，并强制分布式收发视角的物理一致性。理论推导给出压缩感知误差界、Fisher信息极限与线性化误差缩放。

Result: 仿真表明该框架能有效消除成像伪影，在同步偏移与网格失配下相较现有先进基线具有更优鲁棒性；理论上给出压缩感知误差界、Fisher信息界及线性化误差缩放关系。

Conclusion: 分层"粗到精"设计将同步校准、轮廓先验与离格稀疏重建结合，可提升分布式MIMO ISAC扩展目标成像在非理想条件下的稳健性与分辨率。

Abstract: In future integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems, distributed multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) architectures offer high-resolution imaging capabilities. However, reconstructing real-world extended targets is physically challenging due to continuous anisotropic surface scattering and complex occlusions, especially in the presence of system synchronization errors. To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes a hierarchical two-stage computational imaging framework for extended target reconstruction. In Phase I, an incoherent coarse imaging process is performed to serve as a reliable initializer for subsequent high-resolution coherent image generation. By performing line-of-sight (LOS) interference suppression and leveraging network-wide topological constraints, timing and phase offsets are calibrated. This enables image construction by back-projection (BP) and the coarse identification of target contours using the probabilistic Hough transform (PHT). In Phase II, a joint target position and orientation off-grid compensation model is established, capturing Lambertian diffuse and specular reflections on continuous facets via a first-order Taylor expansion. To tackle severe occlusion and spatial grid mismatches, we propose the bilinear off-grid approximate message passing (BiOG-AMP) algorithm. BiOG-AMP iteratively updates surface visibility and dictionary matrices, enforcing physical consistency across distributed transceiver views. Theoretical analysis derives compressed sensing error bounds, Fisher information limits, and linearization error scaling. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively eliminates imaging artifacts and exhibits superior robustness against synchronization offsets and grid mismatches compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [845] [Cross-Band Movable-Antenna Communications under Frequency-Dependent Multipath](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33535)
*Guangchen Wang,Zhifeng Tang,Haiyao Yu,Nan Yang,Salman Durrani,Xiangyun Zhou*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究多频段下共享同一物理配置的可移动天线（MA）下行通信系统，建模频率相关多径信道，建立跨频段空间缩放关系与增益/和速率上界，提出CAGO算法与跨频段图Transformer(CBGT)以降低在线复杂度，数值结果验证关系并显示CAGO优于窄带/宽带/固定天线基准、接近理想独立MA基准，CBGT在线细化后性能接近CAGO且在线开销显著更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MA研究多集中于单频段或连续宽带传输，频率相关多径下MA的跨频段空间行为尚未被充分探索；而多频段共享同一物理MA配置会因各频段偏好配置差异而产生固有配置冲突。

Method: 构建共享传播几何、但多径分量功率与相位随频段变化的频率相关多径信道模型；以用户-频段分配、MA定位与发射预编码联合优化建立和速率最大化问题；推导归一化信道功率的跨频段空间缩放关系，并给出位置无关的信道增益上界与和速率上界；基于此提出跨频段分析引导优化(CAGO)算法及跨频段图Transformer(CBGT)。

Result: 数值结果验证了推导的跨频段空间关系；CAGO稳定优于窄带、宽带与固定天线基准，并接近理想独立MA基准；CBGT结合在线细化以显著更低的在线计算成本达到接近CAGO的和速率性能。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了多频段共享MA配置下的跨频段空间规律，为在多频段通信系统中利用MA空间重构能力提供了兼顾性能与在线复杂度的实用框架。

Abstract: Movable antennas (MAs) provide additional spatial degrees of freedom by adapting their physical positions to the propagation environment. However, existing studies mainly focus on single-band or contiguous wideband transmission, leaving the cross-band spatial behavior of MAs under frequency-dependent multipath propagation largely unexplored. To address this gap, we investigate a downlink multi-band MA communication system where a common physical MA configuration is shared across multiple communication bands. Such sharing induces an inherent configuration conflict, as different bands often favor substantially divergent MA configurations. We first develop a frequency-dependent multipath channel model with shared propagation geometry but band-dependent multipath component powers and phases. Using this model, we formulate a sum-rate maximization problem by jointly optimizing user-band assignment, MA positioning, and transmit precoding. We further establish a cross-band spatial scaling relationship for the normalized channel power and derive both a position-independent channel gain upper bound and a sum-rate upper bound. Based on these results, we propose a cross-band analysis-guided optimization (CAGO) algorithm and a cross-band graph transformer (CBGT) to reduce online optimization complexity. Numerical results validate the derived cross-band spatial relationship and show that CAGO consistently outperforms the narrowband, wideband, and fixed-antenna benchmarks while remaining close to the idealized independent-MA benchmark. Additionally, CBGT with online refinement achieves near-CAGO sum-rate performance with substantially lower online computational cost, providing a practical framework for exploiting the spatial reconfiguration capability of MAs in multi-band communication systems.

</details>


### [846] [A 140.5$μ$W, 99.8% Accuracy, 96.1dB SNR BioZ IC for Real-Time Cell Analysis with On-Demand Push-Pull Excitation and Continuous-Time $ΔΣ$ T-D Readout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33648)
*Jiayang Li,Junzhe Chen,Xin Zhang,Peiqing Li,Liwen Zhang,Navya Nayak,Yating Zou,Xuanyu Liang,Hubin Zhao,Roshan Weerasekera,Xiao Liu,Reza Haqshenas,Dai Jiang,Martin Cryan,Sohmyung Ha,Andreas Demosthenous,Edoardo Charbon,Dinesh Pamunuwa*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种结合按需推挽驱动器与连续时间ΔΣ T-D读出电路的生物阻抗IC，在低功耗下同时实现高SNR与高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物阻抗测量中SNR、精度与功耗之间存在难以兼顾的权衡，本文旨在缓解这一矛盾。

Method: 采用按需推挽驱动器（200μApp输出，THD≤0.14%，功耗80.3μA）与连续时间ΔΣ时间-数字（T-D）读出电路，使用6MHz时钟，在4kΩ负载下实现53.6ps有效时间分辨率（0.1–4Hz噪声积分）。

Result: 峰值SNR达96.1dB，幅度精度99.8%，相位误差0.13°，最大功耗140.5μW。

Conclusion: 该IC验证了按需驱动与连续时间ΔΣ T-D读出的组合可在约140μW级功耗下同时获得高SNR与高幅相精度，有效缓解SNR-精度-功耗权衡。

Abstract: This paper presents a bioimpedance IC combining an on-demand push-pull driver and continuous-time $ΔΣ$ T-D readout to address the trade-off between SNR, accuracy and power consumption. The driver delivers 200$μ$App with $\leq$0.14% THD while consuming 80.3$μ$A. Using a 6MHz clock, the readout achieves 53.6ps effective timing resolution at a 4k$Ω$ load (0.1-4Hz noise integration). The IC achieves 96.1dB peak SNR, 99.8% magnitude accuracy and 0.13$^{\circ}$ phase error at a maximum power consumption of 140.5$μ$W.

</details>


### [847] [Fixed pilot sequences can overstate the gains of learned MIMO-OFDM receivers under power amplifier distortion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33663)
*Mohammad Tasin,Al Imran*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 神经网络接收机可能"记住"训练导频引起的信道估计误差，从而伪造功放补偿能力，须用未见导频和简单基线检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在接近饱和的高效率工作点，功放失真严重，神经网络接收机被用来补偿该失真。但信道由每帧发送的已知导频估计，导频同样经过功放，因而信道估计含与导频序列相关的微小误差。若始终发送同一导频（如Sionna默认设置），该误差固定不变，网络可能学习该误差而非真正补偿功放非线性。

Method: 在仿真的2天线与4天线OFDM链路中测试该效应；结果基于最高信噪比下的二进制导频。比较两类接收机：(1) 每个子载波独立权重的网络；(2) 按开源教程搭建的卷积神经接收机。分别在训练导频与多个未见导频上评估误码率，改变训练时长与功放回退量，并与"跨子载波平滑信道估计"这一无需训练的低复杂度基线对比。

Result: 逐子载波独立权重网络：训练导频下BER降低14–22%，但在所有其他测试导频下反而升高2–18%，且训练越久差距越大。卷积神经接收机：短训练时在训练导频上的增益比未见导频高37个百分点，训练延长至9倍后仍高9个百分点，其中相当部分在线性功放下也出现。差距随功放回退增大而缩小，但在带内失真达到5G限值的区域仍存在。短时延扩展信道下，无需训练的跨子载波信道估计平滑使全部107个测试导频的误码率下降，平均30%。

Conclusion: 固定的训练导频使神经网络可以记忆导频相关的信道估计误差，造成对功放补偿能力的虚高评估；该偏差具有泛化性和持续性。因此学习型接收机必须在未见导频上评估，并与简单基线（如跨子载波平滑）对比。

Abstract: Neural-network receivers are proposed to undo the distortion of a power amplifier driven close to saturation, where it is most efficient. They estimate the channel from pilots, known symbols sent in every frame. The pilots pass through the same amplifier as the data, so the channel estimate carries a small error that depends on the pilot sequence. If one sequence is always sent, as by default in the Sionna simulator, the error never changes, and a network can learn it instead of undoing the amplifier. We tested this in simulated two- and four-antenna orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing links; results are for binary pilots at the highest signal-to-noise ratio tested. A network with separate weights for each subcarrier lowered the bit error rate by 14 to 22% with its training pilot but raised it by 2 to 18% with every other pilot tested, and longer training widened this gap. A convolutional neural receiver following an open-source tutorial gained 37 percentage points more on its training pilot than on unseen pilots after short training, and 9 points more after nine times longer training, much of which also appeared with a linear amplifier. The gap shrank with amplifier back-off but persisted where the in-band distortion meets the 5G limit. On a channel with short delay spread, smoothing the channel estimate across subcarriers without training lowered the error rate on all 107 pilot sequences tested, by 30% on average. Learned receivers should therefore be tested on unseen pilots and against such simple baselines.

</details>


### [848] [Gain Before Tracking: Compensating Power-Amplifier Nonlinearity and Phase Noise in AFDM Uplinks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33672)
*Mohammad Tasin,Sadman Sakib Rahman*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 针对AFDM接收机无法同时校正功放压缩与相位噪声的问题，作者指出AFDM变换各分量幅度相等，使功放效应退化为统一增益、相位噪声退化为公共旋转，且须先校正增益再跟踪相位；该方案在分数多普勒信道下降低误码率7.5–12%，并可与导频方案相当且无额外开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AFDM被视为高速移动车辆与卫星场景的候选波形，但实际发射机存在功放（PA）压缩与振荡器相位噪声，而现有AFDM接收机无法同时对二者进行校正。

Method: 利用AFDM变换对每个分量在幅度上一视同仁的特性，将PA效应归结为所有分量共享的单一增益，将相位噪声归结为公共旋转，再由OFDM标准相位跟踪器消除；并强调处理顺序：先校正增益，再进行依赖判决的相位跟踪。给出闭式增益估计，并与盲估计及需6%开销的基于导频的联合增益估计进行对比。

Result: 在六径、分数多普勒、256子载波、符合标准的PA回退条件下，该方法使AFDM未编码误比特率降低7.5–12%，OFDM约降低5%；在速率3/4编码、10%误块率下节省0.5 dB；轻回退时效果不显著。闭式增益与盲估计吻合，且无需导频即可与导频方案性能相当。对照实验显示AFDM相对OFDM的优势主要来自信道上的扩频而非多普勒鲁棒性，DFT-s-OFDM在同等回退下可达到相同性能。

Conclusion: 非线性失真的校正应遵循“先增益、后相位”的顺序；AFDM的性能增益在本文设置下主要源于扩频效应，而非多普勒稳健性，单载波DFT-s-OFDM在等回退条件下与之相当。

Abstract: Affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) is a candidate waveform for fast-moving vehicles and satellites, but real transmitters add power-amplifier (PA) compression and oscillator phase noise, and no AFDM receiver corrects both. We show that AFDM's transform treats every component equally in magnitude, so the PA's effect reduces to one gain shared by all components and phase noise to a common rotation that OFDM's standard tracker removes. The order matters: the tracker relies on symbol decisions that PA compression corrupts, so the gain should be corrected first. On a six-path, fractional-Doppler channel with 256 subcarriers and a standard-compliant PA back-off, doing so lowers the uncoded bit-error rate by 7.5-12% for AFDM and about 5% for OFDM, and saves 0.5 dB at 10% block error with a rate-3/4 code; the effect is not significant at light back-off. A closed-form gain matches a blind estimate and, without pilots, performs comparably to a pilot-based joint gain estimate that costs 6% overhead. Controls show that AFDM's edge over OFDM is mostly spreading across the channel, not Doppler robustness: single-carrier DFT-s-OFDM matches it at equal back-off.

</details>


### [849] [Agentic Digital Twin-Assisted Multimodal Predictive Handover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33833)
*Afan Ali,Ali Arshad Nasir,Naveed Iqbal,Daniel Benevides da Costa*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出模型无关的"智能体数字孪生"框架用于预测式小区切换：数字孪生生成同步多模态状态，三个智能体分别负责预测选择、切换动作规划与基于执行反馈的决策自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在密集中频与毫米波网络中，快速移动、阻塞与传播条件变化会使基于瞬时测量的切换决策失效，需要预测式切换机制。

Method: 构建柔性、模型无关的Agentic Digital Twin框架：DT持续生成同步的多模态状态；三个智能体自主完成（1）选择预测器/预测结果，（2）规划切换动作，（3）利用执行反馈自适应调整决策。

Result: 在切换活动量、所选链路可靠性与目标gNB选择精度（相对最优未来链路）之间取得最佳综合平衡；平均切换次数由Event A3的11.0次/轨迹降至8.0次/轨迹，同时保持98.2%的射线路径可用率。

Conclusion: 智能体化数字孪生可有效缓解瞬时切换决策的失效问题，在不牺牲链路可用性的前提下降低切换频率，具备模型无关、可扩展的部署潜力。

Abstract: Rapid mobility, blockage, and propagation changes can invalidate instantaneous handover decisions in dense mid-band and millimeter-wave (mmWave) networks. We therefore propose a flexible, model-agnostic \emph{Agentic Digital Twin (DT)} framework for predictive cell handover. The DT generates synchronized multimodal states, while three agents autonomously select forecasts, plan handover actions, and adapt decisions using execution feedback. The proposed Agentic DT provided the best collective balance among handover activity, the reliability of the selected links, and the accuracy of target next-generation Node B (gNB) selection relative to the best available future link. It reduced average handovers from $11.0$ for Event~A3 to $8.0$ per trajectory while maintaining
  $98.2\%$ ray-path availability.

</details>


### [850] [Residual-Calibrated Multimodal Spatiotemporal Learning for Future Beam Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33892)
*Md Ahadul Haque Suvo,Rifat Bin Reza,Saifur Rahman Sabuj*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种残差校准的多模态时空框架，用于DeepSense 6G Scenario 23的下一步波束预测，监督分支与残差分支性能接近，Top-2上残差微调略有提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向DeepSense 6G场景23的“下一条记录”波束预测，融合视觉、位置与历史波束标签等多模态信息，并探索在冻结监督模型之上做残差校准以进一步提升候选排序性能。

Method: 用预训练Swin-Tiny从4帧连续RGB图像提取视觉特征；经双向交叉注意力融合视觉与二维Unit 1位置表示；时序Transformer引入历史波束标签嵌入建模观测窗内依赖；另设离线残差头，基于即时正确性奖励与辅助分类损失对冻结的监督logits进行修正；按验证准确率选取监督输出与残差输出的固定概率混合。

Result: 从11,387条对齐记录构建11,255个时序窗口，按采集批次划分为训练7,854、验证1,905、测试1,496。监督预测器Top-1/2/3/5为62.83%/74.80%/79.75%/81.08%；残差预测器为61.76%/75.07%/79.41%/81.02%。残差调整使Top-2提高0.27个百分点，但监督预测器在Top-1、Top-3、Top-5上更优；验证集选出的混合模型与残差预测器一致。

Conclusion: 该框架将跨模态感知特征、显式波束历史条件化与独立训练的残差修正阶段结合，用于提前一步波束预测；在留出采集批次上的初步评估刻画了两阶段的候选排序能力，Top-1选择上更倾向监督变体，后续需进一步研究历史条件建模与残差细化。

Abstract: We propose a residual calibrated multimodal spatiotemporal framework for future beam prediction on DeepSense 6G Scenario 23. The framework integrates visual observations, location features, and historical beam labels to predict the beam label of the next dataset record. A pretrained Swin-Tiny encoder extracts features from four consecutive RGB frames. Bidirectional cross-attention integrates visual and two dimensional Unit 1 location representations, while a temporal Transformer incorporates historical beam label embeddings to model dependencies across the observation window. A supplementary offline residual head adjusts the frozen supervised logits using immediate correctness rewards and an auxiliary classification loss. A fixed probability mixture of the supervised and residual outputs is selected using validation accuracy. From 11,387 aligned records, we construct 11,255 temporal windows and partition them by capture run into 7,854 training, 1,905 validation, and 1,496 test samples. The supervised predictor achieves Top-1, Top-2, Top-3, and Top-5 test accuracies of 62.83%, 74.80%, 79.75%, and 81.08%, respectively. The residual predictor achieves corresponding accuracies of 61.76%, 75.07%, 79.41%, and 81.02%. Residual adjustment increases Top-2 accuracy by 0.27 percentage points, while the supervised predictor retains higher Top-1, Top-3, and Top-5 accuracies. The validation-selected mixture coincides with the residual predictor. The proposed framework combines cross-modal sensing features with explicit beam-history conditioning and a separately trained residual adjustment stage for one-record-ahead beam prediction. Initial evaluation on held-out capture runs characterizes the candidate-ranking performance of both prediction stages and favors the supervised variant for Top-1 selection. These findings motivate further study of historical conditioning and residual refinement.

</details>


### [851] [Graph Signal Estimation With Unknown Topology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34070)
*Tirza Routtenberg*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 论文研究候选图族中拓扑潜在（未知）时的图信号估计问题，提出利用候选图联合的拓扑盲谱估计器，并给出最优算子刻画、参数约简策略及跨网络共享谱函数框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图信号估计假设拓扑已知，但实际中主动拓扑往往潜在，仅知其属于某个候选图族，因此需要在拓扑不确定下设计估计器并量化性能损失。

Method: 构建拓扑盲图谱估计器（联合利用候选图）；推导最小MSE多基估计器，证明其最优算子为拓扑盲LMMSE算子在多图滤波器空间上的加权投影；进一步采用共享谱响应与低秩表示减少参数；引入数据驱动估计（MAP选择、后验加权/多模型）；扩展到不同规模网络，联合优化公共谱函数。

Result: 得到超额MSE的精确表达式及达到拓扑盲LMMSE的条件；推出共享谱函数的MSE最优系数，并将估计损失分解为图滤波器逼近误差与共享谱响应的额外代价；提出样本可实现方案，共享谱函数系数无需重训练即可用于未见图。

Conclusion: 在IEEE电力网络仿真中验证，所提图谱估计器在拓扑不确定与跨网络迁移场景下具有优势。

Abstract: Graph-signal estimation is commonly designed assuming that the underlying topology is known. In this paper, we consider estimation from general nonlinear measurements when the active topology is latent but is known to belong to a given family of candidate graphs. We first develop a class of topology-blind graph-spectral estimators that jointly exploit the candidate graphs, and characterize the performance loss compared to unconstrained linear estimation. We derive the minimum-mean-squared-error (MSE) multi-basis estimator and show that its optimal operator is the weighted projection of the topology-blind linear MMSE (LMMSE) operator onto the multi-graph filter space. This characterization provides exact expressions for the excess MSE and conditions for attaining the topology-blind LMMSE. To reduce the number of parameters, we develop estimators based on shared spectral responses and low-rank representations, and consider data-dependent estimators that infer the topology from the measurements, by maximum a-posteriori probability (MAP) selection or posterior weighting (multiple-model). We further extend the framework to networks of different sizes by jointly optimizing a common spectral function. We derive its MSE-optimal coefficients and decompose the resulting estimation loss into graph-filter approximation error and the additional cost of sharing a spectral response across networks. The proposed estimators admit sample-based implementations, while the shared spectral function can be applied to unseen graphs without retraining its coefficients. Simulations on IEEE power networks demonstrate the benefits of the proposed graph-spectral estimators under topology uncertainty and cross- network transfer.

</details>


### [852] [Self-Supervised Passive WiFi CSI-Based Motion Tracking with Physics-Informed Deep SSM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34082)
*Yifan Feng,Haiyao Yu,Geng Wang,Yunkai Hu,Shenghong Li,Peng Cheng,Branka Vucetic,Yonghui Li*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出物理信息驱动的贝叶斯状态空间框架，用上下文条件化深度状态空间模型（DSSM）建模CSI观测不确定性与环境动态，融合几何约束实现多模态CSI测量的被动跟踪，轨迹更平滑且精度优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CSI由噪声与异构特性导致其衍生观测（角度、时延、多普勒）仅提供目标位置与速度的不完全信息，在动态多径环境中观测可靠性随时间变化，使被动跟踪困难。

Method: 构建物理信息贝叶斯状态空间跟踪框架：引入上下文条件化DSSM刻画时序运动与环境动态，自适应建模时变观测不确定性；并将几何约束纳入框架，使异构CSI测量模态共同正则化跟踪的一致性与置信度。

Result: 实验表明所提框架输出轨迹更平滑、时间波动更小，跟踪精度优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 将物理几何先验与数据驱动状态空间建模结合，可有效应对CSI观测的噪声、异构与可靠性波动，为无源CSI跟踪提供可行且更优的方案。

Abstract: Inferring target position from WiFi channel state information (CSI) is challenging due to the noisy and heterogeneous nature of CSI-derived observations. Measurements such as angle, delay, and Doppler provide only imperfect information about target position and velocity, particularly in dynamic multipath environments where observation reliability varies. Motivated by this challenge, this paper proposes a physics-informed Bayesian state space framework for passive CSI-based tracking. We introduce a context-conditioned deep state space model (DSSM) that captures temporal motion and environmental dynamics, while adaptively modeling time-varying observation uncertainties. By incorporating geometric constraints, this framework enables heterogeneous CSI measurement modalities to jointly regularize the consistency and confidence of the tracking process. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework yields smoother trajectory estimates with reduced temporal fluctuations and outperforms existing methods in tracking accuracy.

</details>


### [853] [Secure Integrated Sensing and Communications with Movable Beyond-Diagonal RIS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34088)
*Chandan Kumar Sheemar,Symeon Chatzinotas*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出可移动单元的超对角可重构智能表面（BD-RIS）单站ISAC方案，通过双流迫零设计将感知与保密通信解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在ISAC中，当被感知目标本身即为窃听者时，感知所需照射与被抑制的保密泄露相互冲突，需在单站回波经表面返回的场景下解耦两项任务。
