Method: 证明无损互易BD-RIS将K个入射场映射到K个指定场的充要条件（两组场共享相同Gram矩阵且双线性Gram矩阵对称），从而可将二维入射子空间导向任意指定子空间；采用含保密流与高斯感知流的闭式迫零设计，使用户处无感知干扰、目标处无数据泄露；所有变量均为闭式，联合设计化为对单元位置的单调搜索，无需交替优化，并给出鲁棒导数零陷设计。

Result: 单流时感知必然带来速率损失；双流闭式设计下感知仅造成SNR偏移。仿真显示感知需求增加30 dB时双流设计仅损失1.1 bit/s/Hz，而单流为8.3 bit/s/Hz；移动、互连与鲁棒导数零陷设计分别额外贡献1.9、0.9、2.6 bit/s/Hz。

Conclusion: 可移动单元BD-RIS结合闭式双流迫零可在单站ISAC中实现感知与保密通信的有效解耦，且联合设计可简化为低复杂度单调搜索，性能显著优于单流方案。

Abstract: In integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), when the sensed target is itself an eavesdropper, the illumination required for sensing coincides with the leakage that secrecy must suppress. This paper shows how a beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surface (BD-RIS) with movable elements decouples the two tasks in a monostatic setting, where the echo returns to the base station through the surface. We prove that a lossless reciprocal BD-RIS maps $K$ incident fields onto $K$ prescribed fields if and only if the two sets share the same Gram matrix and their bilinear Gram matrix is symmetric; unlike a diagonal RIS, it can thus steer a two-dimensional incident subspace onto any prescribed subspace. With a single stream, sensing incurs an unavoidable rate loss, whereas a closed-form zero-forcing design with a confidential and a Gaussian sensing stream nulls the data at the target and the sensing at the user, so that sensing costs only an SNR offset. Since all variables follow in closed form for any placement, the joint design reduces to a monotone search over the element positions, without alternating optimization. Simulations show that the dual-stream design loses only $1.1$ bit/s/Hz when the sensing requirement grows by $30$ dB, against $8.3$ bit/s/Hz for a single stream, while movement, interconnection, and the robust derivative-null design add up to $1.9$, $0.9$, and $2.6$ bit/s/Hz, respectively.

</details>


### [854] [Dynamic Metasurface-Enabled Generalized Pinching-Antenna Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34091)
*Shan Shan,Chongjun Ouyang,Yufei Zhao,Zhiguo Ding,Yong Liang Guan*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文提出动态超表面赋能的广义pinching天线（DM-GPA）架构，通过联合优化激活单元位置与辐射系数实现多用户下行WSR最大化，并证明其相较传统PASS在空间复用与和速率上的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统pinching天线系统（PASS）仅依靠天线位置调控空间重构性，设计自由度有限；论文旨在引入动态超表面作为GPA的电子实现，以额外自由度增强空间可重构性。

Method: 构建DM-GPA架构并研究多用户下行WSR最大化：两用户场景下通过下界量化DM-GPA相较PASS的和速率增益，分析Lorentzian约束下信道正交化收益与功率损耗的权衡，以及在PASS信道秩亏时实现空间复用与发射分集；一般多用户场景下提出基于WMMSE的交替优化算法，联合设计pinching波束成形与数字预编码器，并采用逐单元顺序搜索优化激活位置，候选位置处辐射系数有闭式解。

Result: 两用户场景中，DM-GPA在足够高信噪比下相比秩亏PASS具有严格的和速率优势；数值结果表明DM-GPA的WSR优于其他PASS架构与固定阵列基准，增加激活单元数可进一步提升WSR，且当候选激活位置受限时辐射系数调整收益尤为显著。

Conclusion: 动态超表面赋能的GPA通过位置与辐射系数的联合优化，突破传统PASS的空间重构局限，在有限候选位置条件下尤为有效，是多用户下行传输的一种有前景的架构。

Abstract: This article investigates dynamic metasurfaces as an electronic realization of generalized pinching antennas (GPA). By jointly optimizing the locations and radiation coefficients of activated elements, the dynamic metasurface-enabled GPA (DM-GPA) architecture exploits additional design flexibility to enhance spatial reconfigurability beyond that attainable through antenna placement in the conventional pinching-antenna system (PASS). Based on this architecture, we study weighted sum rate (WSR) maximization for multiuser downlink transmission. 1) For two-user transmission, the sum-rate improvement of DM-GPA over conventional PASS is quantified through a lower bound that reveals when the benefit of channel orthogonalization achieved by adjusting the radiation coefficients outweighs the channel power loss caused by the Lorentzian constraint. Furthermore, when conventional PASS yields a rank-deficient channel, DM-GPA is shown to achieve spatial multiplexing and transmit diversity, with a strict sum-rate advantage at sufficiently high signal-to-noise ratios. 2) For general multiuser transmission, a weighted minimum mean-square error (WMMSE)-based alternating optimization algorithm is developed for joint pinching beamforming and digital precoder design. A sequential element-wise search is developed to optimize the locations of the activated elements, with a closed-form solution for the radiation coefficient at each candidate location. Numerical results are provided to demonstrate that: (i) DM-GPA achieves higher WSR than other PASS architectures and fixed-array benchmarks, (ii) increasing the number of activated elements further improves the WSR of DM-GPA, and (iii) radiation coefficient adjustment is particularly beneficial when candidate activation locations are limited.

</details>


### [855] [AGENS: Agentic Link Construction for Environment and Intent Aware 6G Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34131)
*Zhaoyang Li,Shangzhuo Xie,Qianqian Yang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文首次提出"环境与意图感知的全链路自动构建"任务，并提出 AGENS——一个面向 AI 原生 6G 链路构建的智能体决策框架。它不替代现有 PHY 协议栈，而是在模块化通信框架之上联合优化端到端 PHY 配置：融合 CSI 与自然语言指令、借助预训练 LLM 做意图推理、用 LSTM 序列动作生成器输出结构化全链路策略，并通过"启发式监督初始化 + 多目标强化学习"两阶段训练在离散动作空间中联合优化可靠性、吞吐与功耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 通信方法多局限于单一任务或单个物理层模块，无法满足 AI 原生 6G 的需求：需联合感知动态环境、理解用户意图、协调多个耦合的 PHY 模块，并与现有通信基础设施兼容。因此需要一种在既有模块化框架上进行全链路协同决策的新范式。

Method: AGENS 框架：1) 对 CSI 与自然语言用户指令进行编码，通过跨模态融合将通信状态与用户意图对齐；2) 利用预训练 LLM 实现意图感知推理；3) 采用基于 LSTM 的序列动作生成器捕捉耦合子动作间依赖，生成结构化全链路策略；4) 两阶段学习：启发式监督初始化 + 多目标强化学习（可靠性、吞吐量、功耗）。整体在模块化 PHY 协议栈之上运行而非黑盒端到端替换。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值，仅说明所提出的两阶段学习框架用于支撑高维离散动作空间中的稳定训练，并实现可靠性、吞吐量与功耗三目标的联合优化。

Conclusion: AGENS 为 AI 原生 6G 提供了一种与环境/意图感知、基础设施兼容的全链路 PHY 决策方案，将 LLM 推理、跨模态意图对齐与多目标强化学习结合，代表了从"单模块 AI"向"系统级智能体化通信"的转变。

Abstract: The emergence of diverse intelligent services is driving 6G networks toward an intelligent communication ecosystem with increasingly complex operating scenarios. However, existing AI-based communication methods mainly focus on isolated tasks or individual physical-layer mod- ules, which is insufficient for AI-native 6G systems that must jointly perceive dynamic environments, understand specific user intents, coordinate multiple coupled PHY-layer modules, and remain compatible with existing communication infrastructures. To address this gap, this paper, for the first time, explores auto- matic environment- and intent-aware full-link construction, which aims to generate executable PHY-layer configurations according to channel conditions and service requirements. We propose AGENS, an agentic communication decision-making framework for AI-native 6G link construction. Rather than replacing the existing PHY-layer protocol stack with a black-box end-to-end model, AGENS operates on top of the modular communication framework and jointly optimizes end-to-end PHY-layer configu- rations. Specifically, AGENS encodes CSI and natural-language user instructions, aligns communication states with user intents through cross-modal fusion, and leverages a pretrained LLM for intent-aware reasoning. An LSTM-based sequential action generator further captures dependencies among coupled sub- actions and produces structured full-link strategies. To enable stable training in the high-dimensional discrete action space, AGENS adopts a two-stage learning framework, where heuristic supervised initialization is followed by multi-objective reinforce- ment learning to jointly optimize reliability, throughput, and power consumption.

</details>


### [856] [Environment-Adaptive Dynamic KV Cache for Multi-Path Parameter Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34135)
*Zhaoyang Li,Yuhao Chen,Qianqian Yang,Zhaoyang Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出环境条件化动态KV缓存框架用于多径参数预测，解耦环境计算与BS-UE几何计算以复用环境侧表示，并引入基于环境侧注意力分数的动态压缩机制，在WAIR-D上KV内存从0.2500MB降至0.1406MB，时延NMSE仅由0.0673升至0.0678。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多径参数预测为环境感知通信提供结构化、物理可解释的传播表征，但现有Transformer方法在预测多条BS-UE链路时会重复编码同一环境，造成冗余计算与KV内存开销。

Method: 将环境相关计算与BS-UE几何计算解耦，使环境侧表示与中间KV状态可在多个链路查询间复用，仅更新几何分支；在此基础上提出动态压缩机制，利用环境侧注意力分数保留信息量高的token，并在Transformer各层间自适应分配固定缓存预算。

Result: 在WAIR-D数据集上，KV内存由0.2500 MB降至0.1406 MB（约减少44%），时延NMSE仅由0.0673轻微上升至0.0678。

Conclusion: 环境条件化KV缓存与动态压缩可在几乎不损失预测精度的前提下显著降低多链路多径预测的内存开销，为环境感知通信系统提供高效的多径参数预测方案。

Abstract: Multipath parameter prediction provides a structured and physically interpretable representation of wireless propagation for environment-aware communication systems. However, existing Transformer-based methods repeatedly encode the same environment when predicting multiple BS--UE links, resulting in redundant computation. To address this issue, we propose an environment-conditioned dynamic KV caching framework for multipath parameter prediction. Specifically, we decouple environment-dependent computation from BS--UE geometry, enabling environment-side representations and intermediate KV states to be reused across multiple link queries while only the geometry branch is updated. Building on this reusable cache, we further introduce a dynamic compression mechanism that uses environment-side attention scores to retain informative tokens and adaptively allocates a fixed cache budget across Transformer layers. Experiments on the WAIR-D dataset show that the proposed method reduces KV memory from 0.2500 MB to 0.1406 MB, while the delay NMSE increases only slightly from 0.0673 to 0.0678. Code is available at https://github.com/LZhaoyang/kv.

</details>


### [857] [Fading Suppression in Distributed Acoustic Sensing Using Frequency-Domain Replica Reconstruction and Noise-Whitened Principal Component Combining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34224)
*Ziang Chen,Zhiyang Xue,Huan Huang,Yuhan Jiang,Dongdong Zou,Gangxiang Shen,Yi Cai*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出频域复制品重构与噪声白化主成分合并（PCC），在phi-OTDR DAS中用全带复制品与重叠子带以固定权重合并，兼顾分集增益与名义空间分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于phi-OTDR的DAS存在频率选择性瑞利衰落，需要有效分集；但现有非重叠子带的旋转矢量求和（RVS）合并会带来空间分辨率损失。

Method: 频域复制品重构＋白化相关复制品噪声后，利用跨探测周期估计的固定权重，对全带复制品与重叠子带进行PCC合并；保留较宽子带并减少对含噪首周期对齐的依赖。

Result: 约7.1 km光纤、16 μs LFM脉冲实验，恢复500 Hz振动，背景相位偏移降低，VBR较首周期RVS提升2.46–2.76 dB。

Conclusion: 该方案在phi-OTDR DAS中实现了分集与名义空间分辨率的更好平衡，并显著提升振动-背景比。

Abstract: Frequency-selective Rayleigh fading in distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) based on phase-sensitive optical time-domain reflectometry (phi-OTDR) calls for effective diversity, but existing rotated-vector-sum (RVS) combining of nonoverlapping subbands incurs a spatial-resolution penalty. In this letter, we propose frequency-domain replica reconstruction and noise-whitened principal component combining (PCC) that combines a full-band replica and overlapping subbands using fixed weights estimated across probing periods after whitening correlated replica noise. This approach retains wider subbands and reduces reliance on noisy first-period alignment, balancing diversity with nominal spatial resolution. Experiments over approximately 7.1 km of fiber with 16-microsecond linear frequency-modulated (LFM) pulses recover 500-Hz vibrations with reduced background phase excursions and a 2.46-2.76-dB improvement in the vibration-to-background ratio (VBR) over the first-period RVS.

</details>


### [858] [RIS-Assisted Downlink Pinching-Antenna Systems With NLOS Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34275)
*Yue Geng,Kah Chan Teh,Tee Hiang Cheng*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该论文研究障碍物导致NLOS用户场景下的RIS辅助下行Pinching天线系统（PASS），通过部署RIS建立虚拟LOS链路扩展PASS覆盖，并提出基于ZF波束成形的交替优化框架最小化发射功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PASS受物理尺寸约束且存在不可避免的障碍物，导致NLOS用户无法获得有效服务，需要借助RIS建立虚拟LOS链路以扩展覆盖范围。

Method: 提出基于ZF波束成形的交替优化（AO）框架，联合优化RIS反射系数与Pinching天线（PA）激活位置以最小化发射功率；RIS反射系数用黎曼共轭梯度（RCG）法求解，PA激活位置采用新提出的投影梯度法高效优化。

Result: 仿真表明，所提AO框架在不同速率需求与RIS尺寸等系统配置下，在发射功率与计算效率两方面均优于基线方案。

Conclusion: RIS辅助可有效扩展PASS在NLOS场景下的覆盖，ZF-AO联合优化框架能够以更高计算效率实现更低的发射功率。

Abstract: This paper investigates a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted downlink pinching-antenna system (PASS) in the presence of non-line-of-sight (NLOS) users caused by unavoidable obstacles. An RIS is deployed to extend the coverage of the physically constrained PASS by establishing virtual line-of-sight (LOS) links. To improve system performance, we propose a zero-forcing (ZF) beamforming-based alternating optimization (AO) framework that minimizes the transmit power by jointly optimizing the RIS reflection coefficients and pinching-antenna (PA) activation positions. Specifically, the RIS reflection coefficients are optimized using the Riemannian conjugate gradient (RCG) method, while a novel projected gradient-based method is developed to efficiently optimize the PA activation positions. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed AO framework outperforms baseline schemes in terms of both transmit power and computational efficiency under different system configurations including the rate requirements and RIS sizes.

</details>


### [859] [Synergizing Wireless Foundation Models and LLMs: A Multi-Task Framework for MA Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34285)
*Haocheng Zhang,Yang Liu,Mengzhen Liu,Qingqing Wu,Qingjiang Shi,Wei Wang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一个融合无线基础模型（WFM）与大语言模型（LLM）的多任务框架，用于可移动天线（MA）系统中 CSI 外推与天线位置优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MA 具有动态重定位带来的空间灵活性，但在获取完整 CSI 与高效优化天线位置方面面临关键挑战；WFM 可提供可泛化的信道先验用于高质量 CSI 外推，LLM 则支持参数高效、token 级的优化。

Method: 1) 面向 MA 信道特性，基于 LWM 架构开发 ExtLWM 以弥合现有 WFM 预训练与 MA 信道的失配；2) 设计统一的 ExtLWM-Connector-LLM 架构，无需结构重设计即可适配不同 MA 配置；3) 将离散 MA 定位重构为序列决策问题，用数值 token 表示候选位置并采用 GRPO 优化，利用 LLM 的串行生成能力；4) 提出多阶段训练策略，在样本有限下维持多任务性能并缓解灾难性遗忘。

Result: 仿真表明 ExtLWM 可生成高质量信道嵌入，且 CSI 外推性能优于多种基准；所提基于 LLM 的方法在性能与计算复杂度之间取得良好折衷。

Conclusion: WFM 与 LLM 的协同集成可有效支撑 MA 系统中的 CSI 外推与天线位置优化，兼具性能与效率优势。

Abstract: While movable antennas (MAs) provide enhanced spatial flexibility through dynamic repositioning, they confront critical challenges in acquiring complete channel state information (CSI) and efficiently optimizing antenna positions. Encouragingly, wireless foundation models (WFMs) capture generalizable channel priors for high-quality CSI extrapolation, while large language models (LLMs) enable parameter-efficient, token-level optimization for wireless tasks. In this paper, we synergistically integrate a WFM and an LLM into a multi-task framework for MA systems. First, to address the mismatch between existing WFM pre-training and MA channel characteristics, we develop an MA-oriented ``ExtLWM'' based on the large wireless model (LWM) architecture. Second, we design a unified ExtLWM-Connector-LLM architecture that flexibly adapts to different MA configurations without structural redesign. Third, we reformulate discrete MA positioning as a sequential decision-making problem, where candidate positions are represented by numerical tokens and optimized using group relative policy optimization (GRPO) to exploit the serial generation capability of the LLM. Finally, a multi-stage training strategy is developed to maintain multi-task performance under limited training samples while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Simulation results show that ExtLWM can produce high-quality channel embeddings while outperforming various benchmarks in CSI extrapolation. Meanwhile, the proposed LLM-based approach achieves a favorable trade-off between performance and computational complexity.

</details>


### [860] [End-to-End Neural Modeling of EM Response and Design Performance for Free-Form RFIC Passives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34462)
*Yuhao Mao,Chenhao Chu,Martin Vechev,Hua Wang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出端到端神经网络框架，用频率条件神经仿真器与电路条件神经求解器联合预测自由形态RFIC无源器件的电磁响应与下游设计性能，21M参数模型在宽频段、多电路上下文中R²>0.98，评估速度比传统EM仿真快数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RFIC中无源匹配网络设计受限于昂贵的有限差分电磁仿真，构成设计瓶颈，亟需快速替代方案。

Method: 频率条件神经仿真器 + 电路条件神经求解器的端到端框架；仿真器输出由显式EM响应与互补响应构成的"神经EM响应"，并引入依赖正则项促使二者捕获正交信息；构建由专家轮廓与随机路径合成的大规模自由形态版图数据集。

Result: 21M参数模型在宽频段、多电路上下文与多种匹配设置下几乎全部目标R²>0.98，评估速度较传统EM仿真快数个数量级。

Conclusion: 神经代理可有效替代昂贵的EM仿真并直接预测下游设计性能，为自由形态RFIC无源器件的快速设计迭代提供可行路径。

Abstract: Passive matching networks are critical components in radio-frequency integrated circuits (RFICs), but their design is bottlenecked by expensive finite-difference-based electromagnetic (EM) simulation. We propose an end-to-end neural framework for free-form RFIC passives that predicts both EM response and downstream design performance under varying frequency and circuit contexts, combining a frequency-conditioned neural simulator with a circuit-conditioned neural solver. To improve design performance prediction, the simulator outputs a neural EM response consisting of both the explicit EM response and a complementary response, together with a dependence regularizer that encourages the two responses to capture orthogonal information. To evaluate the proposed framework, we construct a large-scale dataset of free-form passive layouts, synthesized from both expert-designed contours and random paths. Our 21M-parameter model achieves high accuracy across a broad frequency range, circuit contexts and passive matching settings, with $R^2>0.98$ for almost all targets, while providing orders-of-magnitude faster evaluation than traditional EM simulation. Code available at https://github.com/ETH-IDEAS/RFIC-NeuralSim.

</details>


### [861] [GNSS Anomaly Detection in Urban Canyons: A Comprehensive Survey of Multimodal Visibility Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34468)
*Abdelgabar Ahmed,Tarig Ballal,Nour Kouzayha,Tareq Y. Al-Naffouri*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该综述将城市GNSS接收状态推断归为接收机侧信号、3D地图/环境模型与辅助传感器三类互补证据，比较其精度、可解释性、硬件与标定需求、地图依赖、计算成本与实时性，并指出数据集质量、域泛化、地图时效与轻量化部署等开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集城市环境下GNSS定位可靠性依赖卫星可见性评估与NLOS、多径受损测量的识别；现有研究分散于信号处理、环境建模与传感器融合，缺乏跨证据族的系统对比与设计指引。

Method: 综述性研究方法：按证据来源分类梳理——接收机侧（天线/电磁、跟踪/基带、观测域证据，配合规则、统计、机器学习、深度学习方法）；地图侧（环境表征、几何筛选、shadow matching、3D射线追踪、神经隐式可见性预测）；辅助传感器（IMU、相机、LiDAR提供运动学、视觉与几何证据用于在线筛选）。

Result: 给出跨三类证据族在精度、可解释性、硬件与标定要求、地图依赖性、计算成本及实时部署适应性等维度的对比分析，形成结构化评估。

Conclusion: 提出数据集质量与标注、域泛化、地图新鲜度、资源高效实现等开放问题，并将信号处理、环境建模与传感器融合相联结，为鲁棒城市GNSS测量筛选系统设计提供指引。

Abstract: Reliable GNSS positioning in dense urban environments depends on assessing satellite visibility and identifying measurements degraded by non-line-of-sight (NLOS) reception and multipath. This survey organizes reception-state inference into three complementary evidence families: receiver-side signals, 3D maps and environmental models, and auxiliary sensors. Receiver-side approaches span antenna/electromagnetic, tracking/baseband, and observable-domain evidence, interpreted through rule-based, statistical, machine-learning, and deep-learning methods. Map-based approaches are examined by reviewing environmental representations and methods such as geometric screening, shadow matching, 3D ray tracing, and neural implicit visibility prediction. IMU, camera, and LiDAR measurements provide complementary kinematic, visual, and geometric evidence for online screening. Across these families, we compare accuracy, interpretability, hardware and calibration requirements, map dependence, computational cost, and suitability for real-time deployment. We identify open challenges in dataset quality and labeling, domain generalization, map freshness, and resource-efficient implementation. The resulting synthesis connects signal processing, environmental modeling, and sensor fusion to guide the design of robust urban GNSS measurement-screening systems.

</details>


### [862] [Space-Time Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces for Doppler-Resilient LEO Broadcasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34479)
*Chandan Kumar Sheemar,Giovanni Iacovelli,Sourabh Solanki,Symeon Chatzinotas*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出时空堆叠智能超表面（ST-SIM），利用时间维度对孔径每个空间模式赋予独立频率搬移，解决LEO广播中多终端多普勒残差问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SIM（含LEO卫星方案）层系数仅为空间控制或随机时变，导致每个辐射波束都携带馈源频率；而LEO广播中公共波形到达各终端时存在不同多普勒频移，任何单一公共多普勒校正都会残留最多达多普勒跨度一半的误差。

Method: 提出时间调制的ST-SIM，将每个空间模式与规定的频率搬移配对；建立堆叠的谐波域模型，闭式求解最小能量空频合成；证明导向矩阵列满秩是解耦K个终端专属频率搬移的充要条件（可推广至终端分组）；进一步给出具有平稳性保证的相位仅合成算法及量化与控制速率准则。

Result: 20 GHz下50次随机布点的仿真表明：四层ST-SIM仅用单条射频链路，在足迹半径约45 km以上即消除静态SIM的多普勒底噪；在理想相位仅模型与相等辐射峰值能量下，对可分辨终端与理想数字逐终端预补偿相差0.5 dB以内；而在所评估几何中，单层时间调制无法合成所需模式。

Conclusion: ST-SIM通过对堆叠层进行确定性时间调制，将空频联合合成转化为可解析求解并具备充要秩条件的解耦问题，可作为单射频链路下LEO广播多普勒补偿的有效方案；但所需模式需足够层数支撑，单层时变不足。

Abstract: Stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIMs) cascade programmable layers in front of a feed. In the SIM designs reported so far, including those proposed for low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellites, the layer coefficients are space-only controls or are varied randomly in time to support opportunistic scheduling, so that every radiated beam carries the frequency of the feed. This paper introduces space-time SIMs (ST-SIMs), whose layers are modulated in time and use the temporal dimension of the stack deterministically: each spatial mode of the aperture is paired with its own prescribed frequency translation. The application is LEO broadcasting, where a common waveform reaches terminals with different Doppler shifts, and any common Doppler correction leaves residuals of up to half the Doppler span. We derive the harmonic-domain model of the stack, solve the minimum-energy space-frequency synthesis in closed form, and prove that full column rank of the steering matrix is necessary and sufficient for decoupling K terminal-specific translations, a result that extends to groups of terminals. We further propose a phase-only synthesis algorithm with guaranteed stationarity, together with quantization and control-rate laws. Simulations at 20 GHz over 50 random drops show that a four-layer ST-SIM with a single radio-frequency chain removes the Doppler floor of a static SIM for footprint radii above about 45 km and, under the ideal phase-only model and at equal radiated peak energy, approaches ideal digital per-terminal precompensation within 0.5 dB for resolvable terminals, whereas, in the evaluated geometries, a single time-modulated layer cannot synthesize the required modes.

</details>


### [863] [Frequency-Dependent Hybrid Digital and Microwave Linear Analog Computer (MiLAC) Beamforming for Multiuser MIMO-OFDM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34603)
*Yiyang Peng,Zheyu Wu,Bruno Clerckx*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究频率相关MiLAC电路下的多用户MISO-OFDM混合数字-MiLAC波束成形，提出BCD算法（含定制ADMM处理频率耦合约束）联合优化数字与MiLAC波束成形器以最大化平均和速率，并验证其优于传统混合波束成形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MiLAC可降低大规模MIMO的硬件与数字处理开销，窄带系统中混合数字-MiLAC仅需与数据流数相同的RF链即可获得数字波束成形灵活性；但实际MiLAC电路具有频率相关响应，将该优势推广到宽带系统并非易事。

Method: 建立频率相关MiLAC电路模型，将各可调元件在各子载波上的电纳与其中心频率取值相关联以刻画频率依赖性；分析表明单一MiLAC电路通常无法同时匹配所有子载波的期望波束方向，凸显子载波相关数字预编码的必要性；进而提出BCD算法联合优化数字与MiLAC波束成形器，并定制ADMM算法处理MiLAC子问题中的频率耦合电路约束。

Result: 仿真显示所提混合数字-MiLAC设计优于传统混合数字-模拟波束成形，在RF链更少、信道频率选择性更强时优势更明显：64发射天线、4数据流下仅用8条RF链即达到数字和速率的96.3%；在高频率选择性信道、4条RF链时相较传统混合设计取得48%的和速率增益。

Conclusion: 频率相关MiLAC电路需依赖子载波相关数字预编码配合，所提BCD-ADMM混合数字-MiLAC方案能在显著减少RF链的同时逼近数字波束成形性能，是宽带大规模MIMO的低成本高效替代方案。

Abstract: Microwave linear analog computing (MiLAC) has recently emerged as a promising approach for reducing the hardware and digital-processing requirements of large-scale multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. In narrowband multiuser systems, hybrid digital-MiLAC beamforming can achieve digital beamforming flexibility with only as many radio-frequency (RF) chains as data streams. However, extending this advantage to wideband systems is nontrivial because practical MiLAC circuits exhibit frequency-dependent responses. In this paper, we investigate hybrid digital-MiLAC beamforming for multiuser MISO-OFDM systems with a frequency-dependent MiLAC circuit model. We characterize the frequency dependence of MiLAC by relating the susceptance of each tunable component across subcarriers to its center-frequency value. Under this frequency coupling, we show that a single MiLAC circuit generally cannot simultaneously match the desired beamforming directions across all subcarriers, highlighting the essential role of subcarrier-dependent digital precoding. We then develop a block coordinate descent (BCD) algorithm to jointly optimize the digital and MiLAC beamformers for average sum-rate maximization. In particular, an efficient alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm is custom-designed to handle the frequency-coupled circuit constraints in the MiLAC beamformer subproblem. Simulation results show that the proposed hybrid digital-MiLAC design outperforms conventional hybrid digital-analog beamforming, particularly when fewer RF chains are available and the channel is more frequency-selective. With $64$ transmit antennas and $4$ data streams, it attains $96.3\%$ of the digital sum-rate using only $8$ RF chains. Furthermore, under highly frequency-selective channels and using $4$ RF chains, it provides a $48\%$ sum-rate gain over the conventional hybrid design.

</details>


### [864] [A Unified Channel Model and Performance Evaluation for Underwater-to-Air Optical Links](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34713)
*Xing Du,Mohamed-Slim Alouini*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一个条件统计框架，用于水下—空气光学链路，联合建模体衰减、大气对数正态与水下Weibull涨落、入瞳收集及依赖表面倾斜的Fresnel透射，并给出可复现的误码率与中断计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 名义正常的水下—空气光链路各随机因素（倾斜、光束位移、收集效率）通常被独立或近似处理，忽略了透射与光束位移通过同一倾斜产生的相关性，且等效光束收集近似缺乏误差评估。

Method: 以共同倾斜为条件变量，将透射与光束位移作为条件量以保留其依赖性；采用具有显式支撑与Jacobian的乘积分布，得到对任意正Weibull形状参数均有效的积分；用组件独立的蒙特卡洛在六个参考配置下验证条件模型，并以定向重要性采样校验低至约6×10^-9的BER；用圆瞳高斯积分评估等效光束收集近似的误差。

Result: 在一致功率、噪声与SNR定义下计算平均未编码OOK的BER与中断概率；圆瞳高斯解析结果表明等效光束收集近似存在随参数变化的误差，某一测试工作点BER被低估36.9%；条件功率与距离研究区分了低误差短气段条件与收集受限条件；源端锚定的光谱与水型对比及照明、接收端检查揭示了结果对规定工况的依赖。

Conclusion: 该框架在单patch标量模型内提供可复现的误码与中断计算，但物理工作范围仍取决于表面、传播与接收端假设。

Abstract: This paper develops a conditional statistical framework for nominally normal underwater-to-air optical links. It combines bulk attenuation, normalized log-normal atmospheric and Weibull underwater fluctuations, and entrance-pupil collection with surface-tilt-dependent Fresnel transmission. Conditioning transmission and beam displacement on a common tilt preserves their dependence. Product distributions with explicit support and Jacobians yield integrals valid for arbitrary positive Weibull shape. Average uncoded OOK bit error rate (BER) and outage are evaluated using consistent power, noise and SNR definitions. Independent component-wise Monte Carlo verifies the full conditional model at six reference configurations; targeted importance sampling checks selected BER values down to approximately 6 x 10^-9. A circular-pupil Gaussian integral reveals parameter-dependent errors in the equivalent-beam collection approximation, including a 36.9% BER underestimate at one tested operating point. Conditional power and distance studies therefore use the circular-pupil reference and distinguish low-error short-air-segment conditions from collection-limited conditions. Source-anchored spectral and water-type contrasts, together with illumination and receiver checks, identify the dependence of these results on the prescribed operating conditions. The framework supplies reproducible error and outage calculations within a single-patch scalar model; physical operating ranges additionally depend on the surface, propagation and receiver assumptions.

</details>


### [865] [How Much Sensing is Enough? Landslide Detection from Sparse and Noisy 3D Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34869)
*Arijit Pal,Abhijit Mohanty,Dipanjyoti Paul,Sandip Chakraborty,Basabdatta Palit*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文构建物理约束稀疏地形数据集，用CNN+XGBoost在仅20%观测下实现80%准确率的滑坡检测并量化稀疏度与性能的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模稠密三维地形数据受传感基础设施、覆盖范围和环境条件限制难以获取；新兴传感模态（毫米波雷达、低成本雷达、稀疏LiDAR）可在恶劣条件下工作，但输出稀疏且含噪的三维观测。核心问题：滑坡可靠检测究竟需要多少传感信息？且缺乏大规模稀疏地形数据集。

Method: 将OpenTopography的DEM与NASA SMAP土壤湿度数据融合，构建物理信息数据集；随机生成滑坡事件，并施加受控稀疏化与随机噪声以模拟传感约束；提出基于CNN（地形重建）+XGBoost（滑坡易发区识别）的学习框架。

Result: 仅使用20%原始观测时，检测准确率达80%，ROC-AUC为0.868，测试集重建误差（L2 Chamfer Distance）为99.67 m²；并进一步分析稀疏度影响，揭示传感密度与检测性能之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 稀疏、含噪的三维观测在低采样率下仍足以支撑可靠滑坡检测，为低成本稀疏传感的部署提供了定量依据与稀疏度—性能权衡参考。

Abstract: Dense 3D terrain information is critical for accurate landslide detection; however, acquiring such data at large scale is often limited by sensing infrastructure, coverage, and environmental conditions. Emerging sensing modalities (e.g., mmWave, low-cost radar, sparse LiDAR) can operate under adverse conditions, but inherently produce sparse and noisy 3D observations, raising an important question: \emph{how much sensing is sufficient for reliable landslide detection?} Given the absence of large-scale sparse-terrain datasets, we have constructed a physics-informed dataset by combining digital elevation models from OpenTopography with soil moisture data from NASA's SMAP. Subsequently, we have randomly generated landslide events and introduced controlled sparsification and stochastic noise to emulate sensing constraints. We have then developed a learning-based framework to reconstruct the underlying terrain and identify landslide-prone regions using a CNN + XGBoost method. Our results show that with only 20\% of the original observations, the proposed method achieves a detection accuracy of 80\% and a ROC-AUC of 0.868, with a reconstruction error (L2 Chamfer Distance) of 99.67~$m^2$ on the test set. We have further studied the impact of sparsity, highlighting the trade-off between sensing density and detection performance.

</details>


### [866] [Efficient SCA Algorithms for Sparse Bayesian Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34888)
*Esa Ollila,Majdoddin Esfandiari,Daniel P. Palomar,Xinjue Wang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文重新审视稀疏贝叶斯学习中的协方差学习(CL)问题，在SCA框架下提出三种并行一阶算法(CL-SCA、CL-FP、CL-Hyb)，并给出KKT、充分下降与O(T^{-1/2})收敛速率等理论保证，在大规模随机接入的活跃设备检测中显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统M-SBL依赖EM算法求解多测量向量模型的Type-II SBL，需最小化边际负对数似然；EM收敛慢、计算开销大，因此需要更高效的优化算法替代EM。

Method: 将问题表述为协方差学习(CL)，在逐次凸近似(SCA)框架下构造三种一阶算法：CL-SCA通过对log-determinant项部分线性化得到逐坐标代理函数；CL-FP由平稳性条件导出带阻尼的投影不动点迭代；两者均有闭式更新。CL-Hyb基于局部分析将二者结合，并配以不需调步长的回溯规则(bt)。

Result: 理论上证明两种更新映射的不动点恰为CL问题的KKT点，更新方向满足定量下降不等式，阻尼迭代达到充分下降与O(T^{-1/2})最优迭代平稳性速率；若阻尼因子有下界，则残差沿整个序列消失、所有极限点为KKT点。实验中CL-Hyb-bt在达到最优CL求解器精度的同时运行时间大幅缩短，比EM快一个数量级以上。

Conclusion: CL-SCA与CL-FP为M-SBL提供了有收敛保证的快速一阶替代方案，CL-Hyb-bt兼具精度与效率，可作为EM的高效替代用于大规模稀疏恢复与活跃设备检测。

Abstract: Type-II sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) for the multiple measurement vector model recovers a sparse signal power vector by minimizing the marginal negative log-likelihood via the expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm, referred to as M-SBL. We revisit the covariance learning (CL) problem and develop three parallel first-order algorithms within the successive convex approximation (SCA) framework. CL-SCA minimizes per-coordinate surrogates formed by partially linearizing the log-determinant term, while CL-FP uses a damped projected fixed-point iteration derived from stationarity conditions. Both methods have closed-form updates. We prove that the fixed points of both update maps are exactly the KKT points of the CL problem, that each update direction satisfies a quantitative descent inequality, that the damped iterates achieve sufficient decrease with an $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ best-iterate stationarity rate, and we derive a backtracking rule that retains this rate without step-size tuning. If damping factors are bounded away from zero, the residual vanishes along the whole sequence and every limit point is a KKT point. Local analysis motivates CL-Hyb, which combines CL-SCA and CL-FP. Experiments on device activity detection in massive random access show that CL-Hyb-bt matches the best CL solvers' accuracy at a fraction of the runtime and is over an order of magnitude faster than EM.

</details>


### [867] [Fluid Antennas Enabled UAV Communication Systems: Fundamentals, Challenges, and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35047)
*Wenchao Liu,Weijie Yuan,Jun Wu,Jinke Ren,Xuhui Zhang,Changsheng You*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文综述流体天线（FA）赋能的无人机通信系统，提出“双移动性”视角与离线-在线混合优化框架，并给出车联网案例验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低空无线网络（LAWNs）要求无人机通信系统同时应对大尺度传播变化与快速局部信道波动，而仅靠轨迹规划难以覆盖细粒度信道适配，需引入天线位置重构这一新自由度。

Method: 从基础、设计挑战与未来方向三方面展开：提出双移动性视角（无人机轨迹=宏观移动性，FA位置重构=微观移动性）；识别联合优化无人机轨迹、FA位置与波束成形中的高复杂度与信息不确定性挑战；提出混合离线-在线优化框架，离线利用环境地图、用户移动模式与统计CSI做长期规划，在线利用瞬时CSI与无人机状态快速校正；以FA赋能的无人机辅助车联网为案例。

Result: 案例研究表明所提混合离线-在线框架在FA赋能的无人机辅助车联网场景中有效。

Conclusion: FA为无人机通信提供额外自由度并具应用潜力；未来方向包括通感一体化（ISAC）、安全通信、移动边缘计算（MEC）与空中中继。

Abstract: Low-altitude wireless networks (LAWNs) require uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) communication systems to adapt to large-scale propagation changes and fast local channel fluctuations. Fluid antennas (FAs) provide an additional degree of freedom (DoF) by reconfiguring antenna positions within a compact aperture. This article investigates FA-enabled UAV communication systems from the perspectives of fundamentals, design challenges, and future research directions. We first introduce a dual-mobility perspective, in which UAV trajectory planning provides macro-mobility for large-scale air-to-ground geometry adaptation, and FA position reconfiguration provides micro-mobility for fine-grained local channel adaptation. We then identify key design challenges arising from the high computational complexity and information uncertainty in the joint optimization of UAV trajectory, FA positions, and beamforming under mobility, energy, hardware, and security constraints. To address these challenges, we present a hybrid offline-online optimization framework, where prior information such as environment maps, user mobility patterns, and statistical channel state information (CSI) supports long-term planning, while real-time information such as instantaneous CSI and UAV state enables fast online correction. A case study on FA-enabled UAV-assisted vehicular communications demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Finally, we discuss future directions of FA-enabled UAV communication in integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), secure communication, mobile edge computing (MEC), and aerial relaying.

</details>


### [868] [Analysis and Antenna Position Selection for Pinching-Antenna Systems in Fading Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35140)
*Amy S. Inwood,Peter J. Smith,Hyundong Shin,Michail Matthaiou*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文首次对莱斯衰落与空间相关大尺度衰落下的pinching-antenna系统(PASS)进行统计分析，刻画单用户上行最大可达SNR的分布与均值，并提出基于无线电环境地图(REM)的天线定位策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PASS研究大多假设纯视距(LoS)环境，忽略了实际无线环境中的散射与空间相关阴影衰落，缺乏对非理想LoS条件下PASS性能的刻画与天线定位方法。

Method: 聚焦单用户上行PASS，分析最大可达SNR的分布与均值；对经典指数相关阴影衰落，将信道功率过程表示为布朗运动并给出最大SNR分布与均值的高精度近似；对一般平滑相关阴影衰落过程，基于衰落驻留时长(fade sojourn duration)建模推导SNR分布的精确表达式；并提出基于REM的机会式随机查询与网格化构建等定位策略；通过仿真验证解析结果。

Result: 给出最大SNR分布与均值的解析/近似表达式，经仿真验证具有高精度；揭示莱斯K因子、空间相关性、波导长度与载频等关键参数的影响。

Conclusion: 研究拓展了对PASS超越理想LoS条件的理解，并建立了散射环境下性能评估与天线定位的一般性分析框架。

Abstract: Pinching-antenna systems (PASSs) are an emerging flexible antenna technology that enables the creation of line-of-sight (LoS) links by repositioning a radiating element along a dielectric waveguide (WG). Most existing studies of PASSs assume a purely LoS environment, despite the fact that many practical wireless environments exhibit scattering and spatially correlated shadow fading. In this paper, we present the first statistical analysis of PASS performance under Ricean fading with spatially correlated large-scale fading. Focusing on a fundamental single-user uplink PASS, we characterize the distribution and mean of the maximum achievable signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). For the classical exponentially correlated shadow fading scenario, we express the channel power process in terms of Brownian motion and derive highly accurate approximations for the maximum SNR distribution and mean. For a general class of smoothly correlated shadow fading processes, we derive an accurate expression for the SNR distribution by modeling the process in terms of the fade sojourn duration. To address the challenges of antenna position selection in fading environments, we propose radio environment map (REM)-based positioning strategies, including opportunistic random-look and grid-based constructions. Analytical results are validated by simulation, and the impacts of key system parameters, such as the Ricean $K$-factor, spatial correlation, WG length, and carrier frequency are investigated. The results provide insights into PASS operation beyond idealized LoS conditions and establish a general analytical framework for performance evaluation and antenna positioning in scattered environments.

</details>


### [869] [Sparse Target Parameter and Channel Estimation in MIMO-OOFDM-Aided Visible Light Integrated Sensing and Communication Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35170)
*Shubham Saxena,Garudadri Mythreya,Suraj Srivastava,Washim Uddin Mondal,Aditya K. Jagannatham*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该论文为单站MIMO DCO-OFDM可见光通感一体化系统建立统一框架，同时处理参数估计（PE）与信道估计（CE），提出1D-OffGBL与2D-OffGBL两种离格贝叶斯学习算法并推导闭式BCRB，仿真表明其NMSE优于传统稀疏恢复方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在MIMO DCO-OFDM可见光通感一体化（VL-ISAC）系统中，需要共享光波形同时支撑感知与下行通信，并需应对目标反射、杂波、多普勒效应与通信信道耦合的问题；传统稀疏恢复方法存在离格基失配，难以兼顾高精度与低复杂度。

Method: 构建统一的PE与CE框架，建立一维与二维的on-grid/off-grid稀疏表示；提出1D-OffGBL，采用联合时延-多普勒（DD）字典利用耦合DD信息提升精度；提出2D-OffGBL，按序估计多普勒与时延以规避高维联合字典、降低复杂度；两者均迭代精化连续值时延与多普勒以缓解离格基失配；进一步给出1D/2D稀疏信道表示与相应CE流程，并据此完成距离与速度估计；推导PE、CE、距离、速度估计的闭式贝叶斯Cramér-Rao下界（BCRB）。

Result: 仿真显示所提算法在NMSE上优于传统稀疏恢复方案；1D-OffGBL估计精度最高，2D-OffGBL在性能与复杂度之间取得良好折衷。

Conclusion: 所提离格贝叶斯学习框架可有效缓解离格基失配，为实际MIMO DCO-OFDM VL-ISAC系统提供高精度与性能-复杂度可选的参数/信道估计方案，并以闭式BCRB给出性能基准。

Abstract: A unified framework is developed for parameter estimation (PE) and channel estimation (CE) in monostatic multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) direct-current-biased optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (DCO-OFDM)-aided visible light integrated sensing and communication (VL-ISAC) systems. A common optical waveform supports sensing and downlink communication while accounting for target reflections, clutter, Doppler effects, and the communication channel. For sensing PE, one-dimensional (1D) and two-dimensional (2D) on-grid and off-grid sparse representations are formulated. The proposed 1D off-grid Bayesian learning (1D-OffGBL) algorithm employs a joint delay-Doppler (DD) dictionary to exploit coupled DD information and achieve high estimation accuracy. In contrast, the proposed 2D off-grid Bayesian learning (2D-OffGBL) algorithm sequentially estimates the Doppler and delay parameters, thereby avoiding a high-dimensional joint dictionary and reducing computational complexity. Both algorithms iteratively refine the continuous-valued delay and Doppler parameters to mitigate off-grid basis mismatch. Furthermore, 1D and 2D sparse channel representations and corresponding CE procedures are developed, followed by range and velocity estimation for both sensing models. Closed-form Bayesian Cramer-Rao bounds (BCRBs) are derived for PE, CE, range, and velocity estimation. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithms outperform conventional sparse recovery schemes in terms of normalized mean-squared error (NMSE). In particular, 1D-OffGBL achieves the highest estimation accuracy, whereas 2D-OffGBL provides a favourable performance-complexity trade-off for practical MIMO DCO-OFDM VL-ISAC systems.

</details>


### [870] [Synchronization-Oriented Multi-Radius BMOCZ for Non-Coherent Short-Packet Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35177)
*Hamoud Abdelbasset Hamidouche,Riadh Ouzane,Salah Eddine Zegrar,Huseyin Arslan*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出多半径二进制MOCZ（MR-BMOCZ）方案，通过新的根放置策略增强自相关域多样性，改善定时与频率同步性能并降低PAPR，同时保持BER/BLER相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOCZ是未来无线系统中盲短包通信的有力候选，但其性能对定时与频率同步误差敏感，需在保持非相干通信优势的前提下提升同步鲁棒性。

Method: 引入多半径根放置策略（multi-radius root placement），在自相关域构造更强结构与多样性；以多半径构造把信号能量分散到更多半径上以降低PAPR；利用所得波形的独特频谱结构进行CFO估计与校正。

Result: 自相关特性增强带来更优的TO估计；PAPR降低；CFO估计的NMSE优于基于BMOCZ的方案；在AWGN与衰落信道下同步性能更优，且BER与BLER性能相当。

Conclusion: MR-BMOCZ可视为BMOCZ面向同步的扩展方案，适用于鲁棒的非相干短包通信。

Abstract: Modulation on conjugate-reciprocal zeros (MOCZ) is a promising candidate for blind short-packet communication (SPC) in future wireless systems; however, its performance is sensitive to timing and frequency synchronization errors. In this paper, we propose a novel scheme named multi-radius binary MOCZ (MR-BMOCZ). This method introduces a new root placement strategy that enhances diversity in the autocorrelation domain. The resulting structure enhances the autocorrelation properties of the transmitted waveform, leading to improved timing offset (TO) estimation. Moreover, the multi-radius construction distributes the signal energy over a larger set of radii, hence reducing the peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR). The resulting waveform also exhibits a distinctive spectral structure that is exploited for carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimation and correction, yielding lower normalized mean square error (NMSE) compared with BMOCZ-based schemes. Simulation results over additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) and fading channels demonstrate that MR-BMOCZ achieves superior synchronization performance while maintaining comparable bit error rate (BER) and block error rate (BLER) performance. Consequently, the proposed scheme offers a synchronization oriented extension of BMOCZ for robust non-coherent SPC.

</details>


### [871] [Joint Antenna Rotation and Polarforming for Satellite Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35397)
*Xingxiang Peng,Qingqing Wu,Jingfeng Chen,Wei Feng,Wen Chen,Zan Li*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究LEO卫星上行通信中"天线旋转+极化赋形"的联合设计，以加权和速率最大化为目标，采用WMMSE交替优化框架求解，性能优于基准方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO卫星需同时服务角度上分离的多个地面终端簇：天线旋转可在簇间重新分配方向增益，而极化赋形可增强簇内空间相关信道的可分离性，两者作用互补，需联合优化以提升系统和速率。

Method: 构建联合优化可旋转天线(RA)朝向轨迹、逐阵元极化赋形器与数字接收滤波器的加权和速率最大化问题，受指向范围与相邻时隙转动(slew)约束。采用基于WMMSE的交替优化算法：单阵元最优极化赋形器具半闭式解；通过精确视轴参数化将RA轨迹子问题转化为凸可行集，进而采用Armijo梯度更新。

Result: 仿真表明所提联合设计优于各基准方案，并验证了天线旋转负责方向增益分配、极化赋形负责提升信道可分离性的互补作用。

Conclusion: 天线旋转与极化赋形的联合优化可有效提升多簇LEO上行链路的加权和速率，二者机制互补，WMMSE交替算法为该非凸问题提供了可行且有效的求解途径。

Abstract: This paper investigates joint antenna rotation and polarforming for low-Earth-orbit (LEO) communications, where a satellite equipped with rotatable dual-polarized antenna elements receives uplink signals from ground terminals (GTs) distributed across multiple clusters. In particular, antenna rotation redistributes directional gains across angularly separated clusters, while polarforming improves the separability of spatially correlated GT channels within each cluster. We formulate a weighted sum-rate maximization problem that jointly optimizes rotatable antenna (RA) orientation trajectories, element-wise polarformers, and digital receive filters under steering-range and inter-epoch slew constraints. To solve the resulting nonconvex problem, we develop a weighted minimum mean-square error (WMMSE)-based alternating algorithm, in which the optimal polarformer for each element is derived in semi-closed form, while an exact boresight parameterization yields convex feasible sets for RA-trajectory optimization, enabling Armijo-based gradient updates. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed joint design outperforms benchmark schemes and reveal the complementary roles of antenna rotation in directional-gain allocation and polarforming in improving channel separability.

</details>


### [872] [Movable Antenna Enabled Anti-Jamming: From Local Optimality Guaranteed Design to a Unified Antenna Position Optimization Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35438)
*Lebin Chen,Ming-Min Zhao,Lipeng Zhu,Zhenyu Xiao,Min-Jian Zhao,Rui Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究可移动天线（MA）赋能的抗干扰通信，通过联合优化天线位置向量（APV）与接收波束成形器最大化输出SINR；针对单干扰机单LoS的典型场景提出低复杂度DPGD算法并证明其几乎必然收敛到局部极小点，针对多径/多干扰的一般场景提出SAPG算法，二者复杂度均随接收MA数线性增长，且框架兼容MVDR与ZF接收。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统固定阵列几何限制了可用的空间自由度，使接收机抗干扰性能严重受制于强干扰；而可移动天线可通过天线位置优化提供额外空间自由度，因此有必要研究MA赋能的抗干扰接收设计。

Method: 将抗干扰问题建模为APV与接收波束成形器的联合优化以最大化输出SINR。典型场景（单干扰机、合法链路单LoS径）下，将问题转化为导向相干性最小化，提出阻尼投影梯度下降（DPGD）算法，复杂度随接收MA数线性增长，并建立主动严格鞍点景观、证明其几乎必然收敛至局部极小点而非仅KKT点。一般场景（多径和/或多干扰）下，导出等价的岭最小二乘形式，提出低复杂度软激活投影梯度（SAPG）算法，同样线性复杂度。框架可推广至MVDR与ZF接收。

Result: 理论证明了DPGD的几乎必然局部极小收敛性；SAPG以线性复杂度求解一般场景。数值结果表明所提算法在抗干扰性能与计算效率上均有显著提升。

Conclusion: MA通过位置优化可有效提升空间自由度与抗干扰能力；所提DPGD与SAPG算法兼具低复杂度与可靠收敛性，且统一框架适用于MVDR与ZF接收，为MA赋能的抗干扰接收机设计提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Anti-jamming capability is of paramount importance in modern wireless communications, yet conventional receivers are severely constrained by their fixed array geometries, which limit the available spatial degrees of freedom and leave performance highly susceptible to strong interference. By contrast, movable antennas (MAs) provide additional spatial degrees of freedom through antenna-position optimization. This paper investigates MA-enabled anti-jamming by jointly optimizing the antenna-position vector (APV) and receive beamformer to maximize the output signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR). For the canonical setting with a single jammer and a single line-of-sight (LoS) propagation path on the legitimate link, we develop a damped projected-gradient descent (DPGD) algorithm with low computational complexity, which scales linearly with the number of receive MAs. We establish a generic active strict-saddle landscape for the resulting steering-coherence minimization problem and prove that DPGD converges almost surely to a local minimizer rather than merely to a Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) point. For the general setting with multiple channel paths on the legitimate link and/or multiple jammers, we derive an equivalent ridge least-squares formulation and develop a low-complexity soft-active projected-gradient (SAPG) algorithm, which also scales linearly with the number of receive MAs. We further show that the proposed antenna position optimization framework applies to both minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) and zero-forcing (ZF) reception. Numerical results validate the proposed algorithms, demonstrating substantial gains in both anti-jamming performance and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [873] [XL MIMO Extreme Learning Machines: Wave-Domain Inference with Stacked Metasurfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35469)
*Kyriakos Stylianopoulos,Mattia Fabiani,Davide Dardari,George C. Alexandropoulos*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出在接收端配置堆叠智能超表面(SIM)的XL-MIMO系统，使其作为纯空口两层神经网络运行：第一层为不可控的无线衰落变换（前端MS层提供非线性激活），第二层由SIM线性合并实现；基于极限学习机(ELM)框架证明其为通用逼近器，并给出最优线性SIM合并的闭式解，实现低复杂度波域推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向目标导向通信需在无线传输数据上直接完成ML推理，将计算分摊到发射端、接收端与信道。但传统MS参数化系统受信道衰落与近线性MS模型限制，通常只能承载单层网络计算，波域卸载能力有限。

Method: 接收端采用XL-MIMO+SIM加单天线射频链架构；将无线衰落视为第一层（不可控）网络、SIM视为第二层（可控）线性层，仅前端MS层需非线性响应以充当激活函数；借助ELM框架进行训练，推导最优线性SIM合并的闭式解，支持快速训练与部分信号可观测性。

Result: 理论上证明该XL-MIMO-ELM架构为通用逼近器；多数据集数值实验显示分类精度与理想化数字模型相当。

Conclusion: SIM辅助的XL-MIMO可作为纯空口两层神经网络，验证了低复杂度波域神经计算的可行性，为波域计算卸载提供新范式。

Abstract: The recently envisioned goal-oriented communications paradigm requires machine learning inference to be performed directly on wirelessly transferred data, by splitting neural network computations between the transmitter, the Receiver (RX), and the wireless channel. Such approaches aim to offload large portions of the computation onto the channel itself, which is often controlled by reconfigurable MetaSurfaces (MSs). Typical MS-parametrized systems, however, enable only limited computation offloading in the wave domain, usually corresponding to a single neural network layer, due to adverse channel fading effects and the almost linear operation of the channel and conventional MS models. In this paper, we demonstrate that an eXtremely Large (XL) Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) system equipped with Stacked Intelligent MSs (SIM) at the RX side, together with a single antenna and its accompanying radio-frequency chain, may act as a two-layer neural network operating exclusively over the air. The first (uncontrollable) network layer corresponds to the transformations offered by wireless fading, while the second (controllable) layer is implemented via SIM operations. In particular, only the first, front-end MS layer needs to exhibit nonlinear response to serve as an activation function. Leveraging the Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) framework, the proposed XL MIMO system architecture is shown to be a universal approximator, and the optimal linear-SIM-based combining is derived in closed form, allowing for fast training even and partial signal observability. Numerical evaluations across diverse datasets showcase that the proposed XL-MIMO-ELM framework achieves classification accuracy comparable to idealized digital models, thereby, proving the viability of low complexity, wave-domain neural computations.

</details>


### [874] [Focusing Efficiency for Large Intelligent Surfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35775)
*Jiawang Li,Alireza Saberkari,Buon Kiong Lau,Mats Gustafsson*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对单用户场景下基于大智能表面（LIS）的无线输能（WPT），在总功率约束下推导了任意接收天线时的LIS最优电流分布，从理论上刻画了最大可达聚焦效率，并用FEKO全波仿真验证了理论结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LIS可实现大规模空间聚焦以提升输能效率，但接收端特性（辐射方向图、朝向）与传播几何对聚焦效率的影响尚缺乏理论刻画，需要明确最大可达效率的解析边界。

Method: 在总功率约束下，对任意接收天线求解使传输效率最大的LIS电流分布，得到最优聚焦效率的理论表达式；分析接收辐射方向图、天线朝向与传输距离的影响；并用全波FEKO仿真进行验证。

Result: 效率显著受接收辐射方向图、天线朝向与传输距离影响；在特定朝向下不同实用天线类型差异明显，而经方向平均后其平均聚焦效率趋于接近；FEKO全波仿真与理论预测吻合良好。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了接收端特性与传播几何对LIS辅助WPT的影响机理，为高效单用户输能设计提供了理论依据。

Abstract: This paper studies wireless power transmission (WPT) with large intelligent surfaces (LISs) in a single-user scenario, with emphasis on power-transfer efficiency. The optimal current distribution on the LIS is derived under a total-power constraint for an arbitrary receiving antenna, providing a theoretical characterization of the maximum achievable focusing efficiency. The analysis shows that the efficiency is strongly affected by the receiving radiation pattern, antenna orientation, and transmission distance. Clear performance differences are observed among practical antenna types for specific orientations, whereas directional averaging makes their average focusing efficiencies much closer. The theoretical findings are further validated by full-wave FEKO simulations, showing good agreement with the predictions of the proposed formulation. These results provide insight into the impact of receiver characteristics and propagation geometry on LIS-enabled WPT and offer a theoretical basis for efficient single-user power-transfer design.

</details>


### [875] [Bodyseismography (BSG): Theoretical Foundation and Numerical Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35844)
*WenZhan Song,Yuanyuan Zhang,Yuyan Wu,Sahas Biddappa,Yida Zhang,Jiayu Chen,Zixuan Zeng,Yixuan Li,Jiahui Li,Fei Dou,Zhenlin An,Hae Young Noh*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出"源-传输-测量"框架，将心肌收缩与血管回弹耦合到三轴体震图（BSG）观测，建立目标可观测性判据并用数值建模与27名受试者数据验证方向性振动特征与血流动力学指标的联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体震图可无接触记录经身体与支撑床传递的心血管振动，但要将振动与血流动力学特征关联，必须把心脏激励源与身体/床传输效应分离开，此前缺乏相应的理论框架与物理解释。

Method: 构建源-传输-测量理论框架：把心肌收缩与血管回弹作为方向性激励源，导出观测雅可比与目标雅可比，将每搏量、心输出量与血压同观测量关联；建立局部一阶目标可观测性判据，分析在给定源与传输不确定性下增加传感轴如何降低模糊性。数值上耦合四腔心脏力学、心-体激励与经标定的身体-床算子，采用多层有限元模型并做频率校正，在27名受试者上做匹配窗波形重构，并进行受控每搏量扰动实验。

Result: 多层有限元模型配合标定频率校正，垂直通道波形重构的中位Pearson相关系数为0.865，平面和通道为0.682；受控每搏量扰动显示传输会重塑特征敏感性，在27个受试者专属传递模型中有8个出现垂直特征关联方向反转。

Conclusion: 心血管激励源与机械传播共同决定三轴BSG的形态，该框架为将方向性振动特征与血流动力学变化相关联提供了物理基础。

Abstract: Bodyseismography (BSG) records cardiovascular vibrations transmitted through the body and a supporting bed, enabling contactless assessment of cardiac mechanics. Relating these vibrations to hemodynamic features requires separating cardiac excitation from the effects of body and bed transmission. We develop a source-transmission-measurement framework that couples myocardial contraction and vascular recoil to directional BSG observations. The theory connects stroke volume, cardiac output, and blood pressure to observation and target Jacobians, establishes a local first-order target-observability criterion, and characterizes how additional sensing axes reduce ambiguities under specified source and transmission uncertainties. Numerical modeling combines four-chamber cardiac mechanics, cardiac-to-body excitation, and calibrated body-bed operators. Across 27 participants, a multilayer finite-element model with calibrated frequency correction achieves median Pearson correlation coefficients of 0.865 for the vertical channel and 0.682 for the planar-sum channel in matched-window waveform reconstruction. Controlled stroke-volume perturbations show that transmission reshapes feature sensitivity, including a reversal of the vertical feature association in 8 of 27 participant-specific transfer models. These analytical and numerical studies explain how cardiovascular sources and mechanical propagation jointly shape triaxial BSG and provide a physical basis for relating directional vibration features to hemodynamic changes.

</details>
